  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "select_test">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT 'TEST IS DONE' AS RESULT_COLUMN
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,case when B.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Factory' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.LINE_ID is null then 'Line' else '' end as msg3
                ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg99
          FROM   BUF_EQUIPMENT_M A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) B
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
            FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID
            FROM   SCM_LINE_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) D
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
          	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
					FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE	1=1
					AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
					AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
			) R
			ON		1=1
			AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
			AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
			AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
			AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
			AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
			AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>



    </sql>
  </simple-sqls>

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

         INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
        ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID

        ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
        ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE, CATEGORY_ID
        ,PLAN_DATE
        ,CELL_OUT_QTY
        ,OUT_QTY
        ,DATE_SEQ
        ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
      )
      VALUES (
         UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@INSTANCE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_PLAN_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LOCATION))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@MARKET)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TOP_ITEM_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_TYPE)), 'PLAN'
        ,CONVERT(DATE, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE)))

		<update-batch id = "merge_ExcelImport">
			<insert-sql>
	
      
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
      	MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R AS A
      	USING ( SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, BB.FP_PLAN_ID
                     , DD.COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
                     , BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.ITEM_ID, BB.OPERATION_ID
                     , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                     , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE, BB.CELL_OUT_QTY, BB.OUT_QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON  BB.FACTORY_ID     = DD.FACTORY_ID
                AND DD.COMPANY_ID     = CC.COMPANY_ID
								AND DD.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
                WHERE  BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET
      		       IN_QTY  = CEILING(FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                                  / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
      		     , CELL_IN_QTY  = CEILING(B.OUT_QTY / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , CELL_OUT_QTY = B.OUT_QTY
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.OUT_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,IN_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,CELL_IN_QTY
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                      / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
    			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
    			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
    			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
    			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
    			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
    			                                ) EEE
    			                                ON     1=1
    			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1))
              ,CEILING(B.OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
		                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
		                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
		                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
		                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
		                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
		                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
		                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
		                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
		                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
		                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
		                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
		                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
		                                ) EEE
		                                ON     1=1
		                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
		                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
		                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
		                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
		                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
		                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
		                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
		                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,B.OUT_QTY
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.OUT_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,DD.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID
              ,'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
              ,A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
              ,A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE
              ,A.PLAN_DATE
              ,A.OUT_QTY AS CELL_OUT_QTY -- cell value
              ,FLOOR(A.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(A.PLANT_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE),1) ) AS OUT_QTY
              ,A.DATE_SEQ
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON    A.FACTORY_ID   = DD.FACTORY_ID
        AND	  DD.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        WHERE JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      	;
      	
      END;
    
      ]]>

<SQLS id="BigFilter">
	  <simple-sqls>

      <sql id="list_line_dm">

        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
			Declare @AuthTypePara varchar(100) = 'D';
			IF(@GROUP_ID = 'JV Planner') SET @AuthTypePara = 'J';
				
			DEClARE @TeambyDivision_Lang NVARCHAR(200) = '';
			

			SELECT @TeambyDivision_Lang = ISNULL(Language, 'KO')
			FROM [dbo].[TB_FX_User]
			WHERE UserID = @USER_ID;
				  

			-- 'MyDivision' 
			BEGIN
				SELECT   
					DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID + ' ' + MIN([DIVISION_NAME]) AS NAME 
				FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_DIVISION] A WITH(NOLOCK)  
				WHERE   
					A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
					AND DIVISION_ID IN 
					(SELECT CODE FROM [dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE GroupID = @GROUP_ID AND UserID = @USER_ID AND AuthType = CASE WHEN GroupID = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END)  
					AND VALID_YN = 'Y'  
					GROUP BY 
						DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE1
					ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE1;
			END
 
			-- 'TeambyDivision'
			--[E20260211-001049]_TEAM을 사용하는 방식이 40사업부 방식으로 모두 변경되었기에, 40사업부 방식만 남기고 나머지 주석(START)
			--40 사업부 외의 방식은 모두 주석처리, 기존 40사업부 방식은 모두 사용하도록 수정
			BEGIN
			--	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,
			--		B.DEPT_ID       AS CODE
			--		, CASE @TeambyDivision_Lang WHEN 'EN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_EN
			--									WHEN 'CN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_CN
			--									ELSE B.DEPT_NAME_KO
			--									END
			--		AS NAME
			--	FROM  [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE]          A WITH(NOLOCK) 
			--		, [dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B WITH(NOLOCK) 
			--	WHERE  A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
			--	AND    A.DEPT_ID  = B.DEPT_ID  
			--	AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
			--			FROM   [dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
			--			WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
			--			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
			--			AND    AuthType = 'D')
			--	UNION ALL
				select distinct a.division_id AS DIVISION_ID, c.dept_id AS CODE 
					, CASE @TeambyDivision_Lang WHEN 'EN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_EN
								WHEN 'CN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_CN
								ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO
								END AS NAME
					from [dbo].[scm_mst_site_item] a  WITH(NOLOCK)
						,[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] b  WITH(NOLOCK)
						,[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] c  WITH(NOLOCK)
					where 
					b.user_id = (SELECT top 1 token FROM dbo.String_Split(a.owner,',') )
					and b.dept_id = c.dept_id
				-- 기존 40사업부 방식은 모두 사용하도록 수정 (START)
				-- 	and a.division_id = '40'
					AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT CODE 
											  FROM   [dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
											  WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
											  AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											  AND    AuthType = 'D')
				-- 기존 40사업부 방식은 모두 사용하도록 수정(START)
				--[E20260211-001049]_TEAM을 사용하는 방식이 40사업부 방식으로 모두 변경되었기에, 40사업부 방식만 남기고 나머지 주석(END)
					order by DIVISION_ID;
			END


			-- 'EndCustomerByDivision'
			BEGIN
			-- 'EndCustomerByDivision40'

 				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE 
					, ISNULL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A  WITH(NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN [dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.OWNER = B.USER_ID
					INNER JOIN [dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C  WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
					LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WITH(NOLOCK) 
						ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE 
				B.USER_ID = (SELECT TOP 1 TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(A.OWNER,',') )  -- 20180816
				AND B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
				AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				UNION
				SELECT SEGMENT1, '', SEGMENT2 AS CODE , SEGMENT3 AS NAME
				FROM  [dbo].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
				AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
				AND VALID_YN = 'Y'	
				AND SEGMENT1 = '40' 

				UNION ALL

			-- 'EndCustomerByDivisionDept'
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPT_ID, 
						A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE 
						, ISNULL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
				FROM   [dbo].SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WITH(NOLOCK) 
					ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
									FROM   [dbo].TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GROUPID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
											AND    USERID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AUTHTYPE = 'D')
				AND    END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
				ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID

			END		


			--BizType
			BEGIN
			-- 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'			
				SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_ID
					, L.SEGMENT1  AS CODE
					, L.SEGMENT2  AS NAME
				FROM   [dbo].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] L WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'
				--ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_SEQ
				
				UNION ALL

			-- 'BizTypebyDivision'			
				SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, 
					 BIZ_TYPE       AS CODE 
				   , BIZ_TYPE_NAME  AS NAME
				  FROM   [DBO].[SCM_MST_PROJECT]  WITH(NOLOCK)
				  WHERE   BIZ_TYPE_NAME != ''
			END		

				
			-- 'SiteByEndCustomer'				
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, '' AS DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER,
						SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
						, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [DBO].[SCM_MST_SITE] A WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
											FROM   [DBO].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	

			UNION ALL

			--	'SiteByEndCustomer40'	
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE,
						A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
						, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [DBO].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					LEFT JOIN [DBO].[SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM] AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
					ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
					LEFT JOIN (
								SELECT DISTINCT A.USER_ID, A.DEPT_ID 
								FROM [DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] A WITH(NOLOCK) , [DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK) 
								WHERE A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
							) C ON B.OWNER = C.USER_ID
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
											FROM   [DBO].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
			END

			
			--'FromSiteByDivision'
			BEGIN

				SELECT	A.DIVISION_ID
					,	SCM_SITE_ID        AS CODE
					,	SCM_SITE_ID		   AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
				AND    A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE
				FROM   [dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    				 WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    		 AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)

			END		


			--PlantSiteByEndCustomer			
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER,
					   SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
					 , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
										 FROM   [dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
										 WHERE  GroupID LIKE @GROUP_ID + '%'
						    			 AND    UserID  LIKE @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = 'D')  
			END


			-- EdiSender
			BEGIN
				SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] (NOLOCK)
				WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EDI_SENDER_CODE'
					AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
					AND SEGMENT1 = '81'
				ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ	
			END


			--ScmSitebyEndCustomer40
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT ST.DIVISION_ID, '' AS END_CUSTOMER,
					ST.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS ST WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    ST.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND    ST.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'		
				AND    ST.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
										 FROM   [dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    				 WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    		 AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = 'D')
				ORDER BY DIVISION_ID
			END




      ]]>
        </text>

        <parameters>
          <parameter replace-what="GROUP_ID" name="GROUP_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
          <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        </parameters>
      </sql>

    </simple-sqls>
</SQLS>

<SQLS id="FP01883_Instance_Authority">
<simple-sqls>
 
 <sql id="get_instance_authority">
   <text>
    <![CDATA[
      WITH WITH_ROLE_FACTORY AS (
          SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, UPPER_ROLE_ID, ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER, ROLE_DESCR, APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG,
              	 INSERT_ID, INSERT_DTTM, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_DTTM, 
              	 1 AS LEVEL,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), REPLICATE('0',(3-LEN(CAST(ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)))) + CAST(ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)) AS SORT
          FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE T WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE UPPER_ROLE_ID IS NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT C.ROLE_ID, C.ROLE_NAME, C.UPPER_ROLE_ID, C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER, C.ROLE_DESCR, C.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG,
              	 C.INSERT_ID, C.INSERT_DTTM, C.UPDATE_ID, C.UPDATE_DTTM, 
              	 LEVEL+1,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), RTRIM(P.SORT) + REPLICATE('0',(3-LEN(CAST(C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)))) + CAST(C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)) AS SORT
          FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE C WITH(NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN WITH_ROLE_FACTORY P ON C.UPPER_ROLE_ID = P.ROLE_ID
      )
      SELECT A.ROLE_ID
           , A.ROLE_NAME
           , A.UPPER_ROLE_ID
           , ( SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE B.ROLE_ID=A.UPPER_ROLE_ID) AS UPPER_ROLE_NAME
           , A.ROLE_DESCR
           , A.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER
           , A.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG
           , A.INSERT_ID
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),A.INSERT_DTTM,112) INSERT_DTTM
           , A.UPDATE_ID
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),A.UPDATE_DTTM,112) UPDATE_DTTM
           , LEVEL AS LVL
           , CASE LEVEL WHEN '3' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END IMG
           , '' AS _STATUS
      FROM   WITH_ROLE_FACTORY A
      ORDER BY SORT
    ]]>
   </text>
   <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      <parameter replace-what="PLANT_ID" name="PLANT_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      <parameter replace-what="FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      <parameter replace-what="OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
   </parameters>
 </sql>

 <sql id="find_InstanceInfo_admin">
   <text>
    <![CDATA[
      SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A.INSTANCE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ) AS NUM, A.ROLE_ID,
      	     A.INSTANCE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID,
      	     dbo.FN_GETNAME_FACTORY_ID(A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID) AS FACTORY_NAME,
      	     (CASE A.USE_AT_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN 'True' WHEN 'True' THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END) AS USE_AT_FLAG,
      	     A.INSERT_ID, CONVERT(varchar(max), A.INSERT_DTTM, 112) AS INSERT_DTTM,
      	     A.UPDATE_ID, CONVERT(varchar(max), A.UPDATE_DTTM, 112) AS UPDATE_DTTM
      FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_RELATE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.ROLE_ID = @ROLE_ID
      ORDER BY A.INSTANCE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
    ]]>
   </text>
   <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what="ROLE_ID" name="ROLE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
   </parameters>
 </sql>
 
 <sql id="find_UserList_admin">
   <text>
    <![CDATA[
      SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A.USER_ID ) AS NUM, A.USER_ID AS USER_ID_ALTER, B.USER_NAME,
      	     A.ROLE_ID,
      	     CASE A.USE_AT_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN 'True' WHEN 'True' THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS USE_AT_FLAG,
      	     CASE A.SAVE_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN 'True' WHEN 'True' THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS SAVE_FLAG,
      	     A.INSERT_ID, CONVERT(varchar(max), A.INSERT_DTTM, 112) AS INSERT_DTTM,
      	     A.UPDATE_ID, CONVERT(varchar(max), A.UPDATE_DTTM, 112) AS UPDATE_DTTM
      FROM   TH_UIS_USER_INSTANCE_RELATE A WITH(NOLOCK), TH_UIS_USER_DETAIL B WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
      AND    A.ROLE_ID = @ROLE_ID

 </sql>

 <sql id="find_newInstance">
   <text>
    <![CDATA[
      SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID, B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.FACTORY_NAME
           , (CASE WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                   WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING'   THEN '-' ELSE '-' END) AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
        	 , A.INSTANCE_ID + '_' + B.FACTORY_ID + (CASE WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN '_' + C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                                        WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING'   THEN '' ELSE '' END) AS ROLE_NAME
           , B.SHOP_GROUP_ID
      FROM (
        	SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
        	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
        	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) A
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        	SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID, B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, B.FACTORY_NAME, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
        	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
        	AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) B
      ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        	SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
        	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)

        	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) C
      ON    A.INSTANCE_ID = C.INSTANCE_ID
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   B.COMPANY_ID IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY SITE_ID, INSTANCE_ID, FACTORY_ID, PLAN_GROUP_ID
    ]]>

         --BEGIN

	  SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE

 <sql id="get_instance_authority">
   <text>
         <![CDATA[
         --BEGIN
		    --    BEGIN TRAN


WITH WITH_ROLE_FACTORY AS (
    SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, UPPER_ROLE_ID, ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER, ROLE_DESCR, APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG,
        	INSERT_ID, INSERT_DTTM, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_DTTM, 
        	1 AS LEVEL,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), REPLICATE('0',(3-LEN(CAST(ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)))) + CAST(ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)) AS SORT
    FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE T WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE UPPER_ROLE_ID IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT C.ROLE_ID, C.ROLE_NAME, C.UPPER_ROLE_ID, C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER, C.ROLE_DESCR, C.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG,
        	C.INSERT_ID, C.INSERT_DTTM, C.UPDATE_ID, C.UPDATE_DTTM, 
        	LEVEL+1,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), RTRIM(P.SORT) + REPLICATE('0',(3-LEN(CAST(C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)))) + CAST(C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)) AS SORT
    FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE C WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN WITH_ROLE_FACTORY P ON C.UPPER_ROLE_ID = P.ROLE_ID
)
SELECT A.ROLE_ID
    , A.ROLE_NAME
    , A.UPPER_ROLE_ID
    , ( SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE B.ROLE_ID=A.UPPER_ROLE_ID) AS UPPER_ROLE_NAME
    , A.ROLE_DESCR
    , A.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER
    , A.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG
    , A.INSERT_ID
    , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),A.INSERT_DTTM,112) INSERT_DTTM
    , A.UPDATE_ID
    , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),A.UPDATE_DTTM,112) UPDATE_DTTM
    , LEVEL AS LVL
    , CASE LEVEL WHEN '3' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END IMG
FROM   WITH_ROLE_FACTORY A
ORDER BY SORT		    

   		      --  COMMIT;
		     -- END;
      ]]>   
   </text>

              --AND A@CTRL_INSTANCE_ID -- [AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID]
            ) C
            WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID
      )
				AND ( (@DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR @DIVISION_ID ='') OR A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@DIVISION_ID,',')) )
				AND ( (@PLANT_ID IS NULL OR @PLANT_ID ='') OR A.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(SUBSTRING(@PLANT_ID,1,4),','))   )
				AND ( (@FACTORY_ID IS NULL OR @FACTORY_ID ='') OR A.FACTORY_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@FACTORY_ID,','))   )
				AND ( (@OPERATION_ID IS NULL OR @OPERATION_ID ='') OR A.OPERATION_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@OPERATION_ID,','))   )
				AND ( (@SITE_ID IS NULL OR @SITE_ID ='') OR A.SITE_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@SITE_ID,','))   )
				UNION
				SELECT 
					'-'  AS CODE
					,'-'  AS NAME
					,'-'  AS COMPANY_ID
					,'-' AS DIVISION_ID
					,'-' AS SITE_ID
					,'-' AS PLANT_ID
					,'-' AS FACTORY_ID
					,'-' AS OPERATION_ID
					,'-' AS LINE_ID
					,'-' AS LINE_NAME
				ORDER BY NAME   
   		      --  COMMIT;
		     -- END;
      ]]>   
   </text>
   	      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

 <sql id="get_instance_authority">
   <text>
         <![CDATA[
         --BEGIN
		    --    BEGIN TRAN


WITH WITH_ROLE_FACTORY AS (
    SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, UPPER_ROLE_ID, ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER, ROLE_DESCR, APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG,
        	INSERT_ID, INSERT_DTTM, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_DTTM, 
        	1 AS LEVEL,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), REPLICATE('0',(3-LEN(CAST(ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)))) + CAST(ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)) AS SORT
    FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE T WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE UPPER_ROLE_ID IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT C.ROLE_ID, C.ROLE_NAME, C.UPPER_ROLE_ID, C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER, C.ROLE_DESCR, C.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG,
        	C.INSERT_ID, C.INSERT_DTTM, C.UPDATE_ID, C.UPDATE_DTTM, 
        	LEVEL+1,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), RTRIM(P.SORT) + REPLICATE('0',(3-LEN(CAST(C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)))) + CAST(C.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER AS VARCHAR)) AS SORT
    FROM   TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE C WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN WITH_ROLE_FACTORY P ON C.UPPER_ROLE_ID = P.ROLE_ID
)
SELECT A.ROLE_ID
    , A.ROLE_NAME
    , A.UPPER_ROLE_ID
    , ( SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE B.ROLE_ID=A.UPPER_ROLE_ID) AS UPPER_ROLE_NAME
    , A.ROLE_DESCR
    , A.ROLE_DETAIL_ORDER
    , A.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG
    , A.INSERT_ID
    , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),A.INSERT_DTTM,112) INSERT_DTTM
    , A.UPDATE_ID
    , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),A.UPDATE_DTTM,112) UPDATE_DTTM
    , LEVEL AS LVL
    , CASE LEVEL WHEN '3' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END IMG
FROM   WITH_ROLE_FACTORY A
ORDER BY SORT		    

   		      --  COMMIT;
		     -- END;
      ]]>   
   </text>

    <sql id="find_yieldInfo">    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISNULL(B.YIELD, (CASE WHEN A.YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD END)) AS YIELD
      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
        FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
        AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
      ) B
      on     1=1
      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
      AND    A.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(@PLAN_DATE,1,6)
    
      ]]>

	<sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[
		
		  SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
		       , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
		       , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
		       , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
		       , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
		  FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
		  WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
		  AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
		  GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
		  ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW
		
		]]>
		</text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>

	<sql id = "find_DateMap">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[

		      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
		            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
		            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
		            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
		            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
		            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
		            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
		                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
		            AS _DATE_TXT
		            ,DAY_SEQ
		      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
		      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
		      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

		]]>
		</text>
		
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>

	<sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[

		      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
		           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
		             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
		                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
		           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
		           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
		      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
		      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
		      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
		      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
		      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
		]]>
		</text>
		
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>

	<sql id = "find_BukInfo">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
		]]>
		</text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>
	
</simple-sqls>

</SQLS>

<sql id="find_instance_by_simul">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT3 AS INSTANCE_NAME
            , A.SEGMENT4 AS PLAN_GROUP
            , A.SEGMENT5 AS PLAN_GROUP_NAME
            , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PACK_INSTANCE_ID
            , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS DIVISION
            , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS CELL_INSTANCE_ID
            , B.INSTANCE_NAME AS PACK_INSTANCE_NAME
            , C.INSTANCE_NAME AS CELL_INSTANCE_NAME
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) B
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE1 = B.INSTANCE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) C
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE3 = C.INSTANCE_ID
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_ID_MAPPING'
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      --AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @SITE_ID
      ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER
    

      ]]>
      </text>

    <sql id="list_line2">

<text>
      <![CDATA[


-- SHOP-GROUP_ID

		--SELECT DISTINCT
		--DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,
		--       SHOP_GROUP_ID   AS CODE
		--     , OPERATION_GROUP AS NAME
  --        FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
		--  WHERE 1 = 1
		--  --AND ( (@Param1 IS NULL or @Param1='') OR A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param1,','))  )
		SELECT 
	--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.INSTANCE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS INSTANCE_AUTH,
	ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS LINE_AUTH,
	ISNULL(CASE WHEN LV.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS PLANNER_AUTH,
	--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS OPERATION_AUTH,

	FL.INSTANCE_ID,FL.INSTANCE_NAME,
	FL.COMPANY_ID, FL.COMPANY_NAME,
	FL.LINE_ID, FL.LINE_NAME, 
	FL.DIVISION_ID, FL.DIVISION_NAME,
	FL.SITE_ID, FL.SITE_NAME,
	FL.PLANT_ID, FL.PLANT_NAME,
	FL.FACTORY_ID, FL.FACTORY_NAME,
	FL.OPERATION_ID, FL.OPERATION_NAME,
	FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, 
	FL.MODEL_TYPE, 
	--FL.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,
	AMEND_FLAG,
	AMEND_MAIN_FLAG
, V.CONFIRM_AREA
--, L.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME2
, L.ATTRIBUTE2 AS IS_SAME_PLAN_ID
, L.ATTRIBUTE3 AS USE_WOW_STATUS
, L.SORT_ORDER AS SORT_ORDER
, SHOP_GROUP_ID,OPERATION_GROUP
, FL.ACTIVE_FLAG
,VERSION_YN
FROM
 (

SELECT 
--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS SAVE_FLAG,
SL.LINE_NAME,LK.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME, FL.INSTANCE_ID, 
SL.COMPANY_ID, C.COMPANY_NAME,
SL.DIVISION_ID, D.DIVISION_NAME,
SL.SITE_ID, S.SITE_NAME,
SL.PLANT_ID, P.PLANT_NAME,
SL.FACTORY_ID, F.FACTORY_NAME,
SL.OPERATION_ID, O.OPERATION_NAME,
OV.AMEND_FLAG, OV.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG,
FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID,SSH.OPERATION_GROUP,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG,
SL.LINE_ID, FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, FL.MODEL_TYPE,
ISNULL(VK.VERSION_YN,'N') AS VERSION_YN
--, FL.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG
--FROM FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V FL WITH(NOLOCK) 
--LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M SL  WITH(NOLOCK)
FROM SCM_LINE_M SL WITH(NOLOCK) 
LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V FL  WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND FL.LINE_ID = SL.LINE_ID AND FL.COMPANY_ID = SL.COMPANY_ID ANd FL.SITE_ID = SL.SITE_ID AND FL.PLANT_ID = SL.PLANT_ID AND FL.FACTORY_ID = SL.FACTORY_ID 
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = SL.OPERATION_ID AND FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE = SL.ELECTRODE_TYPE

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE LK WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE='INSTANCE_ID'
AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = LK.SEGMENT1

--VERSION_YN
LEFT OUTER JOIN
				(SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, ATTRIBUTE1 AS VERSION_YN
				FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1=1
				AND    LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ELEC_INSTANCE_OPTION'
				AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
				) VK
				ON 1=1
				AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = VK.INSTANCE_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M  F WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.FACTORY_ID = F.FACTORY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_COMPANY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_DIVISION_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_SITE_M S WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_PLANT_M P WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.SITE_ID = P.SITE_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = P.COMPANY_ID
AND SL.PLANT_ID = P.PLANT_ID
AND SL.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M O WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.SITE_ID = O.SITE_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = O.COMPANY_ID
AND SL.DIVISION_ID = O.DIVISION_ID
AND SL.OPERATION_ID = O.OPERATION_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V OV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.SITE_ID = OV.SITE_ID
AND FL.COMPANY_ID = OV.COMPANY_ID
AND FL.DIVISION_ID = OV.DIVISION_ID
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = OV.OPERATION_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M FV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.INSTANCE_ID = FV.INSTANCE_ID
AND FL.FACTORY_ID = FV.FACTORY_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V SSH WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1 AND FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID = SSH.SHOP_GROUP_ID

--WHERE FV.FACTORY_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP by 
SL.LINE_ID, SL.LINE_NAME,--V.SAVE_FLAG,
FL.INSTANCE_ID, LK.SEGMENT2,
SL.COMPANY_ID, C.COMPANY_NAME,
SL.DIVISION_ID,D.DIVISION_NAME,
SL.SITE_ID,S.SITE_NAME,
SL.PLANT_ID, P.PLANT_NAME,
SL.FACTORY_ID,F.FACTORY_NAME, 
SL.OPERATION_ID, O.OPERATION_NAME,
OV.AMEND_FLAG,OV.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG,
FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID, SSH.OPERATION_GROUP,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG,
FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, FL.MODEL_TYPE,VK.VERSION_YN
) FL

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V V WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND V.USER_ID = @USER_ID  AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = V.INSTANCE_ID AND FL.LINE_ID = V.LINE_ID AND FL.COMPANY_ID = V.COMPANY_ID ANd FL.SITE_ID = V.SITE_ID AND FL.PLANT_ID = V.PLANT_ID AND FL.FACTORY_ID = V.FACTORY_ID 
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = V.OPERATION_ID AND FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE = V.ELECTRODE_TYPE 

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE L WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = L.SEGMENT1

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_USER_LINE_GROUP_M LV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.LINE_ID = LV.LINE_ID
AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
--WHERE FL.LINE_ID = 'EPD01'

ORDER BY DIVISION_NAME,FL.COMPANY_ID, FL.SITE_ID, FL.PLANT_ID, FL.FACTORY_ID, FL.OPERATION_ID,FL.LINE_ID

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>  
</sql>

<sql id="list_line">

<text>

                WHERE  CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN  @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
                AND    A.PLAN_TYPE IN ('RELEASE','MPP','WPP')

UNION ALL SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID ,A.OPERATION_ID,A.LINE_ID,A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                FROM   SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H A WITH(NOLOCK)  
                WHERE  1=1
				AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN  @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
                )A
				INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
 ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID 
                AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID 
                AND    A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID    
                AND    A.ITEM_ID        = B.ITEM_ID  
				AND  ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'') <> ''
                ORDER BY B.NICK_NAME                
 
      ]]>
        </text>

      <sql id="DM_MyDivision">

        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
	SELECT   
		DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID + ' ' + MIN([DIVISION_NAME]) AS NAME 
    FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_DIVISION] A WITH(NOLOCK)  
    WHERE   
	    A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
		AND DIVISION_ID IN 
		(SELECT CODE FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE GroupID = @GROUP_ID AND UserID = @USER_ID AND AuthType = CASE WHEN GroupID = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END)  
		AND VALID_YN = 'Y'  
				GROUP BY 
					DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE1
				ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE1  
 
      ]]>
        </text>

        <parameters>
          <parameter replace-what="GROUP_ID" name="GROUP_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
          <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        </parameters>

      <sql id="list_line_dm">

        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
			Declare @AuthTypePara varchar(100) = 'D';
			IF(@GROUP_ID = 'JV Planner') SET @AuthTypePara = 'J';
				
			DEClARE @TeambyDivision_Lang NVARCHAR(200) = '';
			

			SELECT @TeambyDivision_Lang = ISNULL(Language, 'KO')
			FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_User]
			WHERE UserID = @USER_ID;
				  

			-- 'MyDivision' 
			BEGIN
				SELECT   
					DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID + ' ' + MIN([DIVISION_NAME]) AS NAME 
				FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_DIVISION] A WITH(NOLOCK)  
				WHERE   
					A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
					AND DIVISION_ID IN 
					(SELECT CODE FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE GroupID = @GROUP_ID AND UserID = @USER_ID AND AuthType = CASE WHEN GroupID = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END)  
					AND VALID_YN = 'Y'  
					GROUP BY 
						DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE1
					ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE1;
			END
 
			-- 'TeambyDivision'
			BEGIN

				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,
					B.DEPT_ID       AS CODE
					, CASE @TeambyDivision_Lang WHEN 'EN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_EN
												WHEN 'CN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_CN
												ELSE B.DEPT_NAME_KO
												END
					AS NAME
				FROM  [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE]          A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					, [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
				AND    A.DEPT_ID  = B.DEPT_ID  
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
						FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
						WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
						AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
						AND    AuthType = 'D')

			UNION ALL
				
				select distinct a.division_id AS DIVISION_ID, c.dept_id AS CODE 
					, CASE @TeambyDivision_Lang WHEN 'EN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_EN
								WHEN 'CN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_CN
								ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO
								END AS NAME
					from [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[scm_mst_site_item] a  WITH(NOLOCK)
						,[LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] b  WITH(NOLOCK)
						,[LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] c  WITH(NOLOCK)
					where 
					b.user_id = (SELECT top 1 token FROM dbo.String_Split(a.owner,',') )
					and b.dept_id = c.dept_id
					and a.division_id = '40'
					order by DIVISION_ID;
			END


			-- 'EndCustomerByDivision'
			BEGIN
			-- 'EndCustomerByDivision40'

 				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE 
					, ISNULL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
				FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A  WITH(NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.OWNER = B.USER_ID
					INNER JOIN [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C  WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
					LEFT OUTER JOIN [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WITH(NOLOCK) 
						ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE 
				B.USER_ID = (SELECT TOP 1 TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(A.OWNER,',') )  -- 20180816
				AND B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
				AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				UNION
				SELECT SEGMENT1, '', SEGMENT2 AS CODE , SEGMENT3 AS NAME
				FROM  [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
				AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
				AND VALID_YN = 'Y'	
				AND SEGMENT1 = '40' 

				UNION ALL

			-- 'EndCustomerByDivisionDept'
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPT_ID, 
						A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE 
						, ISNULL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
				FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WITH(NOLOCK) 
					ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
									FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GROUPID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
											AND    USERID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AUTHTYPE = 'D')
				AND    END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
				ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID

			END		


			--BizType
			BEGIN
			-- 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'			
				SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_ID
					, L.SEGMENT1  AS CODE
					, L.SEGMENT2  AS NAME
				FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] L WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'
				--ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_SEQ
				
				UNION ALL

			-- 'BizTypebyDivision'			
				SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, 
					 BIZ_TYPE       AS CODE 
				   , BIZ_TYPE_NAME  AS NAME
				  FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[SCM_MST_PROJECT]  WITH(NOLOCK)
				  WHERE   BIZ_TYPE_NAME != ''
			END		

				
			-- 'SiteByEndCustomer'				
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, '' AS DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER,
						SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
						, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[SCM_MST_SITE] A WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
											FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	

			UNION ALL

			--	'SiteByEndCustomer40'	
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE,
						A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
						, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					LEFT JOIN [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM] AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
					ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
					LEFT JOIN (
								SELECT DISTINCT A.USER_ID, A.DEPT_ID 
								FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] A WITH(NOLOCK) , [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK) 
								WHERE A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
							) C ON B.OWNER = C.USER_ID
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
											FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[DBO].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
			END

			
			--'FromSiteByDivision'
			BEGIN

				SELECT	A.DIVISION_ID
					,	SCM_SITE_ID        AS CODE
					,	SCM_SITE_ID		   AS NAME
				FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
				AND    A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE
				FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    				 WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    		 AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)

			END		


			--PlantSiteByEndCustomer			
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER,
					   SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
					 , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
										 FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
										 WHERE  GroupID LIKE @GROUP_ID + '%'
						    			 AND    UserID  LIKE @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = 'D')  
			END


			-- EdiSender
			BEGIN
				SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
				FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] (NOLOCK)
				WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EDI_SENDER_CODE'
					AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
					AND SEGMENT1 = '81'
				ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ	
			END


			--ScmSitebyEndCustomer40
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT ST.DIVISION_ID, '' AS END_CUSTOMER,
					ST.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
				FROM [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS ST WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    ST.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND    ST.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'		
				AND    ST.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
										 FROM   [LGCE_SCMDEV].[dbo].[TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    				 WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    		 AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = 'D')
				ORDER BY DIVISION_ID
			END




      ]]>
        </text>

        <parameters>
          <parameter replace-what="GROUP_ID" name="GROUP_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
          <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        </parameters>
      </sql>

<sql id="find_instance_by_simul">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT3 AS INSTANCE_NAME
            , A.SEGMENT4 AS PLAN_GROUP
            , A.SEGMENT5 AS PLAN_GROUP_NAME
            , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PACK_INSTANCE_ID
            , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS DIVISION
            , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS CELL_INSTANCE_ID
            , B.INSTANCE_NAME AS PACK_INSTANCE_NAME
            , C.INSTANCE_NAME AS CELL_INSTANCE_NAME
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) B
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE1 = B.INSTANCE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) C
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE3 = C.INSTANCE_ID
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_ID_MAPPING'
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      --AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @SITE_ID
      ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>

	  <sql id="OperationByLine">
        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID,
					A.OPERATION_ID    AS CODE
					, (A.OPERATION_ID + ' ' + B.OPERATION_NAME)  AS NAME, A.OPERATION_ID
		FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V A  WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OPERATION_ID , OPERATION_NAME
				FROM SCM_OPERATION_M B  WITH(NOLOCK)
			) B
		ON  A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
--WHERE 1=1
--AND ( (@Param1 IS NULL or @Param1='') OR A.DIVISION_ID			IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param1,',')))
--AND ( (@Param2 IS NULL or @Param2='') OR A.PLANT_ID			IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param2,',')))
--AND ( (@Param3 IS NULL or @Param3='') OR A.FACTORY_ID			IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param3,',')))
--AND ( (@Param4 IS NULL or @Param4='') OR A.LINE_ID				IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param4,',')))
--AND ( (@Param5 IS NULL or @Param5='') OR A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID	IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param5,',')))
			ORDER BY A.OPERATION_ID
 
      ]]>
        </text>

          <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        </parameters>

	  <sql id="LineByShop"><!-- Using SCP DB -->
        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
		SELECT DISTINCT
		A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID,A.LINE_ID, A.LINE_NAME,
			   A.LINE_ID						AS CODE
			 , A.LINE_ID  +' ' +  A.LINE_NAME	AS NAME
		  FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A WITH(NOLOCK)
		 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
							 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN B WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_EXCEPT_LINE'
							  AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG		= 'Y'
							  AND A.DIVISION_ID		= B.SEGMENT1
							  AND A.PLANT_ID		= B.SEGMENT2
							  AND A.LINE_ID			= B.SEGMENT4
							  AND A.OPERATION_ID	= B.SEGMENT3
							  AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE	= B.SEGMENT5
							)

		ORDER BY A.LINE_ID 
      ]]>
        </text>

        <parameters>
          <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        </parameters>

	  <sql id="OperationByShop"><!-- Using SCP DB -->

    <sql id="list_line2">

<text>
      <![CDATA[


-- SHOP-GROUP_ID

		--SELECT DISTINCT
		--DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,
		--       SHOP_GROUP_ID   AS CODE
		--     , OPERATION_GROUP AS NAME
  --        FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
		--  WHERE 1 = 1
		--  --AND ( (@Param1 IS NULL or @Param1='') OR A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@Param1,','))  )
		SELECT 
	--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.INSTANCE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS INSTANCE_AUTH,
	ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS LINE_AUTH,
	ISNULL(CASE WHEN LV.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS PLANNER_AUTH,
	--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS OPERATION_AUTH,

	FL.INSTANCE_ID,FL.INSTANCE_NAME,
	FL.COMPANY_ID, FL.COMPANY_NAME,
	FL.LINE_ID, FL.LINE_NAME, 
	FL.DIVISION_ID, FL.DIVISION_NAME,
	FL.SITE_ID, FL.SITE_NAME,
	FL.PLANT_ID, FL.PLANT_NAME,
	FL.FACTORY_ID, FL.FACTORY_NAME,
	FL.OPERATION_ID, FL.OPERATION_NAME,
	FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, 
	FL.MODEL_TYPE, 
	--FL.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,
	AMEND_FLAG,
	AMEND_MAIN_FLAG
, V.CONFIRM_AREA
--, L.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME2
, L.ATTRIBUTE2 AS IS_SAME_PLAN_ID
, L.ATTRIBUTE4 AS USE_WOW_STATUS
, L.SORT_ORDER AS SORT_ORDER
, SHOP_GROUP_ID,OPERATION_GROUP
, FL.ACTIVE_FLAG
,VERSION_YN
FROM
 (

SELECT 
--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS SAVE_FLAG,
SL.LINE_NAME,LK.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME, FL.INSTANCE_ID, 
SL.COMPANY_ID, C.COMPANY_NAME,
SL.DIVISION_ID, D.DIVISION_NAME,
SL.SITE_ID, S.SITE_NAME,
SL.PLANT_ID, P.PLANT_NAME,
SL.FACTORY_ID, F.FACTORY_NAME,
SL.OPERATION_ID, O.OPERATION_NAME,
OV.AMEND_FLAG, OV.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG,
FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID,SSH.OPERATION_GROUP,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG,
SL.LINE_ID, FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, FL.MODEL_TYPE,
ISNULL(VK.VERSION_YN,'N') AS VERSION_YN
--, FL.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG
--FROM FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V FL WITH(NOLOCK) 
--LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M SL  WITH(NOLOCK)
FROM SCM_LINE_M SL WITH(NOLOCK) 
LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V FL  WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND FL.LINE_ID = SL.LINE_ID AND FL.COMPANY_ID = SL.COMPANY_ID ANd FL.SITE_ID = SL.SITE_ID AND FL.PLANT_ID = SL.PLANT_ID AND FL.FACTORY_ID = SL.FACTORY_ID 
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = SL.OPERATION_ID AND FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE = SL.ELECTRODE_TYPE

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE LK WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE='INSTANCE_ID'
AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = LK.SEGMENT1

--VERSION_YN
LEFT OUTER JOIN
				(SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, ATTRIBUTE1 AS VERSION_YN
				FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1=1
				AND    LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ELEC_INSTANCE_OPTION'
				AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
				) VK
				ON 1=1
				AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = VK.INSTANCE_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M  F WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.FACTORY_ID = F.FACTORY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_COMPANY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_DIVISION_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_SITE_M S WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_PLANT_M P WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.SITE_ID = P.SITE_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = P.COMPANY_ID
AND SL.PLANT_ID = P.PLANT_ID
AND SL.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M O WITH(NOLOCK)
ON SL.SITE_ID = O.SITE_ID
AND SL.COMPANY_ID = O.COMPANY_ID
AND SL.DIVISION_ID = O.DIVISION_ID
AND SL.OPERATION_ID = O.OPERATION_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V OV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.SITE_ID = OV.SITE_ID
AND FL.COMPANY_ID = OV.COMPANY_ID
AND FL.DIVISION_ID = OV.DIVISION_ID
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = OV.OPERATION_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M FV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.INSTANCE_ID = FV.INSTANCE_ID
AND FL.FACTORY_ID = FV.FACTORY_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V SSH WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1 AND FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID = SSH.SHOP_GROUP_ID

--WHERE FV.FACTORY_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP by 
SL.LINE_ID, SL.LINE_NAME,--V.SAVE_FLAG,
FL.INSTANCE_ID, LK.SEGMENT2,
SL.COMPANY_ID, C.COMPANY_NAME,
SL.DIVISION_ID,D.DIVISION_NAME,
SL.SITE_ID,S.SITE_NAME,
SL.PLANT_ID, P.PLANT_NAME,
SL.FACTORY_ID,F.FACTORY_NAME, 
SL.OPERATION_ID, O.OPERATION_NAME,
OV.AMEND_FLAG,OV.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG,
FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID, SSH.OPERATION_GROUP,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG,
FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, FL.MODEL_TYPE,VK.VERSION_YN
) FL

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V V WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND V.USER_ID = @USER_ID  AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = V.INSTANCE_ID AND FL.LINE_ID = V.LINE_ID AND FL.COMPANY_ID = V.COMPANY_ID ANd FL.SITE_ID = V.SITE_ID AND FL.PLANT_ID = V.PLANT_ID AND FL.FACTORY_ID = V.FACTORY_ID 
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = V.OPERATION_ID AND FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE = V.ELECTRODE_TYPE 

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE L WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = L.SEGMENT1

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_USER_LINE_GROUP_M LV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.LINE_ID = LV.LINE_ID
AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
--WHERE FL.LINE_ID = 'EPD01'

ORDER BY DIVISION_NAME,FL.COMPANY_ID, FL.SITE_ID, FL.PLANT_ID, FL.FACTORY_ID, FL.OPERATION_ID,FL.LINE_ID

      ]]>
      </text>

AND FL.PLANT_ID = P.PLANT_ID
AND FL.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID

INNER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M O WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.SITE_ID = O.SITE_ID
AND FL.COMPANY_ID = O.COMPANY_ID
AND FL.DIVISION_ID = O.DIVISION_ID
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = O.OPERATION_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V OV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.SITE_ID = OV.SITE_ID
AND FL.COMPANY_ID = OV.COMPANY_ID
AND FL.DIVISION_ID = OV.DIVISION_ID
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = OV.OPERATION_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M FV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.INSTANCE_ID = FV.INSTANCE_ID
AND FL.FACTORY_ID = FV.FACTORY_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN @OPTBL SSH
ON 1=1 AND FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID = SSH.SHOP_GROUP_ID

WHERE FV.FACTORY_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP by 
FL.LINE_ID, SL.LINE_NAME,--V.SAVE_FLAG,
FL.INSTANCE_ID, LK.SEGMENT2,
FL.COMPANY_ID, C.COMPANY_NAME,
FL.DIVISION_ID,D.DIVISION_NAME,
FL.SITE_ID,S.SITE_NAME,
FL.PLANT_ID, P.PLANT_NAME,
FL.FACTORY_ID,F.FACTORY_NAME, 
FL.OPERATION_ID, O.OPERATION_NAME,
OV.AMEND_FLAG,OV.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG,
FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID, SSH.OPERATION_GROUP,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG,
FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, FL.MODEL_TYPE,VK.VERSION_YN
) FL

--LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V V WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN @ROLETBL V
ON 1=1
AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = V.INSTANCE_ID AND FL.LINE_ID = V.LINE_ID AND FL.COMPANY_ID = V.COMPANY_ID ANd FL.SITE_ID = V.SITE_ID AND FL.PLANT_ID = V.PLANT_ID AND FL.FACTORY_ID = V.FACTORY_ID 
AND FL.OPERATION_ID = V.OPERATION_ID AND FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE = V.ELECTRODE_TYPE 

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE L WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
AND FL.INSTANCE_ID = L.SEGMENT1

LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_USER_LINE_GROUP_M LV WITH(NOLOCK)
ON FL.LINE_ID = LV.LINE_ID
AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'


ORDER BY DIVISION_NAME,FL.COMPANY_ID, FL.SITE_ID, FL.PLANT_ID, FL.FACTORY_ID, FL.OPERATION_ID,FL.LINE_ID
      ]]>
        </text>

        </parameters>

      <sql id="list_line_old">

        <text>
          <![CDATA[


-- SHOP-GROUP_ID

		SELECT 
	--ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.INSTANCE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS INSTANCE_AUTH,
	ISNULL(CASE WHEN V.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 'N') AS LINE_AUTH,

	FL.INSTANCE_ID,FL.INSTANCE_NAME,
	FL.COMPANY_ID, FL.COMPANY_NAME,

	FL.DIVISION_ID, FL.DIVISION_NAME,

ISNULL(VK.VERSION_YN,'N') AS VERSION_YN
--, FL.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG

FL.PLANT_ID, P.PLANT_NAME,
FL.FACTORY_ID,F.FACTORY_NAME, 
FL.OPERATION_ID, O.OPERATION_NAME,
OV.AMEND_FLAG,OV.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG,
FV.SHOP_GROUP_ID, SSH.OPERATION_GROUP,SL.ACTIVE_FLAG,
FL.ELECTRODE_TYPE, FL.MODEL_TYPE,VK.VERSION_YN
