      <sql id="DM_MyDivision">

        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
	SELECT   
		DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID + ' ' + MIN([DIVISION_NAME]) AS NAME 
    FROM [SCM_MST_DIVISION] A WITH(NOLOCK)  
    WHERE   
	    A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
		AND DIVISION_ID IN 
		(SELECT CODE FROM [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE GroupID = @GROUP_ID AND UserID = @USER_ID AND AuthType = CASE WHEN GroupID = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END)  
		AND VALID_YN = 'Y'  
				GROUP BY 
					DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE1
				ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE1  
 
      ]]>
        </text>

        <parameters>
          <parameter replace-what="GROUP_ID" name="GROUP_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
          <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        </parameters>
      </sql>

      <sql id="list_line_dm">

        <text>
          <![CDATA[
		  
			Declare @AuthTypePara varchar(100) = 'D';
			IF(@GROUP_ID = 'JV Planner') SET @AuthTypePara = 'J';
				
			DEClARE @TeambyDivision_Lang NVARCHAR(200) = '';
			

			SELECT @TeambyDivision_Lang = ISNULL(Language, 'KO')
			FROM [TB_FX_User]
			WHERE UserID = @USER_ID;
				  

			-- 'MyDivision' 
			BEGIN
				SELECT   
					DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID + ' ' + MIN([DIVISION_NAME]) AS NAME 
				FROM [SCM_MST_DIVISION] A WITH(NOLOCK)  
				WHERE   
					A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
					AND DIVISION_ID IN 
					(SELECT CODE FROM [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE GroupID = @GROUP_ID AND UserID = @USER_ID AND AuthType = CASE WHEN GroupID = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END)  
					AND VALID_YN = 'Y'  
					GROUP BY 
						DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE1
					ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE1;
			END
 
			-- 'TeambyDivision'
			BEGIN

				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,
					B.DEPT_ID       AS CODE
					, CASE @TeambyDivision_Lang WHEN 'EN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_EN
												WHEN 'CN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_CN
												ELSE B.DEPT_NAME_KO
												END
					AS NAME
				FROM  [SCM_MST_SITE]          A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					, [SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
				AND    A.DEPT_ID  = B.DEPT_ID  
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
						FROM   [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
						WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
						AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
						AND    AuthType = 'D')

			UNION ALL
				
				select distinct a.division_id AS DIVISION_ID, c.dept_id AS CODE 
					, CASE @TeambyDivision_Lang WHEN 'EN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_EN
								WHEN 'CN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_CN
								ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO
								END AS NAME
					from [scm_mst_site_item] a  WITH(NOLOCK)
						,[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] b  WITH(NOLOCK)
						,[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] c  WITH(NOLOCK)
					where 
					b.user_id = (SELECT top 1 token FROM dbo.String_Split(a.owner,',') )
					and b.dept_id = c.dept_id
					and a.division_id = '40'
					order by DIVISION_ID;
			END


			-- 'EndCustomerByDivision'
			BEGIN
			-- 'EndCustomerByDivision40'

 				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE 
					, ISNULL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
				FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A  WITH(NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN [SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.OWNER = B.USER_ID
					INNER JOIN [SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C  WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
					LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WITH(NOLOCK) 
						ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE 
				B.USER_ID = (SELECT TOP 1 TOKEN FROM DBO.STRING_SPLIT(A.OWNER,',') )  -- 20180816
				AND B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
				AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				UNION
				SELECT SEGMENT1, '', SEGMENT2 AS CODE , SEGMENT3 AS NAME
				FROM  [SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
				AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
				AND VALID_YN = 'Y'	
				AND SEGMENT1 = '40' 

				UNION ALL

			-- 'EndCustomerByDivisionDept'
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPT_ID, 
						A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE 
						, ISNULL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
				FROM   SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WITH(NOLOCK) 
					ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
									FROM   TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GROUPID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
											AND    USERID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AUTHTYPE = 'D')
				AND    END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
				ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID

			END		


			--BizType
			BEGIN
			-- 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'			
				SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_ID
					, L.SEGMENT1  AS CODE
					, L.SEGMENT2  AS NAME
				FROM   [SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] L WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'
				--ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_SEQ
				
				UNION ALL

			-- 'BizTypebyDivision'			
				SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, 
					 BIZ_TYPE       AS CODE 
				   , BIZ_TYPE_NAME  AS NAME
				  FROM   [SCM_MST_PROJECT]  WITH(NOLOCK)
				  WHERE   BIZ_TYPE_NAME != ''
			END		

				
			-- 'SiteByEndCustomer'				
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, '' AS DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER,
						SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
						, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [SCM_MST_SITE] A WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
											FROM   [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	

			UNION ALL

			--	'SiteByEndCustomer40'	
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE,
						A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
						, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					LEFT JOIN [SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM] AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
					ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
					LEFT JOIN (
								SELECT DISTINCT A.USER_ID, A.DEPT_ID 
								FROM [SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] A WITH(NOLOCK) , [SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK) 
								WHERE A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
							) C ON B.OWNER = C.USER_ID
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
											FROM   [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    					WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    			AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
											AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)
				AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
			END

			
			--'FromSiteByDivision'
			BEGIN

				SELECT	A.DIVISION_ID
					,	SCM_SITE_ID        AS CODE
					,	SCM_SITE_ID		   AS NAME
				FROM [SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
				AND    A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE
				FROM   [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    				 WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    		 AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = @AuthTypePara)

			END		


			--PlantSiteByEndCustomer			
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER,
					   SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
					 , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
				FROM   [SCM_MST_SITE] A
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
				AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
										 FROM   [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
										 WHERE  GroupID LIKE @GROUP_ID + '%'
						    			 AND    UserID  LIKE @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = 'D')  
			END


			-- EdiSender
			BEGIN
				SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
				FROM [SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] (NOLOCK)
				WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EDI_SENDER_CODE'
					AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
					AND SEGMENT1 = '81'
				ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ	
			END


			--ScmSitebyEndCustomer40
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT ST.DIVISION_ID, '' AS END_CUSTOMER,
					ST.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
				FROM [SCM_MST_SITE] AS ST WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    ST.DIVISION_ID = '40'
				AND    ST.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'		
				AND    ST.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE 
										 FROM   [TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention] AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					    				 WHERE  GroupID LIKE '%'+ @GROUP_ID + '%'
							    		 AND    UserID  LIKE '%'+ @USER_ID + '%'
										 AND    AuthType = 'D')
				ORDER BY DIVISION_ID
			END




      ]]>
        </text>

<SQLS id="AMENDMEMO">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_memo">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT  A.INSTANCE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
			      , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
			      , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
			      , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE
			      , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS BUCKET_FROM
			      , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS BUCKET_TO
			      , A.MEMO
			      , A.UPDATE_ID AS CREATOR
			      , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.UPDATE_TIME,120) AS CREATION
			      , A.MEMO_TYPE
			FROM    FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE   1=1
      AND (ISNULL(@INSTANCE_ID,'')='' OR A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@COMPANY_ID,'')='' OR A.COMPANY_ID = @COMPANY_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@DIVISION_ID,'')='' OR A.DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@SITE_ID,'')='' OR A.SITE_ID = @SITE_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@PLANT_ID,'')='' OR A.PLANT_ID = @PLANT_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@FACTORY_ID,'')='' OR A.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'')='' OR A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@FACTORY_ID,'')='' OR A.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@LINE_ID,'')='' OR A.LINE_ID = @LINE_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@TOP_ITEM_ID,'')='' OR A.TOP_ITEM_ID = @TOP_ITEM_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@ITEM_ID,'')='' OR A.ITEM_ID = @ITEM_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@ELECTRODE_TYPE,'')='' OR A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = @ELECTRODE_TYPE)
			AND (ISNULL(@EQUIPMENT_ID,'')='' OR A.EQUIPMENT_ID = @EQUIPMENT_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@MARKET,'')='' OR A.MARKET = @MARKET)
			AND (ISNULL(@PRODUCTION_TYPE,'')='' OR A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE)
			AND (ISNULL(@ITEM_ID,'')='' OR A.ITEM_ID = @ITEM_ID)
			AND (ISNULL(@PLAN_DATE,'')='' OR CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = @PLAN_DATE)
			AND (
        (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = @MEMO_TYPE)
			OR (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = 'DPP'))
			AND	A.MEMO IS NOT NULL

      ]]>
      </text>

        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" name="COMPANY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      <![CDATA[

<SQLS id="FP00180_EQUIPMENT">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
    
<text>
      <![CDATA[

      DELETE FROM BUF_EQUIPMENT_M
      WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,case when B.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Factory' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.LINE_ID is null then 'Line' else '' end as msg3
                ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg99
          FROM   BUF_EQUIPMENT_M A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) B
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
            FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID
            FROM   SCM_LINE_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) D
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
          	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
					FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE	1=1
					AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
					AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
			) R
			ON		1=1
			AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
			AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
			AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
			AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
			AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
			AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>



    </sql>
  </simple-sqls>

        begin tran
          merge into scm_equipment_m AS A

            and a.division_id   = b.division_id
            and a.site_id       = b.site_id
            and a.plant_id      = b.plant_id
            and a.factory_id    = b.factory_id
            and a.equipment_id  = b.equipment_id)
          when matched then 
            update set 
              update_id      = @USER_ID
             ,update_time    = dbo.SYSDATE1()
 			       ,line_id        = RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))
  			     ,electrode_type = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE))
  			     ,line_type      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_TYPE))
  			     ,active_flag    = upper(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTIVE_FLAG)))
          when not matched then 
            insert (
               COMPANY_ID,DIVISION_ID,SITE_ID,PLANT_ID,FACTORY_ID
              ,EQUIPMENT_ID,EQUIPMENT_NAME
              ,OPERATION_ID,LINE_ID
              ,MES_LINE_ID,WORK_CENTER_ID
              ,EQUIPMENT_TYPE,ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,LINE_TYPE
              ,ACTIVE_FLAG
              ,DESCRIPTION
              ,INSERT_ID,INSERT_TIME,UPDATE_ID,UPDATE_TIME
            ) values (
               RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))     ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))    ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)),RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)),RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID))
              ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@EQUIPMENT_ID))   ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@EQUIPMENT_NAME))
              ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID))   ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))
              ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@MES_LINE_ID))    ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@WORK_CENTER_ID))
              ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@EQUIPMENT_TYPE)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE))
              ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_TYPE))
              ,upper(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTIVE_FLAG)))
              ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@DESCRIPTION))
              ,@USER_ID,dbo.SYSDATE1(),@USER_ID,dbo.SYSDATE1()
            )
          ;
          
        commit;
        
        begin tran
          insert into his_equipment_m (
                 COMPANY_ID
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_ID

                ,EQUIPMENT_NAME

                ,WORK_CENTER_ID
                ,EQUIPMENT_TYPE

                ,LINE_TYPE
                ,ACTIVE_FLAG
                ,DESCRIPTION
                ,INSERT_ID
                ,INSERT_TIME
                ,UPDATE_ID
                ,UPDATE_TIME
                ,JOB_USER_ID
                ,JOB_TIME
                ,JOB_TYPE
          )
          select COMPANY_ID
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_ID
                ,FACTORY_ID
                ,EQUIPMENT_ID
                ,EQUIPMENT_NAME
                ,OPERATION_ID
                ,LINE_ID
                ,MES_LINE_ID
                ,WORK_CENTER_ID
                ,EQUIPMENT_TYPE
                ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                ,LINE_TYPE
                ,ACTIVE_FLAG
                ,DESCRIPTION
                ,INSERT_ID
                ,INSERT_TIME
                ,UPDATE_ID
                ,UPDATE_TIME
                ,@USER_ID as JOB_USER_ID
                ,dbo.sysdate1() as JOB_TIME
                ,'EXCEL' as JOB_TYPE
          from   scm_equipment_m A(NOLOCK)
    			where  company_id   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))
    			and    division_id  = RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))
    			and    site_id      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))
    			and    plant_id     = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID))
    			and    factory_id   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID))
    			AND    equipment_id = RTRIM(LTRIM(@EQUIPMENT_ID))
          ;
        
        commit;
      end;
    
      ]]>

    <sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      ]]>
      </text>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Division' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                ,CASE WHEN B.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Site' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                ,CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
          FROM   BUF_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SITE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_DIVISION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
    		  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      				SELECT DISTINCT D.COMPANY_ID, D.DIVISION_ID, D.SITE_ID
      				FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V D WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  D.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
      				AND    D.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    		  ) D
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      DELETE FROM BUF_ITEM_M
      WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Division' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                ,CASE WHEN B.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Site' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                ,CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
          FROM   BUF_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SITE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_DIVISION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
    		  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      				SELECT DISTINCT D.COMPANY_ID, D.DIVISION_ID, D.SITE_ID
      				FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V D WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  D.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
      				AND    D.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    		  ) D
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>
  </simple-sqls>

<SQLS id="FP00540_SSP_Shipping_Plan">

	<simple-sqls>
	
		<sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
		
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
			
			DELETE FROM BUF_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_H
			WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
			
			]]>
			</text>
			
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
			
		</sql>

		<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
   
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				SELECT 	A.*
						,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG7 END)
						      ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG7 END)
						      END AS _MSG
						,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG7 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
				FROM (
						SELECT 	A.* 
							  ,MSG1
							  +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                         THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
							  +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                           THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
							  +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                             THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
							  +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')               THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
							  --+(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '') THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
							  + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
						FROM (
								SELECT a.*
								    ,case when B.ITEM_ID is null then 'Material' else '' end as msg1
								    ,case when C.PLANT_ID is null then 'Plant' else '' end as msg2
								    ,case when D.DT is null then 'Ship Date' else '' end as msg3
								    ,case when ((D.ISO_YYYYWW is null OR D.ISO_YYYYWW<>A.SHIP_WEEK) and A.SHIP_WEEK<>'999999') then 'Ship Week' else '' end as msg4
								    ,case when E.SHOP_GROUP_ID is null then 'Shop Group' else '' end as msg5
								    --,case when F.PLANT_ID is null then 'To Site or To Plant' else '' end as msg6
											,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.SHOP_GROUP_ID,A.SCP_PLAN_ID,A.SCP_TARGET_ID,A.FP_TARGET_ID
											                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.SHOP_GROUP_ID,A.SCP_PLAN_ID,A.SCP_TARGET_ID,A.FP_TARGET_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
											      ELSE '' end as msg7
								FROM   	BUF_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_H A(NOLOCK)
										LEFT OUTER JOIN (
															SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
															FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M B(NOLOCK)
															WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS = B.CLASS_ID
															AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
															AND    B.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
														) B
										ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
										AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
										AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
										AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
										LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_PLANT_M C(NOLOCK)
										ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
										AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
										AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
										AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID
										LEFT OUTER JOIN TH_UIS_CAL D(NOLOCK)
										ON  CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.SHIP_DATE, 112) = D.DT
										LEFT OUTER JOIN (
															SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SHOP_GROUP_ID
															FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
															WHERE 1=1
															AND   ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
															GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SHOP_GROUP_ID
														) E
										ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = E.COMPANY_ID
										AND A.DIVISION_ID   = E.DIVISION_ID
										AND A.SITE_ID       = E.SITE_ID
										AND A.PLANT_ID      = E.PLANT_ID
										AND A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = E.SHOP_GROUP_ID
										/*
										LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										SELECT DISTINCT SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
										FROM   SCM_PLANT_M(NOLOCK)
										) F
										ON  A.TO_SITE_ID    = F.SITE_ID
										AND A.TO_PLANT_ID   = F.PLANT_ID
										*/
								WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
							) A
						) A
				ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
     
			]]>
			</text>
		
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
		
		</sql>
	</simple-sqls>


	<update-batchs>

		<insert-sql>
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				 INSERT into BUF_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_H (
			         COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SHOP_GROUP_ID
			        ,SCP_PLAN_ID, SCP_TARGET_ID, FP_TARGET_ID
			        ,ITEM_ID, TO_SITE_ID, TO_PLANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID
			        ,SHIP_DATE, SHIP_WEEK, SHIP_QTY
			        ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, TRANSPORT_MODE, BIZ_TYPE, CONFIRM_TYPE
			        ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
			      )
			      VALUES (
					         UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHOP_GROUP_ID)))
					        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_PLAN_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_TARGET_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_TARGET_ID)))
					        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TO_SITE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TO_PLANT_ID))), @CUSTOMER_ID
					        ,CONVERT(DATETIME, @SHIP_DATE), @SHIP_WEEK, @SHIP_QTY
					        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TRANSPORT_MODE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@BIZ_TYPE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@CONFIRM_TYPE)))
					        ,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
			      		)
	
    
	    ]]>
		</text>

			<parameter replace-what = "TRANSPORT_MODE" name="TRANSPORT_MODE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BIZ_TYPE" name="BIZ_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "CONFIRM_TYPE" name="CONFIRM_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

	<update-batch id = "merge_FP00540">
		<insert-sql>
		<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				BEGIN 
      
			        MERGE INTO FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_H A
			        USING (SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID)) AS COMPANY_ID      , RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID)) AS DIVISION_ID    , RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)) AS SITE_ID,
			                      RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)) AS PLANT_ID          , RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHOP_GROUP_ID)) AS SHOP_GROUP_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_PLAN_ID)) AS SCP_PLAN_ID,
			                      RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_TARGET_ID)) AS SCP_TARGET_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_TARGET_ID)) AS FP_TARGET_ID) B
			        ON (    A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID   AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
			            AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID      AND A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = B.SHOP_GROUP_ID AND A.SCP_PLAN_ID = B.SCP_PLAN_ID
			            AND A.SCP_TARGET_ID = B.SCP_TARGET_ID AND A.FP_TARGET_ID  = B.FP_TARGET_ID)
			        WHEN MATCHED THEN
			        UPDATE SET ITEM_ID    = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)), TO_SITE_ID = RTRIM(LTRIM(@TO_SITE_ID)), TO_PLANT_ID = RTRIM(LTRIM(@TO_PLANT_ID)), CUSTOMER_ID = RTRIM(LTRIM(@CUSTOMER_ID)),
			                   SHIP_DATE  = CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK))<>'999999' AND LEN(ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),''))<>10 THEN (SELECT DT FROM TH_UIS_CAL A(NOLOCK) WHERE ISO_YYYYWW=RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK)) AND DATEPART(DW, DT) = 1) ELSE (SELECT DT FROM TH_UIS_CAL A(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD=REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),'-','')) END,
			        		       SHIP_WEEK  = CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK))='999999' AND LEN(ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),''))=10 THEN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD=REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),'-','')) ELSE RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK)) END,
			                   SHIP_QTY   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_QTY)), PRODUCTION_TYPE = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)), TRANSPORT_MODE = RTRIM(LTRIM(@TRANSPORT_MODE)), 
			                   BIZ_TYPE   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@BIZ_TYPE)), CONFIRM_TYPE = RTRIM(LTRIM(@CONFIRM_TYPE)),
			        		   UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.SYSDATE1()
			        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
			        INSERT (
			                COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SHOP_GROUP_ID, SCP_PLAN_ID, SCP_TARGET_ID, FP_TARGET_ID,
			            		ITEM_ID,TO_SITE_ID,TO_PLANT_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,
			            		SHIP_DATE,
			            		SHIP_WEEK,
			            		SHIP_QTY,
			            		PRODUCTION_TYPE,TRANSPORT_MODE,BIZ_TYPE,CONFIRM_TYPE,
			            		INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
			        )
			        VALUES (
			                RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHOP_GROUP_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_PLAN_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_TARGET_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_TARGET_ID)),
			                RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@TO_SITE_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@TO_PLANT_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@CUSTOMER_ID)),
			            		CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK))<>'999999' AND LEN(ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),''))<>10 THEN (SELECT DT FROM TH_UIS_CAL A(NOLOCK) WHERE ISO_YYYYWW=RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK)) AND DATEPART(DW, DT) = 1) ELSE (SELECT DT FROM TH_UIS_CAL A(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD=REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),'-','')) END,
			            		CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK))='999999' AND LEN(ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),''))=10 THEN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD=REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_DATE)),'-','')) ELSE RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_WEEK)) END,
			            		RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHIP_QTY)),
			            		RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@TRANSPORT_MODE)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@BIZ_TYPE)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@CONFIRM_TYPE)),
			            		@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1()
			        )
			        ;
			      
			        INSERT INTO HIS_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_H (
			              COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SHOP_GROUP_ID, SCP_PLAN_ID, SCP_TARGET_ID, FP_TARGET_ID,
			              ITEM_ID,TO_SITE_ID,TO_PLANT_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,
			              SHIP_DATE,SHIP_WEEK,SHIP_QTY,
			              PRODUCTION_TYPE,TRANSPORT_MODE,BIZ_TYPE,CONFIRM_TYPE,
			              INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME,
			              JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
			        )
			        SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SHOP_GROUP_ID, SCP_PLAN_ID, SCP_TARGET_ID, FP_TARGET_ID,
			               ITEM_ID,TO_SITE_ID,TO_PLANT_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,
			               SHIP_DATE,SHIP_WEEK,SHIP_QTY,
			               PRODUCTION_TYPE,TRANSPORT_MODE,BIZ_TYPE,CONFIRM_TYPE,
			               INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME,
			               @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), 'EXCEL'
			        FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_H A(NOLOCK)
			        WHERE  COMPANY_ID     = RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))
			        AND    DIVISION_ID    = RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))
			        AND    SITE_ID        = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))
			        AND    PLANT_ID       = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID))
			        AND    SHOP_GROUP_ID  = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SHOP_GROUP_ID))
			        AND    SCP_PLAN_ID    = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_PLAN_ID))
			        AND    SCP_TARGET_ID  = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SCP_TARGET_ID))
			        AND    FP_TARGET_ID   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_TARGET_ID))
			        ;
			      
				END;

			]]>
			</text>
			
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" name="COMPANY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

<SQLS id="FP00130_MATERIAL">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
      FROM (
          SELECT YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
                ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
                +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
                       ELSE '(SUN)' END)
                AS _NAME
                , 1 AS _COUNT
                ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
                , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
                , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
                , 'D' AS _TYPE
          FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
          UNION ALL
          SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
               , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
               , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
               , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
               , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
               , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
               , 'W' AS _TYPE
          FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
          AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
          GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ) A
WHERE _TYPE='D'
      ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Division' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                ,CASE WHEN B.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Site' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                ,CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
          FROM   BUF_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SITE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_DIVISION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
    		  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      				SELECT DISTINCT D.COMPANY_ID, D.DIVISION_ID, D.SITE_ID
      				FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V D WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  D.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
      				AND    D.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    		  ) D
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION AND A.PLM_EC_NO = B.PLM_EC_NO AND A.VERSION = B.VERSION )
          WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET IN_QTY  = CEILING(FLOOR(@OUT_QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE))
                                      				/(SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                      					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                      					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                      						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                      						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                      						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                      						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                      						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                      						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                      						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                      						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                      					) EEE
                                      					ON     1=1
                                      					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
                     , OUT_QTY = FLOOR(@OUT_QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE))
                     , CELL_IN_QTY  = CEILING(@OUT_QTY / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                                            FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                                                SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                                WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                                AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                                                AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                                                AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                                AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                                AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                                                AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                                AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                                            ) EEE
                                                            ON     1=1
                                                            WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                            AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
                		 , CELL_OUT_QTY = @OUT_QTY
                     , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
                     , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,IN_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,CELL_IN_QTY
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,PLM_EC_NO
              ,VERSION
            )
            VALUES (
               UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID), UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID)
              ,(SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID AND SITE_ID = @SITE_ID AND PLANT_ID = @PLANT_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
              ,UPPER(@DIVISION_ID)
              ,'PLAN'
              ,UPPER(@SITE_ID), UPPER(@PLANT_ID)
              ,UPPER(@ITEM_ID), UPPER(@OPERATION_ID), UPPER(@FACTORY_ID), UPPER(@LOCATION)
              ,UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE), UPPER(@MARKET)
              ,UPPER(@LINE_ID), @ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE)
              ,UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID), UPPER(@ITEM_TYPE)
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(@OUT_QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE))
                    				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                    					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                    					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                    						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                    						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                    						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                    						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                    						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                    						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                    						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                    						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                    						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                    					) EEE
                    					ON     1=1
                    					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                    					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                    					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                    					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                    					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                    					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                    					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                    					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
              ,FLOOR(@OUT_QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE))
              ,CEILING(@OUT_QTY / (  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                          SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                          FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                          WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                          AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                          AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                          AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                          AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                          AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                          AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                          AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                      ) EEE
                                      ON     1=1
                                      WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                      AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                      AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                      AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                      AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                      AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,@OUT_QTY
              ,1
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,B.PLM_EC_NO
              ,B.VERSION
            )
          ;
        
        COMMIT;
        
        BEGIN TRAN
            INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
                   INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
                  ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
                  ,CATEGORY_ID
                  ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, ITEM_TYPE
                  ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
                  ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  ,PLAN_DATE
                  ,IN_QTY, OUT_QTY
                  ,CELL_IN_QTY, CELL_OUT_QTY
                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,PLM_EC_NO
                  ,VERSION
            )
            SELECT INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
                  ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
                  ,CATEGORY_ID
                  ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, ISNULL(ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE
                  ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
                  ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  ,PLAN_DATE
                  ,IN_QTY, OUT_QTY
                  ,CELL_IN_QTY, CELL_OUT_QTY
                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,PLM_EC_NO
                  ,VERSION
            FROM   FP_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
            AND    A.CATEGORY_ID      = 'PLAN'
            AND    A.SITE_ID          = @SITE_ID
            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID
            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @TOP_ITEM_ID
            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @FACTORY_ID
            AND    A.LOCATION         = @LOCATION
            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @LINE_ID
            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND    A.PLAN_DATE        = CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE)
            AND    A.PLM_EC_NO        = (case when UPPER(@PLM_EC_NO) is null or UPPER(@PLM_EC_NO) = '' then '-' else UPPER(@PLM_EC_NO) end)
            AND    A.VERSION          = @VERSION
            ;
          
        COMMIT;
        
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

<SQLS id="FP00600_PLAN_AMEND_BY_MODEL_PACK">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
      FROM (
          SELECT YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
                ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
                +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
                       WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
                       ELSE '(SUN)' END)
                AS _NAME
                , 1 AS _COUNT
                ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
                , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
                , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
                , 'D' AS _TYPE
          FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
          UNION ALL
          SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
               , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
               , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
               , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
               , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
               , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
               , 'W' AS _TYPE
          FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
          AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
          GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ) A
WHERE _TYPE='D'
      ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

	<sql id = "find_ListData_BOH">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
           , A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID
           , A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID

      FROM   @AMEND_CUTOFF_BOH_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)

	<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Division' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                ,CASE WHEN B.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Site' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                ,CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
          FROM   BUF_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SITE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_DIVISION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
    		  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      				SELECT DISTINCT D.COMPANY_ID, D.DIVISION_ID, D.SITE_ID
      				FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V D WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  D.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
      				AND    D.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    		  ) D
          ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

	<update-batch id = 'merge_data'>
  		
  		<insert-sql>
  
			<text>
	      	<![CDATA[
						BEGIN
				        BEGIN TRAN
				          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R A
				          USING (SELECT UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID) AS INSTANCE_ID, UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID) AS FP_PLAN_ID,
				                        UPPER(@DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID, UPPER(@SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID,
				                        UPPER(@PLANT_ID) AS PLANT_ID, UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID, UPPER(@ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, UPPER(@OPERATION_ID) AS OPERATION_ID,
				                        UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, UPPER(@MARKET) AS MARKET,
				                        UPPER(@FACTORY_ID) AS FACTORY_ID, UPPER(@LINE_ID) AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
				                        @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE, UPPER(@LOCATION) AS LOCATION) B
				          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
				              AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
				              AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
				              AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
				              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET
				              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
				              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION)
				          WHEN MATCHED then
				            UPDATE SET OUT_QTY = @OUT_QTY
			                		 , IN_QTY  = FLOOR(@OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
			                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			                                                      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			                                                          SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
			                                                          FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			                                                          WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
			                                                          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
			                                                          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
			                                                          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
			                                                          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
			                                                          AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
			                                                          AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
			                                                          AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
			                                                      ) B
			                                                      ON     1=1
			                                                      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		                                                          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		                                                          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
			                                                      AND    A.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(@PLAN_DATE,1,6)))
			                     ,  UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
			                     , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
				          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				            INSERT (
				               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
				              ,COMPANY_ID
				              ,DIVISION_ID
				              ,CATEGORY_ID
				              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
				              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
				              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
				              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
				              ,PLAN_DATE
				              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
				              ,IN_QTY
				              ,OUT_QTY
				              ,DATE_SEQ
				              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
				              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
				            )
				            VALUES (
					            	  UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID), UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID)
						              ,(SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID AND SITE_ID = @SITE_ID AND PLANT_ID = @PLANT_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
						              ,UPPER(@DIVISION_ID)
						              ,'PLAN'
						              ,UPPER(@SITE_ID), UPPER(@PLANT_ID)
						              ,UPPER(@ITEM_ID), UPPER(@OPERATION_ID), UPPER(@FACTORY_ID), UPPER(@LOCATION)
						              ,UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE), UPPER(@MARKET)
						              ,UPPER(@LINE_ID), @ELECTRODE_TYPE
						              ,CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE)
						              ,UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID), UPPER(@ITEM_TYPE)
						              ,FLOOR(@OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                        FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		                                                          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		                                                          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
		                                                          AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
		                                                      ) B
		                                                      ON     1=1
		                                                      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		                                                      AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID

				<parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" 		name = "SITE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" 		name = "PLANT_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" 	name = "TOP_ITEM_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" 		name = "PLAN_DATE"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SALES_QTY" 		name = "SALES_QTY"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "CATEGORY_ID" 	name = "CATEGORY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SEQ" 			name = "SEQ"  				dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" 		name = "USER_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			</parameters>

  		</insert-sql>
  		
  		<update-sql>
  
			<text>
	      	<![CDATA[
					BEGIN
				        BEGIN TRAN
				          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_SALES_R A
				          USING (SELECT UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID) AS INSTANCE_ID, UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID) AS FP_PLAN_ID,
				                        UPPER(@DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID, UPPER(@CATEGORY_ID) AS CATEGORY_ID, UPPER(@SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID,
				                        UPPER(@PLANT_ID) AS PLANT_ID, UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID, 
				                        @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE ) B
				          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
				              AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
				              AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
				              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE )
				          WHEN MATCHED THEN
				            UPDATE SET SALES_QTY = ISNULL(@SALES_QTY,0)
				                     , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID
				                     , UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
				          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				            INSERT (
				    		         INSTANCE_ID
					               , FP_PLAN_ID
					               , COMPANY_ID
					               , DIVISION_ID
					               , CATEGORY_ID
					               , SITE_ID
					               , PLANT_ID
					               , ITEM_ID
					               , OPERATION_ID
					               , FACTORY_ID
					               , LOCATION
					               , PRODUCTION_TYPE
					               , MARKET
					               , LINE_ID
					               , ELECTRODE_TYPE
					               , PLAN_DATE
					               , TOP_ITEM_ID
					               , SALES_QTY
					               , INSERT_ID
					               , INSERT_TIME
					               , UPDATE_ID
					               , UPDATE_TIME
					            )
				            VALUES (
				    		         @INSTANCE_ID
					               , @FP_PLAN_ID
					               ,(SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID AND SITE_ID = @SITE_ID AND PLANT_ID = @PLANT_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
					               , @DIVISION_ID
					               , @CATEGORY_ID
					               , @SITE_ID
					               , @PLANT_ID
					               , @TOP_ITEM_ID
					               , '-'
					               , '-'
					               , '-'
					               , '-'
					               , '-'
					               , '-'
					               , '-'
					               , CONVERT(DATETIME, @PLAN_DATE)
					               , @TOP_ITEM_ID
					               , ISNULL(@SALES_QTY,0)
					               , @USER_ID
					               , dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
					               , @USER_ID
					               , dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
					            )
					          ;
				        
				        COMMIT;
				        
				        BEGIN TRAN
				            INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R (
				                   INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
				                  ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
				                  ,CATEGORY_ID
				                  ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
				                  ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
				                  ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
				                  ,PLAN_DATE
				                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
				                  ,OUT_QTY
				                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
				                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
				                  ,DATE_SEQ
				                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
				            )
				            SELECT INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
				                  ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
				                  ,CATEGORY_ID
				                  ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
				                  ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
				                  ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
				                  ,PLAN_DATE
				                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
				                  ,@SALES_QTY AS OUT_QTY
				                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
				                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
				                  ,@SEQ
				                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MERGE_SHIP_SIMUL' AS JOB_TYPE
				            FROM   FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_SALES_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
				            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
				            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
				            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
				            AND    A.CATEGORY_ID      = @CATEGORY_ID
				            AND    A.SITE_ID          = @SITE_ID
				            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID
				            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @TOP_ITEM_ID
				            AND    A.PLAN_DATE        = CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE)
				            ;
				          
				        COMMIT;
				        
				END;	 
			]]>
			</text>
	
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID"		name = "INSTANCE_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "FP_PLAN_ID" 		name = "FP_PLAN_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" 	name = "DIVISION_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" 		name = "SITE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" 		name = "PLANT_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" 	name = "TOP_ITEM_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" 		name = "PLAN_DATE"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SALES_QTY" 		name = "SALES_QTY"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "CATEGORY_ID" 	name = "CATEGORY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SEQ" 			name = "SEQ"  				dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" 		name = "USER_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			</parameters>

  		</update-sql>
  		
	</update-batch>
	  
</update-batchs>
