<update-batchs>
	
	<update-batch id= "insert_Excel_buffer">
		
		<insert-sql>
     
    
			<text>
      		<![CDATA[
					
						INSERT INTO BUF_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R (
							INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
							,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
							,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
							,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
							,CATEGORY_ID
							,PLAN_DATE
							,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
							,CELL_OUT_QTY
							,OUT_QTY
							,DATE_SEQ
							,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
						)
						VALUES (
							UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@INSTANCE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_PLAN_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)))
							,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)))
							,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LOCATION))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@MARKET)))
							,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE))
							,'PLAN'
							,CONVERT(DATE, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE)))
							,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TOP_ITEM_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_TYPE))
							,RTRIM(LTRIM(@CELL_OUT_QTY))
							,RTRIM(LTRIM(@OUT_QTY))
							,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@OUT_QTY)),0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END 
							,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
						)
			
			]]>
			</text>

			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" 		name = "INSTANCE_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "FP_PLAN_ID" 			name = "FP_PLAN_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" 			name = "COMPANY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" 		name = "DIVISION_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" 			name = "SITE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" 			name = "PLANT_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" 			name = "FACTORY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" 		name = "OPERATION_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "LINE_ID" 			name = "LINE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "LOCATION" 			name = "LOCATION"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" 	name = "PRODUCTION_TYPE"  	dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "MARKET" 				name = "MARKET"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "ELECTRODE_TYPE" 		name = "ELECTRODE_TYPE"  	dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" 		name = "TOP_ITEM_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" 			name = "ITEM_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "ITEM_TYPE" 			name = "ITEM_TYPE"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" 			name = "PLAN_DATE"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "CELL_OUT_QTY" 		name = "CELL_OUT_QTY"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "OUT_QTY" 			name = "OUT_QTY"			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" 			name = "USER_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "JOB_ORDER" 			name = "JOB_ORDER"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
			</parameters>
	
		</insert-sql>
		
	</update-batch>

	<update-batch id = "merge_ExcelImport">
	
		<insert-sql>
      
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
						BEGIN
						
							MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R AS A
							USING ( SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, BB.FP_PLAN_ID
							             , (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
							             , BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.ITEM_ID, BB.OPERATION_ID
							             , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
							             , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
							             , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
							             , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
							             , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE, BB.CELL_OUT_QTY, BB.OUT_QTY AS QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
							        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
							        LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
							                   A.ITEM_ID,
							                   (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
							                   	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
							                   	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
							                   ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
							            FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
							              		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
							            WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
							        ) CC
							        ON  (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID) = CC.COMPANY_ID
							        AND BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
							        AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
							        AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
							        WHERE BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
								    ) AS B
							      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
							        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
							        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
							        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
							        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
							        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
							        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
							        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
							        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
							        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
							        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
							        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
							        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
							        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
							        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
							        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
							        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
							        WHEN MATCHED THEN
							      		UPDATE SET OUT_QTY = B.QTY, IN_QTY = FLOOR(B.QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
							                                                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
							                                                                ) EEE
							                                                                ON     1=1
							                                                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
							                   , CELL_OUT_QTY = B.CELL_OUT_QTY, CELL_IN_QTY = FLOOR(B.CELL_OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
														                                                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
														                                                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
														                                                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
														                                                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
														                                                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
														                                                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
														                                                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
														                                                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
														                                                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
														                                                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
														                                                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
														                                                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
														                                                                ) EEE
														                                                                ON     1=1
														                                                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
														                                                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
							                   , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
							    		           , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
											   , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE    		           
						      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
						      		INSERT (
						               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
						              ,COMPANY_ID
						              ,DIVISION_ID
						              ,CATEGORY_ID
						              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
						              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
						              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
						              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
						              ,PLAN_DATE
						              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
						              ,IN_QTY
						              ,OUT_QTY
						              ,CELL_IN_QTY
						              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
						              ,DATE_SEQ
						              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
						              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
						      		)
						      		VALUES (
						               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
						              ,B.COMPANY_ID
						              ,B.DIVISION_ID
						              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
						              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
						              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
						              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
						              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
						              ,B.PLAN_DATE
						              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
						              ,FLOOR(B.QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
						                                ) EEE
						                                ON     1=1
						                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
						              ,B.QTY
						              ,FLOOR(B.CELL_OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
								                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
								                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
								                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
								                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
								                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
								                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
								                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
								                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
								                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
								                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
								                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
								                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
								                                ) EEE
								                                ON     1=1
									                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
									                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
									                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
									                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
									                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
									                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
									                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
									                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
									              ,B.CELL_OUT_QTY 
									              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
									              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
									              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
									      		)
									          ;
									      	  
					        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R (
					               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
					              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
					              ,CATEGORY_ID
					              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
					              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
					              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
					              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
					              ,PLAN_DATE
					              ,CELL_IN_QTY
					              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
					              ,IN_QTY
					              ,OUT_QTY
					              ,DATE_SEQ
					              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
					              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
					              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME,JOB_TYPE
					        )
					        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
					              ,(SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID
					              ,'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
					              ,A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
					              ,A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
					              ,A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
					              ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE
					              ,A.PLAN_DATE
					              ,A.CELL_IN_QTY
					              ,A.CELL_OUT_QTY
					              ,A.IN_QTY
					              ,A.OUT_QTY
					              ,A.DATE_SEQ
					              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
					              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
					              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL2' AS JOB_TYPE
						    FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        					WHERE  JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      						;
      	
      				END;
    
			]]>
			</text>

			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" 			name = "USER_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
				<parameter replace-what = "NEW_SEQ" 			name = "NEW_SEQ"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 	dbLen = "100" 	/>
			</parameters>
		
		</insert-sql>

	</update-batch>
</update-batchs>

</SQLS>

<SQLS id="FP00601_LINEADD">


<simple-sqls>
    
	<sql id="find_target_info">
	
		<text>
		<![CDATA[
				
				  SELECT A.*
			           , '' AS MSG1
			           , CASE WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000','P5500','P9500') AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = 'TEST') THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market' 
			                  WHEN I.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ''
			                  WHEN H.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market'
			                  ELSE '' END AS MSG2
			           , CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
			      FROM (
			      			SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID
					              , (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M FF WHERE FF.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID
					              , @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
					              , @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, @LOCATION AS LOCATION
					              , @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
					              , @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, '-' AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
					              , @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID
			      ) A
			      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
			          			SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
			          					--, A.MARKET, (CASE WHEN A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 'S-TEST' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
								FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  1=1 	--(A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+A.SCP_PLAN_ID) IN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+MAX(SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID FROM FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID)
								AND    EXISTS (
										SELECT 1
										FROM (
												SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID, MAX(SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID 
												FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK), (
														SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
														FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
														WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
														AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
														AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
														AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
												) B
												WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
												AND    A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
												AND    A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
												AND    A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
												AND    A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = B.SHOP_GROUP_ID
												GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
										) BB
										WHERE A.COMPANY_ID    = BB.COMPANY_ID
										AND   A.DIVISION_ID   = BB.DIVISION_ID
										AND   A.SITE_ID       = BB.SITE_ID
										AND   A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = BB.SHOP_GROUP_ID
										AND   A.SCP_PLAN_ID   = BB.SCP_PLAN_ID
								)
								AND    A.MFG_WEEK IN (
								    SELECT DISTINCT ISO_YYYYWW
								    FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								    WHERE  A.YYYYMMDD <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) + (((	SELECT MAX(ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE13,10)) AS ENGINE_PLAN_PER_WEEK 
								    																			FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
								    																			WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID' 
								    																			AND A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID ) -1 ) * 7 ) ) , 112)
								)
								UNION ALL
								SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
								--, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
								FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_TEST_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  A.DUE_DATE <= CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) + (((	SELECT MAX(ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE13,10)) AS ENGINE_PLAN_PER_WEEK 
																											FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
																											WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID' 
																											AND A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID ) -1 ) * 7 ), 112)
			      ) H
			      ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = H.COMPANY_ID
			      AND A.DIVISION_ID = H.DIVISION_ID
			      AND A.SITE_ID     = H.SITE_ID
			      AND A.PLANT_ID    = H.PLANT_ID
			      --AND A.MARKET      = H.MARKET
			      AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = H.ITEM_ID
			      --AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = H.PRODUCTION_TYPE
			  	  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			    			SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID, A.SEGMENT3 AS SITE_ID, A.SEGMENT4 AS PLANT_ID, A.SEGMENT5 AS MODEL_ID
			    			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
			    			WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AMEND_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION'
			    			AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
			    			AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @INSTANCE_ID
			  	  ) I
			  	  ON  A.DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID
			  	  AND A.SITE_ID     = I.SITE_ID
			  	  AND A.PLANT_ID    = I.PLANT_ID
			  	  AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = I.MODEL_ID
			  	  	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
									FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
									WHERE	1=1
									AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
									AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
									AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
					) R
					ON		1=1
					AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
					AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
					AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
					AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
					AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
					AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
					AND		A.LINE_ID			= R.LINE_ID
    
		]]>
		</text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID"		name = "INSTANCE_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" 	name = "DIVISION_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" 		name = "SITE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" 		name = "PLANT_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" 		name = "FACTORY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" 	name = "OPERATION_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "LINE_ID" 		name = "LINE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" name = "PRODUCTION_TYPE"  	dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "MARKET" 			name = "MARKET"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "LOCATION" 		name = "LOCATION"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "ELECTRODE_TYPE" 	name = "ELECTRODE_TYPE"  	dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" 	name = "TOP_ITEM_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" 		name = "ITEM_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" 		name = "PLAN_DATE"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" 		name = "USER_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
		</parameters>

	</sql>

	
</simple-sqls>

<update-batchs>


	<update-batch id="save_all">
  		
	  	<insert-sql>
	  
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
			
					BEGIN
					BEGIN TRAN
					
						MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R A
				        USING (SELECT 	UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID) AS INSTANCE_ID, UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID) AS FP_PLAN_ID,
					                        UPPER(@DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID, UPPER(@SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID,
					                        UPPER(@PLANT_ID) AS PLANT_ID, UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID, UPPER(@ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, UPPER(@OPERATION_ID) AS OPERATION_ID,
					                        UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, UPPER(@MARKET) AS MARKET,
					                        UPPER(@FACTORY_ID) AS FACTORY_ID, UPPER(@LINE_ID) AS LINE_ID, '-' AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
					                        @DATE AS PLAN_DATE, UPPER(@LOCATION) AS LOCATION) B
				          ON (    	A.INSTANCE_ID 	= B.INSTANCE_ID 
				          		AND A.FP_PLAN_ID 	= B.FP_PLAN_ID
				              	AND A.DIVISION_ID 	= B.DIVISION_ID 
				              	AND A.CATEGORY_ID 	= B.CATEGORY_ID 
				              	AND A.SITE_ID 		= B.SITE_ID
				              	AND A.PLANT_ID 		= B.PLANT_ID 
				              	AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID 	= B.TOP_ITEM_ID
				              	AND A.ITEM_ID 		= B.ITEM_ID 
				              	AND A.OPERATION_ID 	= B.OPERATION_ID
				              	AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE 
				              	AND A.MARKET 		= B.MARKET
				              	AND A.FACTORY_ID 	= B.FACTORY_ID 
				              	AND A.LINE_ID 		= B.LINE_ID 
				              	AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
				              	AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE 
				              	AND A.LOCATION 		= B.LOCATION
				             )
				          WHEN MATCHED THEN
				            UPDATE SET 	OUT_QTY = @QTY
				            		 	, IN_QTY  = FLOOR(@QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
				                                                  FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
				                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
				                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
				                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
				                                                      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
				                                                      AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
				                                                      AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
				                                                      AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
				                                                      AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
				                                                      AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
				                                                      AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
				                                                      AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
				                                                  ) B
				                                                  ON     1=1
				                                                  WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
				                                                  AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
				                                                  AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
				                                                  AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
				                                                  AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
				                                                  AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
				                                                  AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
				                                                  AND    A.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(@DATE,1,6)))
					                     ,CELL_IN_QTY = CEILING(FLOOR(@QTY / ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY IS NULL OR A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY END)
												    							 FROM   FP_ITEM_CELL_EXCHANGE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
												                                 WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
												                                 AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
												                                 AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
					    														 AND    A.MODEL_ID     = @TOP_ITEM_ID
					    														 AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID) )
							        				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
							        					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
							        					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							        						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							        						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
							        						WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
							        						AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
							        						AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
							        						AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
							        						AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
							        						AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
							        						AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
							        						AND    CONVERT(DATE,@DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
							        					) B
							        					ON     1=1
							        					WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
							        					AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
							        					AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
							        					AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
							        					AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
							        					AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
							        					AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
							        					AND    A.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(@DATE,1,6)) )
							        ,CELL_OUT_QTY = FLOOR(@QTY / (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY IS NULL OR A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY END)
																	FROM   FP_ITEM_CELL_EXCHANGE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
											                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
											                        AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
											                        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
																	AND    A.MODEL_ID     = @TOP_ITEM_ID
																	AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID) )
				                     , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(@QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				                     , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
				                     , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
				        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				          INSERT (
				               	 INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
						        ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
						        ,CATEGORY_ID
						        ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
						        ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
						        ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
						        ,PLAN_DATE
						        ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
						        ,IN_QTY
						        ,OUT_QTY
						        ,CELL_IN_QTY
						        ,CELL_OUT_QTY
						        ,DATE_SEQ
						        ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
						        ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
				          )
				          VALUES (
				               	UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID), UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID)
						        ,(SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID AND SITE_ID = @SITE_ID AND PLANT_ID = @PLANT_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'), @DIVISION_ID
						        ,'PLAN'
						        ,UPPER(@SITE_ID), UPPER(@PLANT_ID), UPPER(@ITEM_ID), UPPER(@OPERATION_ID), UPPER(@FACTORY_ID)
						        ,UPPER(@LOCATION), UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE), UPPER(@MARKET)
						        ,UPPER(@LINE_ID), '-'
						        ,CONVERT(DATE,@DATE)
						        ,UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID), UPPER(@ITEM_TYPE)
						        ,FLOOR(@QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>

		<update-batch id = 'saveAll_MPPWPP'>
  		
  		<insert-sql>
  
			<text>
	      	<![CDATA[
						BEGIN
					        BEGIN TRAN
					          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_H A
					          USING (SELECT UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID) AS INSTANCE_ID, UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID) AS FP_PLAN_ID,
					                        UPPER(@DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID, UPPER(@SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID,
					                        UPPER(@PLANT_ID) AS PLANT_ID, UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID, UPPER(@ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, UPPER(@OPERATION_ID) AS OPERATION_ID,
					                        UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, UPPER(@MARKET) AS MARKET,
					                        UPPER(@FACTORY_ID) AS FACTORY_ID, UPPER(@LINE_ID) AS LINE_ID, '-' AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
					                        @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE, UPPER(@LOCATION) AS LOCATION) B
					          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
					              AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
					              AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
					              AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
					              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET
					              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
					              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION)
					          WHEN MATCHED THEN
					            UPDATE SET WPP_OUT_QTY = @WPP_OUT_QTY
					                		 , WPP_IN_QTY  = CEILING(@WPP_OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                              FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                                              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					                                                                  SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
					                                                                  FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                                                  WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
					                                                                  AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
					                                                                  AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
					                                                                  AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
					                                                                  AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID

					                     , (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID

					                     , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
					                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
					                     , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
					                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
					                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE
					                     , BB.OUT_QTY AS QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
					                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
					                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
					                           A.ITEM_ID,
					                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
					                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
					                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
					                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
					                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
					                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
					                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
					                ) CC
					                ON  (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') = CC.COMPANY_ID
					                AND BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
					                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
					                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
					                WHERE BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
					      		    ) AS B
					      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
					        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
					        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
					        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
					        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
					        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
					        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
					        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
					        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
					        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
					        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
					        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
					        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
					        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
					        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
					        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
					        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
					        WHEN MATCHED THEN
					      		UPDATE SET @OUT_QTY = B.QTY, @IN_QTY = CEILING(B.QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                                                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					                                                                        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
					                                                                        FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                                                        WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
					                                                                        AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
					                                                                        AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
					                                                                        AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
					                                                                        AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
					                                                                        AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
					                                                                        AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
					                                                                        AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
					                                                                    ) EEE
					                                                                    ON     1=1
					                                                                    WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
					                                                                    AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
					                   , @CELL_OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.QTY / ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY IS NULL OR CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY END)
					                              												FROM   FP_ITEM_CELL_EXCHANGE_M CCC WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                                      WHERE  CCC.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
					                                                      AND    CCC.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
					                                                      AND    CCC.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
					                              												AND    CCC.MODEL_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
					                              												AND    CCC.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID) )
					                   , @CELL_IN_QTY = CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY / ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY IS NULL OR CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY END)
					                                														 FROM   FP_ITEM_CELL_EXCHANGE_M CCC WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                                             WHERE  CCC.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
					                                                             AND    CCC.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
					                                                             AND    CCC.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
					                                														 AND    CCC.MODEL_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
					                                														 AND    CCC.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID) )
					                                      				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                      					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                      					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					                                      						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
					                                      						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
					                                      						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
					                                      						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
					                                      						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
					                                      						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
					                                      						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
					                                      						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
					                                      						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                      					) EEE
                                      					ON     1=1
                                      					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,@IN_QTY
              ,@OUT_QTY
              ,@CELL_IN_QTY
              ,@CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
              ,CEILING(B.QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                ) EEE
                                ON     1=1
                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,B.QTY
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY / ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY IS NULL OR CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY END)
          														 FROM   FP_ITEM_CELL_EXCHANGE_M CCC WITH(NOLOCK)
                                       WHERE  CCC.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND    CCC.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                       AND    CCC.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
          														 AND    CCC.MODEL_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
          														 AND    CCC.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID) )
                				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                					) EEE
                					ON     1=1
                					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
              ,FLOOR(B.QTY / ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY IS NULL OR CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CCC.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY END)
        												FROM   FP_ITEM_CELL_EXCHANGE_M CCC WITH(NOLOCK)
                                WHERE  CCC.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                AND    CCC.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                AND    CCC.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
        												AND    CCC.MODEL_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        												AND    CCC.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID) )
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID
              ,ITEM_TYPE
              ,@OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID
              ,ITEM_TYPE
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL2' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      	;
      	
      END;
	    
			]]>
			</text>
	
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID"		name = "INSTANCE_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "FP_PLAN_ID" 		name = "FP_PLAN_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" 		name = "COMPANY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" 	name = "DIVISION_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" 		name = "SITE_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" 		name = "PLANT_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" 		name = "FACTORY_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />

				<parameter replace-what = "LOCATION" 		name = "LOCATION"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" name = "PRODUCTION_TYPE"  	dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />

				<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" 		name = "PLAN_DATE"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" 	name = "TOP_ITEM_ID"  		dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" 		name = "ITEM_ID"  			dbType = "NVarChar" 		dbLen = "100" />

<SQLS id="FP00601_PLAN_AMEND_BY_LINE_PACK">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>

<update-batchs>

	<update-batch id = 'merge_data'>
  		
  		<insert-sql>
  
			<text>
	      	<![CDATA[
						BEGIN
				        BEGIN TRAN
				          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R A
				          USING (SELECT UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID) AS INSTANCE_ID, UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID) AS FP_PLAN_ID,
				                        UPPER(@DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID, UPPER(@SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID,

				                        UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, UPPER(@MARKET) AS MARKET,
				                        UPPER(@FACTORY_ID) AS FACTORY_ID, UPPER(@LINE_ID) AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
				                        @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE, UPPER(@LOCATION) AS LOCATION) B
				          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
				              AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
				              AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
				              AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
				              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET
				              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
				              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION)
				          WHEN MATCHED then
				            UPDATE SET OUT_QTY = @OUT_QTY
			                		 , IN_QTY  = FLOOR(@OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
			                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			                                                      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			                                                          SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
			                                                          FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			                                                          WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
			                                                          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
			                                                          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
			                                                          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
			                                                          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
			                                                          AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
			                                                          AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
			                                                          AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
			                                                      ) B
			                                                      ON     1=1
			                                                      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		                                                          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		                                                          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
			                                                      AND    A.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(@PLAN_DATE,1,6)))
			                     ,  UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
			                     , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
				          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				            INSERT (
						               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
						              ,COMPANY_ID
						              ,DIVISION_ID
						              ,CATEGORY_ID
						              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
						              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
						              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
						              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
						              ,PLAN_DATE

						              ,IN_QTY
						              ,OUT_QTY
						              ,DATE_SEQ
						              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
						              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
				            )
				            VALUES (
					            	  UPPER(@INSTANCE_ID), UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID)

						              ,UPPER(@ITEM_ID), UPPER(@OPERATION_ID), UPPER(@FACTORY_ID), UPPER(@LOCATION)
						              ,UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE), UPPER(@MARKET)
						              ,UPPER(@LINE_ID), @ELECTRODE_TYPE
						              ,CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE)
						              ,UPPER(@TOP_ITEM_ID), UPPER(@ITEM_TYPE)
						              ,FLOOR(@OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(B.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(A.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(A.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                        FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		                                                          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		                                                          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
		                                                          AND    A.LINE_ID      = @LINE_ID
		                                                          AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
		                                                          AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
		                                                      ) B
		                                                      ON     1=1
		                                                      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		                                                      AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		                                                      AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		                                                      AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		                                                      AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID

		                                                      AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID

				                  ,CATEGORY_ID

				                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'UPDATE' AS JOB_TYPE
				            FROM   FP_AMEND_PLAN_PACK_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
				            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
				            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
				            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
				            AND    A.CATEGORY_ID      = 'PLAN'
				            AND    A.SITE_ID          = @SITE_ID
				            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID

				            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
				            AND    A.PLAN_DATE        = CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE)
				            ;
				          
				        COMMIT;
				        
				        
				      END;
	    
			]]>
			</text>
	
			<parameters>

<SQLS id="FP00602_EXCELIMPORT">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      DELETE FROM BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R
      WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,case when B.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Factory' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.LINE_ID is null then 'Line' else '' end as msg3
                ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg99
          FROM   BUF_EQUIPMENT_M A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) B
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
            FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID
            FROM   SCM_LINE_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) D
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
          	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
					FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE	1=1
					AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
					AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
			) R
			ON		1=1
			AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
			AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
			AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
			AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
