		<update-batch id = "merge_ExcelImport">
			<insert-sql>
	
      
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
      	MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R AS A
      	USING ( SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, BB.FP_PLAN_ID
                     , DD.COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
                     , BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.ITEM_ID, BB.OPERATION_ID
                     , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                     , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE, BB.CELL_OUT_QTY, BB.OUT_QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON  BB.FACTORY_ID     = DD.FACTORY_ID
                AND DD.COMPANY_ID     = CC.COMPANY_ID
								AND DD.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
                WHERE  BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET
      		       IN_QTY  = CEILING(FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                                  / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
      		     , CELL_IN_QTY  = CEILING(B.OUT_QTY / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , CELL_OUT_QTY = B.OUT_QTY
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.OUT_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,IN_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,CELL_IN_QTY
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                      / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
    			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
    			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
    			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
    			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
    			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
    			                                ) EEE
    			                                ON     1=1
    			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1))
              ,CEILING(B.OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
		                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
		                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
		                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
		                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
		                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
		                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
		                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
		                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
		                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
		                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
		                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
		                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
		                                ) EEE
		                                ON     1=1
		                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
		                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
		                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
		                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
		                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
		                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
		                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
		                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,B.OUT_QTY
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.OUT_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,DD.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID

              ,A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID

              ,A.OUT_QTY AS CELL_OUT_QTY -- cell value
              ,FLOOR(A.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(A.PLANT_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE),1) ) AS OUT_QTY

              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON    A.FACTORY_ID   = DD.FACTORY_ID

      <![CDATA[

      DELETE FROM BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R
      WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
    
     
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,case when B.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Factory' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.LINE_ID is null then 'Line' else '' end as msg3
                ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.EQUIPMENT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg99
          FROM   BUF_EQUIPMENT_M A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) B
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
            FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID
            FROM   SCM_LINE_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) D
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
          	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
					FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE	1=1
					AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
					AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
			) R
			ON		1=1
			AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
			AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
			AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
			AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
			AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
			AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>



    </sql>

  <update-batch id= "insert_Excel_buffer">
  	<insert-sql>
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      INSERT INTO BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
         INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
        ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
        ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
        ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
        ,CATEGORY_ID
        ,PLAN_DATE
        ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
        ,CELL_OUT_QTY
        ,OUT_QTY
        ,DATE_SEQ
        ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
      )
      VALUES (
         UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@INSTANCE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_PLAN_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LOCATION))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@MARKET)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))), UPPER(SUBSTRING(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE)),1,1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE)),2,99))
        ,'PLAN'
        ,CONVERT(DATE, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TOP_ITEM_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_TYPE))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@CELL_OUT_QTY))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@QTY))
        ,RTRIM(CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@QTY)),0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) 
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
      )
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" name="COMPANY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

        <parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "MARKET" name="MARKET"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ELECTRODE_TYPE" name="ELECTRODE_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" name="TOP_ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

        <parameter replace-what = "CELL_OUT_QTY" name="CELL_OUT_QTY"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

		<update-batch id = "merge_ExcelImport">
			<insert-sql>
	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
      	MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R AS A
      	USING ( SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, UPPER(@FP_PLAN_ID) AS FP_PLAN_ID
                     , (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
                     , BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.ITEM_ID, BB.OPERATION_ID
                     , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                     , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE, BB.CELL_OUT_QTY, BB.OUT_QTY AS QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') = CC.COMPANY_ID
                AND BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                WHERE BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET 
      		       IN_QTY  = CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                                  / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
      		     , CELL_IN_QTY  = CEILING(B.QTY / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
            			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
            			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
            			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
            			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
            			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
            			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
            			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
            			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
            			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
            			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
            			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
            			                                ) EEE
            			                                ON     1=1
            			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
            			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , CELL_OUT_QTY = B.QTY
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,IN_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,CELL_IN_QTY
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
      		    ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                        / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
      			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
      			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
      			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
      			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
      			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
      			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
      			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
      			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
      			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
      			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
      			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
      			                                ) EEE
      			                                ON     1=1
      			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
      			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		    ,FLOOR(B.QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
      		    ,CEILING(B.QTY / (  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
	                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
	                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
	                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
	                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
	                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
	                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
	                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
	                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
	                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
	                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
	                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
	                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
	                                ) EEE
	                                ON     1=1
	                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
	                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
	                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
	                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
	                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
	                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
	                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
	                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		    ,B.QTY
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME,JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID
              ,(SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID
              ,'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
              ,A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
              ,A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE
              ,A.PLAN_DATE
              ,FLOOR(A.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(A.PLANT_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE),1) ) AS OUT_QTY
              ,A.OUT_QTY AS CELL_OUT_QTY -- cell value
              ,A.DATE_SEQ
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL2' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      	;
      	
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "NEW_SEQ" name="NEW_SEQ"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

<SQLS id="FP00602_LINEADD">

  <simple-sqls>
  
  <sql id="find_pdsType">
    <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT DISTINCT IV.COMPANY_ID, IV.DIVISION_ID, IV.SITE_ID, IV.PLANT_ID, SS.PRODUCTION_TYPE, SS.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        FROM   FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V IV WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SV WITH(NOLOCK)
        , (
          SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SS WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE 1=1
          AND SS.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
          AND SS.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          AND SS.ATTRIBUTE5   = 'Y' -- PDA TARGET FLAG
          --AND SV.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'Y' -- VERSION ONLY
        ) SS
        WHERE	1=1
        AND		SV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'PDS_INSTANCE'
        AND		SV.ACTIVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
        AND		SV.SEGMENT1	  	= IV.INSTANCE_ID
        AND		IV.INSTANCE_ID	= @INSTANCE_ID
        AND		IV.DIVISION_ID	= SS.DIVISION_ID
      ]]>
    </text>
    <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
    </parameters>
  </sql>
  
  <sql id="find_pdsItemLineList">
    <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
             , E.MODEL_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, E.NICK_NAME, E.ITEM_TYPE
             , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	 , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
        FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK) 
        , (
            SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID 
            FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK) 
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
            GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID 
        ) B
        , SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
        , (
        	SELECT DISTINCT IV.COMPANY_ID, IV.DIVISION_ID, IV.SITE_ID, IV.PLANT_ID, SS.PRODUCTION_TYPE, SS.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V IV WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SV WITH(NOLOCK)
        	, (
        			SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SS WITH(NOLOCK)
        			WHERE 1=1
        			AND SS.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
        			AND SS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        			AND SS.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' -- PDA TARGET FLAG
        			--AND SV.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'Y' -- VERSION ONLY
        	) SS
        	WHERE	1=1
        	AND		SV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'PDS_INSTANCE'
        	AND		SV.ACTIVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
        	AND		SV.SEGMENT1		  = IV.INSTANCE_ID
        	AND		IV.INSTANCE_ID	= @INSTANCE_ID
        	AND		IV.DIVISION_ID	=  SS.DIVISION_ID
        ) D
        , (
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                ,ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME, A.FLOW_ID
        		,(CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                       WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                       ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE
            FROM SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                 SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE B WITH(NOLOCK),
                 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK),
            (
        		SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
        		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
        		WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
        		AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
        		AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
        		AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
        		AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        		AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
        		AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
            ) D
            WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
            AND	  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
            AND	  A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
            AND	  A.ITEM_ID     = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
            AND	  A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
            AND   A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
            AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
            AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
            AND   A.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
            AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND   C.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND   B.EFF_END_DATE >= GETDATE()
        ) E 
        , SCM_LINE_M F WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  1=1 
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID 
        AND    A.MFG_WEEK >= (SELECT (ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_DATE)
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID 
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID 
        AND    C.MONTH = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @PLAN_DATE)
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = D.PRODUCTION_TYPE -- DEMAND_TYPE
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.MODEL        = E.MODEL_ID
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID 
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = F.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = F.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = F.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = F.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = F.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = F.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = F.LINE_ID 
        AND    C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = F.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
        @CTRL_OPERATION
        @CTRL_LINE
        @CTRL_ITEM
        @CTRL_NICK
        GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	   , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION, E.NICK_NAME, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
               , E.ITEM_TYPE, E.MODEL_ID
        ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, E.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	   , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
        	   , E.NICK_NAME, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
      ]]>
    </text>
    <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_OPERATION" name="CTRL_OPERATION"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_LINE" name="CTRL_LINE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_ITEM" name="CTRL_ITEM"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_NICK" name="CTRL_NICK"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    </parameters>
  </sql>

  <sql id="find_InstanceType">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISNULL(ATTRIBUTE1,'BUILDING') AS CONFIRM_AREA
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
      AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID

    <sql id = "find_ItemList">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH INST_OP AS (
        	SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
        	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
        	AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
        	AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        	AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
        	AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      )
      , CTE_NODE(COMPANY_ID,DIVISION_ID,SITE_ID,PLANT_ID,PARENT_ITEM_ID,CHILD_ITEM_ID,KEY_DATE,EFF_START_DATE,EFF_END_DATE,PARENT_QTY,PARENT_UOM,CHILD_QTY,CHILD_UOM
      	,PARENT_ITEM_TYPE,PARENT_ITEM_CLASS,PARENT_NICK_NAME,PARENT_LEVEL_2_CODE,PARENT_LEVEL_3_NAME,PARENT_LEVEL_4_NAME
      	,CHILD_ITEM_TYPE,CHILD_ITEM_CLASS,CHILD_NICK_NAME,CHILD_LEVEL_2_CODE,CHILD_LEVEL_3_NAME,CHILD_LEVEL_4_NAME
      	,NLEVEL,NPATH,ROOT, FLOW_ID)
      AS (
        	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.PARENT_ITEM_ID,A.CHILD_ITEM_ID,A.KEY_DATE,A.EFF_START_DATE,A.EFF_END_DATE,A.PARENT_QTY,A.PARENT_UOM,A.CHILD_QTY,A.CHILD_UOM
        		 , PD1.ITEM_TYPE AS PARENT_ITEM_TYPE
        		 , PD1.ITEM_CLASS AS PARENT_ITEM_CLASS
        		 , PD1.NICK_NAME AS PARENT_NICK_NAME
        		 , PDC1.LEVEL_2_CODE AS PARENT_LEVEL_2_CODE
        		 , PDC1.LEVEL_3_NAME AS PARENT_LEVEL_3_NAME
        		 , PDC1.LEVEL_4_NAME AS PARENT_LEVEL_4_NAME
        		 , PD2.ITEM_TYPE AS CHILD_ITEM_TYPE
        		 , PD2.ITEM_CLASS AS CHILD_ITEM_CLASS
        		 , PD2.NICK_NAME AS CHILD_NICK_NAME
        		 , PDC2.LEVEL_2_CODE AS CHILD_LEVEL_2_CODE
        		 , PDC2.LEVEL_3_NAME AS CHILD_LEVEL_3_NAME
        		 , PDC2.LEVEL_4_NAME AS CHILD_LEVEL_4_NAME
        		 , 1 AS NLEVEL,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),PARENT_ITEM_ID+'/'+CHILD_ITEM_ID) AS NPATH,PARENT_ITEM_ID AS ROOT 
        		 , PD1.FLOW_ID
        	FROM SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M PD1 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON  A.COMPANY_ID     = PD1.COMPANY_ID
        	AND A.DIVISION_ID    = PD1.DIVISION_ID
        	AND A.SITE_ID        = PD1.SITE_ID
        	AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = PD1.ITEM_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M PDC1 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON PD1.ITEM_CLASS = PDC1.CLASS_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M PD2 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = PD2.COMPANY_ID
        	AND A.DIVISION_ID   = PD2.DIVISION_ID
        	AND A.SITE_ID       = PD2.SITE_ID
        	AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID = PD2.ITEM_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M PDC2 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON PD2.ITEM_CLASS=PDC2.CLASS_ID
          , INST_OP D
        	WHERE 1=1
        	AND   A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
        	AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
        	AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
        	AND   PD1.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
        	AND   A.EFF_START_DATE <= @DATE
        	AND   A.EFF_END_DATE   >  @DATE
        	AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
        	AND   PD1.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
        	AND   PDC1.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
        	AND   PD2.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
        	AND   PDC2.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
        	UNION ALL
        	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.PARENT_ITEM_ID,A.CHILD_ITEM_ID,A.KEY_DATE,A.EFF_START_DATE,A.EFF_END_DATE,A.PARENT_QTY,A.PARENT_UOM,A.CHILD_QTY,A.CHILD_UOM
        		 , PD1.ITEM_TYPE AS PARENT_ITEM_TYPE
        		 , PD1.ITEM_CLASS AS PARENT_ITEM_CLASS
        		 , PD1.NICK_NAME AS PARENT_NICK_NAME
        		 , PDC1.LEVEL_2_CODE AS PARENT_LEVEL_2_CODE
        		 , PDC1.LEVEL_3_NAME AS PARENT_LEVEL_3_NAME
        		 , PDC1.LEVEL_4_NAME AS PARENT_LEVEL_4_NAME
        		 , PD2.ITEM_TYPE AS CHILD_ITEM_TYPE
        		 , PD2.ITEM_CLASS AS CHILD_ITEM_CLASS
        		 , PD2.NICK_NAME AS CHILD_NICK_NAME
        		 , PDC2.LEVEL_2_CODE AS CHILD_LEVEL_2_CODE
        		 , PDC2.LEVEL_3_NAME AS CHILD_LEVEL_3_NAME
        		 , PDC2.LEVEL_4_NAME AS CHILD_LEVEL_4_NAME
        		 , NLEVEL+1 AS NLEVEL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),NPATH+'/'+A.CHILD_ITEM_ID) AS NPATH,ROOT
        		 , PD1.FLOW_ID
        	FROM SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	INNER JOIN CTE_NODE B
        	ON  A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
        	AND A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
        	AND A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
        	AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M PD1 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON  A.COMPANY_ID     = PD1.COMPANY_ID
        	AND A.DIVISION_ID    = PD1.DIVISION_ID
        	AND A.SITE_ID        = PD1.SITE_ID
        	AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = PD1.ITEM_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M PDC1 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON  PD1.ITEM_CLASS = PDC1.CLASS_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M PD2 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = PD2.COMPANY_ID
        	AND A.DIVISION_ID   = PD2.DIVISION_ID
        	AND A.SITE_ID       = PD2.SITE_ID
        	AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID = PD2.ITEM_ID
        	INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M PDC2 WITH(NOLOCK)
        	ON  PD2.ITEM_CLASS=PDC2.CLASS_ID
          , INST_OP D
        	WHERE 1=1
        	AND   A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
        	AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
        	AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
        	AND   PD1.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
        	AND   A.EFF_START_DATE <= @DATE -- 입력일자 기준으로 ECO 일자 지정
        	AND   A.EFF_END_DATE   >  @DATE
        	AND   PD1.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
        	AND   PDC1.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
        	AND   PD2.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
        	AND   PDC2.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      )
      SELECT DISTINCT A.*
      FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ROOT AS MODEL_ID, A.PARENT_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
          	 , A.PARENT_NICK_NAME AS NICK_NAME
          	 , (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND  ISNULL(A.PARENT_LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN A.PARENT_LEVEL_3_NAME
          			 WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(A.PARENT_LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
          			 ELSE A.PARENT_LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE
          FROM   CTE_NODE A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.ROOT        = B.ITEM_ID
          --AND    B.ITEM_TYPE   = 'P'
          AND    RIGHT(B.FLOW_ID,5) IN ('A3000','A9000')
          AND    EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                  				FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
                  				WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                  				AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  				AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                  				AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
                  				AND	   B.SAVE_FLAG	 = 'Y' )
          AND     
		 
              (ISNULL(@MODEL_ID,'')='' AND A.ROOT LIKE @MODEL_ID)
              (ISNULL(@ITEM_ID,'')='' AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID LIKE @ITEM_ID)
              (ISNULL(@ITEM_ID,'')='' AND A.PARENT_NICK_NAME LIKE @ITEM_ID)
          --[AND    A.ROOT LIKE '%' +  @MODEL_ID + '%']
          --[AND    A.PARENT_ITEM_ID LIKE '%' + @ITEM_ID + '%']
          --[AND    A.PARENT_NICK_NAME LIKE '%' + @NICK_NAME + '%']
      ) A
      ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "DATE" name="DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "MODEL_ID" name="MODEL_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    <sql id="find_LineList">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT DISTINCT 
             A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , ISNULL(B.LINE_NAME,'-') AS LINE_NAME
           , B.LOCATION
      FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
      AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      {
        var sql="";
        
        if($data.CONFIRM_AREA == "PLAN GROUP")  sql="INNER JOIN ";
        else                                    sql="LEFT OUTER JOIN ";
        
        sql;
      }
      (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          and    A.SEGMENT1    = @INSTANCE_ID
      ) C
      ON     B.MODEL_TYPE     = C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
      INNER JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
          AND 	 B.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
          AND    B.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
          AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      ) D
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = D.SITE_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D.OPERATION_ID
      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = @PLANT_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
      [AND    A.LINE_ID LIKE '%' +  @LINE_ID + '%']
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    A.MONTH          = SUBSTRING(@DATE,1,6)
      AND		 A.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0','9')
      AND    EXISTS (
			        	SELECT 1
			        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V BB WITH(NOLOCK)
			        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID     = BB.COMPANY_ID
			        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = BB.DIVISION_ID
			        	AND    A.SITE_ID        = BB.SITE_ID
			        	AND    A.PLANT_ID       = BB.PLANT_ID
					    AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = BB.FACTORY_ID
					    AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = BB.OPERATION_ID
					    AND    A.LINE_ID        = BB.LINE_ID
			        	AND    BB.USER_ID       = @USER_ID
			        	AND	   BB.SAVE_FLAG	  = 'Y'
				    )
      ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, LINE_NAME, LOCATION
    
{--SCRIPT RAW

        var param = $data.param;
        var param2 = $jdbc.queryList("FP00602_addLine","find_instanceType",param);
        
        param.CONFIRM_AREA = param2[0].confirm_area;
        
        $data.querySet1 = $jdbc.queryList("FP00602_addLine","find_LineList",param);
      
}
      ]]>
      </text>

    <sql id="find_target_info">
    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
 
      SELECT A.*
      		, '' AS MSG1
          , ( CASE --WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000','P5500','P9500') AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = 'TEST') THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market'
                   WHEN I.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ''
                   WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000') AND H.MARKET IS NULL AND (@INSTANCE_ID NOT IN ('KR_CELL_A2','KR_CELL_M2'))) THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market'
                   --WHEN H.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market' -- target 필수 조건 추가... 20210125
                   ELSE '' END ) AS MSG2
          , CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
      FROM (
          SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID
              , (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M FF WHERE FF.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID
              , @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
              , @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, @LOCATION AS LOCATION
              , @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
              , @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID
      ) A
      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.MARKET, A.ITEM_ID, (CASE WHEN A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 'S-TEST' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE  1=1 --(A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+A.SCP_PLAN_ID) IN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+MAX(SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID FROM FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID)
					AND    EXISTS (
							SELECT 1
							FROM (
									SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID, MAX(SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID 
									FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK), (
											SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
											FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
											WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
											AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
											AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
											AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
									) B
									WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
									AND    A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
									AND    A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
									AND    A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
									AND    A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = B.SHOP_GROUP_ID
									GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
							) BB
							WHERE A.COMPANY_ID    = BB.COMPANY_ID
							AND   A.DIVISION_ID   = BB.DIVISION_ID
							AND   A.SITE_ID       = BB.SITE_ID
							AND   A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = BB.SHOP_GROUP_ID
							AND   A.SCP_PLAN_ID   = BB.SCP_PLAN_ID
					)
					AND    A.MFG_WEEK IN (
					    SELECT DISTINCT ISO_YYYYWW
					    FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
					    WHERE  A.YYYYMMDD <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) + (((SELECT MAX(ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE13,10)) AS ENGINE_PLAN_PER_WEEK FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID' AND A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID)-1)*7) ), 112)
					)
					UNION ALL
					SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_TEST_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE  A.DUE_DATE <= CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) + (((SELECT MAX(ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE13,10)) AS ENGINE_PLAN_PER_WEEK FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID' AND A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID)-1)*7), 112)
      ) H
      ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = H.COMPANY_ID
      AND A.DIVISION_ID = H.DIVISION_ID
      AND A.SITE_ID     = H.SITE_ID
      AND A.PLANT_ID    = H.PLANT_ID
      AND A.MARKET      = H.MARKET
      AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = H.ITEM_ID
      AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = H.PRODUCTION_TYPE
  	  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    			SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID, A.SEGMENT3 AS SITE_ID, A.SEGMENT4 AS PLANT_ID, A.SEGMENT5 AS MODEL_ID
    			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
    			WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AMEND_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION'
    			AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
    			AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @INSTANCE_ID
  	  ) I
  	  ON  A.DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID
  	  AND A.SITE_ID     = I.SITE_ID
  	  AND A.PLANT_ID    = I.PLANT_ID
  	  AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = I.MODEL_ID
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE	1=1
						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
			) R
			ON		1=1
			AND		A.COMPANY_ID	 = R.COMPANY_ID
			AND		A.DIVISION_ID	 = R.DIVISION_ID
			AND		A.SITE_ID			 = R.SITE_ID
			AND		A.PLANT_ID		 = R.PLANT_ID
			AND		A.FACTORY_ID	 = R.FACTORY_ID
			AND		A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
			AND		A.LINE_ID		   = R.LINE_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

        <parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id="find_LineAdd_dup">

        ,@ITEM_TYPE

        ,@VERSION
        ,@QTY
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
        ,1
        ,@USER_ID , GETDATE() , 'INSERT'

		<update-batch id = "merge_ExcelImport">
			<insert-sql>
	
      
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
      	MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R AS A
      	USING ( SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, BB.FP_PLAN_ID
                     , DD.COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, 'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
                     , BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.ITEM_ID, BB.OPERATION_ID
                     , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                     , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE, BB.CELL_OUT_QTY, BB.OUT_QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON  BB.FACTORY_ID     = DD.FACTORY_ID
                AND DD.COMPANY_ID     = CC.COMPANY_ID
								AND DD.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
                WHERE  BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET
      		       IN_QTY  = CEILING(FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                                  / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
      		     , CELL_IN_QTY  = CEILING(B.OUT_QTY / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                			                                ) EEE
                			                                ON     1=1
                			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , CELL_OUT_QTY = B.OUT_QTY
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.OUT_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,IN_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,CELL_IN_QTY
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1) )
                                      / ( SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
    			                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
    			                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    			                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
    			                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
    			                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
    			                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
    			                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
    			                                ) EEE
    			                                ON     1=1
    			                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
    			                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,FLOOR(B.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE),1))
              ,CEILING(B.OUT_QTY / (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
		                                FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
		                                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
		                                    SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
		                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
		                                    WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
		                                    AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
		                                    AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
		                                    AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
		                                    AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
		                                    AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
		                                    AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
		                                    AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
		                                ) EEE
		                                ON     1=1
		                                WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
		                                AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
		                                AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
		                                AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
		                                AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
		                                AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
		                                AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
		                                AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
              ,B.OUT_QTY
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.OUT_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,DD.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID
              ,'PLAN' AS CATEGORY_ID
              ,A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
              ,A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE
              ,A.PLAN_DATE
              ,A.OUT_QTY AS CELL_OUT_QTY -- cell value
              ,FLOOR(A.OUT_QTY * ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(A.PLANT_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE),1) ) AS OUT_QTY
              ,A.DATE_SEQ
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON    A.FACTORY_ID   = DD.FACTORY_ID
        AND	  DD.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        WHERE JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      	;
      	
      END;
    
      ]]>
