                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , BB.OUT_QTY AS QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                     , BB.VERSION, (case when BB.PLM_EC_NO is null or BB.PLM_EC_NO = '' then '-' else BB.PLM_EC_NO end) AS PLM_EC_NO
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') = CC.COMPANY_ID
                AND BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                WHERE BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        AND A.VERSION         = B.VERSION
        AND A.PLM_EC_NO       = B.PLM_EC_NO
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET @IN_QTY = CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE) )
                        				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                        					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                        					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                        						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                        						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                        						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                        					) EEE
                        					ON     1=1
                        					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
          		 , @OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE) )
          		 , @CELL_IN_QTY = CEILING(B.QTY / (  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                                        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                                        FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                        WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                        AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                                        AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                                        AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                        AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                        AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                                        AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                        AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                                    ) EEE
                                                    ON     1=1
                                                    WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , @CELL_OUT_QTY = B.QTY
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,@IN_QTY
              ,@OUT_QTY
              ,@CELL_IN_QTY
              ,@CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,VERSION, PLM_EC_NO
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE))
                        				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                        					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                        					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                        						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                        						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                        						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                        					) EEE
                        					ON     1=1
                        					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
          		,FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE) )
          		,CEILING(B.QTY / (  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                  FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                      WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                      AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                      AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                      AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                      AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                      AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                  ) EEE
                                  ON     1=1
                                  WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                  AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                  AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                  AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                  AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                  AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                  AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		    ,B.QTY
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,B.VERSION, B.PLM_EC_NO
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID
              ,ITEM_TYPE
              ,@CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
              ,VERSION, PLM_EC_NO
        )
        SELECT INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID
              ,ITEM_TYPE
              ,OUT_QTY AS CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL2' AS JOB_TYPE
              ,VERSION, (case when PLM_EC_NO is null or PLM_EC_NO = '' then '-' else PLM_EC_NO end) AS PLM_EC_NO
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      	;
      	
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="NEW_SEQ" name="NEW_SEQ" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="IN_QTY" name="IN_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="OUT_QTY" name="OUT_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="CELL_IN_QTY" name="CELL_IN_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="CELL_OUT_QTY" name="CELL_OUT_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

	</sql>

    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                                 THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                                   THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                                     THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                                       THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                                         THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                                                           THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                                             THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')                               THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '')                 THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '')  THEN MSG11 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG11 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG11 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '')  THEN MSG12 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG12 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG12 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT
                     A.INSTANCE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                    ,A.ITEM_ID, B.NICK_NAME, B.ITEM_TYPE, A.TOP_ITEM_ID
                    ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                    ,A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                    ,A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.LOCATION
                    ,A.PLAN_DATE, A.QTY, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
                    ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                    ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                    ,CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                    ,CASE WHEN D.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line - Electrode Type - Location' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                    ,CASE WHEN E.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                    ,CASE WHEN F.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                    ,(CASE WHEN @CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING' THEN (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Building' ELSE '' END)
        			                                          ELSE (CASE WHEN D.MODEL_TYPE <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Plan Group' ELSE '' END) END) AS MSG7
            		    --,'' AS MSG8
            		    , (CASE WHEN O.IS_CELL_ASSY = 'Y' AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000') AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID THEN 'not allowed cell product material' ELSE '' END) AS MSG8 -- cell product/assy check... 20230704
            		    --,'' AS MSG9
            		    , CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y'  AND P.VERSION IS NULL AND A.PDS_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'VERSION' 
					                                           WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG <> 'Y' AND A.VERSION <> '-' THEN ' - Version' 
                                                     ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG9 
                    --,'' AS MSG10
            		    , CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y'  AND P.PLM_EC_NO IS NULL AND A.PDS_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'PDS ID' 
					                                           WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG <> 'Y' AND A.PLM_EC_NO <> '-' THEN ' - PDS ID' 
					                                           ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG10
                    ,'' AS MSG11
                    ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG12
                    ,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
            				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION )>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
            				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
              FROM (
                  SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID
                       , B.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                       , A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LOCATION
                       , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                       , A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE 
                       , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.OUT_QTY AS QTY
                       , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
                       , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                       , CASE WHEN ISNULL(PC.PRODUCTION_TYPE, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END PDS_TARGET_FLAG 
                       , PC.PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PDS_PROD_TYPE 
                  FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                  ON    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                  AND   A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
                  AND 	A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
                  AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  		SELECT	DISTINCT IV.COMPANY_ID, IV.DIVISION_ID, IV.SITE_ID, IV.PLANT_ID, SS.PRODUCTION_TYPE, SS.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  		FROM	FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V IV WITH(NOLOCK)
                  			  , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SV WITH(NOLOCK)
                  			  , (
                  					SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  					FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SS WITH(NOLOCK)
                  					WHERE  1=1
                  					AND    SS.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                  					AND    SS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  					--AND    SS.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'N' -- SCP TARGET FLAG
                  					AND    SS.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' -- PDS TARGET FLAG
                  		) SS
                  		WHERE	1=1
                  		AND		SV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'PDS_INSTANCE'
                  		AND		SV.ACTIVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
                  		AND		SV.SEGMENT1	   	= IV.INSTANCE_ID
                  		AND		IV.INSTANCE_ID	= @MASTER_ID
                  		AND		IV.DIVISION_ID	=  SS.DIVISION_ID
                  ) PC
                  ON 1=1
                  AND	  A.DIVISION_ID = PC.DIVISION_ID
                  AND   A.SITE_ID     = PC.SITE_ID
                  AND   A.PLANT_ID    = PC.PLANT_ID
                  AND   A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = PC.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  WHERE A.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
              ) A
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                        , ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME,
                         (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                         	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                         	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE
                  FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                    		 SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE B WITH(NOLOCK),
                    		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK),
                         (
                            SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
                            FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                            WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
                            AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                            AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                            AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                            AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
                            AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
                            AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                         ) D
                  WHERE	 A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                  AND	 A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND	 A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                  AND	 A.ITEM_ID     = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                  AND	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                  AND    A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
                  AND    A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                  AND    A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
                  AND    A.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND    C.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND    B.EFF_END_DATE >= GETDATE()
              ) B
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.MODEL_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
              --AND A.PLAN_DATE >= B.EFF_START_DATE AND A.PLAN_DATE < B.EFF_END_DATE
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = C.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
              AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = D.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = D.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = D.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = D.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = D.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID         = D.LINE_ID
              AND A.LOCATION        = ISNULL(D.LOCATION,'-')
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT  A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS CODE_ID, (CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS _4MCC_TARGET_FLAG 
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  @INSTANCE_COND

              ) E
              ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = E.CODE_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.SEGMENT1
              AND (CASE WHEN A.SITE_ID <> 'A004' AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE IN ('E-TEST','D-TEST') THEN 'XX' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END ) = E.CODE_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE_ID
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              ) F
              ON  A.MARKET = F.CODE_ID
              -- cell product/assy check... 20230704
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            			SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(B.SEGMENT1) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS IS_CELL_ASSY
            			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  B WITH(NOLOCK)
            			WHERE  B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            			AND    B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y'
            			AND    B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CELL_PRODUCT_ASSY'
                  AND B.SEGMENT1 IN (
            				SELECT MAX(SITE_ID)
            				FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
            				WHERE  A.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
            			)
              ) O
              ON 1=1
          		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          		  	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
          		  	  	 , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
          		  	  	 , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
          		  	FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK) 
          		  	, (
          		  	  	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
          		  	  	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		  	  	WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
          		  	  	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
          		  	) B, SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          		  	WHERE  1=1 
          		  	AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
          		  	AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
          		  	AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
          		  	AND    A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
          		  	AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
          		  	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
          		  	AND    A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID 
          		  	AND    A.MFG_WEEK >= (SELECT (ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))
          		  	AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
          		  	AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
          		  	AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
          		  	AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID 
          		  	AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID 
          		  	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID 
          		  	AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID 
          		  	AND    A.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID 
          		  	AND    C.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))
          		  	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
          		  	  	   , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
          		  	  	   , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
          		) P
          		ON  1=1 
          		AND A.COMPANY_ID      = P.COMPANY_ID 
          		AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P.DIVISION_ID 
          		AND A.SITE_ID         = P.SITE_ID 
          		AND A.PLANT_ID        = P.PLANT_ID 
          		AND A.FACTORY_ID      = P.FACTORY_ID 
          		AND A.OPERATION_ID    = P.OPERATION_ID 
          		AND A.LINE_ID         = P.LINE_ID
          		AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = P.ELECTRODE_TYPE
          		AND A.ITEM_ID         = P.ITEM_ID
          		AND A.MARKET          = P.MARKET 
          		AND A.PDS_PROD_TYPE   = P.PRODUCTION_TYPE
          		AND A.PLM_EC_NO       = P.PLM_EC_NO
          		AND A.VERSION         = P.VERSION 
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
      						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
      						WHERE	1=1
      						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
      						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
      						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
      				) R
      				ON		1=1
      				AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
      				AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
      				AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
      				AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
      				AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
      				AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
      				AND		A.LINE_ID			= R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="CONFIRM_AREA" name="CONFIRM_AREA" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="RELEASE_VALUE" name="RELEASE_VALUE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="NEW_SEQ" name="NEW_SEQ" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="MASTER_ID" name="MASTER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
<parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_COND" name="INSTANCE_COND" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>
   	
    </sql>
    
    <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation_OLD_PDS">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                                 THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                                   THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                                     THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                                       THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                                         THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                                                           THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                                             THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')                               THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '')                 THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '')  THEN MSG11 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG11 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG11 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '')  THEN MSG12 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG12 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG12 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT
                     A.INSTANCE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                    ,A.ITEM_ID, B.NICK_NAME, B.ITEM_TYPE, A.TOP_ITEM_ID
                    ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                    ,A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                    ,A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.LOCATION
                    ,A.PLAN_DATE, A.QTY, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
                    ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                    ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                    ,CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                    ,CASE WHEN D.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line - Electrode Type - Location' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                    ,CASE WHEN E.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                    ,CASE WHEN F.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                    ,(CASE WHEN @CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING' THEN (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Building' ELSE '' END)
        			                                          ELSE (CASE WHEN D.MODEL_TYPE <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Plan Group' ELSE '' END) END) AS MSG7
            		    --,'' AS MSG8
            		    , (CASE WHEN O.IS_CELL_ASSY = 'Y' AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000') AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID THEN 'not allowed cell product material' ELSE '' END) AS MSG8 -- cell product/assy check... 20230704
            		    --,'' AS MSG9
            		    , (CASE WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y' AND P.VERSION IS NULL THEN 'Version'
            		            WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG <> 'Y' AND A.VERSION <> '-' THEN ' - Version'
            		            ELSE '' END) AS MSG9
                    ,'' AS MSG10
                    ,'' AS MSG11
                    ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG12
                    ,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
            				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION )>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
            				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
              FROM (
                  SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID
                       , B.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                       , A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LOCATION
                       , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                       , A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE 
                       , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.OUT_QTY AS QTY
                       , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
                       , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                  FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                  ON    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                  AND   A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
                  AND 	A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
                  AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  WHERE A.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
              ) A
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                        , ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME,
                         (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                         	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                         	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE
                  FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                    		 SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE B WITH(NOLOCK),
                    		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK),
                         (
                            SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
                            FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                            WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
                            AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                            AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                            AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                            AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
                            AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
                            AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                         ) D
                  WHERE	 A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                  AND	 A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND	 A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                  AND	 A.ITEM_ID     = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                  AND	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                  AND    A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
                  AND    A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                  AND    A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
                  AND    A.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND    C.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND    B.EFF_END_DATE >= GETDATE()
              ) B
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.MODEL_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
              --AND A.PLAN_DATE >= B.EFF_START_DATE AND A.PLAN_DATE < B.EFF_END_DATE
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = C.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
              AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = D.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = D.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = D.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = D.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = D.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID         = D.LINE_ID
              AND A.LOCATION        = ISNULL(D.LOCATION,'-')
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT  A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS CODE_ID, (CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' AND ATTRIBUTE6 = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS _4MCC_TARGET_FLAG
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  @INSTANCE_COND

              ) E
              ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = E.CODE_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.SEGMENT1
              AND (CASE WHEN A.SITE_ID <> 'A004' AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE IN ('E-TEST','D-TEST') THEN 'XX' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END ) = E.CODE_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE_ID
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              ) F
              ON  A.MARKET = F.CODE_ID
              -- cell product/assy check... 20230704
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            			SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(B.SEGMENT1) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS IS_CELL_ASSY
            			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  B WITH(NOLOCK)
            			WHERE  B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            			AND    B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y'
            			AND    B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CELL_PRODUCT_ASSY'
                  AND B.SEGMENT1 IN (
            				SELECT MAX(SITE_ID)
            				FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
            				WHERE  A.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
            			)                  
              ) O
              ON 1=1
          		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          			SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
          				 , B.OPERATION_ID
          				 , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE , A.VERSION 
          			FROM (
          				SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
          					 , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
          					 , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
          				FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          				, (
          					SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
          					FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
          					WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
          					AND    A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000')
          					GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
          				) B
          				WHERE  1=1
          				AND    A.MFG_WEEK >= (SELECT (ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))
          				AND    A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000','A9000')
          				GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
          					   , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
          					   , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
          			) A
          			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          				SELECT A.OPERATION_ID
          				FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
          				WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
          				AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
          				GROUP BY A.OPERATION_ID
          			) B
          			ON  1=1
          		) P
          		ON  1=1
          		AND A.COMPANY_ID      = P.COMPANY_ID
          		AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P.DIVISION_ID
          		AND A.SITE_ID         = P.SITE_ID
          		AND A.PLANT_ID        = P.PLANT_ID
          		AND A.FACTORY_ID      = P.FACTORY_ID
          		AND A.OPERATION_ID    = P.OPERATION_ID
          		AND A.MARKET          = P.MARKET
          		AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = P.PRODUCTION_TYPE
          		AND A.VERSION         = P.VERSION
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE	1=1
						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
				) R
				ON		1=1
				AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
				AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
				AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
				AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
				AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
				AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
				AND		A.LINE_ID			= R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="CONFIRM_AREA" name="CONFIRM_AREA" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="RELEASE_VALUE" name="RELEASE_VALUE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="NEW_SEQ" name="NEW_SEQ" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="MASTER_ID" name="MASTER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
<parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_COND" name="INSTANCE_COND" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET

                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , BB.OUT_QTY AS QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                     , BB.PLM_EC_NO, BB.VERSION
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') = CC.COMPANY_ID
                AND BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                WHERE BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID

                        						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                        						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID

                        						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                        					) EEE

                        					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID

                                                    AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID

                                                    AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , @CELL_OUT_QTY = B.QTY

              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET

              ,PLAN_DATE

              ,@IN_QTY

              ,@CELL_IN_QTY
              ,@CELL_OUT_QTY

              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID

                     , BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.ITEM_ID, BB.OPERATION_ID
                     , BB.FACTORY_ID, BB.LOCATION
                     , BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                     , BB.LINE_ID, BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , BB.PLAN_DATE, BB.TOP_ITEM_ID
                     , ISNULL(CC.ITEM_TYPE,'-') AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , BB.OUT_QTY AS QTY, BB.DATE_SEQ AS SEQ
                     , BB.PLM_EC_NO, BB.VERSION
                FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                           A.ITEM_ID,
                           (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                           	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                           	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                           ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
                    FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                      		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
                ) CC
                ON  (SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WHERE BB.FACTORY_ID = KK.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') = CC.COMPANY_ID
                AND BB.DIVISION_ID    = CC.DIVISION_ID
                AND BB.SITE_ID        = CC.SITE_ID
                AND BB.ITEM_ID        = CC.ITEM_ID
                WHERE BB.JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      		    ) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.CATEGORY_ID     = B.CATEGORY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        AND A.PLM_EC_NO       = B.PLM_EC_NO
        AND A.VERSION         = B.VERSION
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET @IN_QTY = CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE) )
                        				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                        					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                        					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                        						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                        						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                        						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                        					) EEE
                        					ON     1=1
                        					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
          		 , @OUT_QTY = FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE) )
          		 , @CELL_IN_QTY = CEILING(B.QTY / (  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                                    FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                                        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                                        FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                        WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                        AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                                        AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                                        AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                        AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                        AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                                        AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                        AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                                    ) EEE
                                                    ON     1=1
                                                    WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                                    AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		     , @CELL_OUT_QTY = B.QTY
               , DATE_SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
    		       , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
    		       , PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
              ,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE
              ,@IN_QTY
              ,@OUT_QTY
              ,@CELL_IN_QTY
              ,@CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,PLM_EC_NO
              ,VERSION
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID
              ,B.CATEGORY_ID
              ,B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
              ,B.ITEM_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.LOCATION
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_TYPE
              ,CEILING(FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE))
                        				/ (SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                        					FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                        					LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                        						SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                        						FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                        						WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        						AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        						AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        						AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        						AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        						AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        						AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        						AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                        					) EEE
                        					ON     1=1
                        					WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                        					AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                        					AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                        					AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                        					AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        					AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)) )
          		,FLOOR(B.QTY * dbo.FN_GET_REQ_QTY_MODEL(B.PLANT_ID, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PLAN_DATE) )
          		,CEILING(B.QTY / (  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(EEE.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(YYY.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YYY.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
                                  FROM   SCM_YIELD_M YYY WITH(NOLOCK)
                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M EE WITH(NOLOCK)
                                      WHERE  EE.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND    EE.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                      AND    EE.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                      AND    EE.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                      AND    EE.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                      AND    EE.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                      AND    EE.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN EE.START_TIME AND EE.END_TIME
                                  ) EEE
                                  ON     1=1
                                  WHERE  YYY.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND    YYY.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                                  AND    YYY.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
                                  AND    YYY.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
                                  AND    YYY.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                  AND    YYY.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
                                  AND    YYY.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                  AND    YYY.MONTH        = SUBSTRING((CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112)),1,6)))
      		    ,B.QTY
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(B.QTY,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END
              ,B.PLM_EC_NO
              ,B.VERSION
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID
              ,ITEM_TYPE
              ,@CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,PLM_EC_NO
              ,VERSION
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID
              ,CATEGORY_ID
              ,SITE_ID, PLANT_ID,ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID
              ,ITEM_TYPE
              ,OUT_QTY AS CELL_OUT_QTY
              ,DATE_SEQ
              ,PLM_EC_NO
              ,VERSION
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL2' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  JOB_SAVE_SEQ = @NEW_SEQ
      	;
      	
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="NEW_SEQ" name="NEW_SEQ" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="IN_QTY" name="IN_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="OUT_QTY" name="OUT_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="CELL_IN_QTY" name="CELL_IN_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>
   <parameter replace-what="CELL_OUT_QTY" name="CELL_OUT_QTY" dbType="command" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

		</update-sql>

	</update-batchs>
</SQLS>

 <simple-sqls>
 
  <sql id= "FP00594_find_ListData">
    <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.FP_PLAN_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID , A.CATEGORY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
             , A.LOCATION, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.IN_QTY, A.OUT_QTY
        FROM   FP_AMEND_PLAN_CELL_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID   = @PLAN_ID
        AND    A.CATEGORY_ID  = 'PLAN'
        ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
               , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE
      ]]>
    </text>
    <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_ID"     name="PLAN_ID"     dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
    </parameters>
  </sql>
 
 <sql id= "find_WeekCnt">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

 </sql>

  <sql id= "find_WeekSunCnt">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

 </sql>

 <sql id= "find_DateMap">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

 </sql>
 <sql id= "find_MonthCnt">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

 </sql>
 <sql id= "find_bukInfo">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*

          SELECT A._DATE, A._NAME, A._COUNT

          FROM (
              SELECT YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
                    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
                    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'

                           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
                           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
                           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
                           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'

                    , 1 AS _COUNT
                    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE

        ,'-', '-', 'D'
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))), '-'
        ,'-' ,CONVERT(DATE, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)))
        ,UPPER(ISNULL( (	SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT3 AS GROUP_ITEM_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'MODULE_CELL_GROUP'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND    A.SEGMENT2 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))
          AND    A.SEGMENT1 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))
          AND    A.SEGMENT4 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))
          ), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)) ))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@QTY))
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
      )
    
      ]]>

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_CellAssyYN">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT MAX(B.SEGMENT1) AS INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN MAX(B.SEGMENT1) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS IS_CELL_ASSY
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND    B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CELL_PRODUCT_ASSY_INSTANCE'
          AND    B.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID
          
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
    </sql>
    
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>
