<SQLS id="FP02320_Pancake_Master">

	<simple-sqls>
		
		<sql id = "find_insertValid">
		
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
			
						SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
						FROM   SCM_ITEM_LANE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE  1=1
						AND    UPDATE_ID   = 'PR_XIF_PLM_CONVERSION_RATE_R'
						AND    COMPANY_ID  = @COMPANY_ID
						AND    DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID
						AND    SITE_ID     = @SITE_ID
						AND    PLANT_ID    = @PLANT_ID
						AND    FACTORY_ID  = @FACTORY_ID
						AND    ITEM_ID     = @ITEM_ID
						AND    LANE_QTY    = @LANE_QTY
						AND    PROD_VERSION_TYPE = @PROD_VERSION_TYPE
			
			]]>
			</text>
			
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" name="COMPANY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" name="PLANT_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "LANE_QTY" name="LANE_QTY"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "PROD_VERSION_TYPE" name="PROD_VERSION_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
			
		</sql>
		
		<sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
		
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
			
				DELETE FROM BUF_ITEM_LANE_M
				WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
			
			]]>
			</text>
			
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
			
		</sql>

		<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
   
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				SELECT A.*
			            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
			                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
			                  END AS _MSG
			            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
			      FROM (
			        SELECT A.* 
			              ,MSG1
			              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                           THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
			              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                             THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
			              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')               THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
			              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '') THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
			              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
			        FROM (
			          SELECT A.*
			                ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
			                ,CASE WHEN C.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
			                ,CASE WHEN (ISNULL(A.MAIN_LANE_QTY,0) + ISNULL(A.SUB_LANE_QTY,0)) = 0 THEN '<Main and Sub Slitting is not zero>' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
			                ,CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID = 'E7' AND D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'Wide Range' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
			                ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
			        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.ITEM_ID,A.LANE_QTY,A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
			        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.ITEM_ID,A.LANE_QTY)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
			        				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
			          FROM   BUF_ITEM_LANE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
			              FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC WITH(NOLOCK)
			              WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS=IC.CLASS_ID
			              AND    IC.USE_FLAG='Y'
			              AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
			          ) B
			          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
			          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
			          AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
			          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
			          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
			          AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
			          AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
			          AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID
			          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID
			          AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
				          SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID, A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID, A.SEGMENT3 AS PLANT_ID, A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
				          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
				          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_PROD_VERSION_TYPE'
				          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			  	      ) D
			  	      ON  A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
			  	      AND A.SITE_ID 	= D.SITE_ID
			  	      AND A.PLANT_ID 	= D.PLANT_ID
			  	      AND A.FACTORY_ID 	= D.FACTORY_ID
			  	      AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
			          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			               SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID
			               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
			               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
			               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			          ) R
			          ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
			          AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
			          AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
			          AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
			          AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
			          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
			        ) A
			      ) A
			      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
     
			]]>
			</text>
		
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
		
		</sql>
	</simple-sqls>

	<update-batch id = "merge_FP02320">

		<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				BEGIN
			        MERGE INTO SCM_ITEM_LANE_M A
			        USING (SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID)) AS COMPANY_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID)) AS DIVISION_ID,
			                      RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)) AS SITE_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)) AS PLANT_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)) AS FACTORY_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)) AS ITEM_ID,
			                      (CONVERT(NUMERIC, RTRIM(LTRIM(@MAIN_LANE_QTY)))+CONVERT(NUMERIC, RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@SUB_LANE_QTY,0))))) AS LANE_QTY,
			                      UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PROD_VERSION_TYPE))) AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE) B
			        ON (    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
			            AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			            AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
			            AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
			            AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
			            AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
			            AND A.LANE_QTY    = B.LANE_QTY
			            AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
			        )
			        WHEN MATCHED THEN
			          UPDATE SET
			              A.MAIN_LANE_QTY       = RTRIM(LTRIM(@MAIN_LANE_QTY)),
			              A.SUB_LANE_QTY        = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SUB_LANE_QTY)),
			              A.PATTERN_QTY         = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PATTERN_QTY)),
			              A.HALF_SLIT_FLAG      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@HALF_SLIT_FLAG)),
			              A.ACTIVE_FLAG         = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTIVE_FLAG)),
			              A.DESCRIPTION         = RTRIM(LTRIM(@DESCRIPTION)),
			              A.SLIT_WIDTH          = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SLIT_WIDTH)),
			              A.PC_ROLL_LENGTH      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PC_ROLL_LENGTH)),
			              A.PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM  = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM)),
			              A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE  	= CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID = 'E7' THEN  UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PROD_VERSION_TYPE))) 
			              							   ELSE A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
			              							   END ,
			              A.UPDATE_ID           = @USER_ID,
			              A.UPDATE_TIME         = dbo.SYSDATE1()
			        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
			          INSERT(
			              COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, ITEM_ID, 
			              LANE_QTY,
			              MAIN_LANE_QTY, SUB_LANE_QTY, PATTERN_QTY, HALF_SLIT_FLAG, DESCRIPTION, ACTIVE_FLAG, SLIT_WIDTH,
			              PC_ROLL_LENGTH, PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM,PROD_VERSION_TYPE,
			              INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
			          )
			          VALUES (
			              RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)), 
			              (CONVERT(NUMERIC, RTRIM(LTRIM(@MAIN_LANE_QTY)))+CONVERT(NUMERIC, RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@SUB_LANE_QTY,0))))),
			              RTRIM(LTRIM(@MAIN_LANE_QTY)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SUB_LANE_QTY)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@PATTERN_QTY)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@HALF_SLIT_FLAG)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@DESCRIPTION)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTIVE_FLAG)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SLIT_WIDTH)),
			              RTRIM(LTRIM(@PC_ROLL_LENGTH)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM)), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PROD_VERSION_TYPE))),
			              @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1()

			               MAIN_LANE_QTY, SUB_LANE_QTY, PATTERN_QTY, HALF_SLIT_FLAG, DESCRIPTION, ACTIVE_FLAG, SLIT_WIDTH,
			               PC_ROLL_LENGTH, PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM,PROD_VERSION_TYPE,
			               INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME,
			               JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
			        )
			        SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, ITEM_ID, LANE_QTY,
			               MAIN_LANE_QTY, SUB_LANE_QTY, PATTERN_QTY, HALF_SLIT_FLAG, DESCRIPTION, ACTIVE_FLAG, SLIT_WIDTH,
			               PC_ROLL_LENGTH, PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM,PROD_VERSION_TYPE,
			               INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME, 
			               @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), 'EXCEL'
			        FROM   SCM_ITEM_LANE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
			        WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))
			        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))
			        AND    A.SITE_ID      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))
			        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID))

			        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))
			        AND    A.LANE_QTY     = (CONVERT(NUMERIC, RTRIM(LTRIM(@MAIN_LANE_QTY)))+CONVERT(NUMERIC, RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@SUB_LANE_QTY,0)))))
			        ;
			        
			        
			      
			      END;

			]]>

<SQLS id="FP02560_Site_Bod">

	<simple-sqls>
	
		<sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
		
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
			
				DELETE FROM BUF_SHIPMENT_M
				WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
			
			]]>
			</text>
			
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
			
		</sql>

		<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
   
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				SELECT 	A.*
			            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE __MSG END AS _MSG
			            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
			    FROM	(
					        SELECT A.* 
					              ,MSG1
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                             THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')               THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
					              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
					        FROM (
							          SELECT A.*
							                ,CASE WHEN B.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'From Site-Plant' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
							                ,CASE WHEN C.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'To Site-Plant' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
							                ,CASE WHEN R.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions(From)' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
							                ,CASE WHEN R2.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions(To)' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
							          FROM   BUF_SHIPMENT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
									              FROM   SCM_PLANT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
									          ) B
									          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
									          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
									          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
									          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									              SELECT DISTINCT A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
									              FROM   SCM_PLANT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
									          ) C
									          ON  A.TO_SITE_ID  = C.SITE_ID
									          AND A.TO_PLANT_ID = C.PLANT_ID
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									               SELECT DISTINCT R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID
									               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
									               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
									               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
									          ) R
									          ON   A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
									          AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									               SELECT DISTINCT R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID
									               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
									               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
									               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
									          ) R2
									          ON   A.TO_SITE_ID   = R2.SITE_ID
									          AND  A.TO_PLANT_ID  = R2.PLANT_ID
							          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
								) A
			      		) A
				ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
     
			]]>
			</text>
		
			<parameters>
				<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			</parameters>
		
		</sql>
	</simple-sqls>

<SQLS id="Instance">
	  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id="list_instance">

<text>
      <![CDATA[

SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID, B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID  
 --, (CASE WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN C.PLAN_GROUP_ID                                              
 --        WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING'   THEN '-' ELSE '-' END) AS PLAN_GROUP_ID                      
 --, A.INSTANCE_ID + '_' + B.FACTORY_ID + (CASE WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN '_' + C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
 --                                              WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING'   THEN '' ELSE '' END) AS ROLE_NAME 
 --, B.SHOP_GROUP_ID                                           
FROM (                                                         
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
 FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)           
    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'            
  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'                         
) A                                                 
LEFT OUTER JOIN (                                               
   SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID, B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID   
         , B.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, B.FACTORY_NAME, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID       
   FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK) 
   WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID                     
    AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'                         
) B                                                          
ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID                              
LEFT OUTER JOIN (                                              
   SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PLAN_GROUP_ID 
    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)              
    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'  
   AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'                         
) C                                                         
ON    A.INSTANCE_ID = C.INSTANCE_ID             
WHERE 1=1                                   
AND   B.COMPANY_ID IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY SITE_ID,INSTANCE_ID

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>  
</sql>
</simple-sqls>
</SQLS>

<SQLS id="Line">
	  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id="list_line">

<text>
      <![CDATA[
 SELECT  A.COMPANY_ID AS COMPANY_ID,  A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,   A.SITE_ID AS SITE_ID         
   , A.PLANT_ID   AS PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID          
   , A.LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, A.LINE_NAME AS LINE_NAME, A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID  
   , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,  A.LINE_TYPE AS LINE_TYPE                                 
   , A.LINE_TYPE_NAME AS LINE_TYPE_NAME, A.MODEL_TYPE AS LINE_MODEL_TYPE                           
   , ( CASE WHEN A.LINE_ATTR_1 = '-' THEN 'Normal' ELSE A.LINE_ATTR_1 END ) AS LINE_ATTRIBUTE1 
   , A.LOCATION AS LINE_LOCATION, A.ACTIVE_FLAG AS ACTIVE_FLAG,      A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION  
   , A.SCP_LINE_ID AS SCP_LINE_ID,A.MES_LINE_ID AS MES_LINE_ID, A.WORK_CENTER_ID AS WORK_CENTER_ID,   A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE As PROD_VERSION_TYPE                      
   ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCM_EQUIPMENT_M T(NOLOCK)                                               
      WHERE T.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID   AND  T.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID                
         AND   T.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID      AND  T.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID                   
         AND   T.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID   AND  T.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID               
         AND   T.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID      AND  T.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE             
         AND   T.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'          AND  T.EQUIPMENT_TYPE = 'M'                        
     ) AS EQUIPMENT_COUNT                                                                          
	  , '' AS MESSAGE_ID, CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END EDIT_YN          
   , A.TOP_LINE_ID AS ORG_LINE_ID,  A.UPDATE_ID AS UPDATE_ID                                       
	  , A.UPDATE_TIME AS UPDATE_TIME                                                                  
	FROM  SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)                                                                   
     LEFT OUTER JOIN (                                                                             
          SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID         
          FROM    FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)		
          WHERE   R.USER_ID	    = 'chkim.68' 	
          AND     R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'					
		) R                                                 
		ON  1=1                                             
		AND A.COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID                  
		AND A.DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID                 
		AND A.SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID                     
		AND A.PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID                    
		AND A.FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID                  
	, SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)  ,FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M M WITH(NOLOCK)                      
	WHERE 1=1
            AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = N'Y' 
	AND (A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID OR ISNULL(@DIVISION_ID,'') = '') 
            AND (A.SITE_ID = @SITE_ID OR ISNULL(@SITE_ID,'') = '') 
            AND (A.PLANT_ID = @PLANT_ID OR ISNULL(@PLANT_ID,'') = '')
	AND A.FACTORY_ID    = M.FACTORY_ID                   
	AND (M.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID OR ISNULL(@INSTANCE_ID,'') = '')
	AND   A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID                       
            AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID                   
	AND   A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID                   
	AND   A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID                  
	AND  ( B.WO_FLAG = 'Y' OR B.MO_FLAG = 'Y' )     
AND EXISTS (                                                                                  
                SELECT 1                                                                        
                FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V C WITH(NOLOCK)                                       
                WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID  AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID          
                  AND  A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID     AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID             
                  AND  A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID  AND C.USER_ID     = @USER_ID    
            )              
	ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID         


      ]]>
      </text>

<SQLS id="MEASURE_COMMON">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "select_measure">
    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
    	 WITH M_TABLE AS (
					   		SELECT SEGMENT1     AS USER_ID  			
									, SEGMENT2     AS MENU_ID  			
									, SEGMENT3     AS MEA_ID 		  	         													
									, SEGMENT4     AS MEA_NAME													
									, SEGMENT5     AS MEA_VALUE          
									, ATTRIBUTE1   AS TYPE                   
									, ATTRIBUTE2   AS FLAG               
									, ATTRIBUTE3   AS ACTIVE_FLAG       
					     	FROM   	SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
						    WHERE  	A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'UI_AMEND_MEASURE'
						    AND     A.SEGMENT2 = @MENU_ID
						    AND 	A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			   )
			 SELECT * FROM (SELECT   ISNULL(A.MEA_ID, B.MEA_ID) MEA_ID
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_NAME, A.MEA_NAME) MEA_NAME
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_VALUE, A.MEA_VALUE) MEA_VALUE
						,ISNULL(B.TYPE, A.TYPE) TYPE
						,ISNULL(B.FLAG, A.FLAG) FLAG
						,A.MENU_ID
						,@USER_ID AS USER_ID
			FROM   M_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			    SELECT *
			    FROM   TH_UIS_USER_AMEND_MEA_RELATE B WITH(NOLOCK)
			    WHERE  USER_ID = @USER_ID
			    AND    MENU_ID = @MENU_ID
			    AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			) B
			ON    A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID
			AND   A.MEA_ID  = B.MEA_ID
			AND   A.TYPE 	= B.TYPE
			WHERE 1=1
			AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') B
GROUP BY MEA_ID, MEA_NAME, MEA_VALUE, TYPE, FLAG, MENU_ID, USER_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		<parameter replace-what = "MENU_ID" name="MENU_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
    </sql>

</sql>

		<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">

			<text>
				<![CDATA[


SELECT TT.DIVISION_ID
	,TT.SITE_ID
	,TT.PLANT_ID
	,TT.OPERATION_ID
	,TT.FACTORY_ID
	,TT.LINE_ID
	,TT.ITEM_ID
	,TT.ELECTRODE_TYPE
	,TT.PRODUCTION_TYPE
	,TT.EQUIPMENT_ID
	,TT.MARKET
	,TT.PLAN_DATE
	,TT.TOP_ITEM_ID
	,TT.INSTANCE_ID
	,TT.MEMO_RANGE 
	,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE __MSG END as _MSG
	,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
  FROM
(
      SELECT 
	  msg1 
	  + CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '') THEN msg2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ','+MSG2 END) END
      + CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END
      + CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' and msg3='') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END
      + CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' and msg3='' and msg4='') THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END
      + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
	  ,tt.*
FROM
(

SELECT DISTINCT TT.DIVISION_ID
	,TT.SITE_ID
	,TT.PLANT_ID
	,TT.OPERATION_ID
	,TT.FACTORY_ID
	,TT.LINE_ID
	,TT.ITEM_ID
	,TT.ELECTRODE_TYPE
	,TT.PRODUCTION_TYPE
	,TT.EQUIPMENT_ID
	,TT.MARKET
	,TT.PLAN_DATE
	,TT.TOP_ITEM_ID
	,TT.INSTANCE_ID
	,CASE WHEN ISNULL(TT.ITEM_ID,'-') = '-' THEN 'LINE' ELSE 'MATERIAL' END AS MEMO_RANGE
	,CASE WHEN ISNULL(TT.OPERATION_ID,'') = '' THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
	,CASE WHEN ISNULL(TT.FACTORY_ID,'') = '' THEN 'Factory' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
	,CASE WHEN ISNULL(TT.LINE_ID,'') = ''THEN 'Line' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
	,CASE WHEN (ISNULL(TT.INSTANCE_TYPE,'') NOT LIKE 'E%' AND ISNULL(TT.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') <> '-') THEN 'Equipment' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
	,'' AS MSG5
	FROM (
SELECT	A.DIVISION_ID
	,A.SITE_ID
	,A.PLANT_ID
	,A.OPERATION_ID
	,A.FACTORY_ID
	,A.LINE_ID
	,A.ITEM_ID
	,A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
	,A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
	,A.EQUIPMENT_ID
	,A.MARKET
	,A.PLAN_DATE
	,A.TOP_ITEM_ID
	,A.INSTANCE_ID
	,FI.INSTANCE_TYPE
--,A.INSERT_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.INSERT_TIME, 120) AS INSERT_TIME
--	,B.NICK_NAME AS PROBLEM_DATA_NICK
--,C.NICK_NAME AS TOP_ITEM_ID_NICK
FROM	BUF_FP_AMEND_MEMO_VALIDATION A WITH(NOLOCK)

--- VALIDATION EQUIMPMENT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V FI WITH(NOLOCK)
ON A.INSTANCE_ID = FI.INSTANCE_ID

--- VALIDATION LINE_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
ON  A.DIVISION_ID     = D.DIVISION_ID
AND A.SITE_ID   = D.SITE_ID
AND A.PLANT_ID  = D.PLANT_ID
AND A.FACTORY_ID      = D.FACTORY_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID    = D.OPERATION_ID
AND A.LINE_ID   = D.LINE_ID
AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'

--- VALIDATION ITEM_ID
LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON  
A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID

--- VALIDATION FACTORY_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M F WITH(NOLOCK)
ON    A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
AND   A.SITE_ID     = F.SITE_ID
AND   A.PLANT_ID    = F.PLANT_ID
AND 	A.FACTORY_ID  = F.FACTORY_ID
AND   F.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
--- VALIDATION OPERATION_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
ON
A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
AND A.SITE_ID   = C.SITE_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
---DIVISION_ID
-- LEFT OUTER JOIN (
--      SELECT DISTINCT  A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS CODE_ID
--   FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
--      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
--      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
--UNION ALL 
--SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS SEGMENT1, 'M/C' AS CODE_ID 
--FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M A(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B(NOLOCK) 
--ON     A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID 
--AND	   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' 
--WHERE  1=1 
--AND	   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' 
--AND    B.INSTANCE_ID = 'KR_CELL'   
--     ) E
--  ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = E.CODE_ID
--AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.SEGMENT1
--AND (CASE WHEN A.SITE_ID <> ''A004'' AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE IN (''E-TEST,D-TEST'') THEN ''XX'' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END ) = E.CODE_ID
--- MARKET
WHERE A.GUID = @GUID
  ) AS TT
  ) AS TT
  ) AS TT
    
      ]]>
			</text>

				<parameter replace-what="GUID" name="GUID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

			</parameters>
		</sql>

    <sql id="save_option_menu">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      		BEGIN
		        BEGIN TRAN
		          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A
		          USING (	  SELECT A.*, B.YYYYMMDD AS PLAN_DATE
                      	FROM (
  		          					SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID,
  				                       @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID,@PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, 
  				                       @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
  				                       (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID,
  				                       @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, 
  				                       @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET,
                                 CASE @MEMO_TYPE WHEN '' THEN 'DPP'
                                 ELSE ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE, 'DPP') END   AS MEMO_TYPE
					              ) A
	                      INNER JOIN TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK)
	                      ON  B.DT BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
		                 ) B
		          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
		              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
		              AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              AND ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = B.EQUIPMENT_ID 
		              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
		              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
		              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET 
		              AND A.MEMO_TYPE = B.MEMO_TYPE 
		              )
		          WHEN MATCHED THEN
		            UPDATE SET MEMO = LEFT(@MEMO,700),
		            ATTR1=ISNULL(@ATTR1,''),
		            ATTR2=ISNULL(@ATTR2,''),
		            ATTR3=ISNULL(@ATTR3,''),
		            ATTR4=ISNULL(@ATTR4,''),
		            ATTR5=ISNULL(@ATTR5,'')
		                 , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		                 , IF_TIME = GETDATE()
		          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
		            INSERT (
		               INSTANCE_ID
		              ,COMPANY_ID
		              ,DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
		              ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
		              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
		              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
		              ,MEMO
		              ,MEMO_TYPE
		              ,ATTR1
		              ,ATTR2
		              ,ATTR3
		              ,ATTR4
		              ,ATTR5
		              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		              ,IF_TIME
		            )
		            VALUES (
		               B.INSTANCE_ID
		              ,(SELECT MAX(COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
		              ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
		              ,B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,B.EQUIPMENT_ID ,CONVERT(DATETIME,B.PLAN_DATE)
		              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
		              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
		              ,LEFT(@MEMO,700)
		              ,B.MEMO_TYPE
		              ,ISNULL(@ATTR1,'')
		              ,ISNULL(@ATTR2,'')
		              ,ISNULL(@ATTR3,'')
		              ,ISNULL(@ATTR4,'')
		              ,ISNULL(@ATTR5,'')
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		              ,GETDATE()
		            )
		          ;
		        
		        COMMIT;
		        
		        BEGIN TRAN
		            INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_MEMO_M (
		                   INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,MEMO
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
		                  ,ATTR1
		                  ,ATTR2
		                  ,ATTR3
		                  ,ATTR4
		                  ,ATTR5
		            )
		            SELECT INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,LEFT(@MEMO,700)
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MERGE' AS JOB_TYPE
		                  ,ATTR1,ATTR2,ATTR3,ATTR4,ATTR5
		            FROM   FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
		            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
		            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
		            AND    A.SITE_ID       	  = @SITE_ID
		            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID
		            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @FACTORY_ID
		            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
		            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @LINE_ID
		            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @TOP_ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
		            AND    ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END)
		            AND    A.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_FROM) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
		            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
		            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
                AND         ((ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')<>'' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = @MEMO_TYPE)
			OR (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = 'DPP'))
			AND	A.MEMO IS NOT NULL
		            AND    ISNULL(A.ATTR1,'')          = ISNULL(@ATTR1,'')
		            AND    ISNULL(A.ATTR2,'')          = ISNULL(@ATTR2,'')
		            AND    ISNULL(A.ATTR3,'')          = ISNULL(@ATTR3,'')
		            AND    ISNULL(A.ATTR4,'')          = ISNULL(@ATTR4,'')
		            AND    ISNULL(A.ATTR5,'')          = ISNULL(@ATTR5,'')
		            ;
		          
		        COMMIT;
		        
		      END;
		
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

    <sql id="delete_memo">
      <text><![CDATA[

      		BEGIN
		        BEGIN TRAN
		          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A
		          USING (	  SELECT A.*, B.YYYYMMDD AS PLAN_DATE
                      	FROM (
  		          					SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID,
  				                       @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID,@PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, 
  				                       @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
  				                       (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID,
  				                       @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, 
  				                       @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET,
                                 CASE @MEMO_TYPE WHEN '' THEN 'DPP'
                                 ELSE ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE, 'DPP') END   AS MEMO_TYPE
					              ) A
	                      INNER JOIN TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK)
	                      ON  B.DT BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
		                 ) B
		          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
		              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
		              AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              AND ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = B.EQUIPMENT_ID 
		              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
		              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
		              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET 
		              AND A.MEMO_TYPE = B.MEMO_TYPE )
		          WHEN MATCHED THEN
		            UPDATE SET MEMO = CASE @MEMO WHEN '' then NULL else LEFT(@MEMO,700) END
		                 , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		                 , IF_TIME = GETDATE()
		          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
		            INSERT (
		               INSTANCE_ID
		              ,COMPANY_ID
		              ,DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
		              ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
		              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
		              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
		              ,MEMO
		              ,MEMO_TYPE
		              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		              ,IF_TIME
		            )
		            VALUES (
		               B.INSTANCE_ID
		              ,(SELECT MAX(COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
		              ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
		              ,B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,B.EQUIPMENT_ID ,CONVERT(DATETIME,B.PLAN_DATE)
		              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
		              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
		              ,LEFT(@MEMO,700)
		              ,B.MEMO_TYPE
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		              ,GETDATE()
		            )
		          ;
		        
		        COMMIT;
		        
		        BEGIN TRAN
		            INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_MEMO_M (
		                   INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,MEMO
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
		            )
		            SELECT INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,MEMO
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MERGE' AS JOB_TYPE
		            FROM   FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
		            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
		            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
		            AND    A.SITE_ID       	  = @SITE_ID
		            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID
		            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @FACTORY_ID
		            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
		            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @LINE_ID
		            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @TOP_ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
		            AND    ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END)
		            AND    A.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_FROM) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
		            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
		            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
                AND
 ((ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')<>'' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = @MEMO_TYPE)
			OR (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = 'DPP'))

			AND	A.MEMO IS NOT NULL;		          
		        COMMIT;
		        
		      END;
		
      ]]></text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

		            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
                AND         ((ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')<>'' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = @MEMO_TYPE)
			OR (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = 'DPP'))
			AND	A.MEMO IS NOT NULL
		            ;
		          
		        COMMIT;
		        
		      END;

        <text><![CDATA[

				          USING (	  	SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID,

				              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)

    <sql id="find_LookUp_AllData">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4, SEGMENT5
               , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10, ATTRIBUTE11, ATTRIBUTE12, ATTRIBUTE13, ATTRIBUTE14, ATTRIBUTE15
               , SORT_ORDER, ACTIVE_FLAG, VALUE_DESCRIPTION, PLANT_ID
               , CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DATE
               , MODIFY_USER_ID, MODIFY_DATE
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = @LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE
          AND    A.SEGMENT1 = (CASE WHEN @SEGMENT1 != '' AND @SEGMENT1 IS NOT NULL THEN @SEGMENT1 ELSE A.SEGMENT1 END)
          AND    A.SEGMENT2 = (CASE WHEN @SEGMENT2 != '' AND @SEGMENT2 IS NOT NULL THEN @SEGMENT2 ELSE A.SEGMENT2 END)
          AND    A.SEGMENT3 = (CASE WHEN @SEGMENT3 != '' AND @SEGMENT3 IS NOT NULL THEN @SEGMENT3 ELSE A.SEGMENT3 END)
          AND    A.SEGMENT4 = (CASE WHEN @SEGMENT4 != '' AND @SEGMENT4 IS NOT NULL THEN @SEGMENT4 ELSE A.SEGMENT4 END)
          AND    A.SEGMENT5 = (CASE WHEN @SEGMENT5 != '' AND @SEGMENT5 IS NOT NULL THEN @SEGMENT5 ELSE A.SEGMENT5 END)
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
        ]]>
      </text>

    <sql id="find_dwSubmit_check">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, HISTORY_TIME, 20) AS HISTORY_TIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, SUBMIT_TIME, 20) AS SUBMIT_TIME
          	 , CASE WHEN HISTORY_TIME IS NULL THEN 'N'  -- 보정자체를 안하면 패스
          	        WHEN HISTORY_TIME IS NOT NULL AND SUBMIT_TIME IS NULL THEN 'Y' -- 보정은 하고 전송은 안했으면 메세지 출력
          	        WHEN HISTORY_TIME IS NOT NULL AND SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND HISTORY_TIME > SUBMIT_TIME  THEN 'Y' -- 보정, 전송 둘다했는데 전송시간보다 보정시간이 이후면 메세지 출력
          	   ELSE 'N' END AS IS_SUBMIT
          FROM (
            	-- AMEND 
              SELECT MAX(JOB_TIME) AS HISTORY_TIME
              FROM   @DW_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  1=1
              AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
              AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID  = @FP_PLAN_ID
          ) A
          , (
            	-- DW SUBMIT
            	SELECT MAX(INSERT_TIME) AS SUBMIT_TIME
            	FROM   FP_PROC_PARAMETER_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
            	WHERE  1=1
            	AND    CONDITION_TYPE  = 'FP_PLAN_ID'
            	AND    CONDITION_VALUE = @FP_PLAN_ID
          ) B
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "DW_TABLE" name="DW_TABLE"  dbType="command" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id="findPeriod_DWSubmit">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT @CURR_DATE AS START_DATE
           , CASE WHEN @MPP_WPP = 'WPP_OUT_QTY' THEN ( SELECT MAX(CCC.DATED7)
                                                        FROM   TH_UIS_CALENDAR CCC WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                        WHERE  CCC.D0 IN (
                                                            SELECT CC.ISO_YYYYWW
                                                            FROM   TH_UIS_CAL CC WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                            WHERE  CC.YYYYMMDD = (CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) + ((CONVERT(NUMERIC, ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE15,'8')))*7), 112))
                                                        ))
             --ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),DATEADD(MONTH,2,@CURR_DATE),112) + '01'), 112) END AS END_DATE
             ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -1, CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),DATEADD(MONTH,2, CONVERT(VARCHAR, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME((SELECT MAX(VV.SITE_ID) FROM FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V VV WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE VV.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID)), 112) ),112) + '01'), 112) END AS END_DATE -- site 별 현지날짜로 변경... 20230531
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @MASTER_ID

<sql id="find_instanceInfo">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS CODE_NAME
           , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS IS_SAME_PLAN_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS USE_WOW_STATUS
           , ISNULL(C.AMEND_TYPE,'AMEND UI') AS AMEND_TYPE
           , A.ATTRIBUTE10 AS FIX_DATE_SYNC, A.ATTRIBUTE12 AS SYNC_YN
           , D.SITE_ID
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, ATTRIBUTE1 AS AMEND_TYPE
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE AMEND UI'
      ) C
      ON     A.SEGMENT1 = C.INSTANCE_ID
  	  INNER JOIN (
      		SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, MAX(B.SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID
      		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      		INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      		ON    A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
      		WHERE A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      		AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      		GROUP BY A.INSTANCE_ID
  	  ) D
  	  ON     A.SEGMENT1 = D.INSTANCE_ID
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID
      GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, ISNULL(C.AMEND_TYPE,'AMEND UI')
             , A.ATTRIBUTE10, A.ATTRIBUTE12, D.SITE_ID

      ]]>
      </text>

        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

</sql>
<sql id="find_isCurrWeek">
	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)- ( SELECT ISNULL(LLL2._DAY, CONVERT(NUMERIC,ISNULL(LLL.SEGMENT1,'0'))) AS _DAY
                                                        				FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE LLL WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                        				LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                                                        					SELECT CONVERT(NUMERIC,ISNULL(SEGMENT1,'0')) AS _DAY
                                                        					FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE LLL2 WITH(NOLOCK)
                                                        					WHERE  LLL2.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'WPP_DAY_RANGE_BY_INSTANCE'
                                                        					AND    LLL2.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                        					AND    LLL2.SEGMENT2 = @MASTER_ID
                                                        				) LLL2
                                                        				ON 1=1
                                                        				WHERE LLL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'WPP_DAY_RANGE') ,112) AS CURR_DATE
           , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID, (CASE WHEN A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID = @PLAN_ID THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_LATEST_PLAN, A.RELEASE_TYPE AS RELEASE_VALUE
      FROM (
      	SELECT A.*
      		   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.INSERT_TIME DESC) AS ROW_NUM
      		   , B.RELEASE_TYPE
      	FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
      	INNER JOIN (
        		SELECT RR.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN RR.FACTORY_ID ='-' THEN RR.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE RR.FACTORY_ID END) AS RELEASE_TYPE
        		FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H RR WITH(NOLOCK)
        		WHERE  INSTANCE_ID     = @MASTER_ID
        		AND    RELEASE_PLAN_ID = @PLAN_ID
      	) B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
      	AND (CASE WHEN @CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING' THEN A.FACTORY_ID ELSE A.PLAN_GROUP_ID END) = B.RELEASE_TYPE
      ) A
      WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" 		name="SITE_ID"  		dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "MASTER_ID" 		name="MASTER_ID"  		dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_ID" 		name="PLAN_ID"  		dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "CONFIRM_AREA" 	name="CONFIRM_AREA"  	dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
      

</sql>

	<sql id="find_saveAuth">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[
					SELECT A.RELEASE_VALUE, B._VALUE
					FROM (
							SELECT (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID = '-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) AS RELEASE_VALUE
							FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE  INSTANCE_ID     = @INSTANCE_ID
							AND    INSTANCE_DATE   = @PLAN_DATE
							AND    RELEASE_PLAN_ID = @PLAN_ID
						) A
						LEFT OUTER JOIN (
											-- 전송 가능 기준은 배포기준이 된 동 혹은 PLAN GROUP 기준으로 저장권한 있는지 여부로 확인한다.
											SELECT DISTINCT (CASE WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) AS _VALUE
											FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK)
											WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.SEGMENT1
											AND    A.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
											AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
											AND    A.SAVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
											AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
											AND    B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
						) B
						ON A.RELEASE_VALUE = B._VALUE
		]]>
		</text>

			<parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id = "delete_memo">
    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      		BEGIN
		        BEGIN TRAN
		          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A
		          USING (	  SELECT A.*, B.YYYYMMDD AS PLAN_DATE
                      	FROM (
  		          					SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID,
  				                       @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID,@PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, 
  				                       @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
  				                       (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID,
  				                       @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, 
  				                       @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET,
                                 CASE @MEMO_TYPE WHEN '' THEN 'DPP'
                                 ELSE ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE, 'DPP') END   AS MEMO_TYPE
					              ) A
	                      INNER JOIN TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK)
	                      ON  B.DT BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
		                 ) B
		          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
		              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
		              AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              AND ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = B.EQUIPMENT_ID 
		              AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
		              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
		              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET 
		              AND A.MEMO_TYPE = B.MEMO_TYPE )
		          WHEN MATCHED THEN
		            UPDATE SET MEMO = @MEMO
		                 , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		                 , IF_TIME = GETDATE()
		          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
		            INSERT (
		               INSTANCE_ID
		              ,COMPANY_ID
		              ,DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
		              ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
		              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
		              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
		              ,MEMO
		              ,MEMO_TYPE
		              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		              ,IF_TIME
		            )
		            VALUES (
		               B.INSTANCE_ID
		              ,(SELECT MAX(COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
		              ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
		              ,B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,B.EQUIPMENT_ID ,CONVERT(DATETIME,B.PLAN_DATE)
		              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
		              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
		              ,@MEMO
		              ,B.MEMO_TYPE
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
		              ,GETDATE()
		            )
		          ;
		        
		        COMMIT;
		        
		        BEGIN TRAN
		            INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_MEMO_M (
		                   INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,MEMO
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
		            )
		            SELECT INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,MEMO
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MERGE' AS JOB_TYPE
		            FROM   FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
		            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
		            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
		            AND    A.SITE_ID       	  = @SITE_ID
		            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID
		            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @FACTORY_ID
		            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
		            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @LINE_ID
		            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @TOP_ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
		            AND    ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END)
		            AND    A.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_FROM) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
		            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
		            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
                AND
 ((ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = @MEMO_TYPE)
			OR (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = 'DPP'))

			AND	A.MEMO IS NOT NULL;		          
		        COMMIT;
		        
		      END;
		
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
		            )
		            SELECT INSTANCE_ID
		                  ,COMPANY_ID
		                  ,DIVISION_ID
		                  ,SITE_ID
		                  ,PLANT_ID
		                  ,FACTORY_ID
		                  ,OPERATION_ID
		                  ,LINE_ID
		                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
		                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
		                  ,PLAN_DATE
		                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
		                  ,ITEM_ID
		                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
		                  ,MARKET
		                  ,MEMO
		                  ,MEMO_TYPE
		                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MERGE' AS JOB_TYPE
		            FROM   FP_AMEND_MEMO_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
		            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
		            AND    A.DIVISION_ID      = @DIVISION_ID
		            AND    A.SITE_ID       	  = @SITE_ID
		            AND    A.PLANT_ID         = @PLANT_ID
		            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @FACTORY_ID
		            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
		            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @LINE_ID
		            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @TOP_ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
		            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
		            AND    ISNULL(A.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') = (CASE WHEN @EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL OR @EQUIPMENT_ID = '' THEN '-' ELSE @EQUIPMENT_ID END)
		            AND    A.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_FROM) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
		            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
		            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
                AND         ((ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = @MEMO_TYPE)
			OR (ISNULL(@MEMO_TYPE,'')='' AND A.MEMO_TYPE = 'DPP'))
			AND	A.MEMO IS NOT NULL
		            ;
		          
		        COMMIT;
		        
		      END;

<SQLS id="DIO">

  <simple-sqls>

    <sql id = "find_dio">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
;WITH BASE_SCM AS
(
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,ISNULL(B.PARENT_ITEM_ID,A.ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID,A.ITEM_NAME, A.NICK_NAME FRoM SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)--,SCM_BOM_M B WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_BOM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON B.CHILD_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
AND B.SITE_ID = A.SITE_ID
WHERE 1=1
AND (ISNULL(@DIVISION_ID,'') = '' OR A.DIVISION_ID =@DIVISION_ID) 
AND (ISNULL(@SITE_ID,'') = '' OR A.SITE_ID =@SITE_ID) 
AND (ISNULL(@ITEM_ID,'') = '' OR A.ITEM_ID LIKE '%'+ @ITEM_ID+'%' OR A.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' + @ITEM_ID + '%') 
AND (ISNULL(B.PARENT_ITEM_ID,'') = '' OR B.PARENT_ITEM_ID LIKE '%' + @TOP_ITEM_ID + '%') 
AND (ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') = '-' OR A.NICK_NAME LIKE '%' + @NICK_NAME + '%') 
GROUP By A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID,A.ITEM_NAME, A.NICK_NAME,B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
),
LOOK_UP AS
(
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS SITE_ID,SEGMENT3 AS ITEM_ID, SEGMENT4 AS DIO
,create_user_id as insert_id, create_date as insert_time
,modify_user_id as update_id, modify_date as update_time

FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'MATERIAL_DIO_DAY'
)
SELECT S.DIVISION_ID, S.SITE_ID, S.ITEM_ID,ISNULL(MAX(S.NICK_NAME),'-') AS NICK_NAME ,S.ITEM_NAME, ISNULL(L.DIO,5) AS DIO, CASE WHEN ISNULL(L.DIO,'')='' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEFAULT_YN,
L.insert_id, L.insert_time, L.update_id, L.update_time
FROM BASE_SCM S WITH(NOLOCK) 
LEFT OUTER JOIN  LOOK_UP L WITH(NOLOCK) 
ON 1=1
AND L.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
AND L.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID
AND L.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
GROUP BY S.DIVISION_ID, S.SITE_ID, S.ITEM_ID,S.ITEM_NAME, DIO, L.insert_id, L.insert_time, L.update_id, L.update_time
]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
		  <parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		  <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		  <parameter replace-what = "TOP_ITEM_ID" name="TOP_ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		  <parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "NICK_NAME" name="NICK_NAME"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>

    </sql>


	  <sql id = "list_dio">
		  <text>
			  <![CDATA[
;WITH LOOK_UP AS
(
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS SITE_ID,SEGMENT3 AS ITEM_ID, SEGMENT4 AS DIO

FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'MATERIAL_DIO_DAY'
AND (ISNULL(@DIVISION_ID,'') = '' OR A.SEGMENT1 =@DIVISION_ID) 
AND (ISNULL(@SITE_ID,'') = '' OR A.SEGMENT2 =@SITE_ID) 
AND (ISNULL(@ITEM_ID,'') = '' OR A.SEGMENT3 =@ITEM_ID) 
)
SELECT * FROM LOOK_UP
]]>
		  </text>

		  <parameters>
			  <parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			  <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			  <parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

	  </sql>

	<update-batchs>

		<update-batch id="save_dio">

			<insert-sql>

				<text>
					<![CDATA[
BEGIN
		        BEGIN TRAN
		          MERGE INTO SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
		          USING (	  
				  
				  					SELECT 
									@DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,
  				                    @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID,
									@ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
					    ) B
		          ON 1=1
				  AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.DIVISION_ID
				  AND A.SEGMENT2 = B.SITE_ID 
				  AND A.SEGMENT3 = B.ITEM_ID
				  AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'MATERIAL_DIO_DAY'
		          WHEN MATCHED THEN  
		            UPDATE SET SEGMENT4 = @DIO
		                 , modify_user_id = @USER_ID, modify_date = GETDATE()
		          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
		            INSERT (
		               SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2,SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4, 
					   SEGMENT5, LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE
		              ,modify_user_id, modify_date
		              ,create_user_id, create_date
		            )
		            VALUES (
		               @DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID, @ITEM_ID,@DIO,
					   '-', 'MATERIAL_DIO_DAY',
					   @USER_ID, GetDate(),
					   @USER_ID, GetDate()
		            )
		          ;
		        
		        COMMIT;
		       
		        
		      END;
]]>
				</text>

				<parameters>
					<parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
					<parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
					<parameter replace-what="ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
					<parameter replace-what="DIO" name="DIO" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
					<parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
				</parameters>

  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
  	

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                           THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                             THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')               THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '') THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
		        ,A.DIVISION_ID
		        ,A.SITE_ID
		        ,A.PLANT_ID
		        ,A.FACTORY_ID
		        ,A.LINE_ID
		        ,A.ITEM_ID
		        ,A.OPERATION_ID
		        ,A.SHORTER_LT
            ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE
            ,CASE WHEN B.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Factory' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
            ,CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
            ,CASE WHEN  ( AFTER_DEGAS_LT_DAY * (-1) ) > A.SHORTER_LT THEN 'Shorter L/T' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
            ,CASE WHEN E.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
            ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
            ,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.LINE_ID,A.ITEM_ID
    		                                 ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.LINE_ID,A.ITEM_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
    		      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
          FROM   BUF_FORMATION_SHORTER_LT_M A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
          AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID,
                     (CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                     	     WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                     	     ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE,
                     ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
              FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.ITEM_ID         = C.ITEM_ID
    		  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    		  		SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.SHORTER_OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, ROUND(ISNULL(A.AFTER_DEGAS_LT,0)/60/24,2) AS AFTER_DEGAS_LT_DAY
    		  		FROM 	 FP_FORMATION_LT_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  SHORTER_OPERATION_ID IS NOT NULL
    		  ) D
    		  ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID     = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID         = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID        = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID      = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND A.LINE_ID	        = D.LINE_ID
          AND A.ITEM_ID         = D.ITEM_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = D.SHORTER_OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = E.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID     = E.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID         = E.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = E.OPERATION_ID
          AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
               SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) R
          ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
          AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
          AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
          AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
          AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
          AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
          AND  A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


  </sql>

  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.TRAY_TYPE_CODE AS TRAY_ID
			,A.TRAY_TYPE_NAME AS TRAY_NAME, ISNULL(B.ATTRIBUTE1, A.DEGAS_BEFORE_TYPE) AS TRAY_TYPE, A.CELL_CNT, A.LOAD_YIELD
			,A.BUFFER_DAY, A.TRAY_CNT AS INVENTORY_CNT, A.INTRANSIT_CNT, A.DESCRIPTION
			,A.USE_YN AS ACTIVE_FLAG, A.TRAY_TYPE_GROUP AS GROUP_TRAY_ID
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
		        SELECT A.* 
		              ,MSG1
		              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                             THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
		              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')               THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
		              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
		        FROM (
		          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.TRAY_TYPE_CODE
						,A.TRAY_TYPE_NAME, A.DEGAS_BEFORE_TYPE, A.CELL_CNT, A.LOAD_YIELD
						,A.BUFFER_DAY, A.TRAY_CNT, A.INTRANSIT_CNT, A.DESCRIPTION
						,A.USE_YN, A.TRAY_TYPE_GROUP
						,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
		                ,CASE WHEN B.TRAY_TYPE_CODE IS NULL THEN 'Tray ID' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
		                --,CASE WHEN C.DEGAS_BEFORE_TYPE IS NULL OR A.DEGAS_BEFORE_TYPE <> C.DEGAS_BEFORE_TYPE THEN 'Tray Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
		                , '' AS MSG2
		                ,CASE WHEN R.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
						,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.TRAY_TYPE_CODE
						                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.TRAY_TYPE_CODE)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
						      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
		          FROM   BUF_FCS_TRAY_M A(NOLOCK)
				          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FCS_TRAY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
				          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
				          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
				          AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
				          AND A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
				          AND A.TRAY_TYPE_CODE	= B.TRAY_TYPE_CODE
						 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FCS_TRAY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
				          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
				          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
				          AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
				          AND A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
				          AND A.TRAY_TYPE_GROUP	= C.TRAY_TYPE_CODE
			          	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
								           	SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID
											FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
											WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
											AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
						) R
						ON   A.COMPANY_ID  = R.COMPANY_ID
						AND  A.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
						AND  A.SITE_ID     = R.SITE_ID
						AND  A.PLANT_ID    = R.PLANT_ID
		    	WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        	) A
      ) A
			LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK)
			ON 1=1
			AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_TRAY_TYPE'
			AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND A.PLANT_ID = B.SEGMENT1
			AND A.DEGAS_BEFORE_TYPE = B.SEGMENT2
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>

  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG6 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG6 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG6 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                           THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                             THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')               THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '') THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' 
              AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,case when B.PLANT_ID is null then 'Plant' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID is null then 'Line Setup Group' else '' end as msg3
                ,case when E.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID is null then 'Category' else '' end as msg4
                ,case when F.SETUP_KEY_ID is null then 'Class' else '' end as msg5
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID,A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID,A.SETUP_KEY_ID,A.SETUP_CONDITION_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.OPERATION_ID,A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID,A.SETUP_KEY_ID,A.SETUP_CONDITION_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg6
          FROM   BUF_SETUP_CONDITION_M A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_PLANT_M B(NOLOCK)
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
              FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M A(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT 
                     A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_LINE_SETUP_GROUP_M A(NOLOCK)
          ) D
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID      = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID = D.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID, SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_M(NOLOCK)
          ) E
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = E.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = E.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = E.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = E.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID   = E.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID, SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, SETUP_KEY_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_M(NOLOCK)
          ) F
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = F.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = F.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = F.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = F.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID   = F.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          AND A.SETUP_KEY_ID        = F.SETUP_KEY_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  	
  </sql>
