  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation_sub">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG9 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG9 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG9 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                   THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                     THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                       THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                         THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                           THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                             THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')               THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '') THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
              + ' Not Found'
              AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.*
                ,case when B.PLANT_ID is null then 'Plant' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID is null then 'Line Setup Group' else '' end as msg3
                ,case when E.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID is null then 'Category' else '' end as msg4
                ,case when F.SETUP_KEY_ID is null then 'Class' else '' end as msg5
                ,case when G.ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID is null then 'From Setup Group' else '' end as msg6
                ,case when H.ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID is null then 'To Setup Group' else '' end as msg7
                ,case when I.SETUP_CONDITION_ID is null then 'Setup Condition or Setup Time' else '' end as msg8
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID,A.SETUP_KEY_ID,A.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.SETUP_CONDITION_ID,A.OPERATION_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID,A.SETUP_KEY_ID,A.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID,A.SETUP_CONDITION_ID,A.OPERATION_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                ,CASE WHEN R.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG10
          FROM   BUF_SETUP_MATRIX_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_PLANT_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
              FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT 
                     A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_LINE_SETUP_GROUP_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          ) D
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = D.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID      = D.PLANT_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID = D.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID, SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
          ) E
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = E.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = E.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = E.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = E.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID   = E.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID, SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, SETUP_KEY_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
          ) F
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = F.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = F.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = F.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = F.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID   = F.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          AND A.SETUP_KEY_ID        = F.SETUP_KEY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
                    ,SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, SETUP_KEY_ID, ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
              UNION ALL
              SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
                    ,'Item' AS SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, '-' AS SETUP_KEY_ID, A.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_FLOW_V A
              GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID
          ) G
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = G.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = G.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = G.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = G.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID         = G.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          AND A.SETUP_KEY_ID              = G.SETUP_KEY_ID
          AND A.FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID  = G.ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
                    ,SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, SETUP_KEY_ID, ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
              UNION ALL
              SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
                    ,'Item' AS SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, '-' AS SETUP_KEY_ID, A.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_FLOW_V A
              GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID
          ) H
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = H.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = H.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = H.SITE_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = H.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID       = H.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          AND A.SETUP_KEY_ID            = H.SETUP_KEY_ID
          AND A.TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID  = H.ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT 
                     COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
                    ,SETUP_CATEGORY_ID, SETUP_KEY_ID, SETUP_CONDITION_ID, SETUP_TIME
              FROM   SCM_SETUP_CONDITION_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
          ) I
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = I.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = I.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = I.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID      = I.PLANT_ID
          AND A.OPERATION_ID  = I.OPERATION_ID
          AND A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID = I.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID   = I.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID
          AND A.SETUP_KEY_ID        = I.SETUP_KEY_ID
          AND A.SETUP_CONDITION_ID  = I.SETUP_CONDITION_ID
          AND A.SETUP_TIME          = I.SETUP_TIME
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
               SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) R
          ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
          AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
          AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
          AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
          AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  	
  </sql>

  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN LEFT(__MSG,10)=' Not Found' THEN REPLACE(__MSG,' Not Found, And ','') ELSE __MSG END) END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM 
      (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                         THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                           THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                             THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')               THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '') THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN NROW>1 THEN ' Not Found, And Data Overlap!' ELSE ' Not Found' END) AS __MSG
        FROM 
        (
            SELECT T1.*
                  ,CASE WHEN T2.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line' else '' END AS MSG1
                  ,CASE WHEN T3.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' else '' END AS MSG2
                  ,'' AS MSG3
                  ,CASE WHEN T6.WO_FLAG = 'Y' THEN (CASE WHEN T5.PARENT_ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'BOM' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                  ,CASE WHEN T6.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Pack Operation' else '' END AS MSG5
                  ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
          				,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.COMPANY_ID,T1.DIVISION_ID,T1.SITE_ID,T1.PLANT_ID,T1.FACTORY_ID,T1.ITEM_ID,T1.OPERATION_ID,T1.LINE_ID
          				                   ORDER BY T1.COMPANY_ID,T1.DIVISION_ID,T1.SITE_ID,T1.PLANT_ID,T1.FACTORY_ID,T1.ITEM_ID,T1.OPERATION_ID,T1.LINE_ID) AS NROW
            FROM   BUF_PACK_WORKER_M T1(NOLOCK)
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M T2(NOLOCK)
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T2.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T2.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.PLANT_ID = T2.PLANT_ID
            AND    T1.FACTORY_ID = T2.FACTORY_ID
            AND    T1.OPERATION_ID = T2.OPERATION_ID
            AND    T1.LINE_ID = T2.LINE_ID
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN
                   (
                      SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                                    , IC.LEVEL_2_CODE
                      FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS=IC.CLASS_ID
                      AND    IC.USE_FLAG='Y'
                      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
                   ) T3
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T3.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T3.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T3.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.ITEM_ID = T3.ITEM_ID
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                      SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                      FROM  SCM_BOM_M B(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   ) T5
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T5.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T5.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T5.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.PLANT_ID = T5.PLANT_ID
            AND    T1.ITEM_ID = T5.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M T6
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T6.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T6.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T6.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.OPERATION_ID = T6.OPERATION_ID
            AND    T6.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P'
            AND    T6.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                 SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
                 FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
                 WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                 AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            ) R
            ON   T1.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
            AND  T1.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND  T1.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
            AND  T1.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
            AND  T1.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
            AND  T1.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
            AND  T1.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
            WHERE  T1.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

<sql id="findWeekFirstDay">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

SELECT 
  'D' + ISNULL(CAL.YYYYMMDD, '') AS COL_NM,  
  CAL.ISO_YEAR  AS YEAR,  
  CAL.HALF  AS HALF,  
  CAL.QUARTER  AS QUARTER,  
  CAL.YYYYMM AS MONTH,  
  CAL.ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK,  
  'D' AS TYPE,  
  CAL.YYYYMMDD AS VALUE,  
  'D' + ISNULL(CAL.DAY, '') AS LABLE, 
  DAY_SEQ  as DAY 
FROM TH_UIS_CAL CAL(NOLOCK)
WHERE ISO_YYYYWW >= (SELECT MAX(ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL WHERE YYYYMMDD=@BASIS_DATE)
AND ISO_YYYYWW < (SELECT MAX(ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL WHERE DT=(CONVERT(DATETIME,@BASIS_DATE,112)+56))
        ORDER BY CAL.YYYYMMDD
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BASIS_DATE" name="BASIS_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

	
</sql>	

  <sql id="findBucketList">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

						SELECT DISTINCT A.COL_NM, A.YEAR, A.HALF, A.QUARTER, A.MONTH, A.WEEK, A.TYPE, A.VALUE, A.LABLE, A.DAY 
						FROM  
						   ( 
						      SELECT  
						         'D' + ISNULL(CAL.YYYYMMDD, '')  AS COL_NM,  
						         CAL.ISO_YEAR  AS YEAR,  
						         CAL.HALF  AS HALF,  
						         CAL.QUARTER  AS QUARTER,  
						         CAL.YYYYMM  AS MONTH,  
						         CAL.ISO_YYYYWW  AS WEEK,  
						         'D' AS TYPE,  
						         CAL.YYYYMMDD  AS VALUE,  
						         'D' + ISNULL(CAL.DAY, '')  AS LABLE, 
						         DAY_SEQ  as day 
						      FROM TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL(NOLOCK) 
						      WHERE ISO_YYYYWW >= (SELECT MAX(ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL WHERE YYYYMMDD=@BASIS_DATE)
						        AND ISO_YYYYWW < (SELECT MAX(ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL WHERE DT=(CONVERT(DATETIME,@BASIS_DATE,112)+56))
						   )  AS A 
        
      ]]>
      </text>

															LINE_ID,ITEM_ID,WORKER_QTY,
															INSERT_ID,INSERT_TIME,UPDATE_ID,UPDATE_TIME
										)

															B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID,B.OPERATION_ID,
															 B.LINE_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.WORKER_QTY,
															B.JOB_USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), B.JOB_USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1()
										);
										
									INSERT INTO HIS_PACK_WORKER_M
										(COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID,WORKER_QTY, INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME

											AND B.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
										);
								END
        
      ]]>

<SQLS id="FP00902_ItemSetupAttr">

  <simple-sqls>

    <sql id = "get_item_list">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
                     	select distinct a.instance_id, lk.segment2 as instance_name, a.operation_id
             ,a.active_flag	as 	ACTIVE_FLAG																			   
             ,a.insert_id, a.update_id																				   
             ,a.insert_time,a.update_time															   
             ,a.attribute1 as ATTRIBUTE1,a.attribute2 as ATTRIBUTE2,a.attribute3 as ATTRIBUTE3,a.attribute4 as ATTRIBUTE4,a.attribute5 as ATTRIBUTE5	
             ,a.attribute6 as ATTRIBUTE6 ,a.attribute7 as ATTRIBUTE7,a.attribute8 as ATTRIBUTE8,a.attribute9 as ATTRIBUTE9,a.attribute10 as ATTRIBUTE10	
             ,a.attribute11 as ATTRIBUTE11,a.attribute12 as ATTRIBUTE12,a.attribute13 as ATTRIBUTE13,a.attribute14 as ATTRIBUTE14,a.attribute15  as ATTRIBUTE15	
             
                FROM    FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_SETUP_ATTR_TYPE_M a WITH(NOLOCK)        
                
			       LEFT OUTER JOIN (                            
                  SELECT DISTINCT R.INSTANCE_ID, R.OPERATION_ID 
                  FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK) 
                  WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID 
                  AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'                
             ) R 
             ON   A.INSTANCE_ID = R.INSTANCE_ID   
             AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID 
			 
			 	   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE LK WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE='INSTANCE_ID'
AND A.INSTANCE_ID = LK.SEGMENT1
                
                WHERE 1=1
                AND ISNULL(A.INSTANCE_ID,'') <> ''
                AND (A.INSTANCE_ID = ISNULL(@INSTANCE_ID,'') OR ISNULL(@INSTANCE_ID,'') = '')
                AND (A.OPERATION_ID = ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'') OR ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'') = '')
     
]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>

    </sql>

    <sql id = "get_material_list">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
                  ;WITH USER_SHOP (INSTANCE_ID, OPERATION_ID) AS (            
                SELECT DISTINCT B.INSTANCE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
                FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)            
                WHERE  1=1                                           
                AND    B.INSTANCE_ID   = @INSTANCE_ID
                AND    B.OPERATION_ID   = @OPERATION_ID
                AND    B.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                AND	   B.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'                           
            )                              
SELECT DISTINCT V.INSTANCE_ID, V.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID,A.ITEM_NAME FROM SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK) 
INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V V WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.COMPANY_ID = V.COMPANY_ID
AND A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
AND V.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
AND V.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
       AND   EXISTS (                             
                                SELECT INSTANCE_ID FROM USER_SHOP   
                                WHERE INSTANCE_ID = V.INSTANCE_ID 
                                AND OPERATION_ID  = V.OPERATION_ID
                               )    
                               AND (ISNULL(@ITEM_NAME,'')='' OR A.ITEM_ID LIKE '%' + ISNULL(@ITEM_NAME,'') + '%')
     
]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id = "get_attr_list">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
     	
     	select distinct a.instance_id,lk.SEGMENT2 as instance_name, a.operation_id
             ,a.attribute_type as ATTRIBUTE_TYPE,
			 CASE 
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE1' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE2' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE2 
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE3' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE4' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE4 
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE5' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE5
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE6' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE6
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE7' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE7
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE8' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE8
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE9' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE9
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE10' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE10
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE11' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE11
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE12' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE12
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE13' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE13
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE14' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE14
				 WHEN ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = 'ATTRIBUTE15' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE15
				 ELSE ''
			 END AS ATTRIBUTE_NAME
			 ,a.attribute_list as ATTRIBUTE_LIST
             ,a.active_flag	as 	ACTIVE_FLAG							
             ,a.description as DESCRIPTION
             ,a.insert_id, a.update_id																				   
             ,a.insert_time,a.update_time															   
       from   FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_SETUP_ATTR_LIST_M   a WITH(NOLOCK)   		
	   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE LK WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE='INSTANCE_ID'
AND A.INSTANCE_ID = LK.SEGMENT1
	   INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_SETUP_ATTR_TYPE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
	   ON 
	   A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
	   AND A.operation_id = B.operation_id

                AND (A.OPERATION_ID = ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'') OR ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'') = '')
     
]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

    <sql id = "get_recent_item_list">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[

SELECT DISTINCT C.ITEM_ID,C.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_NAME  FROM 
(
SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID,LEFT(A.SCP_PLAN_ID,8) AS LDATE
FROm FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
WHERE
LEFT(A.SCP_PLAN_ID,8) >= CONVERT(varchar(8), DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE()), 112)
AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
AND B.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID,CONVERT(varchar(8), A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS LDATE -- LEFT(A.PLAN_DATE,8),  B.INSTANCE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, * 
FROm SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H  A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
WHERE
A.PLAN_DATE > DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE())
AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID 
AND B.OPERATION_ID =@OPERATION_ID


UNION ALL 

SELECT DISTINCT FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS ITEM_ID, FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS ITEM_NAME 
from   FP_SETUP_MATRIX_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE 1=1
AND B.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID = 'ITEM'
AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID 
AND B.OPERATION_ID =@OPERATION_ID
AND ISNULL(FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID,'') <> 'ALL'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS ITEM_ID, FROM_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID AS ITEM_NAME 
from   FP_SETUP_MATRIX_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE 1=1
AND B.SETUP_CATEGORY_ID = 'ITEM'
AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID 
AND B.OPERATION_ID =@OPERATION_ID
AND ISNULL(TO_ITEM_SETUP_GROUP_ID,'') <> 'ALL'
) C

--LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
--ON C.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID
ORDER BY ITEM_ID															
     
]]>
      </text>

BEGIN

using 
(
	SELECT 
	@INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID,

) B

  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN LEFT(__MSG,10)=' Not Found' THEN REPLACE(__MSG,' Not Found, And ','') ELSE __MSG END) END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM 
      (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                         THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                           THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                             THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')               THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '') THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN NROW>1 THEN ' Not Found, And Data Overlap!' ELSE ' Not Found' END) AS __MSG
        FROM 
        (
            SELECT T1.*
                  ,CASE WHEN T2.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line' else '' END AS MSG1
                  ,CASE WHEN T3.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' else '' END AS MSG2
                  ,'' AS MSG3
                  ,CASE WHEN T6.WO_FLAG = 'Y' THEN (CASE WHEN T5.PARENT_ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'BOM' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                  ,CASE WHEN T6.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Pack Operation' else '' END AS MSG5
                  ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
          				,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T1.COMPANY_ID,T1.DIVISION_ID,T1.SITE_ID,T1.PLANT_ID,T1.FACTORY_ID,T1.ITEM_ID,T1.OPERATION_ID,T1.LINE_ID
          				                   ORDER BY T1.COMPANY_ID,T1.DIVISION_ID,T1.SITE_ID,T1.PLANT_ID,T1.FACTORY_ID,T1.ITEM_ID,T1.OPERATION_ID,T1.LINE_ID) AS NROW
            FROM   BUF_PACK_WORKER_M T1(NOLOCK)
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M T2(NOLOCK)
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T2.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T2.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.PLANT_ID = T2.PLANT_ID
            AND    T1.FACTORY_ID = T2.FACTORY_ID
            AND    T1.OPERATION_ID = T2.OPERATION_ID
            AND    T1.LINE_ID = T2.LINE_ID
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN
                   (
                      SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                                    , IC.LEVEL_2_CODE
                      FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS=IC.CLASS_ID
                      AND    IC.USE_FLAG='Y'
                      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
                   ) T3
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T3.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T3.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T3.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.ITEM_ID = T3.ITEM_ID
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                      SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                      FROM  SCM_BOM_M B(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   ) T5
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T5.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T5.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T5.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.PLANT_ID = T5.PLANT_ID
            AND    T1.ITEM_ID = T5.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M T6
            ON     T1.COMPANY_ID = T6.COMPANY_ID
            AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T6.DIVISION_ID
            AND    T1.SITE_ID = T6.SITE_ID
            AND    T1.OPERATION_ID = T6.OPERATION_ID
            AND    T6.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P'
            AND    T6.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                 SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
                 FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
                 WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                 AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            ) R
            ON   T1.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
            AND  T1.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND  T1.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
            AND  T1.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
            AND  T1.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
            AND  T1.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
            AND  T1.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
            WHERE  T1.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id = "get_item_list">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
                     	select a.instance_id, a.operation_id
             ,a.active_flag	as 	ACTIVE_FLAG																			   
             ,a.insert_id, a.update_id																				   
             ,a.insert_time,a.update_time															   
             ,a.attribute1 as ATTRIBUTE1,a.attribute2 as ATTRIBUTE2,a.attribute3 as ATTRIBUTE3,a.attribute4 as ATTRIBUTE4,a.attribute5 as ATTRIBUTE5	
             ,a.attribute6 as ATTRIBUTE6 ,a.attribute7 as ATTRIBUTE7,a.attribute8 as ATTRIBUTE8,a.attribute9 as ATTRIBUTE9,a.attribute10 as ATTRIBUTE10	
             ,a.attribute11 as ATTRIBUTE11,a.attribute12 as ATTRIBUTE12,a.attribute13 as ATTRIBUTE13,a.attribute14 as ATTRIBUTE14,a.attribute15  as ATTRIBUTE15	
             
                FROM    FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_SETUP_ATTR_TYPE_M a WITH(NOLOCK)        
                
			       LEFT OUTER JOIN (                            
                  SELECT DISTINCT R.INSTANCE_ID, R.OPERATION_ID 
                  FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK) 
                  WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID 
                  AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'                
             ) R 
             ON   A.INSTANCE_ID = R.INSTANCE_ID   
             AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID 
                
                WHERE 1=1
                AND ISNULL(A.INSTANCE_ID,'') <> ''
                AND (A.INSTANCE_ID = ISNULL(@INSTANCE_ID,'') OR ISNULL(@INSTANCE_ID,'') = '')
                AND (A.OPERATION_ID = ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'') OR ISNULL(@OPERATION_ID,'') = '')
     
]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>

    </sql>

    <sql id = "get_material_list">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
                  ;WITH USER_SHOP (INSTANCE_ID, OPERATION_ID) AS (            
                SELECT DISTINCT B.INSTANCE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
                FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)            
                WHERE  1=1                                           
                AND    B.INSTANCE_ID   = @INSTANCE_ID
                AND    B.OPERATION_ID   = @OPERATION_ID
                AND    B.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                AND	   B.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'                           
            )                              
SELECT DISTINCT V.INSTANCE_ID, V.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID,A.ITEM_NAME FROM SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK) 
INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V V WITH(NOLOCK)
ON 1=1
AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.COMPANY_ID = V.COMPANY_ID
AND A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID

    <sql id = "get_recent_item_list">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
SELECT DISTINCT C.ITEM_ID,C.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_NAME  FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID,LEFT(A.SCP_PLAN_ID,8) AS LDATE
FROm FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
WHERE
LEFT(A.SCP_PLAN_ID,8) >= CONVERT(varchar(8), DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE()), 112)
AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
AND B.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID,CONVERT(varchar(8), A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS LDATE -- LEFT(A.PLAN_DATE,8),  B.INSTANCE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, * 
FROm SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H  A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
WHERE
A.PLAN_DATE > DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE())
AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID 
AND B.OPERATION_ID =@OPERATION_ID
) C
--LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
--ON C.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID
ORDER BY ITEM_ID											
     
]]>
      </text>

<simple-sqls>

	<sql id="delete_Excel_buffer">
	
		<text>
			<![CDATA[
			
						DELETE FROM BUF_OPERATION_MOVE_M
	  					WHERE JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
			
			]]>
		</text>
	
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	
	</sql>
	
  	<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">

		<text>
			<![CDATA[
						
						  SELECT A.*
					            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE __MSG END AS _MSG
					            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
					      FROM (
					        SELECT A.* 
					              ,MSG1
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                           THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                             THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')               THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '') THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
					              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
					        FROM (
					          SELECT A.*
					                ,CASE WHEN B.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Factory' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
					                ,CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
					                ,CASE WHEN D.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Model Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
					                ,CASE WHEN E.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Attribute' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
					                ,(CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END) AS MSG5
					          FROM   BUF_OPERATION_MOVE_M A(NOLOCK)
					          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
					            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M BBB(NOLOCK)
					            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
					          ) B
					          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
					          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
					          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
					          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
					          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
					          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
					            FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M CCC(NOLOCK)
					            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
					          ) C
					          ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
					          AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
					          AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
					          AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
					          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					              SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT3 AS PLANT_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT5 AS CODE_ID
					              FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
					              WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_MODEL_TYPE'
					              AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
					          ) D
					          ON  A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
					          AND A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
					          AND A.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID
					          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = D.FACTORY_ID
					          AND A.MODEL_TYPE  = D.CODE_ID
					          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					              SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT3 AS PLANT_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID
					                   , A.SEGMENT5 AS CODE_ID
					              FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
					              WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_ATTRIBUTE'
					              AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
					          ) E
					          ON  A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
					          AND A.SITE_ID     = E.SITE_ID
					          AND A.PLANT_ID    = E.PLANT_ID
					          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = E.FACTORY_ID
					          AND A.LINE_ATTR_1 = E.CODE_ID
					          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					               SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
					               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
					               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
					               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
					          ) R
					          ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
					          AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
					          AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
					          AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
					          AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
					          AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
					          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
					        ) A
					      ) A
					      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
			]]>
		</text>
		
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	
	</sql>

  	<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation_sub">

		<text>
      		<![CDATA[
						SELECT A.*
						    ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE __MSG END AS _MSG
						    ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
						FROM (
								SELECT A.*
								      ,MSG1
								      +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                         THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
								      +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                           THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
								      +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                             THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
								      +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')               THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
								      +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '') THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
								      + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
								FROM (
										  SELECT A.*, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME
										        ,case when B.ITEM_ID is null then 'Material' else '' end as msg1
										        ,case when C.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Factory' else '' end as msg2
										        ,case when D.OPERATION_ID is null then 'Operation' else '' end as msg3
										        ,CASE WHEN E.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Model Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
										        ,CASE WHEN F.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Attribute' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
										        ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
										  FROM   BUF_ITEM_FLOW_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
										  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										      SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
										      FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC WITH(NOLOCK)
										      WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS=IC.CLASS_ID
										      AND    IC.USE_FLAG='Y'
										      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
										  ) B
										  ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
										  AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
										  AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
										  AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
										  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										    SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
										    FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M CCC(NOLOCK)
										    WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
										  )C
										  ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
										  AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
										  AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
										  AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID
										  AND A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID
										  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										    SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
										    FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M DDD(NOLOCK)
										    WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
										  ) D
										  ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
										  AND A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
										  AND A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
										  AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
										  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT3 AS PLANT_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT5 AS CODE_ID
										      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
										      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_MODEL_TYPE'
										      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
										  ) E
										  ON  A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
										  AND A.SITE_ID     = E.SITE_ID
										  AND A.PLANT_ID    = E.PLANT_ID
										  AND A.FACTORY_ID  = E.FACTORY_ID
										  AND A.MODEL_TYPE  = E.CODE_ID
										  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT3 AS PLANT_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID
										           , A.SEGMENT5 AS CODE_ID
										      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
										      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_ATTRIBUTE'
										      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
										  ) F
										  ON  A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
										  AND A.SITE_ID     = F.SITE_ID
										  AND A.PLANT_ID    = F.PLANT_ID
										  AND A.FACTORY_ID  = F.FACTORY_ID
										  AND A.LINE_ATTR_1 = F.CODE_ID
										  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
										       SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
										       FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
										       WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
										       AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
										  ) R
										  ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
										  AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
										  AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
										  AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
										  AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
										  AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
										  WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
									) A
							) A
						ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER	
    
			]]>
		</text>
	
		<parameters>

		<sql id = "delete_Excel_buffer">
		
			<text>

			]]>
			</text>
			
			<parameters>

		<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
   
			<text>
			<![CDATA[
				
				SELECT 	A.*
			            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN '' ELSE __MSG END AS _MSG
			            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
			    FROM	(
					        SELECT A.* 
					              ,MSG1
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                             THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')               THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
					              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '') THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
					              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
					        FROM (
							          SELECT A.*
							                ,CASE WHEN B.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'From Site-Plant' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
							                ,CASE WHEN C.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'To Site-Plant' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
							                ,CASE WHEN R.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions(From)' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
							                ,CASE WHEN R2.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions(To)' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
							          FROM   BUF_SHIPMENT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
									              FROM   SCM_PLANT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
									          ) B
									          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
									          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
									          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
									          AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									              SELECT DISTINCT A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
									              FROM   SCM_PLANT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
									          ) C
									          ON  A.TO_SITE_ID  = C.SITE_ID
									          AND A.TO_PLANT_ID = C.PLANT_ID
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									               SELECT DISTINCT R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID
									               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
									               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
									               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
									          ) R
									          ON   A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
									          AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
									          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									               SELECT DISTINCT R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID
									               FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
									               WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
									               AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
									          ) R2
									          ON   A.TO_SITE_ID   = R2.SITE_ID
									          AND  A.TO_PLANT_ID  = R2.PLANT_ID
							          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
								) A
			      		) A
				ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER

			              RTRIM(LTRIM(@MON)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@TUE)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@WED)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@THU)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@FRI)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SAT)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SUN)),

<SQLS id="FP00591">
  <simple-sqls>
   
    <sql id="findSiteList">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT SITE_ID AS CODE,
        	   '(' + SITE_ID + ')' + CASE WHEN SITE_NAME = '' OR SITE_NAME IS NULL THEN SITE_ID ELSE SITE_NAME END AS NAME		
        FROM   SCM_SITE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    A.SITE_ID IN (
        	SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT3 AS SITE_ID
        	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'TOTAL_INSTANCE_INFO'
        	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG	    = 'Y'
        )
        AND    EXISTS (
        	SELECT 1
        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
        	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
        	AND    B.USER_ID	   = @USER_ID
        )
        GROUP BY SITE_ID, SITE_NAME
        ORDER BY SITE_ID ASC
      ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>
  	
    <sql id="findTotalInstanceList">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE, A.SEGMENT1 AS NAME, MAX(A.SEGMENT2) AS INSTANCE_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'TOTAL_INSTANCE_INFO'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
          AND    A.SEGMENT3         = @SITE_ID
          GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1
          ORDER BY A.SEGMENT1
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>
    
    <sql id="findIsRunningPlan">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT ISNULL(MAX(A.ACTIVE_FLAG),0) AS CNT
               , MAX(A.PLAN_ID) AS PLAN_ID
               , MAX(A.INSERT_ID) AS INSERT_ID
          FROM   FP_PLAN_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = '1'
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID IN (
          	SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_ID
          	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'TOTAL_INSTANCE_INFO'
          	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          	AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID
          )
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>
    
    <sql id="findTotalPlanList">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT A.INTG_PLAN_ID AS CODE, A.INTG_PLAN_ID AS NAME
          FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.INTG_PLAN_ID LIKE '%' + @INSTANCE_ID + '%'
          AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.PLAN_START_TIME, 112) = @PLAN_DATE
          AND    PLAN_TYPE <> 'RELEASE'
          AND    RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID,2) <> '00'
          GROUP BY A.INTG_PLAN_ID
          ORDER BY A.INTG_PLAN_ID DESC
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>
    
    <sql id="findPlanList">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT A.PLAN_ID AS CODE, A.PLAN_ID AS NAME
               , A.INSTANCE_ID, A.PLAN_ID, A.PLAN_TYPE, A.SITE_ID
          	   , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.PLAN_START_TIME, 112) AS PLAN_START_TIME
          	   , A.PLAN_HORIZON, A.DEMAND_HORIZON, A.CONFIG_SET_ID, A.BASIS_PLAN_ID  
          	   , A.DESCRIPTION, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.INSERT_ID
          	   , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.CONFIRM_TIME, 120) AS CONFIRM_TIME
          	   , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.INSERT_TIME , 120) AS INSERT_TIME
          	   , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PRE_FIX_DATE,112) AS PRE_FIX_DATE
          FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.INTG_PLAN_ID = @INTG_PLAN_ID
          AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.PLAN_START_TIME, 112) = @PLAN_DATE
          AND    PLAN_TYPE <> 'RELEASE'
          AND    RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID,2) <> '00'
          ORDER BY CODE DESC
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INTG_PLAN_ID" name="INTG_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>
    
    <sql id="findEngineRun">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          WITH _PLAN_INFO AS (
          	SELECT INSTANCE_ID, PLAN_ID
          	FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          	WHERE  A.INTG_PLAN_ID  = @INTG_PLAN_ID
          )
          SELECT A.*
          	 , CASE WHEN A.STATUS_FLAG = 'R' THEN 'Ready'
          		    WHEN A.STATUS_FLAG = 'P' THEN 'Processing'+CASE WHEN A.STATUS_START IS NOT NULL THEN ' ('+CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,GETDATE())/60) + ':' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,GETDATE())-(DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,GETDATE())/60)*60) + ')' END
          		    --WHEN A.STATUS_FLAG = 'C' THEN 'Completed' +CASE WHEN A.STATUS_END   IS NOT NULL THEN ' ('+CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.STATUS_START, 20) + '  /  '  + CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,A.STATUS_END)/60) + ':' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,A.STATUS_END)-(DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,A.STATUS_END)/60)*60) + ')' END
          		    WHEN A.STATUS_FLAG = 'C' THEN 'Completed' +CASE WHEN A.STATUS_END   IS NOT NULL THEN ' ('+CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.STATUS_START, 20) + ' / ' +CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.STATUS_END, 20) + '(' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,A.STATUS_END)/60) + ':' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,A.STATUS_END)-(DATEDIFF(SECOND,A.STATUS_START,A.STATUS_END)/60)*60) + '))' END
          		    WHEN A.STATUS_FLAG = 'E' THEN 'Error'
          	        ELSE NULL END AS STATUS_MSG
          FROM (
          	SELECT MAX(ENGINE_STATUS) AS ENGINE_STATUS
          		 , MAX(STATUS_NAME) AS STATUS_NAME 
          		 , MAX(STATUS_FLAG) AS STATUS_FLAG
          		 , MAX(STATUS_STEP) AS STATUS_STEP
          		 , MAX(STATUS_START) AS STATUS_START, MIN(STATUS_END) AS STATUS_END
          	FROM (
          		SELECT (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN ENGINE_STATUS ELSE '' END) AS ENGINE_STATUS
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_NAME   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_NAME
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_FLAG   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_FLAG
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_STEP   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_STEP
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_START  ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '1990-01-01') END) AS STATUS_START
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM2 = 1 THEN STATUS_END   ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '2999-01-01') END) AS STATUS_END
          			 , RNUM, RNUM2
          		FROM (
          			SELECT A.*
          				 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP, A.STATUS_START ) AS RNUM
          				 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP DESC, A.STATUS_END DESC ) AS RNUM2
          			FROM (
          			   SELECT 'INBOUND' AS ENGINE_STATUS, 'Input Data Create' AS STATUS_NAME, 
          				   A.INBOUND_FLAG AS STATUS_FLAG, A.INBOUND_STEP AS STATUS_STEP ,      
          				   FORMAT(A.INBOUND_START ,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS STATUS_START ,  
          				   FORMAT(A.INBOUND_END   ,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS STATUS_END
          			   FROM   FP_PLAN_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK), _PLAN_INFO B with(nolock)
          			   WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
          			   AND    A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID
          			) A
          		) A
          	) A
          	UNION ALL
          	SELECT MAX(ENGINE_STATUS) AS ENGINE_STATUS
          		 , MAX(STATUS_NAME) AS STATUS_NAME 
          		 , MAX(STATUS_FLAG) AS STATUS_FLAG
          		 , MAX(STATUS_STEP) AS STATUS_STEP
          		 , MAX(STATUS_START) AS STATUS_START, MIN(STATUS_END) AS STATUS_END
          	FROM (
          		SELECT (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN ENGINE_STATUS ELSE '' END) AS ENGINE_STATUS
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_NAME   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_NAME
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_FLAG   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_FLAG
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_STEP   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_STEP
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_START  ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '1990-01-01') END) AS STATUS_START
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM2 = 1 THEN STATUS_END   ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '2999-01-01') END) AS STATUS_END
          			 , RNUM, RNUM2
          		FROM (
          			SELECT A.*
          				 --, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP, A.STATUS_START ) AS RNUM
          				 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP DESC, A.STATUS_START DESC ) AS RNUM
          				 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP DESC, A.STATUS_END DESC ) AS RNUM2
          			FROM (
          			   SELECT 'ENGINE' AS ENGINE_STATUS, 'Engine Running' AS STATUS_NAME, 
          				   A.ENGINE_FLAG AS STATUS_FLAG, A.ENGINE_STEP AS STATUS_STEP ,      
          				   FORMAT(A.ENGINE_START ,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS STATUS_START ,
          				   FORMAT(A.ENGINE_END   ,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS STATUS_END
          			   FROM   FP_PLAN_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK), _PLAN_INFO B with(nolock)
          			   WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
          			   AND    A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID
          			) A
          		) A
          	) A
          	UNION ALL
          	SELECT MAX(ENGINE_STATUS) AS ENGINE_STATUS
          		 , MAX(STATUS_NAME) AS STATUS_NAME 
          		 , MAX(STATUS_FLAG) AS STATUS_FLAG
          		 , MAX(STATUS_STEP) AS STATUS_STEP
          		 , MAX(STATUS_START) AS STATUS_START, MIN(STATUS_END) AS STATUS_END
          	FROM (
          		SELECT (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN ENGINE_STATUS ELSE '' END) AS ENGINE_STATUS
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_NAME   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_NAME
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_FLAG   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_FLAG
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_STEP   ELSE '' END) AS STATUS_STEP
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM = 1 THEN STATUS_START  ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '1990-01-01') END) AS STATUS_START
          			 , (CASE WHEN RNUM2 = 1 THEN STATUS_END   ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '2999-01-01') END) AS STATUS_END
          			 , RNUM, RNUM2
          		FROM (
          			SELECT A.*
          				 --, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP, A.STATUS_START ) AS RNUM
          				 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP DESC, A.STATUS_START DESC ) AS RNUM
          				 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ENGINE_STATUS, A.STATUS_NAME ORDER BY A.STATUS_STEP DESC, A.STATUS_END DESC ) AS RNUM2
          			FROM (
          			   SELECT 'OUTBOUND' AS ENGINE_STATUS, 'Output Data Create' AS STATUS_NAME, 
          				   A.OUTBOUND_FLAG AS STATUS_FLAG, A.OUTBOUND_STEP AS STATUS_STEP ,      
          				   FORMAT(A.OUTBOUND_START ,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS STATUS_START ,  
          				   FORMAT(A.OUTBOUND_END   ,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS STATUS_END
          			   FROM   FP_PLAN_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK), _PLAN_INFO B with(nolock)
          			   WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
          			   AND    A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID
          			) A
          		) A
          	) A
          ) A
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INTG_PLAN_ID" name="INTG_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>
    
    <sql id="findInstanceList">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE, A.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
               , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS IS_SAME_PLAN_ID
               , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS USE_WOW_STATUS
               , ISNULL(C.AMEND_TYPE,'AMEND UI' ) AS AMEND_TYPE
               , A.ATTRIBUTE10 AS FIX_DATE_SYNC, A.ATTRIBUTE12 AS SYNC_YN
          	   , A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
               SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, ATTRIBUTE1 AS AMEND_TYPE
               FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
               WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE AMEND UI'
          ) C
          ON     A.SEGMENT1         = C.INSTANCE_ID
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
          AND   ( A.SEGMENT1 LIKE '%CELL%' OR A.SEGMENT1 LIKE '%PACK%' OR A.SEGMENT1 LIKE '%FORM%' OR A.SEGMENT1 LIKE '%PMIX%' OR A.SEGMENT1 LIKE '%PRE%' OR  A.SEGMENT1 LIKE 'PL_E_%')
          AND    A.SEGMENT1 NOT IN ( 'CN_FORM_T' )
          AND    EXISTS (
          	SELECT 1
          	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
          	WHERE  A.SEGMENT1 = B.INSTANCE_ID
          	AND    B.SITE_ID  = @SITE_ID
          	AND    B.USER_ID  = @USER_ID
          )
          AND   A.SEGMENT1 IN (
          	SELECT A.SEGMENT2
          	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'TOTAL_INSTANCE_INFO'
          	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG	    = 'Y'
          	AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @INTG_PLAN_ID
          )
          GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE3, ISNULL(C.AMEND_TYPE,'AMEND UI')
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE10, A.ATTRIBUTE12
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE10, A.ATTRIBUTE12  ,A.SORT_ORDER
          ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER
        ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="INTG_PLAN_ID" name="INTG_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
      </parameters>
    </sql>

      <text>
      <![CDATA[
          WITH _INSTANCELIST AS (
          	SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT3 AS SITE_ID, @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE
          	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)

          SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, MAX(A.PLAN_ID) AS PLAN_ID
          FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK), _INSTANCELIST B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
          AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.PLAN_START_TIME, 112) = @PLAN_DATE
          AND    A.PLAN_TYPE <> 'RELEASE'
          GROUP BY A.INSTANCE_ID

  <sql id="findLineCode_List">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE
           , '(' + A.LINE_ID + ')' + (CASE WHEN A.LINE_NAME = '' OR A.LINE_NAME IS NULL THEN A.LINE_ID ELSE A.LINE_NAME END) AS NAME
      FROM   SCM_LINE_M A(NOLOCK)

      AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

			        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID

			        	AND    A.PLANT_ID	 = B.PLANT_ID
			        	AND    A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
			        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
			        	AND    A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
			        	AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
			      	)
      AND   EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID
              FROM  SCM_FACTORY_M A(NOLOCK)
              INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B(NOLOCK)
              ON    A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID
              AND		B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              WHERE 1=1
              AND   B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
              AND		A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID

      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      
      @CTRL_INSTANCE
      @CTRL_PLAN_TYPE
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      
      GROUP BY A.LINE_ID, A.LINE_NAME
      ORDER BY A.LINE_ID
      ]]>

                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                  ,TOTAL_BATCH
                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, @LINE_ID+'_LINE_COPY_UPDATE' AS JOB_TYPE
            FROM   FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @COPY_FACTORY_ID
            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @COPY_LINE_ID
            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID     = (	SELECT 	MAX(EQUIPMENT_ID) FROM SCM_EQUIPMENT_M SA 
											WHERE 	SA.DIVISION_ID 	= @DIVISION_ID
											[AND 	SA.SITE_ID 		= @SITE_ID] 
											[AND 	SA.PLANT_ID 	= @PLANT_ID]
											AND		SA.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID	
											[AND 	SA.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID]
											AND		SA.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
									    )
            AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)
            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
            ;
          
        COMMIT;
        
        
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

          	SELECT ISNULL(REPLICATE ('0',2-LEN(A.SEQ)) + CAST (A.SEQ AS VARCHAR ), '01') AS SEQ
          	FROM (
          		SELECT CONVERT(NUMERIC, (CASE WHEN A.SEQ > A.SEQ2 THEN A.SEQ ELSE A.SEQ2 END)) + 1 AS SEQ
          		FROM   (
          			--SELECT MAX(RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID, 2)) AS SEQ, MAX(RIGHT(A.INTG_PLAN_ID, 2)) AS SEQ2
          			--SELECT MAX(RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID, 2)) AS SEQ, ISNULL(MAX(RIGHT(A.INTG_PLAN_ID, 2)),'01') AS SEQ2

          			FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK), _INSTANCELIST B WITH(NOLOCK)

             , SCP_PLAN_ID,        PLAN_WEEK,         CONFIRM_FLAG,       PRE_FIX_FLAG
             , PRE_FIX_TARGET_ID,  SYNC_OPERATION_ID, DESCRIPTION,        INSERT_ID
             , INSERT_TIME,        UPDATE_ID,         UPDATE_TIME,        PRE_FIX_DATE
             , PRE_FIX_TYPE,       PRE_FIX_DATE1,     PRE_FIX_TYPE1,      PRE_FIX_DATE2
             , PRE_FIX_TYPE2,      INTG_PLAN_ID
          )
          SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.PLAN_ID, 'PRE' AS PLAN_TYPE, A.SITE_ID

               , NULL AS PRE_FIX_TARGET_ID,  NULL AS SYNC_OPERATION_ID, A.DESCRIPTION, A.USER_ID AS INSERT_ID
               , dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME, A.USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME, CONVERT(DATE,@FIX_DATE) AS PRE_FIX_DATE
               , @FIX_TYPE AS PRE_FIX_TYPE, CONVERT(DATE,@FIX_DATE) AS PRE_FIX_DATE1, @FIX_TYPE AS PRE_FIX_TYPE1, NULL AS PRE_FIX_DATE2
               , NULL AS PRE_FIX_TYPE2, A.INTG_PLAN_ID
          FROM   (
          	SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, (A.INSTANCE_ID + '-' + A.PLAN_DATE + '-' + B.SEQ) AS PLAN_ID, (A.TOTAL_INSTANCE_ID + '-' + A.PLAN_DATE + '-' + B.SEQ) AS INTG_PLAN_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.USER_ID

				                 WHEN CHARINDEX('E_PRE', A.INSTANCE_ID) > 0 THEN @DESC_ELEC
				                 ELSE '' END) AS DESCRIPTION
          	FROM   _INSTANCELIST A, _SEQ B

      ]]>

           , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
           , A.ITEM_ID
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.START_DATE,112) AS START_DATE
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.END_DATE,112) AS END_DATE
           , A.YIELD AS YIELD
           , A.CHILD_YIELD AS CHILD_YIELD
      FROM   @AMEND_BOR_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
      AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID  = @PLAN_ID
      ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, START_DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>
