 <sql id="merge_Excel_import">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
      	MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R AS A
      	USING (
            SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, BB.FP_PLAN_ID
                 , BB.COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.FACTORY_ID, ISNULL(CC.LOCATION,'-') AS LOCATION
                 , BB.OPERATION_ID, BB.LINE_ID, CC.ELECTRODE_TYPE, BB.EQUIPMENT_ID
                 , BB.ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, BB.ITEM_ID
                 , UPPER(BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                 , BB.PLAN_DATE
                 , ROUND(BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                 , ROUND(BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                 , BB.SEQ
                 , BB.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, BB.VERSION, DD.PROD_SEQ
                 , (case when BB.PLM_EC_NO is null or BB.PLM_EC_NO = '' then '-' else BB.PLM_EC_NO end) AS PLM_EC_NO
            FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M CC WITH(NOLOCK)
            ON     BB.DIVISION_ID     = CC.DIVISION_ID
            AND    BB.SITE_ID         = CC.SITE_ID
            AND    BB.PLANT_ID        = CC.PLANT_ID
            AND    BB.FACTORY_ID      = CC.FACTORY_ID
            AND    BB.OPERATION_ID    = CC.OPERATION_ID
            AND    BB.LINE_ID         = CC.LINE_ID
            AND    BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = CC.ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
            INNER JOIN (
    	           	SELECT FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION AS OPERATION_ID, VERSION, MAX(PROD_SEQ) AS PROD_SEQ
    	          	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    	           	WHERE  1=1
    	           	AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
    	           	AND    A.CATEGORY IN ( 'JUMBO ROLL (CELL/M)', 'LANE NUMBER', 'PANCAKE (M/BATCH)', 'CELL/BATCH', 'JUMBO ROLL (M/BATCH)', 'PANCAKE (CELL/M)' )
    	           	GROUP BY FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION, VERSION
            ) DD
            ON  BB.FACTORY_ID            = DD.FACTORY_ID
            AND BB.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = DD.MODEL_ID
            AND BB.ITEM_ID               = DD.ITEM_ID
            AND BB.OPERATION_ID          = DD.OPERATION_ID
            AND BB.VERSION               = DD.VERSION
            WHERE  BB.JOB_USER_ID     = @USER_ID
            AND	   BB.INSTANCE_ID     = @INSTANCE_ID
      	) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID 	  = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
        AND A.VERSION               = B.VERSION
        AND A.PLM_EC_NO             = B.PLM_EC_NO
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET 	ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH 		= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
						, ADJUST_IN_QTY_M 			= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
						, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL 		= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
						, ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR 			= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
						, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
						--, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
	                    --, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
	                    --, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
	                    , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
					  	, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
						, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))                                                
                                                      
                    , SEQ = B.SEQ
                    , PRODUCTION_TYPE       = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
    		            , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,SEQ
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_IN_QTY
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_M, PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_OUT_QTY
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,(SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE KK.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
              ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
              ,B.LOCATION, B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.EQUIPMENT_ID ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.SEQ
              ,null, null
              ,null, null
              ,null, null
              ,null, null
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, 0
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, 0
              --,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              --,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              --,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR 
              , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
			  , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
			  , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID

						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID

						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))						                                                  
			  
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, B.VERSION, B.PROD_SEQ, B.PLM_EC_NO
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,SEQ
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_IN_QTY
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_M, PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_OUT_QTY
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME,JOB_TYPE
              ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO
        )
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,(SELECT MAX(YY.COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M YY WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = YY.FACTORY_ID AND	YY.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID
              ,A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,ISNULL(C.LOCATION,'-') AS LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PLAN_DATE
              ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
              ,UPPER(A.PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
              ,A.SEQ
              ,0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY
              ,0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY_M, 0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,0 AS PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS  PLAN_OUT_QTY
              ,0 AS PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, 0 AS PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS ADJUST_IN_QTY

              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
              ,A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, (case when A.PLM_EC_NO is null or A.PLM_EC_NO = '' then '-' else A.PLM_EC_NO end) AS PLM_EC_NO
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON     A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID        = C.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = C.FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
        AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
        INNER JOIN FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R B WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID 	  = B.DIVISION_ID

  <sql id="find_addPdsValidation">
    <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
             , E.MODEL_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, E.NICK_NAME, E.ITEM_TYPE
             , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	 , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
        FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK) 
        , (
            SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID 
            FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK) 
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
            GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID 
        ) B
        , SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
        , (
        	SELECT DISTINCT IV.COMPANY_ID, IV.DIVISION_ID, IV.SITE_ID, IV.PLANT_ID, SS.PRODUCTION_TYPE, SS.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V IV WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SV WITH(NOLOCK)
        	, (
        			SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SS WITH(NOLOCK)
        			WHERE 1=1
        			AND SS.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
        			AND SS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        			AND SS.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' -- PDA TARGET FLAG
        			--AND SV.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'Y' -- VERSION ONLY
        	) SS
        	WHERE	1=1
        	AND		SV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'PDS_INSTANCE'
        	AND		SV.ACTIVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
        	AND		SV.SEGMENT1		  = IV.INSTANCE_ID
        	AND		IV.INSTANCE_ID	= @INSTANCE_ID
        	AND		IV.DIVISION_ID	=  SS.DIVISION_ID
        ) D
        , (
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                ,ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME, A.FLOW_ID
        		,(CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                       WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                       ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE
            FROM SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                 SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE B WITH(NOLOCK),
                 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK),
            (
        		SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
        		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
        		WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
        		AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
        		AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
        		AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
        		AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        		AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
        		AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
            ) D
            WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
            AND	  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
            AND	  A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
            AND	  A.ITEM_ID     = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
            AND	  A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
            AND   A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
            AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
            AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
            AND   A.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
            AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND   C.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND   B.EFF_END_DATE >= GETDATE()
        ) E 
        , SCM_LINE_M F WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  1=1 
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID 
        AND    A.MFG_WEEK >= (SELECT (ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_DATE)
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID 
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID 
        AND    C.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @PLAN_DATE)
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = D.PRODUCTION_TYPE -- DEMAND_TYPE
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID 
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = F.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = F.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = F.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = F.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = F.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = F.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = F.LINE_ID 
        AND    C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = F.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = @FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID       = @OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.LINE_ID            = @LINE_ID
        AND    C.ELECTRODE_TYPE     = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    A.ITEM_ID            = @ITEM_ID
        AND    A.MARKET             = @MARKET
        AND    D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND    A.PLM_EC_NO          = @PLM_EC_NO
        AND    A.VERSION            = @VERSION
        GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	   , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION, E.NICK_NAME, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
               , E.ITEM_TYPE, E.MODEL_ID
        ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, E.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	   , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
        	   , E.NICK_NAME, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
      ]]>
    </text>
    <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "ELECTRODE_TYPE" name="ELECTRODE_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "MARKET" name="MARKET"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "PLM_EC_NO" name="PLM_EC_NO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      <parameter replace-what = "VERSION" name="VERSION"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
    </parameters>
  </sql>

  <sql id="find_pdsItemLineList">
    <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
             , A.ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, E.NICK_NAME, E.ITEM_TYPE
             , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	   , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION, G.EQUIPMENT_ID
        	   , H.MODEL_ID, H.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, H.MAX_VER_FLAG, H.VERSION_TYPE, H.PROD_SEQ
        FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK) 
        , (
            SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID 
            FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK) 
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
            GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID 
        ) B
        , SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
        , (
        	SELECT DISTINCT IV.COMPANY_ID, IV.DIVISION_ID, IV.SITE_ID, IV.PLANT_ID, SS.PRODUCTION_TYPE, SS.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V IV WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SV WITH(NOLOCK)
        	, (
        			SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE 
        			FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SS WITH(NOLOCK)
        			WHERE 1=1
        			AND SS.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
        			AND SS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        			AND SS.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' -- PDA TARGET FLAG
        			--AND SV.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'Y' -- VERSION ONLY
        	) SS
        	WHERE	1=1
        	AND		SV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'PDS_INSTANCE'
        	AND		SV.ACTIVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
        	AND		SV.SEGMENT1		  = IV.INSTANCE_ID
        	AND		IV.INSTANCE_ID	= @INSTANCE_ID
        	AND		IV.DIVISION_ID	=  SS.DIVISION_ID
        ) D
        , (
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                ,ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME, A.FLOW_ID
                ,(CASE WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' AND ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-') = '-' THEN C.LEVEL_3_NAME
                       WHEN LEFT(A.FLOW_ID,5) = 'A9000' THEN ISNULL(C.LEVEL_4_NAME, '-')
                       ELSE C.LEVEL_3_NAME END) AS ITEM_TYPE
            FROM SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                 SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE B WITH(NOLOCK),
                 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK),
            (
        		SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
        		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
        		WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
        		AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
        		AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
        		AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
        		AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        		AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
        		AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
            ) D
            WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
            AND	  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
            AND	  A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
            AND	  A.ITEM_ID     = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
            AND	  A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
            AND   A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
            AND   A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
            AND   A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
            AND   A.FLOW_ID LIKE '%' + D.OPERATION_ID + '%'
            AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND   C.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND   B.EFF_END_DATE >= GETDATE()
        ) E 
        , SCM_LINE_M F WITH(NOLOCK)
        , SCM_EQUIPMENT_M G WITH(NOLOCK)
        , (
          	SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION AS OPERATION_ID 
          		   , A.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.MAX_VER_FLAG, A.VERSION_TYPE, A.PROD_SEQ
          	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          	, (
            		SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
            		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
            		WHERE  B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
            		AND    B.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
          	) B
          	WHERE  1=1 
          	AND    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          	AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          	AND    A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
          	AND    A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          	AND    A.OPERATION   = B.OPERATION_ID
          	AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000' 
          	AND    A.CATEGORY IN ( 'cell/batch', 'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)', 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)', 'Lane Number', 'Pancake (cell/m)', 'Pancake (m/batch)' )
        ) H
        WHERE  1=1
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID 
        AND    A.MFG_WEEK >= (SELECT (ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_DATE)
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID 
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID 
        AND    C.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @PLAN_DATE)
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = D.PRODUCTION_TYPE -- DEMAND_TYPE
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID 
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = F.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = F.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = F.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = F.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = F.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = F.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = F.LINE_ID 
        AND    C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = F.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID     = G.COMPANY_ID
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = G.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID        = G.SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID       = G.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = G.FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = G.OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.LINE_ID        = G.LINE_ID
        AND    C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = G.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = H.COMPANY_ID 
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = H.DIVISION_ID 
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = H.SITE_ID 
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = H.PLANT_ID 
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = H.FACTORY_ID 
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = H.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.MODEL        = H.MODEL_ID
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = H.ITEM_ID 
        AND    A.VERSION      = H.VERSION 
        AND    F.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = H.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
        AND    D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
        @CTRL_LINE
        @CTRL_ITEM
        @CTRL_NICK
        GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	     , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION, E.NICK_NAME, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
               , E.ITEM_TYPE, G.EQUIPMENT_ID
               , H.MODEL_ID, H.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, H.MAX_VER_FLAG, H.VERSION_TYPE, H.PROD_SEQ
        ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE, G.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, D.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        	     , A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
        	     , E.NICK_NAME, F.LINE_NAME, F.LOCATION
      ]]>
    </text>
    <parameters>
      <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

    <sql id="insert_Line">

      <text>
        <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
        MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A
        USING (SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID,
                      @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID,@PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, 
                      @LOCATION AS LOCATION, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
                      @EQUIPMENT_ID AS EQUIPMENT_ID, @DATE AS PLAN_DATE,
                      @ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, 
                      UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
                      , @WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID AS WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION AS VERSION, @PROD_SEQ AS PROD_SEQ, @PLM_EC_NO AS PLM_EC_NO
                      ) B
        ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
            AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION
            AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = B.EQUIPMENT_ID AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
            AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
            AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET 
            AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID =  B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
            AND A.VERSION =  B.VERSION
            
            AND A.PLM_EC_NO =  B.PLM_EC_NO
            )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
          UPDATE SET ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH  = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                   , ADJUST_IN_QTY_M      = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                   , ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL   = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                   , ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR     = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                   , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                   , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M     = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                   , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL  = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                   , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR    = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                   , PRODUCTION_TYPE      = UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)
                   , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
          INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,SEQ
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_IN_QTY, PLAN_IN_QTY_M, PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_OUT_QTY, PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY, ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR

              ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO

              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO
          )
          VALUES (
               @INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID
              ,(SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M WHERE FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'), @DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID
              ,@LOCATION, @OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE, @EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,CONVERT(DATETIME,@DATE)
              ,@ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID
              ,UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE), @MARKET
              ,1
              ,null, null, null, null
              ,null, null, null, null
              ,@ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, @ADJUST_IN_QTY, @ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, @ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, @ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, @ADJUST_OUT_QTY, @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL, @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR

              ,@WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION, @PROD_SEQ, @PLM_EC_NO

              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,@WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION, @PROD_SEQ, @PLM_EC_NO
          )
        ;
        
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

    <sql id="find_LineList">

      <text>
        <![CDATA[
      SELECT DISTINCT 
             A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , ISNULL(B.LINE_NAME,'-') AS LINE_NAME
           , B.LOCATION
           , ISNULL(B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE,'GENERAL') AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
           , E.EQUIPMENT_ID
      FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
      AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      @CTRL_CONFIRM
      --{
       -- var sql="";
        
       -- if($data.CONFIRM_AREA == "PLAN GROUP")  sql="INNER JOIN ";
       -- else                                    sql="LEFT OUTER JOIN ";
        
       -- sql;
      --}
      (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          and    A.SEGMENT1    = @INSTANCE_ID
      ) C
      ON     B.MODEL_TYPE     = C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
      INNER JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
          AND 	 B.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
          AND    B.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
          AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      ) D
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = D.SITE_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D.OPERATION_ID
      INNER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON  A.COMPANY_ID     = E.COMPANY_ID
      AND A.DIVISION_ID    = E.DIVISION_ID
      AND A.SITE_ID        = E.SITE_ID
      AND A.PLANT_ID       = E.PLANT_ID
      AND A.FACTORY_ID     = E.FACTORY_ID
      AND A.OPERATION_ID   = E.OPERATION_ID
      AND A.LINE_ID        = E.LINE_ID
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = E.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
     -- [AND    A.LINE_ID LIKE '%' +  @LINE_ID + '%']
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    A.MONTH          = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@DATE,112),1,6)
      AND		 A.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0','9')
      AND    EXISTS (
			        	SELECT 1
			        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V BB WITH(NOLOCK)
			        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID     = BB.COMPANY_ID
			        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = BB.DIVISION_ID
			        	AND    A.SITE_ID        = BB.SITE_ID
			        	AND    A.PLANT_ID       = BB.PLANT_ID
					    AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = BB.FACTORY_ID
					    AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = BB.OPERATION_ID
					    AND    A.LINE_ID        = BB.LINE_ID
			        	AND    BB.USER_ID       = @USER_ID
			        	AND	   BB.SAVE_FLAG	  = 'Y'
				    )
      ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, LINE_NAME, LOCATION

    <sql id="find_VersionList">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
      WITH PDS_4M_FLAG AS (
      	SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(ATTRIBUTE6) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE MAX(ATTRIBUTE6) END) AS VERSIONONLY
      	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
      	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      	AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @DIVISION_ID
      	AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
      )
      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
      	 , A.LINE_ID, D.LINE_NAME , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      	 , B.MODEL_ID, C.NICK_NAME 
      	 , B.VERSION_TYPE, B.VERSION 
      	 , A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID 
      	 , ISNULL(E.ACTIVE_FLAG, 'Y') AS ACTIVE_FLAG 
      	 , B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, B.MAX_VER_FLAG, E.DESCRIPTION 
         , ISNULL(E.UPDATE_ID, '') AS UPDATE_ID, ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,E.UPDATE_TIME,20), '') AS UPDATE_TIME 
         , B.PROD_SEQ
      FROM ( 
      	SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      	FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK) 
      	WHERE  1=1 
      	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' 
      	AND    A.MONTH = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), GETDATE(), 112) 
      	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' 
      	AND    A.PRIORITY IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8) 
      	AND    A.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID
      	AND    A.LINE_ID = @LINE_ID
      	AND    A.ITEM_ID = @ITEM_ID
      ) A 
      INNER JOIN ( 
      	SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION AS OPERATION_ID 
      		 , A.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.MAX_VER_FLAG, A.VERSION_TYPE, A.PROD_SEQ
      	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK) 
      	WHERE 1=1 
      	AND   A.OPERATION = 'E2000' 
      	AND   A.CATEGORY IN ( 'cell/batch', 'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)', 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)', 'Lane Number', 'Pancake (cell/m)', 'Pancake (m/batch)' )
      	AND   A.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID
      	AND   A.ITEM_ID = @ITEM_ID
      ) B 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
      AND A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
      AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M C WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND B.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
      AND B.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
      AND B.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
      AND B.MODEL_ID     = C.ITEM_ID 
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID        = D.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID       = D.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID           = D.SITE_ID 
      AND A.PLANT_ID          = D.PLANT_ID 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID        = D.FACTORY_ID 
      AND A.OPERATION_ID      = D.OPERATION_ID 
      AND A.LINE_ID           = D.LINE_ID 
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE    = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      AND B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_USE_M E WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID     = E.FACTORY_ID 
      AND B.MODEL_ID       = E.MODEL_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID        = E.ITEM_ID 
      AND A.LINE_ID        = E.LINE_ID 
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = E.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      AND B.VERSION        = E.VERSION 
      WHERE 1=1 
      AND   D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = @PROD_VERSION_TYPE
      AND    B.VERSION_TYPE IN (
      	SELECT (CASE WHEN BB.VERSIONONLY = 'Y' THEN '4M' ELSE 'MASS' END) FROM PDS_4M_FLAG BB WITH(NOLOCK)
      	UNION ALL
      	SELECT (CASE WHEN BB.VERSIONONLY = 'Y' THEN '4M' ELSE 'TEST' END) FROM PDS_4M_FLAG BB WITH(NOLOCK)
      )
      ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID
             , (CASE WHEN @PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST%' THEN (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'MASS' THEN 2 ELSE 9999 END) -- TEST, MASS, 4M
			               WHEN @PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%4M%'   THEN (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = '4M'   THEN 1 WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'MASS' THEN 2 ELSE 9999 END) -- 4M, TEST, MASS
			                                                   ELSE (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'MASS' THEN 1 WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 9999 END) -- MASS, TEST, 4M
			               END)
             , MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, LINE_ID, VERSION DESC
    ]]>
      </text>

    <sql id="find_VersionList_ASIS">
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
      	 , A.LINE_ID, D.LINE_NAME , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      	 , B.MODEL_ID, C.NICK_NAME 
      	 , B.VERSION_TYPE, B.VERSION 
      	 , A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID 
      	 --, ISNULL(E.ACTIVE_FLAG, 'Y') AS ACTIVE_FLAG 
      	 , 'Y' AS ACTIVE_FLAG
      	 , B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, B.MAX_VER_FLAG, E.DESCRIPTION 
         , ISNULL(E.UPDATE_ID, '') AS UPDATE_ID, ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,E.UPDATE_TIME,20), '') AS UPDATE_TIME 
         , B.PROD_SEQ
      FROM ( 
      	SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      	FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK) 
      	WHERE  1=1 
      	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' 
      	AND    A.MONTH = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), GETDATE(), 112) 
      	AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' 
      	AND    A.PRIORITY IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8) 
      	AND    A.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID
      	AND    A.LINE_ID = @LINE_ID
      	AND    A.ITEM_ID = @ITEM_ID
      ) A 
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT A.*
        FROM (
        	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION AS OPERATION_ID
           		 , A.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.MAX_VER_FLAG, A.VERSION_TYPE, A.PROD_SEQ
           		 , A.APPLY_DATE
           		 -- 1. MAX_VER_FLAG, 2. APPLY_DATE 3. VERSION_TYPE match, 4. VERSION
           		 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
        							              ORDER BY (CASE WHEN A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
        									                 , (CASE WHEN @PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST%' THEN (CASE WHEN A.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 9999 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN A.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 9999 ELSE 1 END) END)
        									                 , A.APPLY_DATE DESC
        									                 , A.VERSION DESC) AS ROW_NUM
        	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  1=1
        	AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
        	--AND    A.CATEGORY IN ( 'cell/batch', 'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)', 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)', 'Lane Number', 'Pancake (cell/m)', 'Pancake (m/batch)' )
        	AND    A.CATEGORY = 'cell/batch'
        	AND    A.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID
        	AND    A.ITEM_ID = @ITEM_ID
        	AND    A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
        ) A
        WHERE ROW_NUM = 1
      ) B 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
      AND A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
      AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M C WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND B.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
      AND B.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
      AND B.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
      AND B.MODEL_ID     = C.ITEM_ID 
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID        = D.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID       = D.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID           = D.SITE_ID 
      AND A.PLANT_ID          = D.PLANT_ID 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID        = D.FACTORY_ID 
      AND A.OPERATION_ID      = D.OPERATION_ID 
      AND A.LINE_ID           = D.LINE_ID 
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE    = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      AND B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_USE_M E WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID     = E.FACTORY_ID 
      AND B.MODEL_ID       = E.MODEL_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID        = E.ITEM_ID 
      AND A.LINE_ID        = E.LINE_ID 
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = E.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      AND B.VERSION        = E.VERSION 
      WHERE 1=1 
      AND   D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = @PROD_VERSION_TYPE
      ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID
             , (CASE WHEN @PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST%' THEN (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 9999 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 9999 ELSE 1 END) END)
             , MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, LINE_ID, VERSION 
    ]]>
      </text>

or

			--or
			--(@PRODUCTION_TYPE = '4M-VALID' AND A.VERSION_TYPE =  '4M')
		)

      AND B.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID

      AND A.LINE_ID        = E.LINE_ID

      WHERE 1=1 
      AND   D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = @PROD_VERSION_TYPE
      ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID
             , (CASE WHEN @PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST%' THEN (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 9999 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 9999 ELSE 1 END) END)
             , MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, LINE_ID, VERSION DESC

AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = @FACTORY_ID
AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = @OPERATION_ID
AND    A.LINE_ID         = @LINE_ID
AND    A.ITEM_ID         = @ITEM_ID
AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
AND    A.MARKET          = @MARKET
		)

	    
			--(@PRODUCTION_TYPE <> '4M-VALID' AND A.VERSION_TYPE <>  '4M')
			--or
			--(@PRODUCTION_TYPE = '4M-VALID' AND A.VERSION_TYPE =  '4M')
		)  
*/
      ) B 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
      AND A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
      AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M C WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND B.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
      AND B.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
      AND B.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
      AND B.MODEL_ID     = C.ITEM_ID 
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID        = D.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID       = D.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID           = D.SITE_ID 
      AND A.PLANT_ID          = D.PLANT_ID 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID        = D.FACTORY_ID 
      AND A.OPERATION_ID      = D.OPERATION_ID 
      AND A.LINE_ID           = D.LINE_ID 
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE    = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      AND B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_USE_M E WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.FACTORY_ID     = E.FACTORY_ID 
      AND B.MODEL_ID       = E.MODEL_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID        = E.ITEM_ID 
      AND A.LINE_ID        = E.LINE_ID 
      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = E.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
      AND B.VERSION        = E.VERSION 
      WHERE 1=1 
      AND   D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = @PROD_VERSION_TYPE
      ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID
             , (CASE WHEN @PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST%' THEN (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 9999 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN B.VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 9999 ELSE 1 END) END)
             , MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, LINE_ID, VERSION DESC
    ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

    <sql id="find_targetInfo">

      <text>
        <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
      		--, ( CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID='A9000' THEN ( CASE WHEN G.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'RCCP or Test Target' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END ) AS MSG1
      		, '' AS MSG1
          --, ( CASE WHEN H.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG2
      		, '' AS MSG2
          , ( CASE WHEN C.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'cell/batch' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG3
          , ( CASE WHEN D.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'Pancake (m/batch)' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG4
          , ( CASE WHEN E.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG5
          ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
      FROM (
	          SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID
		              , (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M FF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE FF.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID AND FF.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID
		              , @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
		              , @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, @LOCATION AS LOCATION
		              , @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
		              , @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              , @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID
		              , (CASE WHEN @PROD_VERSION_TYPE IS NULL OR @PROD_VERSION_TYPE = '' THEN 'GENERAL' ELSE @PROD_VERSION_TYPE END) AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		              , @WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID AS WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION AS VERSION, @PROD_SEQ AS PROD_SEQ
		      ) A
		      INNER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
		      AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
		      AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID            = C.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.FACTORY_ID            = C.FACTORY_ID
		      AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = C.MODEL_ID
		      AND A.VERSION               = C.VERSION
		      AND A.OPERATION_ID          = C.OPERATION
		      AND A.ITEM_ID               = C.ITEM_ID
		      AND C.CATEGORY = 'cell/batch'
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID            = D.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.FACTORY_ID            = D.FACTORY_ID
		      AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = D.MODEL_ID
		      AND A.VERSION               = D.VERSION
		      AND A.OPERATION_ID          = D.OPERATION
		      AND A.ITEM_ID               = D.ITEM_ID
		      AND D.CATEGORY = 'Pancake (m/batch)'
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID            = E.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.FACTORY_ID            = E.FACTORY_ID
		      AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = E.MODEL_ID
		      AND A.VERSION               = E.VERSION
		      AND A.OPERATION_ID          = E.OPERATION
		      AND A.ITEM_ID               = E.ITEM_ID
		      AND E.CATEGORY = 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
		          SELECT DISTINCT INSTANCE_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, ITEM_ID
		          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_V
		      ) G
		      ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = G.INSTANCE_ID
		      AND A.COMPANY_ID  = G.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID     = G.SITE_ID
		      AND A.PLANT_ID    = G.PLANT_ID
		      AND A.ITEM_ID     = G.ITEM_ID
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
		          SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		          FROM (
		              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_ELEC_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  (A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+A.SCP_PLAN_ID) IN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+MAX(A.SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID FROM FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_ELEC_H A WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID)
		    					UNION ALL
		    					SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_AUTO_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  A.SCP_PLAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID FROM FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_AUTO_H A WITH(NOLOCK))
		    					UNION ALL
		    					SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_TEST_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  A.DUE_DATE >= (SELECT CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PLAN_START_TIME,112))
		    					                      FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H
		    					                      WHERE  PLAN_ID = @FP_PLAN_ID )
		    					UNION ALL
		    					SELECT  DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_DAILY_INSTANCE_DEMAND_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  1=1
		    					AND   INSTANCE_ID = CASE WHEN @INSTANCE_ID = 'KR_E_PRE_A' OR @INSTANCE_ID = 'KR_E_PRE_M' THEN 'KR_E_PRE'
		    					                    ELSE @INSTANCE_ID END
		    					AND   INSTANCE_DATE = SUBSTRING(@FP_PLAN_ID,CHARINDEX('-',@FP_PLAN_ID,1)+1,8)
		    					AND   CONVERT(VARCHAR, INSTANCE_DATE,102) = ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, PLAN_START_TIME,102)
		    				                                                FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H KK WITH(NOLOCK)
		    				                                                WHERE  PLAN_ID = @FP_PLAN_ID
		    				                                            	)
		          ) A
		      ) H
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = H.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID = H.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID     = H.SITE_ID
		      AND A.PLANT_ID    = H.PLANT_ID
		      AND A.MARKET      = H.MARKET
		      AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = H.ITEM_ID
		      	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE	1=1
						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
				) R
				ON		1=1
				AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
				AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
				AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
				AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
				AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
				AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
				AND		A.LINE_ID			= R.LINE_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PLANT_ID" name="PLANT_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="LOCATION" name="LOCATION" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="MARKET" name="MARKET" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ELECTRODE_TYPE" name="ELECTRODE_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="TOP_ITEM_ID" name="TOP_ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PROD_VERSION_TYPE" name="PROD_VERSION_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID" name="WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="VERSION" name="VERSION" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PROD_SEQ" name="PROD_SEQ" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

    </sql>

		              ) A
		          ) E
		          ON     A.COMPANY_ID         = E.COMPANY_ID
		          AND    A.DIVISION_ID        = E.DIVISION_ID
		          AND    A.SITE_ID            = E.SITE_ID
		          AND    A.PLANT_ID           = E.PLANT_ID
		          AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = E.FACTORY_ID
		          AND    A.OPERATION          = E.OPERATION
		          AND    A.ITEM_ID            = E.ITEM_ID
		          AND    A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE  = E.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		          --AND    A.MODEL_ID           = E.MODEL_ID
		          WHERE  A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
		          AND    A.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (m/batch)'
		          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		      ) D
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = D.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID       = D.SITE_ID
		      AND A.PLANT_ID      = D.PLANT_ID
		      AND A.FACTORY_ID    = D.FACTORY_ID
		      --AND B.APPLIED_MODEL = D.MODEL_ID
		      AND A.OPERATION_ID  = D.OPERATION
		      AND A.ITEM_ID       = D.ITEM_ID
		      AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
		          SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
		               --, A.MODEL_ID
		               , A.OPERATION
		               , A.ITEM_ID
		               , A.CATEGORY
		               , A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		          FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
		          INNER JOIN (
		              SELECT DISTINCT A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS E_CATEGORY
		              FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
		              WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ITEM_CONV_CALC'
		              AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
		          ) D
		          ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
		          INNER JOIN (
		              SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		              FROM (
		                  SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE
		                  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
		                  WHERE  A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
		                  AND    A.VALUE > 0
		                  AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)'
		                                        , 'Lane Number'
		                                        , 'Pancake (m/batch)'
		                                        , 'cell/batch'
		                                        , 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
		                                        , 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
		                  GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE
		                  HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
		              ) A
		          ) E
		          ON     A.COMPANY_ID         = E.COMPANY_ID
		          AND    A.DIVISION_ID        = E.DIVISION_ID
		          AND    A.SITE_ID            = E.SITE_ID
		          AND    A.PLANT_ID           = E.PLANT_ID
		          AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = E.FACTORY_ID
		          AND    A.OPERATION          = E.OPERATION
		          AND    A.ITEM_ID            = E.ITEM_ID
		          AND    A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE  = E.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		          --AND    A.MODEL_ID           = E.MODEL_ID
		          WHERE  A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
		          AND    A.CATEGORY     = 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
		          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
		          AND    A.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
		          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = @PLANT_ID
		          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = @FACTORY_ID
		      ) E
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = E.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID   = E.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID       = E.SITE_ID
		      AND A.PLANT_ID      = E.PLANT_ID
		      AND A.FACTORY_ID    = E.FACTORY_ID
		      --AND B.APPLIED_MODEL = E.MODEL_ID
		      AND A.OPERATION_ID  = E.OPERATION
		      AND A.ITEM_ID       = E.ITEM_ID
		      AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = E.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
		          SELECT DISTINCT INSTANCE_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, ITEM_ID
		          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_V
		      ) G
		      ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = G.INSTANCE_ID
		      AND A.COMPANY_ID  = G.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID     = G.SITE_ID
		      AND A.PLANT_ID    = G.PLANT_ID
		      AND A.ITEM_ID     = G.ITEM_ID
		      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
		          SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		          FROM (
		              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_ELEC_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  (A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+A.SCP_PLAN_ID) IN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID+A.SHOP_GROUP_ID+MAX(A.SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID FROM FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_ELEC_H A WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SHOP_GROUP_ID)
		    					UNION ALL
		    					SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_AUTO_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  A.SCP_PLAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(SCP_PLAN_ID) AS SCP_PLAN_ID FROM FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_SHIPMENT_AUTO_H A WITH(NOLOCK))
		    					UNION ALL
		    					SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_TEST_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  A.DUE_DATE >= (SELECT CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PLAN_START_TIME,112))
		    					                      FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H
		    					                      WHERE  PLAN_ID = @FP_PLAN_ID )
		    					UNION ALL
		    					SELECT  DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, ISNULL(A.MARKET,'D') AS MARKET, A.ITEM_ID
		    					FROM   FP_DAILY_INSTANCE_DEMAND_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
		    					WHERE  1=1
		    					AND   INSTANCE_ID = CASE WHEN @INSTANCE_ID = 'KR_E_PRE_A' OR @INSTANCE_ID = 'KR_E_PRE_M' THEN 'KR_E_PRE'
		    					                    ELSE @INSTANCE_ID END
		    					AND   INSTANCE_DATE = SUBSTRING(@FP_PLAN_ID,CHARINDEX('-',@FP_PLAN_ID,1)+1,8)
		    					AND   CONVERT(VARCHAR, INSTANCE_DATE,102) = ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, PLAN_START_TIME,102)
		    				                                                FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H KK WITH(NOLOCK)
		    				                                                WHERE  PLAN_ID = @FP_PLAN_ID
		    				                                            	)
		          ) A
		      ) H
		      ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = H.COMPANY_ID
		      AND A.DIVISION_ID = H.DIVISION_ID
		      AND A.SITE_ID     = H.SITE_ID
		      AND A.PLANT_ID    = H.PLANT_ID
		      AND A.MARKET      = H.MARKET
		      AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = H.ITEM_ID
		      	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE	1=1
						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
				) R
				ON		1=1
				AND		A.COMPANY_ID		= R.COMPANY_ID
				AND		A.DIVISION_ID		= R.DIVISION_ID
				AND		A.SITE_ID			= R.SITE_ID
				AND		A.PLANT_ID			= R.PLANT_ID
				AND		A.FACTORY_ID		= R.FACTORY_ID
				AND		A.OPERATION_ID		= R.OPERATION_ID
				AND		A.LINE_ID			= R.LINE_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

    <sql id="find_targetInfo_Elec">

      <text>
        <![CDATA[

  SELECT A.*
      , '' AS MSG1
        , '' AS MSG2
      , ( CASE WHEN C.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'cell/batch' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG3
        , ( CASE WHEN D.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'Pancake (m/batch)' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG4
        , ( CASE WHEN E.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG5

,F.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID,	F.VERSION,	F.PROD_SEQ,	F.PLM_EC_NO 

  FROM (
      SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID
          , (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M FF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE FF.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID AND FF.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID
          , @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
          , @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, @LOCATION AS LOCATION
          , @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
          , @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID
  ) A
  INNER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
  ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
  AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
  AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
  AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

           , A.OPERATION

      INNER JOIN (

              GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE
              HAVING COUNT(1) = 6

  ) D
  ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = D.COMPANY_ID
  AND A.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
  AND A.SITE_ID       = D.SITE_ID
  AND A.PLANT_ID      = D.PLANT_ID
  AND A.FACTORY_ID    = D.FACTORY_ID
  --AND B.APPLIED_MODEL = D.MODEL_ID
  AND A.OPERATION_ID  = D.OPERATION

  LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (

      ) D
      ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
      INNER JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID

                                    , 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
              GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE
              HAVING COUNT(1) = 6

      AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = E.FACTORY_ID

  ) E

  AND A.DIVISION_ID   = E.DIVISION_ID

  AND A.PLANT_ID      = E.PLANT_ID
  AND A.FACTORY_ID    = E.FACTORY_ID

    <sql id="is4MValid">


      <text>
        <![CDATA[
--  PDS_TARGET_FLAG가 Y이면 TARGET_PDS(ATTR5)에서 사용하는 DEMAND_TYPE임, 4MCC_TARGET_FLAG(ATTR6)가 Y이면 TARGET_PDS에서 들어온 버전을 사용하다.
  SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' end AS IS_4M_VALID FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
AND ISNULL(A.SEGMENT1,'') =  @DIVISION_ID
AND ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'') = '4M-VALID'--FP PRODUCTION_TYPE
AND ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE5,'') = 'Y' -- _4MCC_TARGET_FLAG-> PDS_TARGET_FLAG
AND ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE6,'') = 'Y' -- _4MCC_TARGET_FLAG 
AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID
, A.SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
,A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
--, (CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL OR A.ATTRIBUTE5 = '' THEN 'N' ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE5 END) AS _PDS_TARGET_FLAG -- 향후 5는 PDS_TARGET_FLAG
, (CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL OR A.ATTRIBUTE5 = '' THEN 'N' ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE5 END) AS _4MCC_TARGET_FLAG -- 향후 6이 4MCC_TARGET_FLAG로
FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
AND ISNULL(A.SEGMENT1,'') =  @DIVISION_ID
AND ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'') = '4M-VALID'
AND ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE5,'') = 'Y'
AND ISNULL(A.ATTRIBUTE6,'') = 'Y'
AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>


    </sql>
