<update-batch id="merge_Excel_import">
<insert-sql>

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

		      BEGIN
		      	MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H AS A
		      	USING (
		            SELECT BB.INSTANCE_ID, BB.FP_PLAN_ID
		                 , BB.COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.FACTORY_ID, ISNULL(CC.LOCATION,'-') AS LOCATION
		                 , BB.OPERATION_ID, BB.LINE_ID, CC.ELECTRODE_TYPE, BB.EQUIPMENT_ID
		                 , BB.ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, BB.ITEM_ID
		                 , UPPER(BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
		                 , BB.PLAN_DATE
		                 , ROUND(BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
		                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
		                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
		                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
		                 , ROUND(BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
		                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
		                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
		                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
		                 , BB.SEQ
		                 , BB.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, BB.VERSION, DD.PROD_SEQ, (case when BB.PLM_EC_NO is null or BB.PLM_EC_NO = '' then '-' else BB.PLM_EC_NO end) as PLM_EC_NO
		            FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
		            INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M CC WITH(NOLOCK)
		            ON     BB.DIVISION_ID     = CC.DIVISION_ID
		            AND    BB.SITE_ID         = CC.SITE_ID
		            AND    BB.PLANT_ID        = CC.PLANT_ID
		            AND    BB.FACTORY_ID      = CC.FACTORY_ID
		            AND    BB.OPERATION_ID    = CC.OPERATION_ID
		            AND    BB.LINE_ID         = CC.LINE_ID
		            AND    BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = CC.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		            AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
		            INNER JOIN (
    	            	SELECT FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION AS OPERATION_ID, VERSION, MAX(PROD_SEQ) AS PROD_SEQ
    	            	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    	            	WHERE  1=1
    	            	AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
    	            	AND    A.CATEGORY IN ( 'JUMBO ROLL (CELL/M)', 'LANE NUMBER', 'PANCAKE (M/BATCH)', 'CELL/BATCH', 'JUMBO ROLL (M/BATCH)', 'PANCAKE (CELL/M)' )
    	            	GROUP BY FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION, VERSION
		            ) DD
		            ON  BB.FACTORY_ID            = DD.FACTORY_ID
		            AND BB.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = DD.MODEL_ID
		            AND BB.ITEM_ID               = DD.ITEM_ID
		            AND BB.OPERATION_ID          = DD.OPERATION_ID
		            AND BB.VERSION               = DD.VERSION
		            WHERE  BB.JOB_USER_ID     = @USER_ID
		            AND		 BB.INSTANCE_ID			= @INSTANCE_ID
		      	) AS B
		      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
		        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
		        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
		        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
		        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
		        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
		        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		        AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
		        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
		        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
		        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
		        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
		        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
		        AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
		        AND A.VERSION               = B.VERSION
		        AND A.PLM_EC_NO             = B.PLM_EC_NO
		        WHEN MATCHED THEN
		      		UPDATE SET 	  @IN_QTY_BATCH 	= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
      						       	, @IN_QTY_M 		= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
			                    , @IN_QTY_CELL 	= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
			                    , @IN_QTY_JR 		= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
			                    , @OUT_QTY_BATCH 	= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
			                    , @OUT_QTY_M = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
					  	, @OUT_QTY_CELL = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID

						, @OUT_QTY_JR = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD

							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME

		              ,@OUT_QTY_CELL
		              ,@OUT_QTY_JR
		              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
		              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
		              ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO
		      		)
		      		VALUES (

		              ,(SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE KK.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'), B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
		              ,B.LOCATION, B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE

		              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
		              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET

		              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
		              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
		              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
		              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
		              ,0
		              , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID

						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
			 		 , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD

						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID

						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID

						                                                  ) SB

						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID

			 		, CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD

						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1

						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
		              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)

		              ,B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, B.VERSION, B.PROD_SEQ, B.PLM_EC_NO
		      		)
		          ;
		      	  
		        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R (
		               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
		              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
		              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE

		              ,(SELECT MAX(YY.COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M YY WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = YY.FACTORY_ID AND YY.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
		              ,ISNULL(C.LOCATION,'-') AS LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		              ,A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PLAN_DATE
		              ,A.ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
		              ,UPPER(A.PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
		              ,A.SEQ
		              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
		              ,0 AS ADJUST_IN_QTY
		              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
		              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
		              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
		              ,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
		              ,0 AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY
		              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
		              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
		              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
		              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
		              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
		              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
		              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
		              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
		              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MPP/WPP_EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
		              ,B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, B.VERSION, B.PROD_SEQ, (case when B.PLM_EC_NO is null or B.PLM_EC_NO = '' then '-' else B.PLM_EC_NO end) as PLM_EC_NO
		        FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
		        INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
		        ON     A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
		        AND    A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
		        AND    A.PLANT_ID        = C.PLANT_ID
		        AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = C.FACTORY_ID
		        AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
		        AND    A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
		        AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		        AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
		        INNER JOIN FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H B WITH(NOLOCK)
		        ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
		        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
		        AND A.DIVISION_ID 	  = B.DIVISION_ID
		        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
		        AND ISNULL(C.LOCATION,'-') = B.LOCATION
		        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
		        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
		        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		        AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
		        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
		        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
		        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID

		        AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID  = B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
		        AND A.VERSION                = B.VERSION
		        AND A.PLM_EC_NO              = B.PLM_EC_NO
		        WHERE  JOB_USER_ID 			 = @USER_ID
		        AND		 A.INSTANCE_ID		 = @INSTANCE_ID
		      	;
		      	
		      END;
    
      ]]>

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
        BEGIN TRAN

      BEGIN
        BEGIN TRAN
          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H A
          USING (SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID,
                        @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID,@PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, 
                        @LOCATION AS LOCATION, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
                        @EQUIPMENT_ID AS EQUIPMENT_ID, @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE,
                        @ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, 
                        UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET,
                        @WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID AS WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION AS VERSION, @PROD_SEQ AS PROD_SEQ, @PLM_EC_NO AS PLM_EC_NO
                ) B
          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION
              AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = B.EQUIPMENT_ID AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET
              AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID AND A.VERSION = B.VERSION AND A.PLM_EC_NO = B.PLM_EC_NO
             )
          WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET @IN_QTY_BATCH  = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                     , @IN_QTY_M      = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                     , @IN_QTY_CELL   = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                     , @IN_QTY_JR     = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                     , @OUT_QTY_BATCH = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                     , @OUT_QTY_M     = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                     , @OUT_QTY_CELL  = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                     , @OUT_QTY_JR    = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                     , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID

              ,@IN_QTY_JR

              ,@OUT_QTY_M
              ,@OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,@OUT_QTY_JR

              ,@EQUIPMENT_ID ,CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE)
              ,@ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID
              ,UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE), @MARKET
              ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(@ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE @SEQ END
              ,@ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH

      			  ,@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
      			  ,@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
      			  ,@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR

              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, B.VERSION, B.PROD_SEQ, B.PLM_EC_NO

        COMMIT;

                  ,TOTAL_BATCH

                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
                  ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO

                  ,@IN_QTY

              	  ,@IN_QTY_CELL
              	  ,@IN_QTY_JR
                  ,@OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,@OUT_QTY
                  ,@OUT_QTY_M
                  ,@OUT_QTY_CELL
                  ,@OUT_QTY_JR
                  ,TOTAL_BATCH
                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MPP/WPP_UPDATE' AS JOB_TYPE
                  ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO
            FROM   FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @FACTORY_ID
            AND    A.LOCATION         = @LOCATION
            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @LINE_ID
            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE

            AND    A.PLAN_DATE        = CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE)
            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)
            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
		        AND    A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID  = @WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
		        AND    A.VERSION                = @VERSION
		        AND    A.PLM_EC_NO              = @PLM_EC_NO
            
            ;
            
          
        COMMIT;
        
      END;
        
      ]]>

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                                                                             THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                                                                               THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                                                                                 THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                                                                                   THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                                                                                     THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                                                                                                       THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                                                                                         THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')                                                                           THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '')                                                             THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '')                                              THEN MSG11 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG11 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG11 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '')                               THEN MSG12 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG12 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG12 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '' AND MSG12 = '')				THEN MSG13 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG13 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG13 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '' AND MSG12 = '' AND MSG13 = '')	THEN MSG14 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG14 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG14 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
                    ,A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                    ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.LOCATION
                    ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, D.LINE_NAME, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    ,A.PLAN_DATE
                    ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, B.NICK_NAME
                    ,A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                    ,A.SEQ, A.QTY
                    ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                    ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                    ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                    ,CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                    ,CASE WHEN D.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line - Electrode Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                    ,CASE WHEN E.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                    ,CASE WHEN F.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                    ,CASE WHEN L.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Equipment' ELSE '' END AS MSG7
                    --,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID='A9000' THEN ( CASE WHEN G.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'RCCP or Test Target' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG8
                    , CASE WHEN A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y'  AND P.PLM_EC_NO IS NULL AND A.PDS_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'PDS ID' 
                    												 --WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG <> 'Y' AND A.PLM_EC_NO <> '-' THEN ' - PDS ID' 
                    												 ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG8
                    --,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN H.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                    --,'' AS MSG9
                    --,CASE WHEN (E._4MCC_VERSION_FLAG = 'Y' AND E._4MCC_VERSION_FLAG2 = 'Y') THEN (CASE WHEN O.VERSION IS NULL THEN 'PDS Target Version' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END MSG9
                    --, (CASE WHEN A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = '4M-VALID' THEN ((CASE WHEN O.VERSION IS NULL THEN 'PDS Target Version' ELSE '' END)) ELSE '' END) AS MSG9 -- line assign Active sync... 20240202
                    , CASE WHEN A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN E._4MCC_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y'  AND P.VERSION IS NULL AND A.PDS_TARGET_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'PDS Version' 
                    												 ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                    ,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN I.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Assign' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG10
                    ,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN K.KEY_VALUE = 'DAILY_CAPA' THEN (CASE WHEN (J.DAILY_CAPA IS NULL OR J.DAILY_CAPA = 0) THEN 'Daily Capa' ELSE '' END)
                                                     ELSE (CASE WHEN (J.TACT_TIME IS NULL OR J.TACT_TIME = 0) THEN 'Tact Time' ELSE '' END) END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG11
                    --,CASE WHEN N.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Model Measure Conversion' ELSE '' END AS MSG12
                    ,CASE WHEN N.VERSION IS NULL OR N.ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'Y' THEN 'Model Measure Conversion' ELSE '' END AS MSG12
                    ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG13
                    ,(CASE WHEN @CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING' THEN (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Building' ELSE '' END)
        			                                          ELSE (CASE WHEN D.MODEL_TYPE <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Plan Group' ELSE '' END) END) AS MSG14
                    ,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE, A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PLM_EC_NO
            				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE, A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PLM_EC_NO)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
            				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
            				, A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, A.PLM_EC_NO
              FROM (
                  SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
                       , ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID
                       , A.FACTORY_ID, A.LOCATION
                       , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                       , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
                       , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                       , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                       , A.SEQ, A.QTY
                       , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                       , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                       , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, A.PLM_EC_NO
                       , CASE WHEN ISNULL(PC.PRODUCTION_TYPE, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END PDS_TARGET_FLAG, PC.PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PDS_PROD_TYPE
                  FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                  ON    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND	  A.SITE_ID	    = B.SITE_ID
                  AND	  A.PLANT_ID	  = B.PLANT_ID
                  AND 	A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
                  AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  		SELECT	DISTINCT IV.COMPANY_ID, IV.DIVISION_ID, IV.SITE_ID, IV.PLANT_ID, SS.PRODUCTION_TYPE, SS.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  		FROM	FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V IV WITH(NOLOCK)
                  				, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SV WITH(NOLOCK)
                  				, (
                  					SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE2 AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  					FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SS WITH(NOLOCK)
                  					WHERE 1=1
                  					AND SS.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                  					AND SS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  					--AND SS.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'N' -- SCP TARGET FLAG
                  					AND SS.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' -- PDA TARGET FLAG
                  					--AND SV.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'Y' -- VERSION ONLY
                  		) SS
                  		WHERE	1=1
                  		AND		SV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'PDS_INSTANCE'
                  		AND		SV.ACTIVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
                  		AND		SV.SEGMENT1		  = IV.INSTANCE_ID
                  		AND		IV.INSTANCE_ID	= @INSTANCE_ID
                  		AND		IV.DIVISION_ID	= SS.DIVISION_ID
                  ) PC
                  ON  1=1
                  AND A.DIVISION_ID = PC.DIVISION_ID
                  AND A.SITE_ID     = PC.SITE_ID
                  AND A.PLANT_ID    = PC.PLANT_ID
                  AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = PC.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
                  AND		A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
              ) A
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                         A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME,
                         A.APPLIED_MODEL
                  FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                    		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
              ) B
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = C.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
              AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = D.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = D.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = D.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = D.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = D.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID         = D.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  --SELECT DISTINCT  A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS CODE_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE5 AS _4MCC_VERSION_FLAG, A.ATTRIBUTE6 AS _4MCC_VERSION_FLAG2 -- line assign Active sync... 20240202
                  SELECT DISTINCT  A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS CODE_ID, (CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS _4MCC_TARGET_FLAG
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              ) E
              ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = E.CODE_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.SEGMENT1
              --AND (CASE WHEN A.SITE_ID <> 'A004' AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE IN ('E-TEST','D-TEST') THEN 'XX' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END ) = E.CODE_ID
              AND (CASE WHEN (A.SITE_ID <> 'A004' AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '81_UC') AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE IN ('E-TEST','D-TEST') THEN 'XX' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END ) = E.CODE_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE_ID
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              ) F
              ON  A.MARKET = F.CODE_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT INSTANCE_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, ITEM_ID
                  FROM   FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_V
              ) G
              ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = G.INSTANCE_ID
              AND A.COMPANY_ID  = G.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID     = G.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID    = G.PLANT_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID     = G.ITEM_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M I WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID     = I.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID        = I.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID       = I.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID     = I.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID        = I.ITEM_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID   = I.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID        = I.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = I.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND SUBSTRING(A.PLAN_DATE,1,6) = I.MONTH
              AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
              AND I.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0','9')
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_TACT_TIME_M J WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = J.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = J.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = J.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = J.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = J.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = J.ITEM_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = J.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID         = J.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = J.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND SUBSTRING(A.PLAN_DATE,1,6) = J.MONTH
              LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_CONFIG_M K WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = K.INSTANCE_ID
              AND K.KEY_ID          = 'FINAL_OP_CAPA'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M L WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = L.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = L.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = L.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = L.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = L.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = L.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID		      = L.LINE_ID
              AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = L.EQUIPMENT_ID
              AND L.ACTIVE_FLAG 	  = 'Y'
              /*
              LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
                  SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE -- PROD_VERSION_TYPE 필수값 추가.... 20200706
                  FROM (
                      SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE
                      FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
                      AND    A.VALUE > 0
                      AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)'
                                            , 'Lane Number'
                                            , 'Pancake (m/batch)'
                                            , 'cell/batch'
                                            , 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
                                            , 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
                      GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE
                      HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
                  ) A
                  GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              ) N
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = N.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID   = N.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID       = N.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID      = N.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID    = N.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID  = N.OPERATION
              AND A.ITEM_ID       = N.ITEM_ID
              AND ISNULL(D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE,'GENERAL') = N.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              */
              LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.MODEL_ID, A.OPERATION, A.ITEM_ID, A.VERSION 
                       , B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE, ISNULL(B.ACTIVE_FLAG, 'Y') AS ACTIVE_FLAG 
                  FROM (
                      SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
                      FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.OPERATION = 'E2000' 
                      AND    A.VALUE > 0
                      AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)', 'Lane Number', 'Pancake (m/batch)', 'cell/batch', 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)', 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
                      GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
                      HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
                  ) A
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_USE_M B WITH(NOLOCK) 
                  ON  A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID 
                  AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID 
                  AND A.MODEL_ID   = B.MODEL_ID 
                  AND A.VERSION    = B.VERSION 
                  AND A.OPERATION  = B.OPERATION_ID 
                  AND A.ITEM_ID    = B.ITEM_ID 
              ) N
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = N.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID   = N.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID       = N.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID      = N.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID    = N.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID  = N.OPERATION
              AND A.ITEM_ID       = N.ITEM_ID
              AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = N.MODEL_ID
              AND A.VERSION       = N.VERSION
              AND A.LINE_ID        = N.LINE_ID 
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = N.ELECTRODE_TYPE 
              -- line assign Active sync... 20240202
              /*
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        					SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.VERSION 
        					FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK) 
        					INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V B WITH(NOLOCK) 
        					ON     1=1 
        					AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
        					AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
        					AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
        					AND    A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
        					AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
        					AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
        					AND    A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID 
        					AND    B.INSTANCE_ID  = '' -----
        					GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.VERSION 
              ) O 
              ON     A.COMPANY_ID      = O.COMPANY_ID 
              AND    A.DIVISION_ID     = O.DIVISION_ID 
              AND    A.SITE_ID         = O.SITE_ID 
              AND    A.PLANT_ID        = O.PLANT_ID 
              AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = O.FACTORY_ID 
              AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = O.OPERATION_ID 
              AND    A.LINE_ID         = O.LINE_ID 
              AND    A.ITEM_ID         = O.ITEM_ID 
              AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = O.PRODUCTION_TYPE 
              AND    A.MARKET          = O.MARKET 
              AND    A.LINE_ID         = O.LINE_ID 
              AND    A.VERSION         = O.VERSION 
              */
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
                	  	 , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                	  	 , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION
                	FROM   FP_WEEKLY_DEMAND_PRODUCT_PDS_H A WITH(NOLOCK) 
                	, (
                	  	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                	  	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
                	  	WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
                	  	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                	) B, SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                	WHERE  1=1 
                	AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID 
                	AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID 
                	AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID 
                	AND    A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID 
                	AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID 
                	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
                	AND    A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID 
                	AND    A.MFG_WEEK >= (SELECT (ISO_YYYYWW) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))
                	AND    A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID 
                	AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID 
                	AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID 
                	AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID 
                	AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID 
                	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID 
                	AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID 
                	AND    A.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID 
                	AND    C.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))
                	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID 
                	  	   , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                	  	   , A.MARKET, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.PLM_EC_NO, A.VERSION 
              ) P
              ON  1=1 
              AND A.COMPANY_ID      = P.COMPANY_ID 
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P.DIVISION_ID 
              AND A.SITE_ID         = P.SITE_ID 
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = P.PLANT_ID 
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = P.FACTORY_ID 
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = P.OPERATION_ID 
              AND A.LINE_ID         = P.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = P.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = P.ITEM_ID
              AND A.MARKET          = P.MARKET 
              AND A.PDS_PROD_TYPE   = P.PRODUCTION_TYPE
              AND A.PLM_EC_NO       = P.PLM_EC_NO
              AND A.VERSION         = P.VERSION 
              
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
      						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
      						WHERE	1=1
      						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
      						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
      						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
      				) R
      				ON		1=1
      				AND		A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
      				AND		A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
      				AND		A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
      				AND		A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
      				AND		A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
      				AND		A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
      				AND		A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="CONFIRM_AREA" name="CONFIRM_AREA" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="RELEASE_VALUE" name="RELEASE_VALUE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>
  
  </sql>

  <sql id="find_LineAdd_dup">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
      FROM   FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID     = @INSTANCE_ID
      AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID      = @FP_PLAN_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID     = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID         = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID        = @PLANT_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID         = @ITEM_ID
      AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = @TOP_ITEM_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = @OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = @FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
      AND    A.MARKET          = @MARKET
      AND    A.LINE_ID         = @LINE_ID
      AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
      AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = @EQUIPMENT_ID
      AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112)    = @DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PLANT_ID" name="PLANT_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="TOP_ITEM_ID" name="TOP_ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="MARKET" name="MARKET" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ELECTRODE_TYPE" name="ELECTRODE_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="EQUIPMENT_ID" name="EQUIPMENT_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DATE" name="DATE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_targetInfo">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
      		, '' AS MSG1
          	, '' AS MSG2
        	, ( CASE WHEN C.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'cell/batch' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG3
          	, ( CASE WHEN D.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'Pancake (m/batch)' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG4
          	, ( CASE WHEN E.CATEGORY IS NULL THEN 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)' ELSE '' END ) AS MSG5
      FROM (
          SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID
              , (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M FF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE FF.FACTORY_ID = @FACTORY_ID AND FF.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID
              , @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
              , @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, @LOCATION AS LOCATION
              , @PRODUCTION_TYPE AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
              , @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID
              , @WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID AS WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION AS VERSION, @PROD_SEQ AS PROD_SEQ
      ) A
      INNER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
      AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
      AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)

      ON  A.COMPANY_ID            = D.COMPANY_ID
      AND A.FACTORY_ID            = D.FACTORY_ID

      AND A.VERSION               = D.VERSION
      AND A.OPERATION_ID          = D.OPERATION

      AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = E.MODEL_ID
      AND A.VERSION               = E.VERSION
      AND A.OPERATION_ID          = E.OPERATION

  <sql id="find_capasync">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '' END) AS ACTIVE_FLAG
           , A.INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID
           , A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(B.LINE_NAME, '-') AS LINE_NAME, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , C.START_DATE, C.END_DATE
      FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON    A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
      AND   A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
      AND   A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
      AND   A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        	SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.OPERATION_ID
                , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.START_DATE,112) AS START_DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.END_DATE,112) AS END_DATE
                , A.ACTIVE_FLAG
        	FROM   FP_LINE_CAPA_SYNC_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  1=1
        	AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        	AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID   = @FP_PLAN_ID
        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
      ) C
      ON    A.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID
      AND   A.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID
      AND   A.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID
      AND   A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
      AND   A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
      ORDER BY FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

  </sql>

<sql id="find_linecopyllist">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT DISTINCT 
             A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , ISNULL(B.LINE_NAME,'-') AS LINE_NAME
           , B.LOCATION
           , ISNULL(B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE,'GENERAL') AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
      FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
      AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
@CTRL_CONFIRM_AREA      
   
      (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          and    A.SEGMENT1    = @INSTANCE_ID
      ) C
      ON     B.MODEL_TYPE     = C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
      INNER JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
          AND 	 B.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
          AND    B.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
          AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      ) D
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = D.SITE_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D.OPERATION_ID
      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID 		  <> @LINE_ID
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    A.MONTH          = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@BUCKET_FROM,112),1,6)
      AND	 A.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0','9')
      ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, LINE_NAME, LOCATION

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="CTRL_CONFIRM_AREA" name="CTRL_CONFIRM_AREA" dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>


</sql>  
<sql id="find_LineCopy_Validation">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

		SELECT  SUM(CNT) AS CNT
		FROM(
				SELECT  COUNT(1) AS CNT
				FROM   	SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  	A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
			    AND    	A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
			    AND    	A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
			    AND    	A.LINE_ID 		 = @LINE_ID
			    AND    	A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
			    AND	 	A.PRIORITY IN ('0','9')
      			AND    	A.MONTH          BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),@BUCKET_FROM,112) AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),@BUCKET_TO,112)
				UNION ALL
				SELECT  COUNT(1) AS CNT
				FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN (
					SELECT DT
					FROM TH_UIS_CAL
					WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR, DT, 112) BETWEEN  @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
				) B
				ON 1=1
				WHERE  	A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
			    AND    	A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
			    AND    	A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
			    AND    	A.LINE_ID 		 = @LINE_ID
			    AND    	A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
				AND	  	A.PRIORITY IN ('0','9')
				AND    	B.DT BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
			) A

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

        <parameter replace-what="LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

        <parameter replace-what="BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

  	<sql id="find_Prod_Version_Type">
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

	    			SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
							, CASE WHEN B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END IDX1
							, CASE WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='GENERAL' THEN 1
									 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='WIDE' THEN 2
								 	 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='PREWET_UNIT2' THEN 3
								 	 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='PREWET_UNIT3' THEN 4
								 	 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='UNIT2' THEN 5
									 ELSE 6 
							  END AS IDX2
					FROM   	SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
							ON 1=1
							AND		A.FACTORY_ID = C.FACTORY_ID
							AND		C.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
							AND		C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
							LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									SELECT  DISTINCT A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
									FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
									WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_PROD_VERSION_TYPE'
							) B
							ON A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
							AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
					WHERE  	1=1
					@CTRL_DIVISION_LT
					@CTRL_SITE_LT
					AND		A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
					AND		A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
					AND		A.CATEGORY IN ('cell/batch','Pancake (m/batch)','Jumbo Roll (m/batch)')
					ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, IDX1, IDX2
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="MASTER_ID" name="MASTER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

       <sql id="find_yieldInfo">    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISNULL(B.YIELD, (CASE WHEN A.YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD END)) AS YIELD

      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD

        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
        AND    CONVERT(DATE,@PLAN_DATE) BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME

      on     1=1
          WHERE  1=1

      AND A.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID

  	<sql id="find_YieldInfo_Child">
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
           , A.ITEM_ID
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.START_DATE,112) AS START_DATE
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.END_DATE,112) AS END_DATE
           , A.YIELD AS YIELD
           , A.CHILD_YIELD AS CHILD_YIELD
           , A.UTILIZATION
		   , A.CHILD_UTILIZATION
		   , A.LANE_TACT_TIME
      FROM   @AMEND_BOR_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
      AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID  = @PLAN_ID
      
      @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
      @CTRL_SITE_LT
      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      @CTRL_ITEM_LK
      ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, START_DATE

  	<sql id="find_UOMInfo">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION, A.ITEM_ID
     , UPPER(A.CATEGORY) AS CATEGORY
     , A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE
     , A.MODEL_ID, A.VALUE, A.APPLY_DATE
     , A.VERSION
FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT DISTINCT A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS E_CATEGORY
	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ITEM_CONV_CALC'
	AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
) D
ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  1=1
	AND    A.VALUE > 0
	AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)'
    						, 'Lane Number'
    						, 'Pancake (m/batch)'
    						, 'cell/batch'
    						, 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
    						, 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
	GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
) E
ON     A.COMPANY_ID         = E.COMPANY_ID
AND    A.DIVISION_ID        = E.DIVISION_ID
AND    A.SITE_ID            = E.SITE_ID
AND    A.PLANT_ID           = E.PLANT_ID
AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = E.FACTORY_ID
AND    A.OPERATION          = E.OPERATION
AND    A.ITEM_ID            = E.ITEM_ID
AND    A.MODEL_ID           = E.MODEL_ID
AND    A.VERSION            = E.VERSION
WHERE  1=1
AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
AND    A.CATEGORY IN ('cell/batch','Pancake (m/batch)','Jumbo Roll (m/batch)')
@CTRL_DIVISION_LT
@CTRL_SITE_LT
@CTRL_PLANT_LT
@CTRL_FACTORY_LT
--ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
--       , A.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.APPLY_DATE DESC
--       , A.CATEGORY, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE
ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
       , A.OPERATION, A.ITEM_ID, A.MAX_VER_FLAG DESC, A.APPLY_DATE DESC, A.VERSION DESC
       , A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE
       , A.CATEGORY, A.MODEL_ID
      ]]>
      </text>

  	<sql id="find_UOMInfo_ASIS">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
SELECT A.*
FROM (
	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID

		AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
	) D
	ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
	INNER JOIN (
		SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE , A.VERSION
		FROM (
			SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE , A.VERSION
			FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)

			AND    A.CATEGORY IN ( 'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)', 'Lane Number', 'Pancake (m/batch)', 'cell/batch', 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)', 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
			GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE , A.VERSION
			HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
		) A
		GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE , A.VERSION
	) E
	ON     A.COMPANY_ID        = E.COMPANY_ID
	AND    A.DIVISION_ID       = E.DIVISION_ID
	AND    A.SITE_ID           = E.SITE_ID
	AND    A.PLANT_ID          = E.PLANT_ID
	AND    A.FACTORY_ID        = E.FACTORY_ID
	AND    A.OPERATION         = E.OPERATION
	AND    A.ITEM_ID           = E.ITEM_ID
	AND    A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = E.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
	AND    A.VERSION_TYPE      = E.VERSION_TYPE
	AND    A.VERSION           = E.VERSION
	WHERE  1=1
  @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
  @CTRL_SITE_LT
  @CTRL_PLANT_LT
  @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
	--AND    A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
	AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
	AND    A.CATEGORY IN ('cell/batch','Pancake (m/batch)','Jumbo Roll (m/batch)')
	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
		   , A.OPERATION, A.ITEM_ID, A.MODEL_ID
		   , A.CATEGORY, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION, A.APPLY_DATE, A.MAX_VER_FLAG

  	<sql id="find_ListData">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
           , A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
           , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
           , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
           , A.SEQ
           , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PLM_EC_NO
           , A.PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, A.PLAN_IN_QTY, A.PLAN_IN_QTY_M, A.PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
           , A.PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, A.PLAN_OUT_QTY, A.PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, A.PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
           
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN ROUND(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN ROUND(A.MPP_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  ELSE ROUND(A.WPP_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
		   , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY_M)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY_M) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY_CELL)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY_CELL) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY_JR)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY_JR) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
           
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN ROUND(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN ROUND(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  ELSE ROUND(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_M)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_M) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_CELL)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_CELL) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_JR)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_JR) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
           , B.RELEASE_TYPE
           , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, A.PLM_EC_NO
      FROM   @AMEND_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN (
      	SELECT 'DPP' AS RELEASE_TYPE
      	UNION ALL
      	SELECT 'MPP' AS RELEASE_TYPE
      	UNION ALL
      	SELECT 'WPP' AS RELEASE_TYPE
      ) B
      ON 1=1
      WHERE 1=1
      AND	 A.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
      AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID  = @PLAN_ID
      AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
      @CTRL_SITE_LT
      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      ORDER BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
             , LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID
             , TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
             , PLAN_DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="MASTER_ID" name="MASTER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PLAN_ID" name="PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

  <sql id="findLineCode_List">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE
           , '(' + A.LINE_ID + ')' + (CASE WHEN A.LINE_NAME = '' OR A.LINE_NAME IS NULL THEN A.LINE_ID ELSE A.LINE_NAME END) AS NAME
      FROM   SCM_LINE_M A(NOLOCK)
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      AND    EXISTS (
			        	SELECT 1
			        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
			        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
			        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			        	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
			        	AND    A.PLANT_ID	 = B.PLANT_ID
			        	AND    A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
			        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
			        	AND    A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
			        	AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
			      	)
      AND   EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID
              FROM  SCM_FACTORY_M A(NOLOCK)
              INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B(NOLOCK)
              ON    A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID
              AND		B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              WHERE 1=1
              AND   B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
              AND		A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID
      )

      @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
      @CTRL_SITE_LT
      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      
      @CTRL_INSTANCE
      @CTRL_PLAN_TYPE
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      
      GROUP BY A.LINE_ID, A.LINE_NAME
      ORDER BY A.LINE_ID

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
        BEGIN TRAN
          MERGE INTO FP_LINE_CAPA_SYNC_H A
          USING (SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID
                      , @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID
                      , @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , CONVERT(DATETIME, @START_DATE) AS START_DATE
                      , CONVERT(DATETIME, @END_DATE) AS END_DATE ) B
          ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID

          WHEN MATCHED THEN

                 	FROM	FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A
                 	WHERE	A.INSTANCE_ID 	= @INSTANCE_ID 
          			AND 	A.FP_PLAN_ID 	= @FP_PLAN_ID

	              	AND 	A.ITEM_ID 		= @ITEM_ID

	              	AND 	A.MARKET 		= @MARKET

          ON (      A.INSTANCE_ID 	= B.INSTANCE_ID

              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR

					AND		SA.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID	
					AND 	SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
					AND		SA.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
			   )

              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.SEQ
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, B.ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY

              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
