		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL 
		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR  
		                    , A.SEQ 
                 	FROM	FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A
                 	WHERE	A.INSTANCE_ID 	= @INSTANCE_ID 
          			AND 	A.FP_PLAN_ID 	= @FP_PLAN_ID
	              	AND 	A.FACTORY_ID 	= @FACTORY_ID 
	              	AND 	A.OPERATION_ID 	= @OPERATION_ID 
	              	AND 	A.LINE_ID 		= @LINE_ID 
	              	AND 	A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
	              	AND 	A.EQUIPMENT_ID 	= @EQUIPMENT_ID 
	              	AND 	CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
	              	AND 	A.TOP_ITEM_ID 	= @TOP_ITEM_ID
	              	AND 	A.ITEM_ID 		= @ITEM_ID
	              	AND 	A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
	              	AND 	A.MARKET 		= @MARKET
	              	AND		ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0) <> 0
                ) B
          ON (      A.INSTANCE_ID 	= B.INSTANCE_ID 
          		AND A.FP_PLAN_ID 	= B.FP_PLAN_ID
              	AND A.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID
              	AND A.LOCATION 		= B.LOCATION
              	AND A.OPERATION_ID 	= B.OPERATION_ID 
              	AND A.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
              	AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              	AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID 	= (	SELECT 	MAX(EQUIPMENT_ID) FROM SCM_EQUIPMENT_M SA 
              							WHERE 	SA.DIVISION_ID 	= B.DIVISION_ID 
              							AND 	SA.SITE_ID 		= B.SITE_ID 
              							AND 	SA.PLANT_ID 	= B.PLANT_ID 
              							AND		SA.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID	
              							AND 	SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
              							AND		SA.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
              						  )
              	AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
              	AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID 	= B.TOP_ITEM_ID 
              	AND A.ITEM_ID 		= B.ITEM_ID
              	AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE 
              	AND A.MARKET 		= B.MARKET 
            )
          WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET SEQ = CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10), ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0) + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE B.SEQ END 
                     , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH  = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0)  + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M      = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M,0)      + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL   = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL,0)   + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR     = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR,0)     + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,0) + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M     = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M,0)     + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL  = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL,0)  + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL,0)
                     , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR    = ISNULL(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR,0)    + ISNULL(B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR,0)
                     , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,SEQ
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
            )
            VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,B.COMPANY_ID
              ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, @COPY_FACTORY_ID
              ,B.LOCATION, B.OPERATION_ID, @COPY_LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,(	SELECT 	MAX(EQUIPMENT_ID) FROM SCM_EQUIPMENT_M SA 
					WHERE 	SA.DIVISION_ID 	= B.DIVISION_ID 
					AND 	SA.SITE_ID 		= B.SITE_ID 
					AND 	SA.PLANT_ID 	= B.PLANT_ID 
					AND		SA.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID	
					AND 	SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID 
					AND		SA.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
			   )
              ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.SEQ
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, B.ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
            )
          ;
        
        COMMIT;
        
        BEGIN TRAN
          	UPDATE	FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R
          	SET 	SEQ = 0
					, ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH  = 0
					, ADJUST_IN_QTY_M      = 0
					, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL   = 0
					, ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR     = 0
					, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH = 0
					, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M     = 0
					, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL  = 0
					, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR    = 0
					, UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
	     	WHERE	INSTANCE_ID 	= @INSTANCE_ID 
			AND 	FP_PLAN_ID 		= @FP_PLAN_ID
	      	AND 	FACTORY_ID 		= @FACTORY_ID 
	      	AND 	OPERATION_ID 	= @OPERATION_ID 
	      	AND 	LINE_ID 		= @LINE_ID 
	      	AND 	ELECTRODE_TYPE 	= @ELECTRODE_TYPE
	      	AND 	EQUIPMENT_ID 	= @EQUIPMENT_ID 
	      	AND 	CONVERT(VARCHAR, PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
	      	AND 	TOP_ITEM_ID 	= @TOP_ITEM_ID
	      	AND 	ITEM_ID 		= @ITEM_ID
	      	AND 	PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
	      	AND 	MARKET 			= @MARKET
	      	AND		ISNULL(ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0) <> 0
	        ;
          
        COMMIT;
        
        BEGIN TRAN
            INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R (
                   INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
                  ,COMPANY_ID
                  ,DIVISION_ID
                  ,SITE_ID
                  ,PLANT_ID
                  ,FACTORY_ID
                  ,LOCATION
                  ,OPERATION_ID
                  ,LINE_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
                  ,PLAN_DATE
                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  ,MARKET
                  ,SEQ
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY_M
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_M
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                  ,TOTAL_BATCH
                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
            )
            SELECT INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
                  ,COMPANY_ID
                  ,DIVISION_ID
                  ,SITE_ID
                  ,PLANT_ID
                  ,FACTORY_ID
                  ,LOCATION
                  ,OPERATION_ID
                  ,LINE_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  ,EQUIPMENT_ID
                  ,PLAN_DATE
                  ,TOP_ITEM_ID
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,UPPER(PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
                  ,MARKET
                  ,SEQ
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY_M
                  ,PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_M
                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                  ,TOTAL_BATCH
                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, @LINE_ID+'_LINE_COPY_UPDATE' AS JOB_TYPE
            FROM   FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @COPY_FACTORY_ID
            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @COPY_LINE_ID
            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID     = (	SELECT 	MAX(EQUIPMENT_ID) FROM SCM_EQUIPMENT_M SA 
											WHERE 	SA.DIVISION_ID 	= @DIVISION_ID
											[AND 	SA.SITE_ID 		= @SITE_ID] 
											[AND 	SA.PLANT_ID 	= @PLANT_ID]
											AND		SA.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID	
											[AND 	SA.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID]
											AND		SA.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
									    )
            AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)
            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
            ;
          
        COMMIT;
        
        
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

<simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
             , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
             , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
             , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
             , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
        FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
        AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
        GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
        ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id = "find_DateMap">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
        SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
              ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
              ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
              ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
              ,MONTH AS _MONTH
              ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
              +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                     WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                     ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
              AS _DATE_TXT
              ,DAY_SEQ
        FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
        ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
      ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
      ]]>
      </text>
      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
    </sql>

    <sql id = "find_BukInfo">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
      ]]>
      </text>
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
    </sql>
</simple-sqls>


<update-batchs>
  
	<update-batch id = 'merge_data'>
    <insert-sql>
      <text>
        <![CDATA[
          BEGIN
            BEGIN TRAN
              MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A
              USING (
                          SELECT DISTINCT A.*
                               , B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
                               , C.LOCATION
                          FROM (
                          	SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID
                          		   , @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID
                          		   , @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          		   , @EQUIPMENT_ID AS EQUIPMENT_ID, @PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_DATE
                          		   , @ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, @ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
                          		   , UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, @MARKET AS MARKET
                          ) A
                          INNER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                          ON  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
                          INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                          ON  A.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID
                          AND A.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID
                          AND A.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID
                          AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ) B
              ON (    A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.FP_PLAN_ID = B.FP_PLAN_ID
                  AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION
                  AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = B.EQUIPMENT_ID AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) = B.PLAN_DATE
                  AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                  AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET )
              WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE SET ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH  = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                         , ADJUST_IN_QTY_M      = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                         , ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL   = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                         , ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR     = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                         , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                         , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M     = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                         , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL  = @ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL

<SQLS id="FP00631_CellSimul_CellPack">
  <simple-sqls>
  	<sql id="find_Release_Plan_list">
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID, A.CONFIRM_AREA
      FROM (
          SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) AS RELEASE_VALUE
              , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, INSERT_TIME, B.CONFIRM_AREA
              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END)
                                  ORDER BY     A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) AS ROW_NUM
          FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A WITH(NOLOCK), (
          		SELECT MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1) AS CONFIRM_AREA
          		FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          		AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          		AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @TARGET_INSTANCE
        	) B
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @TARGET_INSTANCE
          --and    A.INSTANCE_DATE <= 'PLAN_DATE' -- 가장 최신날짜
      ) A
      WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "TARGET_INSTANCE" name="TARGET_INSTANCE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  	</sql>
  	<sql id="find_site">
  		
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT SITE_ID AS CODE
           , '(' + SITE_ID + ')' + CASE WHEN SITE_NAME = '' OR SITE_NAME IS NULL THEN SITE_ID ELSE SITE_NAME END AS NAME
      FROM  SCM_SITE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE 1 = 1
      AND  EXISTS (
        	SELECT 1 
        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
        	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
        	AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
      )
      AND A.SITE_ID IN ('A003','A004') -- 미국, 폴란드 전용... 20200723
      GROUP BY A.SITE_ID, A.SITE_NAME
      ORDER BY A.SITE_ID ASC

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  </sql>  
  <sql id="find_instance">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT3 AS INSTANCE_NAME
            , A.SEGMENT4 AS PLAN_GROUP
            , A.SEGMENT5 AS PLAN_GROUP_NAME
            , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PACK_INSTANCE_ID
            , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS DIVISION
            , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS CELL_INSTANCE_ID
            , B.INSTANCE_NAME AS PACK_INSTANCE_NAME
            , C.INSTANCE_NAME AS CELL_INSTANCE_NAME
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) B
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE1 = B.INSTANCE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) C
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE3 = C.INSTANCE_ID
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_ID_MAPPING'
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @SITE_ID
      ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_currdate">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH SITE_T AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT INSTANCE_ID, SITE_ID
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( @INSTANCE_LT )
      )
      SELECT MIN(A.CURR_DATE) AS CURR_DATE
      FROM (
      	SELECT (CASE WHEN FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') < (FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMdd') + A.BASIS_START_TIME)
      					THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(DD,-1,FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMdd')),112) 
      				 ELSE FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMdd') END) AS CURR_DATE
      	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_START_TIME_V A, SITE_T B
      	WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
      ) A
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_LT" name="INSTANCE_LT"  dbType="command" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_bucketdate">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH CURR_DATE AS (
      	SELECT @PLAN_DATE AS CURR_DATE
      )
      SELECT (SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR CC WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = AA.CURR_DATE)) AS START_DATE
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 27, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = AA.CURR_DATE)))), 112) AS END_DATE
      FROM   CURR_DATE AA
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  	
  </sql>
  <sql id="find_plan">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.PLAN_ID AS CODE, A.PLAN_ID AS NAME
      FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  1=1
      AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
      AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_START_TIME,112) = @PLAN_DATE
      AND    A.PLAN_TYPE = 'PRE'
      AND    RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID,2) <> '00'
      -- 인스턴스들의 배포정보중에 가장 최근에 배포된 시점 이후로 만들어진 plan 들만 뽑아옴
      /*
      AND    A.INSERT_TIME > (
        	SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
        	FROM (
          		SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
          		FROM   HIS_FP_PLAN_DETAIL_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( 'INSTANCE_LT' )
          		UNION ALL
          		SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
          		FROM   HIS_FP_PLAN_GROUP_DETAIL_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( 'INSTANCE_LT' )
        	) A
      )
      */
      ORDER BY A.PLAN_ID DESC
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_LastestReleaseTime">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME), 20) AS LAST_TIME
      FROM (
        SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
        FROM   HIS_FP_PLAN_DETAIL_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( @INSTANCE_LT )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
        FROM   HIS_FP_PLAN_GROUP_DETAIL_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( @INSTANCE_LT )
      ) A
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_LT" name="INSTANCE_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
 	
  </sql>
  <sql id="find_BOM_RATE">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

    	-- BOM 전개 코드 :  1순위 --
    	SELECT  A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
    			, A.PARENT_ITEM_ID, A.PARENT_UOM
    			, A.CHILD_ITEM_ID AS P5000_ITEM_ID, A.CHILD_UOM
    			, A.CHILD_QTY/A.PARENT_QTY AS BOM_RATE_P5000 
    			, A.ALT_ID, A.ALT_PRIORITY 
    			, A.EFF_START_DATE, A.EFF_END_DATE
    			, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID AS CELL_ITEM_ID , B.BOM_RATE_CELL ,B.ALT_ID AS CELL_ALT_ID, B.ALT_PRIORITY AS CELL_ALT_PRIORITY -- BOM_RATE_CELL 값이 cell request 에 쓰임
    			, B.FACTORY_ID 
    			, B.MONTH , B.PRIORITY 
    			, CASE WHEN B.PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.PRIORITY END S1
    			, CASE WHEN B.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.ALT_PRIORITY END S2
    			, CASE WHEN A.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE A.ALT_PRIORITY END S3
    			, RANK() OVER(  PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.PARENT_ITEM_ID , A.EFF_START_DATE, A.EFF_END_DATE 
            							ORDER BY    CASE WHEN B.PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.PRIORITY END
            									,	CASE WHEN B.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.ALT_PRIORITY END
            									,	CASE WHEN A.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE A.ALT_PRIORITY END
            					 ) RNK
    	FROM	SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    	INNER HASH JOIN ( --: PACK쪽 인스턴스만 필터링
    			SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
    			FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
    			WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
    			AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    			AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    			AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @PACK_INSTANCE_ID -- pack instance 기준 plant
    	) E
    	ON   1=1
    	AND  A.COMPANY_ID = E.COMPANY_ID
    	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
    	AND  A.SITE_ID     = E.SITE_ID
    	AND  A.PLANT_ID    = E.PLANT_ID
    	INNER HASH JOIN ( --: PACK ITEM 필터조건
    			SELECT CC.COMPANY_ID, CC.DIVISION_ID, CC.SITE_ID, CC.ITEM_ID, CC.ITEM_CLASS, DD.LEVEL_3_CODE, DD.LEVEL_3_NAME, CC.FLOW_ID
    			FROM   SCM_ITEM_M CC WITH(NOLOCK),	SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
    			WHERE  1=1
    			AND    CC.ITEM_CLASS  = DD.CLASS_ID
    			AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    			AND    DD.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
    			AND    DD.LEVEL_3_NAME IN ('Pack', 'Module' )
    			AND    LEFT(ISNULL(CC.FLOW_ID,'Z'),5)  IN ( 'P9500','P5500')
    	) CC
    	ON   1=1
    	AND  A.COMPANY_ID  = CC.COMPANY_ID
    	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = CC.DIVISION_ID
    	AND  A.SITE_ID     = CC.SITE_ID
    	AND  A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = CC.ITEM_ID 
    	INNER HASH JOIN ( ---B: CELL ITEM 검색
    			SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID , A.PARENT_ITEM_ID , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID , A.CHILD_QTY/A.PARENT_QTY AS BOM_RATE_CELL , A.ALT_ID, A.ALT_PRIORITY, A.ALT_RATE, A.EFF_START_DATE , A.EFF_END_DATE
    				 , B1.FACTORY_ID, B1.MONTH , B1.PRIORITY
    			FROM    SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    			INNER HASH JOIN  (
    					SELECT CC.COMPANY_ID , CC.DIVISION_ID , CC.SITE_ID, CC.ITEM_ID , CC.ITEM_CLASS , DD.LEVEL_3_CODE, DD.LEVEL_3_NAME, CC.FLOW_ID 
    					FROM   SCM_ITEM_M CC WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
    					WHERE  1=1
    					AND    CC.ITEM_CLASS  = DD.CLASS_ID
    					AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    					AND    DD.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
    					AND    LEFT(ISNULL(CC.FLOW_ID,'Z'),5) IN ('A9000')
    					AND    DD.LEVEL_3_NAME = 'Cell'
    			) EE 
    			ON   1=1
    			AND  A.COMPANY_ID  = EE.COMPANY_ID
    			AND  A.DIVISION_ID = EE.DIVISION_ID
    			AND  A.SITE_ID     = EE.SITE_ID
    			AND  A.CHILD_ITEM_ID = EE.ITEM_ID
    			LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN ( --- 자품목이 LINE ASSIGN에 있는 것 조회용.
    						SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID,  A.MONTH, A.PRIORITY--, B.ASSY_FACTORY_ID
              	FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    						INNER HASH JOIN (
    								SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
    								FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
    								WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
    								AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    								AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    								AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @ASSY_INSTANCE_ID
    						) B
    						ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
    						AND   A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
    						AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
    						AND   A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
    						WHERE 1=1
        				AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        				AND   A.MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTRING(@BUCKET_FROM,1,6) AND SUBSTRING(@BUCKET_TO,1,6)
        				AND   A.PRIORITY NOT IN (0,9)
          		) B1
          		ON    1=1
          		AND   A.COMPANY_ID     = B1.COMPANY_ID
          		AND   A.DIVISION_ID    = B1.DIVISION_ID
          		AND   A.SITE_ID        = B1.SITE_ID
          		AND   A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = B1.ITEM_ID
          		AND   B1.MONTH <   = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),A.EFF_END_DATE,112)
    			WHERE 1=1
    			AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_START_DATE,112) <= @PLAN_DATE
    			AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_END_DATE,112) > @PLAN_DATE  --- INSTANCE_DATE
      ) B
      ON    1=1
      AND   A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND   A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND   A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
      AND   A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_START_DATE,112) <= @PLAN_DATE
      AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_END_DATE,112) > @PLAN_DATE  --- INSTANCE_DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PACK_INSTANCE_ID" name="PACK_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ASSY_INSTANCE_ID" name="ASSY_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
 <sql id="find_YLD_F6000">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
      	 , D1.LINE_ID
      	 , D1.ITEM_ID
      	 , CASE WHEN ISNULL(ISNULL(D2.YIELD, D1.YIELD), 1) = 0 THEN 1
      		    ELSE ISNULL(ISNULL(D2.YIELD, D1.YIELD), 1)
      		    END  AS YIELD
      FROM (
        	SELECT DISTINCT A.*, 'F6000' AS OPERATION_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, B.DATE_ID, 112) AS PLAN_DATE, B.YEAR+B.MONTH AS MONTH
        	FROM (
          		SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
          		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          		AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          		AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          		AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID
        	) A, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE 1=1
        	AND   B.DATE_ID BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_FROM) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
      ) A
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_YIELD_M AS D1 WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D1.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D1.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = D1.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = D1.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = D1.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D1.OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.MONTH          = D1.MONTH
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M D2 WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D2.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D2.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = D2.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = D2.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = D2.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D2.OPERATION_ID
      AND    D1.OPERATION_ID  = D2.OPERATION_ID 
      AND    A.PLAN_DATE     >= D2.START_TIME
      AND    A.PLAN_DATE     <= D2.END_TIME
      AND    D2.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
      WHERE  D1.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, D1.LINE_ID, D1.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MONTH, YIELD
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "FORM_INSTANCE_ID" name="FORM_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
	
 </sql>
 <sql id="find_AGING_STOCK">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.RECEIVING_DTTM, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
           , A.ROUTE_ID AS LINE_ID
           , A.ITEM_ID -- form item
           , ISNULL(A.QTY,0) AS AGING_STOCK 
      FROM   TH_MST_STOCK_PLAN_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.MASTER_ID    = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID
      AND    A.PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_ID_SCRIPT
 
      )
      AND    A.STOCK_STATUS = 'AGING_STOCK'
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "FORM_INSTANCE_ID" name="FORM_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_ID_SCRIPT" name="PLAN_ID_SCRIPT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
 	
 </sql>
 <sql id="find_Cell_ExchangeValue">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
           , SUM(MCT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUM_QTY
      FROM (
          SELECT MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID, MCT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
               , DENSE_RANK() OVER( PARTITION BY MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID ORDER BY MCT.ALT_PRIORITY ) AS RANK_VAL
          FROM   SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE MCT WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    MCT.EFF_START_DATE <= @PLAN_DATE
          AND    MCT.EFF_END_DATE    > @PLAN_DATE
          AND    MCT.MODEL_ID = MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID -- 화면 특성상 각 SHOP별 최상위공정의 품번들만 가지고 수정하므로 이 조건이 유효함
          -- cell 계획 테이블 품번 기준으로만 가져온다.
          AND EXISTS (
            	SELECT 1
            	FROM (
              		SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
              		FROM   @CELL_AMEND_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
              		WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @ASSY_INSTANCE_ID               --->  UI FILTER: INSTANCE_ID
              		AND	   A.FP_PLAN_ID IN ( @ASSY_PLAN_LT )   --->  UI FILTER: PLAN_ID
              		AND	   A.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
              		AND	   A.CATEGORY_ID  = 'PLAN'
              		AND    A.OPERATION_ID = 'A9000'
              		--AND	  (A.OUT_QTY > 0 OR A.RESULT_OUT_QTY > 0 )
              		AND   A.DIVISION_ID  IN (CASE WHEN INSTANCE_ID = @ASSY_INSTANCE_ID THEN '81' ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END )
            	) A
            	WHERE MCT.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
            	AND   MCT.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
            	AND   MCT.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
            	AND   MCT.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
            	AND   MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
          )
      ) MCT
      WHERE MCT.RANK_VAL = 1
      GROUP BY MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
      ORDER BY MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ASSY_INSTANCE_ID" name="ASSY_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "CELL_AMEND_TABLE" name="CELL_AMEND_TABLE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ASSY_PLAN_LT" name="ASSY_PLAN_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />

 </sql>
 <sql id="find_yield_F1000">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F1000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F1000 END) AS YIELD_F1000
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4000 END) AS YIELD_F4000
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4500 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4500 END) AS YIELD_F4500
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4700 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4700 END) AS YIELD_F4700
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F1000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F1000 END)
             *(CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4000 END)
             *(CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4500 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4500 END)
             *(CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4700 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4700 END) AS YIELD
      FROM (
      	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F1000' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F1000
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F4000' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F4000
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F4500' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F4500
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F4700' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F4700
      	FROM (
      		SELECT *
      		FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      		WHERE  1=1
      		AND    OPERATION_ID IN ('F1000', 'F4000', 'F4500', 'F4700')
      		AND    A.MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTRING(@PLAN_DATE,1,6) AND SUBSTRING(@BUCKET_TO,1,6) -- INSTANCE DATE ~ END DATE
      		AND EXISTS (
      				SELECT 1
      				FROM (
      					SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
      					FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      					WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
      					AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      					AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      					AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID -- FORM INSTANCE 기준 PLANT
      				) BB
      				WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = BB.COMPANY_ID
      				AND   A.DIVISION_ID = BB.DIVISION_ID
      				AND   A.SITE_ID     = BB.SITE_ID
      				AND   A.PLANT_ID    = BB.PLANT_ID
      				AND   A.FACTORY_ID  = BB.FACTORY_ID
      		)
      	) A
      	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

<SQLS id="FP00634_Tray_Simulation">
  <simple-sqls>
  	
      	
  <sql id="findInstanceList_common">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID AS CODE, B.SEGMENT2 AS NAME, B.SORT_ORDER
           , B.ATTRIBUTE3 AS USE_WOW_STATUS
           , B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
           , B.ATTRIBUTE2 AS IS_SAME_PLAN_ID
           , B.ATTRIBUTE14 AS ROUND_POINT
           , C.SITE_ID
           , ISNULL(D.FACTORY_YN, 'N') AS FACTORY_YN
      FROM (
			        	SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID
			        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
			        	WHERE  USER_ID = @USER_ID
			      ) A
	      		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
								SELECT	SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, 'Y' AS FACTORY_YN
								FROM	SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE                                                                                          		
								WHERE	1=1                                                                                                                       
								AND		LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORM_TRAY_SIMUL_OPTION'                                                                      
								AND		ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'     				
								AND	    ATTRIBUTE1 = 'BUILDING'
								GROUP BY SEGMENT1
						) D
						ON 1=1
						AND A.INSTANCE_ID = D.INSTANCE_ID
						, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK), (
			          SELECT B.INSTANCE_ID, MAX(A.SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID
			          FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
			          WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
			          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			          GROUP BY B.INSTANCE_ID
					  ) C
      WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID      = B.SEGMENT1
      AND   A.INSTANCE_ID      = C.INSTANCE_ID
      AND   B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
      AND   B.SEGMENT1 IN 	(
								SELECT INSTANCE_ID
								FROM   FP_AMEND_UI_V
								WHERE  AMEND_UI_NAME = @AMEND_INSTANCE
								AND    USE_FLAG = 'Y'
								--AND    INSTANCE_ID = 'KR_FORM_A'
								AND    INSTANCE_ID NOT IN ('CN_FORM_EB', 'CN_FORM_E') -- auto 만 보여줌
      						)
      AND   A.INSTANCE_ID NOT LIKE '%_M'
      ORDER BY B.SORT_ORDER

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "AMEND_INSTANCE" name="AMEND_INSTANCE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>  
    <sql id="find_isPast">
    
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT AA.*
           , (SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR T1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = AA.CURR_DATE)) AS PLAN_START_DATE
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 27, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR _T2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = AA.CURR_DATE)))), 112) AS PLAN_END_DATE
      FROM (
          SELECT A.BASIS_START_TIME
        		   , CASE WHEN FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') < CONVERT(VARCHAR,dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID),112) + A.BASIS_START_TIME 
        				  THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD,-1,dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)), 112)
        				  ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID), 112) END AS CURR_DATE
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_START_TIME_V A, (
          		SELECT MAX(B.SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID
          		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
          		AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          		AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          		AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
      	  ) B
          WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
      ) AA

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>  
  <sql id="findFpPlan_info">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH RELEASE_PLAN AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 A.INSTANCE_ID
                ,A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID
                ,STUFF(( SELECT ',' + FACTORY_ID
                         FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H B
                         WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
                         AND    A.INSTANCE_DATE   = B.INSTANCE_DATE
                         AND    A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID = B.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
                         FOR XML PATH('') ),1,1,'') AS FACTORY_LT
                ,A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                ,A.INSTANCE_DATE AS PLAN_DATE
          FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A
          WHERE  1=1
          @CTRL_INSTANCE
          @CTRL_INSTANCE_DATE

      )
      SELECT A.PLAN_ID AS CODE, SUBSTRING(A.PLAN_ID,CHARINDEX('-',A.PLAN_ID)+1,11) AS NAME
            ,A.PLAN_ID
            ,A.PLAN_TYPE
            ,A.PLAN_START_TIME
            ,A.PLAN_HORIZON
            ,A.PLAN_HORIZON_UOM
            ,A.DEMAND_HORIZON
            ,A.DEMAND_HORIZON_UOM
            ,A.CONFIG_SET_ID
            ,A.BASIS_PLAN_ID
            ,A.DEMAND_PLAN_ID
            ,A.SCP_PLAN_ID
            ,A.PLAN_WEEK
            --,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  YYYYMMDD = PLAN_DATE)) AS PLAN_START_DATE
            ,@PLAN_DATE AS PLAN_START_DATE
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 27, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_DATE)))), 112) AS PLAN_END_DATE
            --,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  YYYYMMDD = PLAN_DATE)) AS DEFAULT_START_DATE
            ,@PLAN_DATE AS DEFAULT_START_DATE
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 27, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_DATE)))), 112) AS DEFAULT_END_DATE
            ,A.INSTANCE_ID
            ,A.SITE_ID
            ,A.DESCRIPTION
            ,A.PLAN_TYPE
            ,CASE WHEN A.RELEASE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.RELEASE_ID ELSE A.INSERT_ID END AS INSERT_ID
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.INSERT_TIME, 120) AS INSERT_TIME
            ,CASE WHEN A.RELEASE_FLAG = 'Y' 
            	  THEN (SELECT DISTINCT SA.DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_FP_PLAN_H SA WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID = SA.INSTANCE_ID AND A.BASIS_PLAN_ID = SA.PLAN_ID ) 
            	  ELSE A.DESCRIPTION END AS DESCS
            ,SUBSTRING(BASIS_PLAN_ID,CHARINDEX('-',BASIS_PLAN_ID)+1,11) AS BASIC_VERSION
            ,C.FACTORY_LT
            ,(CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' THEN 'N' -- input MPP WPP
				           WHEN RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID,2) = '00' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) READ_ONLY
      FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
    	LEFT OUTER JOIN RELEASE_PLAN C WITH(NOLOCK)
  		ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = C.INSTANCE_ID
  		AND A.PLAN_ID     = C.PLAN_ID
      WHERE 1=1
     -- AND   A.PLAN_TYPE <> 'RELEASE'
      AND 	CHARINDEX('-00',A.PLAN_ID) = 0
      @CTRL_INSTANCE
	    @CTRL_START_TIME
 
      ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_START_TIME,112) DESC, A.PLAN_ID DESC
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
<parameter replace-what = "CTRL_INSTANCE_DATE" name="CTRL_INSTANCE_DATE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
<parameter replace-what = "CTRL_INSTANCE" name="CTRL_INSTANCE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
<parameter replace-what = "CTRL_START_TIME" name="CTRL_START_TIME"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>    
<sql id = "find_planInfo_p">
	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					WITH FORM_PLAN AS (
						        	SELECT 'FORM_PLAN' AS PLAN_TYPE, A.*
						        	FROM (
							        		SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) AS RELEASE_VALUE
							                		, RELEASE_PLAN_ID, CONVERT(CHAR(19), A.INSERT_TIME, 20) AS INSERT_TIME, B.INSERT_ID
							                		, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END)
							                						ORDER BY     A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) AS ROW_NUM
							        		FROM   	FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A WITH(NOLOCK) ,
							        			   	SCM_FP_PLAN_H B WITH(NOLOCK)

											AND		A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID = B.PLAN_ID
							        		AND	   	A.INSTANCE_DATE <= @PLAN_DATE

						        	--  else            sql = "      	AND   1=0\r\n";

									SELECT  'FORM_PLAN' AS PLAN_TYPE, A.INSTANCE_ID, '-' AS RELEASE_VALUE, A.PLAN_ID AS RELEASE_PLAN_ID
											, CONVERT(CHAR(19), A.INSERT_TIME, 20) AS INSERT_TIME, A.INSERT_ID, 1 AS ROW_NM

    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_WHERE" name="CTRL_WHERE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />

</sql>

    <sql id="findOperationCode_common">
    
      <text>

           , A.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG

@CTRL_DIVISION_LT

  <sql id="findLineCode_List">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE
           , '(' + A.LINE_ID + ')' + (CASE WHEN A.LINE_NAME = '' OR A.LINE_NAME IS NULL THEN A.LINE_ID ELSE A.LINE_NAME END) AS NAME
      FROM   SCM_LINE_M A(NOLOCK)
      WHERE A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      AND    EXISTS (
			        	SELECT 1
			        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
			        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
			        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			        	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
			        	AND    A.PLANT_ID	 = B.PLANT_ID
			        	AND    A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
			        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
			        	AND    A.LINE_ID 	 = B.LINE_ID
			        	AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
			      	)
      AND   EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID
              FROM  SCM_FACTORY_M A(NOLOCK)
              INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B(NOLOCK)
              ON    A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID
              AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              WHERE 1=1
              AND   B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
          ) C
          WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID
      )
      @CTRL_COMPANY_LT
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
      @CTRL_SITE_LT
      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      
      @CTRL_INSTANCE
      @CTRL_PLAN_TYPE
      
      GROUP BY A.LINE_ID, A.LINE_NAME
      ORDER BY A.LINE_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
     
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_COMPANY_LT" name="CTRL_COMPANY_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_LINE_LT" name="CTRL_LINE_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_DIVISION_LT" name="CTRL_DIVISION_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_SITE_LT" name="CTRL_SITE_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_PLANT_LT" name="CTRL_PLANT_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_FACTORY_LT" name="CTRL_FACTORY_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_OPERATION_LT" name="CTRL_OPERATION_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
  
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_INSTANCE" name="CTRL_INSTANCE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    <parameter replace-what = "CTRL_PLAN_TYPE" name="CTRL_PLAN_TYPE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
    
      </parameters>
 
  </sql>  
  	
  <sql id="find_Model_List">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT DISTINCT A.TOP_ITEM_ID AS CODE_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID AS CODE
      FROM (
          -- P
          SELECT A.TOP_ITEM_ID
          FROM   @AMEND_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
          AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID   = @PLAN_ID
          AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) >= @PLAN_DATE
          @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
          @CTRL_SITE_LT
          @CTRL_PLANT_LT
          @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
          @CTRL_LINE_LT
          -- S
          UNION ALL
          SELECT A.TOP_ITEM_ID
          FROM   @AMEND_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @MASTER_ID
          AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID   = @PLAN_ID
          AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) >= @PLAN_DATE
          @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
          @CTRL_SITE_LT
          @CTRL_PLANT_LT
          @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID = '-'
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
          UNION ALL
          SELECT A.TOP_ITEM_ID
          FROM   FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) < @PLAN_DATE
          AND    A.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE'
          @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
          @CTRL_SITE_LT
          @CTRL_PLANT_LT
          @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = @OPERATION_ID
          @CTRL_LINE_LT
          UNION ALL
          SELECT A.TOP_ITEM_ID

  <sql id="chk_PlanId">    
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

		        	SELECT A.*
		        	FROM (
			        		SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) AS RELEASE_VALUE
			                	 , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, INSERT_TIME
			                	 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END)
			                						 ORDER BY     A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) AS ROW_NUM
			        		FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
			        		WHERE	1=1
			        		AND   	A.INSTANCE_ID IN (
										        		SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS ASSY_ID
										        		FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
										        		WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ELEC_ASSY_INSTANCE_MAP'
										        		AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @INSTANCE_ID
										          	 ) 
							AND		A.INSERT_TIME > ( 
														SELECT  DISTINCT A.INSERT_TIME
														FROM SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
														WHERE  1=1
														AND A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
														AND A.PLAN_ID =  @PLAN_ID
														AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.INSERT_TIME,112)	= 	
																									( 
																										SELECT CASE WHEN FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') < CONVERT(VARCHAR,dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID),112) + A.BASIS_START_TIME 
																								        				  THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD,-1,dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)), 112)
																								        				  ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID), 112) END AS CURR_DATE
																								          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_START_TIME_V A, (
																								          		SELECT MAX(B.SITE_ID) AS SITE_ID
																								          		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
																								          		WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID

																								      	  ) B

																									)
													 )
		        	) A
		        	WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1

      ]]>

<simple-sqls>

  	<sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>
