                 , BB.COMPANY_ID, BB.DIVISION_ID, BB.SITE_ID, BB.PLANT_ID, BB.FACTORY_ID, ISNULL(CC.LOCATION,'-') AS LOCATION
                 , BB.OPERATION_ID, BB.LINE_ID, CC.ELECTRODE_TYPE, BB.EQUIPMENT_ID
                 , BB.ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID, BB.ITEM_ID
                 , UPPER(BB.PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, BB.MARKET
                 , BB.PLAN_DATE
                 , ROUND(BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
                 , BB.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                 , ROUND(BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
                 , BB.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
                 , BB.SEQ
            FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R BB WITH(NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M CC WITH(NOLOCK)
            ON     BB.DIVISION_ID     = CC.DIVISION_ID
            AND    BB.SITE_ID         = CC.SITE_ID
            AND    BB.PLANT_ID        = CC.PLANT_ID
            AND    BB.FACTORY_ID      = CC.FACTORY_ID
            AND    BB.OPERATION_ID    = CC.OPERATION_ID
            AND    BB.LINE_ID         = CC.LINE_ID
            AND    BB.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = CC.ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
            WHERE  BB.JOB_USER_ID     = @USER_ID
            AND	   BB.INSTANCE_ID     = @INSTANCE_ID
      	) AS B
      	ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID 	  = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LOCATION        = B.LOCATION
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
      		UPDATE SET 	ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH 		= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
						, ADJUST_IN_QTY_M 			= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
						, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL 		= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
						, ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR 			= B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
						, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
						--, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
	                    --, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
	                    --, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR 		= B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
	                    , ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
					  	, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
						, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
							                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
							                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB
							                                                  ON     1=1
							                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
                    , SEQ = B.SEQ
                    , PRODUCTION_TYPE       = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
    		            , UPDATE_ID = @USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID)
      	WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
      		INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,SEQ
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_IN_QTY
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_M, PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_OUT_QTY
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
      		)
      		VALUES (
               B.INSTANCE_ID, B.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,(SELECT MAX(KK.COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M KK WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE KK.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID AND KK.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')
              ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
              ,B.LOCATION, B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,B.EQUIPMENT_ID ,B.PLAN_DATE
              ,B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
              ,B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
              ,B.SEQ
              ,null, null
              ,null, null
              ,null, null
              ,null, null
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, 0
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, 0
              --,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              --,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              --,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR 
              , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
			  , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
			  , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD
					                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_M SA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)
						                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
						                                                  ) SB
						                                                  ON     1=1
						                                                  WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))						                                                  
			  
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
              ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID)
      		)
          ;
      	  
        INSERT INTO HIS_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R (
               INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_DATE
              ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,SEQ
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_IN_QTY
              ,PLAN_IN_QTY_M, PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, PLAN_OUT_QTY
              ,PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
              ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME,JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
              ,(SELECT MAX(YY.COMPANY_ID) AS COMPANY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M YY WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = YY.FACTORY_ID AND	YY.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') AS COMPANY_ID
              ,A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,ISNULL(C.LOCATION,'-') AS LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PLAN_DATE
              ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
              ,UPPER(A.PRODUCTION_TYPE) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
              ,A.SEQ
              ,0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY
              ,0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY_M, 0 AS PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,0 AS PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS  PLAN_OUT_QTY
              ,0 AS PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, 0 AS PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, 0 AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
        FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON     A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID        = C.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = C.FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
        AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
        INNER JOIN FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R B WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID 	  = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND ISNULL(C.LOCATION,'-') = B.LOCATION
        AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
        AND A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
        AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
        AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
        AND A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
        WHERE  JOB_USER_ID 		= @USER_ID
        AND	   A.INSTANCE_ID    = @INSTANCE_ID
      	;
      	
      END;
      
      ]]>
    </text>
    <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ROUND_POINT" name="ROUND_POINT" dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100"/>
    </parameters>
    </sql>

<SQLS id="FP00641_Cell_Simulation_Cell_Pack">
  <simple-sqls>
  	<sql id="find_Release_Plan_list">
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID, A.CONFIRM_AREA
      FROM (
          SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) AS RELEASE_VALUE
              , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, INSERT_TIME, B.CONFIRM_AREA
              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.INSTANCE_ID, (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID='-' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END)
                                  ORDER BY     A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) AS ROW_NUM
          FROM   FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A WITH(NOLOCK), (
          		SELECT MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1) AS CONFIRM_AREA
          		FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          		AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          		AND    A.SEGMENT1 = @TARGET_INSTANCE
        	) B
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @TARGET_INSTANCE
          --and    A.INSTANCE_DATE <= 'PLAN_DATE' -- 가장 최신날짜
      ) A
      WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "TARGET_INSTANCE" name="TARGET_INSTANCE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  	</sql>
  	<sql id="find_site">
  		
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT SITE_ID AS CODE
           , '(' + SITE_ID + ')' + CASE WHEN SITE_NAME = '' OR SITE_NAME IS NULL THEN SITE_ID ELSE SITE_NAME END AS NAME
      FROM  SCM_SITE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE 1 = 1
      AND  EXISTS (
        	SELECT 1 
        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
        	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
        	AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
      )
      AND A.SITE_ID IN ('A003','A004') -- 미국, 폴란드 전용... 20200723
      GROUP BY A.SITE_ID, A.SITE_NAME
      ORDER BY A.SITE_ID ASC

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  </sql>  
  <sql id="find_instance">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS SITE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_ID
            , A.SEGMENT3 AS INSTANCE_NAME
            , A.SEGMENT4 AS PLAN_GROUP
            , A.SEGMENT5 AS PLAN_GROUP_NAME
            , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PACK_INSTANCE_ID
            , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS DIVISION
            , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS CELL_INSTANCE_ID
            , B.INSTANCE_NAME AS PACK_INSTANCE_NAME
            , C.INSTANCE_NAME AS CELL_INSTANCE_NAME
      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) B
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE1 = B.INSTANCE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      ) C
      ON A.ATTRIBUTE3 = C.INSTANCE_ID
      WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_ID_MAPPING'
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      AND    A.SEGMENT1         = @SITE_ID
      ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_currdate">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH SITE_T AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT INSTANCE_ID, SITE_ID
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( @INSTANCE_LT )
      )
      SELECT MIN(A.CURR_DATE) AS CURR_DATE
      FROM (
      	SELECT (CASE WHEN FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') < (FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMdd') + A.BASIS_START_TIME)
      					THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(DD,-1,FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMdd')),112) 
      				 ELSE FORMAT(dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(B.SITE_ID) ,'yyyyMMdd') END) AS CURR_DATE
      	FROM   FP_INSTANCE_START_TIME_V A, SITE_T B
      	WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
      ) A
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_LT" name="INSTANCE_LT"  dbType="command" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_bucketdate">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH CURR_DATE AS (
      	SELECT @PLAN_DATE AS CURR_DATE
      )
      SELECT (SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR CC WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = AA.CURR_DATE)) AS START_DATE
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 27, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = AA.CURR_DATE)))), 112) AS END_DATE
      FROM   CURR_DATE AA
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  	
  </sql>
  <sql id="find_plan">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.PLAN_ID AS CODE, A.PLAN_ID AS NAME
      FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  1=1
      AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
      AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_START_TIME,112) = @PLAN_DATE
      AND    A.PLAN_TYPE = 'PRE'
      AND    RIGHT(A.PLAN_ID,2) <> '00'
      -- 인스턴스들의 배포정보중에 가장 최근에 배포된 시점 이후로 만들어진 plan 들만 뽑아옴
      /*
      AND    A.INSERT_TIME > (
        	SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
        	FROM (
          		SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
          		FROM   HIS_FP_PLAN_DETAIL_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( 'INSTANCE_LT' )
          		UNION ALL
          		SELECT MAX(A.RELEASE_TIME) AS RELEASE_TIME
          		FROM   HIS_FP_PLAN_GROUP_DETAIL_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
          		WHERE  INSTANCE_ID IN ( 'INSTANCE_LT' )
        	) A
      )
      */
      ORDER BY A.PLAN_ID DESC
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>

  <sql id="find_BOM_RATE_BACK">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

    	-- BOM 전개 코드 :  1순위 --
    	SELECT  A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
    			, A.PARENT_ITEM_ID, A.PARENT_UOM
    			, A.CHILD_ITEM_ID AS P5000_ITEM_ID, A.CHILD_UOM
    			, A.CHILD_QTY/A.PARENT_QTY AS BOM_RATE_P5000 
    			, A.ALT_ID, A.ALT_PRIORITY 
    			, A.EFF_START_DATE, A.EFF_END_DATE
    			, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID AS CELL_ITEM_ID , B.BOM_RATE_CELL ,B.ALT_ID AS CELL_ALT_ID, B.ALT_PRIORITY AS CELL_ALT_PRIORITY -- BOM_RATE_CELL 값이 cell request 에 쓰임
    			, B.FACTORY_ID 
    			, B.MONTH , B.PRIORITY 
    			, CASE WHEN B.PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.PRIORITY END S1
    			, CASE WHEN B.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.ALT_PRIORITY END S2
    			, CASE WHEN A.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE A.ALT_PRIORITY END S3
    			, RANK() OVER(  PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.PARENT_ITEM_ID , A.EFF_START_DATE, A.EFF_END_DATE 
            							ORDER BY    CASE WHEN B.PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.PRIORITY END
            									,	CASE WHEN B.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE B.ALT_PRIORITY END
            									,	CASE WHEN A.ALT_PRIORITY IS NULL THEN 99 ELSE A.ALT_PRIORITY END
            					 ) RNK
    	FROM	SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    	INNER HASH JOIN ( --: PACK쪽 인스턴스만 필터링
    			SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
    			FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
    			WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
    			AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    			AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    			AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @PACK_INSTANCE_ID -- pack instance 기준 plant
    	) E
    	ON   1=1
    	AND  A.COMPANY_ID = E.COMPANY_ID
    	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
    	AND  A.SITE_ID     = E.SITE_ID
    	AND  A.PLANT_ID    = E.PLANT_ID
    	INNER HASH JOIN ( --: PACK ITEM 필터조건
    			SELECT CC.COMPANY_ID, CC.DIVISION_ID, CC.SITE_ID, CC.ITEM_ID, CC.ITEM_CLASS, DD.LEVEL_3_CODE, DD.LEVEL_3_NAME, CC.FLOW_ID
    			FROM   SCM_ITEM_M CC WITH(NOLOCK),	SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
    			WHERE  1=1
    			AND    CC.ITEM_CLASS  = DD.CLASS_ID
    			AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    			AND    DD.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
    			AND    DD.LEVEL_3_NAME IN ('Pack', 'Module' )
    			AND    LEFT(ISNULL(CC.FLOW_ID,'Z'),5)  IN ( 'P9500','P5500')
    	) CC
    	ON   1=1
    	AND  A.COMPANY_ID  = CC.COMPANY_ID
    	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = CC.DIVISION_ID
    	AND  A.SITE_ID     = CC.SITE_ID
    	AND  A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = CC.ITEM_ID 
    	INNER HASH JOIN ( ---B: CELL ITEM 검색
    			SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID , A.PARENT_ITEM_ID , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID , A.CHILD_QTY/A.PARENT_QTY AS BOM_RATE_CELL , A.ALT_ID, A.ALT_PRIORITY, A.ALT_RATE, A.EFF_START_DATE , A.EFF_END_DATE
    				 , B1.FACTORY_ID, B1.MONTH , B1.PRIORITY
    			FROM    SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    			INNER HASH JOIN  (
    					SELECT CC.COMPANY_ID , CC.DIVISION_ID , CC.SITE_ID, CC.ITEM_ID , CC.ITEM_CLASS , DD.LEVEL_3_CODE, DD.LEVEL_3_NAME, CC.FLOW_ID 
    					FROM   SCM_ITEM_M CC WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)
    					WHERE  1=1
    					AND    CC.ITEM_CLASS  = DD.CLASS_ID
    					AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    					AND    DD.USE_FLAG    = 'Y'
    					AND    LEFT(ISNULL(CC.FLOW_ID,'Z'),5) IN ('A9000')
    					AND    DD.LEVEL_3_NAME = 'Cell'
    			) EE 
    			ON   1=1
    			AND  A.COMPANY_ID  = EE.COMPANY_ID
    			AND  A.DIVISION_ID = EE.DIVISION_ID
    			AND  A.SITE_ID     = EE.SITE_ID
    			AND  A.CHILD_ITEM_ID = EE.ITEM_ID
    			LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN ( --- 자품목이 LINE ASSIGN에 있는 것 조회용.
    						SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID,  A.MONTH, A.PRIORITY--, B.ASSY_FACTORY_ID
              	FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    						INNER HASH JOIN (
    								SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID
    								FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
    								WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
    								AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    								AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
    								AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @ASSY_INSTANCE_ID
    						) B
    						ON    A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
    						AND   A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
    						AND   A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
    						AND   A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
    						WHERE 1=1
        				AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        				AND   A.MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTRING(@BUCKET_FROM,1,6) AND SUBSTRING(@BUCKET_TO,1,6)
        				AND   A.PRIORITY NOT IN (0,9)
          		) B1
          		ON    1=1
          		AND   A.COMPANY_ID     = B1.COMPANY_ID
          		AND   A.DIVISION_ID    = B1.DIVISION_ID
          		AND   A.SITE_ID        = B1.SITE_ID
          		AND   A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = B1.ITEM_ID
          		AND   B1.MONTH <   = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),A.EFF_END_DATE,112)
    			WHERE 1=1
    			AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_START_DATE,112) <= @PLAN_DATE
    			AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_END_DATE,112) > @PLAN_DATE  --- INSTANCE_DATE
      ) B
      ON    1=1
      AND   A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND   A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND   A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
      AND   A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_START_DATE,112) <= @PLAN_DATE
      AND   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),A.EFF_END_DATE,112) > @PLAN_DATE  --- INSTANCE_DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PACK_INSTANCE_ID" name="PACK_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ASSY_INSTANCE_ID" name="ASSY_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  
   <sql id="find_BOM_RATE">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

    	-- BOM 전개 코드 :  1순위 --
    	SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID

    			FROM   SCM_ITEM_M CC WITH(NOLOCK),	SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)

    			AND    CC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

    				 , B1.FACTORY_ID, B1.MONTH , B1.PRIORITY
    			FROM    SCM_BOM_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
    			INNER HASH JOIN  (

    					FROM   SCM_ITEM_M CC WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M DD WITH(NOLOCK)

    			LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN ( --- 자품목이 LINE ASSIGN에 있는 것 조회용.
    						SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID,  A.MONTH, A.PRIORITY--, B.ASSY_FACTORY_ID

 <sql id="find_YLD_F6000">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MONTH, A.LINE_ID, B.CELL_PRODUCT_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, A.YIELD -- cell product
	FROM (
        SELECT A.*
        	 , D1.LINE_ID
        	 , D1.ITEM_ID
        	 , CASE WHEN ISNULL(ISNULL(D2.YIELD, D1.YIELD), 1) = 0 THEN 1
        		    ELSE ISNULL(ISNULL(D2.YIELD, D1.YIELD), 1)
        		    END  AS YIELD
        FROM (
          	SELECT DISTINCT A.*, 'F6000' AS OPERATION_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, B.DATE_ID, 112) AS PLAN_DATE, B.YEAR+B.MONTH AS MONTH
          	FROM (
            		SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
            		FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
            		WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
            		AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            		AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            		AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID
          	) A, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          	WHERE 1=1
          	AND   B.DATE_ID BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_FROM) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
        ) A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_YIELD_M AS D1 WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D1.COMPANY_ID
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D1.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID        = D1.SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID       = D1.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = D1.FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D1.OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.MONTH          = D1.MONTH
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M D2 WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D2.COMPANY_ID
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D2.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID        = D2.SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID       = D2.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = D2.FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D2.OPERATION_ID
        AND    D1.OPERATION_ID  = D2.OPERATION_ID 
        AND    A.PLAN_DATE     >= D2.START_TIME
        AND    A.PLAN_DATE     <= D2.END_TIME
        AND    D2.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
        WHERE  D1.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL
        --ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, D1.LINE_ID, D1.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MONTH, YIELD
	  ) A
	  INNER JOIN FP_CELL_ASSY_PRODUCT_MAP_V B WITH(NOLOCK) 
	  ON  1=1 
	  AND A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID 
	  AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID 
	  AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID 
	  AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID -- cell assy
	  ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, B.CELL_PRODUCT_ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MONTH, YIELD
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "FORM_INSTANCE_ID" name="FORM_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
	
 </sql>
 <sql id="find_AGING_STOCK">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.RECEIVING_DTTM, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
           , A.ROUTE_ID AS LINE_ID
           --, A.ITEM_ID -- form item
           , B.CELL_PRODUCT_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID -- cell product
           , ISNULL(A.QTY,0) AS AGING_STOCK 
      FROM   TH_MST_STOCK_PLAN_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN (
    			SELECT C.FACTORY_ID AS SITE_ID, B.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, B.CELL_PRODUCT_ITEM_ID
    			FROM   FP_CELL_ASSY_PRODUCT_MAP_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
    			, (
      				SELECT C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.FACTORY_ID
      				FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V C WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  1=1
      				AND    C.INSTANCE_ID = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID
      				GROUP BY C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.FACTORY_ID
    			) C
    			WHERE  1=1
    			AND    B.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
    			AND    B.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
    			AND    B.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
    			GROUP BY C.FACTORY_ID, B.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, B.CELL_PRODUCT_ITEM_ID
      ) B
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID -- factory_id
      AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID 
      WHERE  A.MASTER_ID    = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID
      AND    A.PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_ID_SCRIPT
 
      )
      AND    A.STOCK_STATUS = 'AGING_STOCK'
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "FORM_INSTANCE_ID" name="FORM_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_ID_SCRIPT" name="PLAN_ID_SCRIPT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
 	
 </sql>
 <sql id="find_Cell_ExchangeValue">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
           , SUM(MCT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUM_QTY
      FROM (
          SELECT MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID, MCT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
               , DENSE_RANK() OVER( PARTITION BY MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID ORDER BY MCT.ALT_PRIORITY ) AS RANK_VAL
          FROM   SCM_MODEL_COMP_EFFECTIVE_DATE MCT WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    MCT.EFF_START_DATE <= @PLAN_DATE
          AND    MCT.EFF_END_DATE    > @PLAN_DATE
          AND    MCT.MODEL_ID = MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID -- 화면 특성상 각 SHOP별 최상위공정의 품번들만 가지고 수정하므로 이 조건이 유효함
          -- cell 계획 테이블 품번 기준으로만 가져온다.
          AND EXISTS (
            	SELECT 1
            	FROM (
              		SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
              		FROM   @CELL_AMEND_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
              		WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID  = @ASSY_INSTANCE_ID               --->  UI FILTER: INSTANCE_ID
              		AND	   A.FP_PLAN_ID IN ( @ASSY_PLAN_LT )   --->  UI FILTER: PLAN_ID
              		AND	   A.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN CONVERT(DATETIME,@PLAN_DATE) AND CONVERT(DATETIME,@BUCKET_TO)
              		AND	   A.CATEGORY_ID  = 'PLAN'
              		AND    A.OPERATION_ID = 'A9000'
              		--AND	  (A.OUT_QTY > 0 OR A.RESULT_OUT_QTY > 0 )
              		AND   A.DIVISION_ID  IN (CASE WHEN INSTANCE_ID = @ASSY_INSTANCE_ID THEN '81' ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END )
            	) A
            	WHERE MCT.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
            	AND   MCT.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
            	AND   MCT.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
            	AND   MCT.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
            	AND   MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
          )
      ) MCT
      WHERE MCT.RANK_VAL = 1
      GROUP BY MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
      ORDER BY MCT.PLANT_ID, MCT.MODEL_ID, MCT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ASSY_INSTANCE_ID" name="ASSY_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "CELL_AMEND_TABLE" name="CELL_AMEND_TABLE"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ASSY_PLAN_LT" name="ASSY_PLAN_LT"  dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
      </parameters>
 	
 </sql>
 <sql id="find_yield_F1000">
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID
            --, ITEM_ID
            , B.CELL_PRODUCT_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID -- cell product
            , A.MONTH
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F1000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F1000 END) AS YIELD_F1000
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4000 END) AS YIELD_F4000
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4500 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4500 END) AS YIELD_F4500
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4700 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4700 END) AS YIELD_F4700
            , (CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F1000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F1000 END)
             *(CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4000 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4000 END)
             *(CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4500 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4500 END)
             *(CASE WHEN A.YIELD_F4700 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE A.YIELD_F4700 END) AS YIELD
      FROM (
      	SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F1000' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F1000
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F4000' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F4000
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F4500' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F4500
      		 , MAX(CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'F4700' THEN A.YIELD ELSE 0 END) AS YIELD_F4700
      	FROM (
      		SELECT *
      		FROM   SCM_YIELD_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      		WHERE  1=1
      		AND    OPERATION_ID IN ('F1000', 'F4000', 'F4500', 'F4700')
      		AND    A.MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTRING(@PLAN_DATE,1,6) AND SUBSTRING(@BUCKET_TO,1,6) -- INSTANCE DATE ~ END DATE
      		AND EXISTS (
      				SELECT 1
      				FROM (
      					SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
      					FROM   FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      					WHERE  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
      					AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      					AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      					AND    A.INSTANCE_ID = @FORM_INSTANCE_ID -- FORM INSTANCE 기준 PLANT
      				) BB
      				WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = BB.COMPANY_ID
      				AND   A.DIVISION_ID = BB.DIVISION_ID
      				AND   A.SITE_ID     = BB.SITE_ID
      				AND   A.PLANT_ID    = BB.PLANT_ID
      				AND   A.FACTORY_ID  = BB.FACTORY_ID
      		)
      	) A
      	GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
      ) A
      INNER JOIN FP_CELL_ASSY_PRODUCT_MAP_V B WITH(NOLOCK) 
      ON  1=1 
      AND A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID 
      AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID 
      AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID 
      AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID 
      ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, A.MONTH
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "FORM_INSTANCE_ID" name="FORM_INSTANCE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
	
 </sql>

  <sql id="find_capasync">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '' END) AS ACTIVE_FLAG
           , A.INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID
           , A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(B.LINE_NAME, '-') AS LINE_NAME, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , C.START_DATE, C.END_DATE
      FROM   FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON    A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
      AND   A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
      AND   A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
      AND   A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        	SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.OPERATION_ID
                , CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.START_DATE,112) AS START_DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.END_DATE,112) AS END_DATE
                , A.ACTIVE_FLAG
        	FROM   FP_LINE_CAPA_SYNC_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
        	WHERE  1=1
        	AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
        	AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID   = @FP_PLAN_ID
        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
      ) C
      ON    A.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID
      AND   A.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID
      AND   A.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID
      AND   A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
      AND   A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
      ORDER BY FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>

  </sql>

<sql id="find_linecopyllist">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT DISTINCT 
             A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           , ISNULL(B.LINE_NAME,'-') AS LINE_NAME
           , B.LOCATION
           , ISNULL(B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE,'GENERAL') AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
      FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
      AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
@CTRL_CONFIRM_AREA      
   
      (
          SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
          FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
          AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          and    A.SEGMENT1    = @INSTANCE_ID
      ) C
      ON     B.MODEL_TYPE     = C.PLAN_GROUP_ID
      INNER JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID
          FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.INSTANCE_ID  = @INSTANCE_ID
          AND 	 B.DIVISION_ID  = @DIVISION_ID
          AND    B.SITE_ID      = @SITE_ID
          AND    A.AMEND_FLAG   = 'Y'
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      ) D
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID     = D.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = D.SITE_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID   = D.OPERATION_ID
      WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID 		  <> @LINE_ID
      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
      AND    A.MONTH          = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,@BUCKET_FROM,112),1,6)
      AND	 A.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0','9')
      ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, LINE_NAME, LOCATION

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="CTRL_CONFIRM_AREA" name="CTRL_CONFIRM_AREA" dbType="COMMAND" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>


</sql>  
<sql id="find_LineCopy_Validation">


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

		SELECT  SUM(CNT) AS CNT
		FROM(
				SELECT  COUNT(1) AS CNT
				FROM   	SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  	A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
			    AND    	A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
			    AND    	A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
			    AND    	A.LINE_ID 		 = @LINE_ID
			    AND    	A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
			    AND	 	A.PRIORITY IN ('0','9')
      			AND    	A.MONTH          BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),@BUCKET_FROM,112) AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),@BUCKET_TO,112)
				UNION ALL
				SELECT  COUNT(1) AS CNT
				FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN (
					SELECT DT
					FROM TH_UIS_CAL
					WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR, DT, 112) BETWEEN  @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
				) B
				ON 1=1
				WHERE  	A.DIVISION_ID    = @DIVISION_ID
			    AND    	A.SITE_ID        = @SITE_ID
			    AND    	A.ITEM_ID        = @ITEM_ID
			    AND    	A.LINE_ID 		 = @LINE_ID
			    AND    	A.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
				AND	  	A.PRIORITY IN ('0','9')
				AND    	B.DT BETWEEN A.START_TIME AND A.END_TIME
			) A

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

  	<sql id="find_Prod_Version_Type">
  		
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

	    			SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
							, CASE WHEN B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END IDX1
							, CASE WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='GENERAL' THEN 1
									 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='WIDE' THEN 2
								 	 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='PREWET_UNIT2' THEN 3
								 	 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='PREWET_UNIT3' THEN 4
								 	 WHEN A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE='UNIT2' THEN 5
									 ELSE 6 
							  END AS IDX2
					FROM   	SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
							ON 1=1
							AND		A.FACTORY_ID = C.FACTORY_ID
							AND		C.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
							AND		C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
							LEFT OUTER JOIN (
									SELECT  DISTINCT A.SEGMENT4 AS FACTORY_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
									FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
									WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_PROD_VERSION_TYPE'
							) B
							ON A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
							AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
					WHERE  	1=1
					@CTRL_DIVISION_LT
					@CTRL_SITE_LT
					AND		A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
					AND		A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
					AND		A.CATEGORY IN ('cell/batch','Pancake (m/batch)','Jumbo Roll (m/batch)')
					ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, IDX1, IDX2
    

      ]]>
      </text>

  	<sql id="find_UOMInfo">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[
SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION, A.ITEM_ID
     , UPPER(A.CATEGORY) AS CATEGORY
     , A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE
     , A.MODEL_ID, A.VALUE, A.APPLY_DATE
     , A.VERSION
FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT DISTINCT A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS E_CATEGORY
	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ITEM_CONV_CALC'
	AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
) D
ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  1=1
	AND    A.VALUE > 0
	AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)'
    						, 'Lane Number'
    						, 'Pancake (m/batch)'
    						, 'cell/batch'
    						, 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
    						, 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
	GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
) E
ON     A.COMPANY_ID         = E.COMPANY_ID
AND    A.DIVISION_ID        = E.DIVISION_ID
AND    A.SITE_ID            = E.SITE_ID
AND    A.PLANT_ID           = E.PLANT_ID
AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = E.FACTORY_ID
AND    A.OPERATION          = E.OPERATION
AND    A.ITEM_ID            = E.ITEM_ID
AND    A.MODEL_ID           = E.MODEL_ID
AND    A.VERSION            = E.VERSION
WHERE  1=1
AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
AND    A.CATEGORY IN ('cell/batch','Pancake (m/batch)','Jumbo Roll (m/batch)')
@CTRL_DIVISION_LT
@CTRL_SITE_LT
@CTRL_PLANT_LT
@CTRL_FACTORY_LT
ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
       , A.MODEL_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.APPLY_DATE DESC
       , A.CATEGORY, A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE
      ]]>
      </text>

  	<sql id="find_ListData">

   
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
           , A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
           , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
           , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
           , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
           , A.SEQ
           , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PLM_EC_NO
           , A.PLAN_IN_QTY_BATCH, A.PLAN_IN_QTY, A.PLAN_IN_QTY_M, A.PLAN_IN_QTY_CELL
           , A.PLAN_OUT_QTY_BATCH, A.PLAN_OUT_QTY, A.PLAN_OUT_QTY_M, A.PLAN_OUT_QTY_CELL
           
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN ROUND(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN ROUND(A.MPP_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  ELSE ROUND(A.WPP_IN_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
		   , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY_M)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY_M) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY_CELL)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY_CELL) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_IN_QTY_JR)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_IN_QTY_JR) END AS ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
           
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN ROUND(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN ROUND(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT)
           		  ELSE ROUND(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_BATCH,@ROUND_POINT) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_M)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_M) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_CELL)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_CELL) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
           , CASE WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'DPP' THEN CEILING(A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR)
           		  WHEN B.RELEASE_TYPE = 'MPP' THEN CEILING(A.MPP_OUT_QTY_JR)
           		  ELSE CEILING(A.WPP_OUT_QTY_JR) END AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
           , B.RELEASE_TYPE
           , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, A.PLM_EC_NO
      FROM   @AMEND_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN (
      	SELECT 'DPP' AS RELEASE_TYPE
      	UNION ALL
      	SELECT 'MPP' AS RELEASE_TYPE
      	UNION ALL
      	SELECT 'WPP' AS RELEASE_TYPE
      ) B
      ON 1=1
      WHERE 1=1
      AND	 A.INSTANCE_ID = @MASTER_ID
      AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID  = @PLAN_ID
      AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
      @CTRL_SITE_LT
      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      ORDER BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
             , LOCATION, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID
             , TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
             , PLAN_DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

  <sql id="findLineCode_List">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE
           , '(' + A.LINE_ID + ')' + (CASE WHEN A.LINE_NAME = '' OR A.LINE_NAME IS NULL THEN A.LINE_ID ELSE A.LINE_NAME END) AS NAME
      FROM   SCM_LINE_M A(NOLOCK)
      WHERE 1=1
      AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
      AND    EXISTS (
			        	SELECT 1
			        	FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V B WITH(NOLOCK)
			        	WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
			        	AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			        	AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
			        	AND    A.PLANT_ID	 = B.PLANT_ID
			        	AND    A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
			        	AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
			        	AND    A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
			        	AND    B.USER_ID     = @USER_ID
			      	)
      AND   EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID
              FROM  SCM_FACTORY_M A(NOLOCK)
              INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B(NOLOCK)
              ON    A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID
              AND		B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              WHERE 1=1
              AND   B.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
              AND		A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID
      )

      @CTRL_DIVISION_LT
      @CTRL_SITE_LT
      @CTRL_PLANT_LT
      @CTRL_FACTORY_LT
      @CTRL_OPERATION_LT
      
      @CTRL_INSTANCE
      @CTRL_PLAN_TYPE
      @CTRL_LINE_LT
      
      GROUP BY A.LINE_ID, A.LINE_NAME
      ORDER BY A.LINE_ID

      BEGIN
        BEGIN TRAN

          USING (	SELECT 	A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID, A.COMPANY_ID,
                        	A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, 
                        	A.LOCATION, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE,
                        	A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PLAN_DATE,
                        	A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, 
                        	A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                        	, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY
                        	, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH  
		                    , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M     
		                    , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL  
		                    , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR    
		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY
		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M    
		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL 
		                    , A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR  
		                    , A.SEQ 
                 	FROM	FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A
                 	WHERE	A.INSTANCE_ID 	= @INSTANCE_ID 
          			AND 	A.FP_PLAN_ID 	= @FP_PLAN_ID
	              	AND 	A.FACTORY_ID 	= @FACTORY_ID 
	              	AND 	A.OPERATION_ID 	= @OPERATION_ID 
	              	AND 	A.LINE_ID 		= @LINE_ID 
	              	AND 	A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
	              	AND 	A.EQUIPMENT_ID 	= @EQUIPMENT_ID 
	              	AND 	CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
	              	AND 	A.TOP_ITEM_ID 	= @TOP_ITEM_ID
	              	AND 	A.ITEM_ID 		= @ITEM_ID
	              	AND 	A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
	              	AND 	A.MARKET 		= @MARKET
	              	AND		ISNULL(A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH,0) <> 0
                ) B
          ON (      A.INSTANCE_ID 	= B.INSTANCE_ID 
          		AND A.FP_PLAN_ID 	= B.FP_PLAN_ID
              	AND A.FACTORY_ID 	= @COPY_FACTORY_ID
              	AND A.LOCATION 		= B.LOCATION
              	AND A.OPERATION_ID 	= B.OPERATION_ID 
              	AND A.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID

              							AND 	SA.SITE_ID 		= B.SITE_ID 
              							AND 	SA.PLANT_ID 	= B.PLANT_ID

              ,EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,PLAN_DATE

              ,SEQ
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
              ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY
              ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL

                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH

                  ,PLAN_OUT_QTY

                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_IN_QTY

                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH
                  ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY

                  ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
                  ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
                  ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, @LINE_ID+'_LINE_COPY_UPDATE' AS JOB_TYPE
            FROM   FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID      = @INSTANCE_ID
            AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID       = @FP_PLAN_ID
            AND    A.FACTORY_ID       = @COPY_FACTORY_ID
            AND    A.OPERATION_ID     = @OPERATION_ID
            AND    A.LINE_ID          = @COPY_LINE_ID
            AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
            AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID     = (	SELECT 	MAX(EQUIPMENT_ID) FROM SCM_EQUIPMENT_M SA 
											WHERE 	SA.DIVISION_ID 	= @DIVISION_ID
											@CTRL_SITE_ID

											AND		SA.LINE_ID 		= @COPY_LINE_ID
									    )
            AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
            AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID      = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.ITEM_ID          = @ITEM_ID
            AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE  = UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE)
            AND    A.MARKET           = @MARKET
            ;
          
        COMMIT;
        
        
      END;
    
      ]]>

							                                                      WHERE  AA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                      AND    B.PLAN_DATE BETWEEN AA.START_TIME AND AA.END_TIME
							                                                  ) SB

							                                                  AND    SA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID

							                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
							                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
						, @OUT_QTY_JR = CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD

		              ,0
		              , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD

						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD
						                                                      FROM   SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M AA WITH(NOLOCK)

						                                                      AND    AA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID

						                                                      AND    AA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID

						                                                  ) SB

						                                                  AND    SA.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
						                                                  AND    SA.MONTH        = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112),1,6)))
			 		 , CEILING(B.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL * (	  SELECT ISNULL( ISNULL(MAX(SB.YIELD),(CASE WHEN MAX(SA.YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(SA.YIELD) END)) ,1) AS YIELD

						                                                      SELECT (CASE WHEN MAX(YIELD) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(YIELD) END) AS YIELD

		              ,0 AS ADJUST_OUT_QTY
		              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M

		              --,A.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
		              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M
		              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL
		              ,B.ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
		              ,@USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS INSERT_TIME
		              ,@USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(A.SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
		              ,@USER_ID AS JOB_USER_ID, GETDATE() AS JOB_TIME, 'MPP/WPP_EXCEL' AS JOB_TYPE
                  ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
                  ,VERSION
                  ,PROD_SEQ
                  ,PLM_EC_NO
		        FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
		        INNER JOIN SCM_LINE_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
		        ON     A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
		        AND    A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
		        AND    A.PLANT_ID        = C.PLANT_ID

		        AND    A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
		        AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
		        AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
		        INNER JOIN FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H B WITH(NOLOCK)
		        ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = B.INSTANCE_ID
		        AND A.FP_PLAN_ID      = B.FP_PLAN_ID
		        AND A.DIVISION_ID 	  = B.DIVISION_ID
		        AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID

      ]]>

      <![CDATA[
      BEGIN
        BEGIN TRAN
          MERGE INTO FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H A
          USING (SELECT @INSTANCE_ID AS INSTANCE_ID, @FP_PLAN_ID AS FP_PLAN_ID,

              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
              AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET
              AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = B.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
              AND A.VERSION = B.VERSION
              AND A.PLM_EC_NO = B.PLM_EC_NO )
          WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET @IN_QTY_BATCH  = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH
                     , @IN_QTY_M      = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_M
                     , @IN_QTY_CELL   = @ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL
