      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                                                                             THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                                                                               THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                                                                                 THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                                                                                   THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                                                                                     THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                                                                                                       THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                                                                                         THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')                                                                           THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '')                                                             THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '')                                              THEN MSG11 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG11 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG11 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '')                               THEN MSG12 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG12 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG12 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '' AND MSG12 = '')				THEN MSG13 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG13 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG13 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '' AND MSG11 = '' AND MSG12 = '' AND MSG13 = '')	THEN MSG14 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG14 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG14 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
                    ,A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                    ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.LOCATION
                    ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, D.LINE_NAME, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    ,A.PLAN_DATE
                    ,A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID, B.NICK_NAME
                    ,A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                    ,A.SEQ, A.QTY
                    ,A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                    ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                    ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Material' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                    ,CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                    ,CASE WHEN D.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line - Electrode Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                    ,CASE WHEN E.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                    ,CASE WHEN F.CODE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                    ,CASE WHEN L.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Equipment' ELSE '' END AS MSG7
                    ,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID='A9000' THEN ( CASE WHEN G.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'RCCP or Test Target' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG8
                    --,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN H.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'SCP or Test Target-Market' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                    ,'' AS MSG9
                    ,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN I.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Assign' ELSE '' END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG10
                    ,CASE WHEN A.QTY > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN K.KEY_VALUE = 'DAILY_CAPA' THEN (CASE WHEN (J.DAILY_CAPA IS NULL OR J.DAILY_CAPA = 0) THEN 'Daily Capa' ELSE '' END)
                                                     ELSE (CASE WHEN (J.TACT_TIME IS NULL OR J.TACT_TIME = 0) THEN 'Tact Time' ELSE '' END) END ) ELSE '' END AS MSG11
                    ,CASE WHEN N.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Model Measure Conversion' ELSE '' END AS MSG12
                    ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG13
                    ,(CASE WHEN @CONFIRM_AREA = 'BUILDING' THEN (CASE WHEN A.FACTORY_ID <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Building' ELSE '' END)
        			                                          ELSE (CASE WHEN D.MODEL_TYPE <> @RELEASE_VALUE THEN 'Release - Unacceptable Plan Group' ELSE '' END) END) AS MSG14
                    ,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE
            				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, A.PLAN_DATE)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
            				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
                    , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, A.PLM_EC_NO
              FROM (
                  SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FP_PLAN_ID
                       , ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID
                       , A.FACTORY_ID, A.LOCATION
                       , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                       , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
                       , A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                       , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                       , A.SEQ, A.QTY
                       , A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, A.ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
                       , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                       , A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, A.VERSION, A.PROD_SEQ, A.PLM_EC_NO
                  FROM   BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                  ON    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND	  A.SITE_ID	    = B.SITE_ID
                  AND	  A.PLANT_ID	  = B.PLANT_ID
                  AND 	A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
                  AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
                  AND		A.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
              ) A
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,
                         A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(A.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME,
                         A.APPLIED_MODEL
                  FROM	 SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK),
                    		 SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE	 A.ITEM_CLASS  = C.CLASS_ID
              ) B
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = C.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = C.SITE_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
              AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_LINE_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = D.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = D.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = D.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = D.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = D.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID         = D.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT  A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS CODE_ID
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              ) E
              ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = E.CODE_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.SEGMENT1
              AND (CASE WHEN A.SITE_ID <> 'A004' AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE IN ('E-TEST','D-TEST') THEN 'XX' ELSE A.PRODUCTION_TYPE END ) = E.CODE_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE_ID
                  FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                  WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                  AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              ) F
              ON  A.MARKET = F.CODE_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT INSTANCE_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, ITEM_ID
                  FROM   FP_INSTANCE_ITEM_V
              ) G
              ON  A.INSTANCE_ID = G.INSTANCE_ID
              AND A.COMPANY_ID  = G.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID     = G.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID    = G.PLANT_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID     = G.ITEM_ID
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M I WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID     = I.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID        = I.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID       = I.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID     = I.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID        = I.ITEM_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID   = I.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID        = I.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = I.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND SUBSTRING(A.PLAN_DATE,1,6) = I.MONTH
              AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
              AND I.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0','9')
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_TACT_TIME_M J WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = J.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = J.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = J.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = J.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = J.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID         = J.ITEM_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = J.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID         = J.LINE_ID
              AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = J.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              AND SUBSTRING(A.PLAN_DATE,1,6) = J.MONTH
              LEFT OUTER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_CONFIG_M K WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.INSTANCE_ID     = K.INSTANCE_ID
              AND K.KEY_ID          = 'FINAL_OP_CAPA'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M L WITH(NOLOCK)
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID      = L.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID     = L.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID         = L.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID        = L.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID      = L.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID    = L.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID		      = L.LINE_ID
              AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = L.EQUIPMENT_ID
              AND L.ACTIVE_FLAG 	  = 'Y'
              LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
                  FROM (
                      SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
                      FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
                      AND    A.VALUE > 0
                      AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)'
                                            , 'Lane Number'
                                            , 'Pancake (m/batch)'
                                            , 'cell/batch'
                                            , 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
                                            , 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
                      GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
                      HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
                  ) A
              ) N
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = N.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID   = N.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID       = N.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID      = N.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID    = N.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID  = N.OPERATION
              AND A.ITEM_ID       = N.ITEM_ID
              AND A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = N.MODEL_ID
              AND A.VERSION       = N.VERSION
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
      						SELECT	DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
      						FROM	FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
      						WHERE	1=1
      						AND		R.USER_ID	= @USER_ID
      						AND		R.SAVE_FLAG	= 'Y'
      						AND		R.INSTANCE_ID = @INSTANCE_ID
      				) R
      				ON		1=1
      				AND		A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
      				AND		A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
      				AND		A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
      				AND		A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
      				AND		A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
      				AND		A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
      				AND		A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="CONFIRM_AREA" name="CONFIRM_AREA" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="RELEASE_VALUE" name="RELEASE_VALUE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      </parameters>
  
  </sql>

  <sql id="insert_Excel_buffer">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      INSERT INTO BUF_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_R (
         INSTANCE_ID, FP_PLAN_ID
        ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, LOCATION
        ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID
        ,PLAN_DATE
        ,TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
        ,PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
        ,SEQ
        ,QTY
        ,ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_IN_QTY_M, ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL, ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR
        ,ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL, ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR
        ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
        ,WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, VERSION, PROD_SEQ, PLM_EC_NO
      )
      VALUES (
         UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@INSTANCE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FP_PLAN_ID)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID))), ''
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))), UPPER(SUBSTRING(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE)),1,1)) + LOWER(SUBSTRING(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ELECTRODE_TYPE)),2,99))
        , UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@EQUIPMENT_ID)))
        ,CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)))
        ,UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@MARKET)))
        ,RTRIM(CASE WHEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,10),ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH)),0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE RTRIM(LTRIM(@SEQ)) END) 
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@QTY))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_IN_QTY_BATCH)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_IN_QTY_M)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_IN_QTY_CELL)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_IN_QTY_JR))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_BATCH)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_M)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_CELL)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ADJUST_OUT_QTY_JR))
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
        ,@WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID, @VERSION, @PROD_SEQ, @PLM_EC_NO
      )
    
      ]]>
      </text>

  <sql id="find_LineAdd_dup">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
      FROM   FP_AMEND_DAILY_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  A.INSTANCE_ID     = @INSTANCE_ID
      AND    A.FP_PLAN_ID      = @FP_PLAN_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID     = @DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID         = @SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID        = @PLANT_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID         = @ITEM_ID
      AND    A.TOP_ITEM_ID     = @TOP_ITEM_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID    = @OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID      = @FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = @PRODUCTION_TYPE
      AND    A.MARKET          = @MARKET
      AND    A.LINE_ID         = @LINE_ID
      AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = @ELECTRODE_TYPE
      AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = @EQUIPMENT_ID
      AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112)    = @DATE
      AND    A.WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID = @WORK_REQUEST_MODEL_ID
      AND    A.VERSION               = @VERSION
      AND    A.PLM_EC_NO             = @PLM_EC_NO
      
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="INSTANCE_ID" name="INSTANCE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FP_PLAN_ID" name="FP_PLAN_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PLANT_ID" name="PLANT_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="TOP_ITEM_ID" name="TOP_ITEM_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="MARKET" name="MARKET" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="ELECTRODE_TYPE" name="ELECTRODE_TYPE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="EQUIPMENT_ID" name="EQUIPMENT_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>
        <parameter replace-what="DATE" name="DATE" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*

              , @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , @TOP_ITEM_ID AS TOP_ITEM_ID

      INNER HASH JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)

      AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID

          --AND    A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE  = E.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
          --AND    A.MODEL_ID           = E.MODEL_ID
          WHERE  A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'

      ) D
      ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = D.COMPANY_ID

      AND A.SITE_ID       = D.SITE_ID
      AND A.PLANT_ID      = D.PLANT_ID
      AND A.FACTORY_ID    = D.FACTORY_ID
      --AND B.APPLIED_MODEL = D.MODEL_ID
      AND A.OPERATION_ID  = D.OPERATION
      AND A.ITEM_ID       = D.ITEM_ID
      LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
               --, A.MODEL_ID
               , A.OPERATION
               , A.ITEM_ID
               , A.CATEGORY
          FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS E_CATEGORY

          ) D
          ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
          INNER JOIN (
              SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID
              FROM (

                  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)

                  GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, PROD_VERSION_TYPE, VERSION_TYPE

          WHERE  A.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'

<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
	

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                ,CONVERT(CHAR(8), A.CUTOFF_DATE, 112) AS CUTOFF_DATE, A.WORK_ORDER_ID, A.DEMAND_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
                ,A.ORDER_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME, '-') AS NICK_NAME
                ,A.LINE_ID, A.WORK_CENTER_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_START_TIME, 120) AS PLAN_START_TIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_END_TIME, 120) AS PLAN_END_TIME
                ,A.PLAN_QTY
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.ACTUAL_START_TIME, 120) AS ACTUAL_START_TIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.ACTUAL_END_TIME, 120) AS ACTUAL_END_TIME
                ,A.ACTUAL_QTY, A.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY, A.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY, A.BOM_VERSION_ID, A.WO_STATUS
                ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_SEQ, A.JOB_ORDER
                ,case when B.ITEM_ID is null then 'Material' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Building' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.DT is null then 'CutOff Date' else '' end as msg3
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.CUTOFF_DATE,A.WORK_ORDER_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.CUTOFF_DATE,A.WORK_ORDER_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg99
          FROM   BUF_ERP_WORK_ORDER_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
            FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M B(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS = B.CLASS_ID
            AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND    B.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) B
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN TH_UIS_CAL D(NOLOCK)
          ON  CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.CUTOFF_DATE, 112) = D.DT
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

<sql id="merge_FP00770">
	

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

  BEGIN
        
        MERGE INTO FP_ERP_WORK_ORDER_STATUS_H A
          USING (SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID)) AS COMPANY_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID)) AS DIVISION_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)) AS SITE_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)) AS PLANT_ID,
                        RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)) AS FACTORY_ID, RTRIM(LTRIM(@CUTOFF_DATE)) AS CUTOFF_DATE, RTRIM(LTRIM(@WORK_ORDER_ID)) AS WORK_ORDER_ID) B
          ON (A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
          AND CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.CUTOFF_DATE, 112) = B.CUTOFF_DATE
          AND A.WORK_ORDER_ID = B.WORK_ORDER_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
          UPDATE SET
              ORDER_TYPE        = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ORDER_TYPE))
            , ITEM_ID           = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID))
            , TOP_ITEM_ID       = RTRIM(LTRIM(@TOP_ITEM_ID))
            , OPERATION_ID      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID))
            , LINE_ID           = RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID))
            , WORK_CENTER_ID    = RTRIM(LTRIM(@WORK_CENTER_ID))
            , PLAN_DATE         = CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE)))
            , PLAN_START_TIME   = CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_START_TIME)))
            , PLAN_END_TIME     = CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_END_TIME)))
            , PLAN_QTY          = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_QTY))
            , ACTUAL_START_TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTUAL_START_TIME)))
            , ACTUAL_END_TIME   = CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTUAL_END_TIME)))
            , ACTUAL_QTY        = RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTUAL_QTY))
            , BOM_VERSION_ID    = RTRIM(LTRIM(@BOM_VERSION_ID))
            , WO_STATUS         = RTRIM(LTRIM(@WO_STATUS))
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
          INSERT (
              COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, CUTOFF_DATE, 
              WORK_ORDER_ID, ORDER_TYPE, ITEM_ID, TOP_ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, 
              WORK_CENTER_ID, PLAN_DATE, PLAN_START_TIME, PLAN_END_TIME, PLAN_QTY, 
              ACTUAL_START_TIME, ACTUAL_END_TIME, ACTUAL_QTY, 
              BOM_VERSION_ID, WO_STATUS, INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
          )
          VALUES(
              RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@FACTORY_ID)), CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@CUTOFF_DATE))),
              RTRIM(LTRIM(@WORK_ORDER_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ORDER_TYPE)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ITEM_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@TOP_ITEM_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@OPERATION_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@LINE_ID)),
              RTRIM(LTRIM(@WORK_CENTER_ID)), CONVERT(DATETIME, @PLAN_DATE), 
              CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_START_TIME))), CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_END_TIME))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_QTY)),
              CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTUAL_START_TIME))), CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTUAL_END_TIME))), RTRIM(LTRIM(@ACTUAL_QTY)),
              RTRIM(LTRIM(@BOM_VERSION_ID)), RTRIM(LTRIM(@WO_STATUS)), @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1()
          )
          ;
        
        INSERT INTO HIS_ERP_WORK_ORDER_STATUS_H (
               COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, 
               CUTOFF_DATE, WORK_ORDER_ID, ORDER_TYPE, ITEM_ID, TOP_ITEM_ID, 
               OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, WORK_CENTER_ID, PLAN_DATE, PLAN_START_TIME, 
               PLAN_END_TIME, PLAN_QTY, ACTUAL_START_TIME, ACTUAL_END_TIME, ACTUAL_QTY, 
               BOM_VERSION_ID, WO_STATUS, INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, 
               JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
        )
        SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, 
               CUTOFF_DATE, WORK_ORDER_ID, ORDER_TYPE, ITEM_ID, TOP_ITEM_ID, 
               OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, WORK_CENTER_ID, PLAN_DATE, PLAN_START_TIME, 
               PLAN_END_TIME, PLAN_QTY, ACTUAL_START_TIME, ACTUAL_END_TIME, ACTUAL_QTY, 
               BOM_VERSION_ID, WO_STATUS, INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, 
               @USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), 'EXCEL'
        FROM   FP_ERP_WORK_ORDER_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  COMPANY_ID    = RTRIM(LTRIM(@COMPANY_ID))
        AND    DIVISION_ID   = RTRIM(LTRIM(@DIVISION_ID))
        AND    SITE_ID       = RTRIM(LTRIM(@SITE_ID))
        AND    PLANT_ID      = RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLANT_ID))

        AND    CUTOFF_DATE   = CONVERT(DATE, RTRIM(LTRIM(@CUTOFF_DATE)))

        ;

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>

<SQLS id="FP01559_IN_HOUSE_REQUEST_MOVING_PLAN">

  <simple-sqls>
    <sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>

</simple-sqls>

<sql id="updateReleaseFlag">
	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
        UPDATE SY_XIF_ERP_PRODUCTION_PLAN_S
        SET    SY_XIF_ERP_PRODUCTION_PLAN_S.TRANSFER_FLAG = 'N'
        WHERE  @USER_ID=@USER_ID
        AND FP_PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)
        ;
        
        UPDATE SY_XIF_MES_WO_S
        SET    SY_XIF_MES_WO_S.IF_FLAG = 'N'
        WHERE  @USER_ID=@USER_ID
        AND PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)

        ;
        
        UPDATE SY_XIF_MES_DAILY_PP_S
        SET    SY_XIF_MES_DAILY_PP_S.IF_FLAG = 'N'
        WHERE  @USER_ID=@USER_ID
        AND PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)
        ;
        
        UPDATE SCM_FP_PLAN_DETAIL_H
        SET    MES_TRANSFER_FLAG = 'Y'
              ,MES_TRANSFER_TIME = GETDATE()
        WHERE  PLAN_DATE     = @PLAN_DATE
        AND PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)
        ;
        
        UPDATE SCM_FP_PLAN_GROUP_DETAIL_H
        SET    MES_TRANSFER_FLAG = 'Y'
              ,MES_TRANSFER_TIME = GETDATE()
        WHERE  PLAN_DATE     = @PLAN_DATE
        AND PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)
        ;
        
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_LT" name="PLAN_LT"  dbType="command" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

</sql>  	

<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation_lineAssign">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT 
                     A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                    ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
                    ,A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PLAN_DATE
                    ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    ,CASE WHEN B.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Assign Priority' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                    ,'' AS MSG99
              FROM (
                  SELECT ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                       , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, SUBSTRING(A.PLAN_DATE, 1, 6) AS PLAN_MONTH
                       , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                  FROM   BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_LINEASSIGN_M A
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B
                  ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                  AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                  WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
              ) A
              LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                  SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.MONTH
                  FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A
                  WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  AND    A.PRIORITY < 9
              ) B
              ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
              AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
              AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
              AND A.PLANT_ID     = B.PLANT_ID
              AND A.FACTORY_ID   = B.FACTORY_ID
              AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
              AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
              AND A.LINE_ID      = B.LINE_ID
              and A.PLAN_MONTH   = B.MONTH
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
	
</sql>

	  <sql id = "find_CurMonthWeek">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

		      SELECT 	YYYYMM AS CUR_MONTH, ISO_YYYYWW AS CUR_WEEK
		      FROM   	TH_UIS_CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
		      WHERE		1=1
		      AND			YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112)

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  
  <sql id = "find_PlanWeek">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT DISTINCT A.PLAN_WEEK AS CODE, A.PLAN_WEEK AS NAME
            ,B.DATED1 AS WEEK_START_DATE
      FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_H A
      LEFT OUTER JOIN TH_UIS_CALENDAR B
      ON A.PLAN_WEEK = B.D0
      ORDER BY A.PLAN_WEEK DESC

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id = "find_PlanMonth">
  
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT DISTINCT A.MONTH AS CODE, A.MONTH AS NAME
      FROM (
        SELECT B.DATED1 AS WEEK_START_DATE, B.MONTH
        FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_H A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN TH_UIS_CALENDAR B
        ON A.PLAN_WEEK = B.D0
        WHERE A.MPP = 'Y'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT B.DATED1 AS WEEK_START_DATE, B.CAL_YEAR_MON AS MONTH
        FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_H A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN TH_UIS_CALENDAR B
        ON A.PLAN_WEEK = B.D0
        WHERE A.MPP = 'Y'
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.MONTH DESC
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id= "find_excel_week">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT *
      FROM (
        SELECT D0 AS CODE, D0 AS NAME
             , DATED1 AS START_DATE
             , CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(DATETIME, A.DATED1)+27, 112) AS END_DATE
             , DATED1 AS MIN_DATE
        FROM   TH_UIS_CALENDAR A WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  D0 BETWEEN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE()-(7*(SELECT CONVERT(NUMERIC, A.SEGMENT1) AS MIN_WEEK_RANGE FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'WPP_WEEK_RANGE')),112))
                  AND     (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE()-7,112))
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS CODE, ISO_YYYYWW AS NAME
             --, (CASE WHEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) > MIN(YYYYMMDD) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) ELSE MIN(YYYYMMDD) END) AS START_DATE
             , MIN(YYYYMMDD) AS START_DATE
             --, (CASE WHEN TODAY > MIN(YYYYMMDD) THEN TODAY ELSE MIN(YYYYMMDD) END) AS START_DATE
             , CONVERT(VARCHAR, (MIN(DT)+27), 112) AS END_DATE
             , MIN(YYYYMMDD) AS MIN_DATE
        FROM   TH_UIS_CAL
        WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN (SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = @TODAY))
        AND     CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 13, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))))), 112)
        
        --WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN (SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112)))
        --                AND     CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DD, 13, CONVERT(DATE,(SELECT DATED1 FROM TH_UIS_CALENDAR WHERE D0 = (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW FROM TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112))))), 112)
        
        GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ) A
      ORDER BY CODE

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "TODAY" name="TODAY"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="find_excel_month">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.YYYYMM AS CODE, SUBSTRING(A.YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.YYYYMM,5,2) AS NAME
            ,MIN(YYYYMMDD) AS START_DATE
            --,(CASE WHEN TODAY > MIN(YYYYMMDD) THEN TODAY ELSE MIN(YYYYMMDD) END) AS START_DATE
            ,MAX(YYYYMMDD) AS END_DATE
            ,MIN(YYYYMMDD) AS MIN_DATE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN (SUBSTRING(@TODAY,1,6)+'01')
      AND    (SELECT MAX(YYYYMMDD) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMM = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(MM,1,CONVERT(DATETIME,SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112),1,6)+'01')),112),1,6))
      --/*
      --WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN (SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112),1,6)+'01')
      --                AND     (SELECT MAX(YYYYMMDD) FROM TH_UIS_CAL B WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE YYYYMM = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(MM,1,CONVERT(DATETIME,SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112),1,6)+'01')),112),1,6))
      --*/
      GROUP BY A.YYYYMM
      ORDER BY A.YYYYMM
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "TODAY" name="TODAY"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
