  <sql id="insert_Excel_buffer">
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      INSERT INTO BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M (
         PLAN_WEEK, PLAN_REVISION
        ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
        ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
        ,PLAN_DATE, PLAN_QTY
        ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
      )
      VALUES (
         RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PLAN_WEEK))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PLAN_REVISION)))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@COMPANY_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@DIVISION_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@SITE_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PLANT_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@FACTORY_ID)))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@OPERATION_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@LINE_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(ISNULL(@EQUIPMENT_ID,'')))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@ITEM_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@MARKET)))
        ,CONVERT(DATE,RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE))), CEILING( REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_QTY)),CHAR(9),0) )
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
      )
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_WEEK" name="PLAN_WEEK"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_REVISION" name="PLAN_REVISION"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" name="COMPANY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "DIVISION_ID" name="DIVISION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLANT_ID" name="PLANT_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "FACTORY_ID" name="FACTORY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "LINE_ID" name="LINE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "EQUIPMENT_ID" name="EQUIPMENT_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "ITEM_ID" name="ITEM_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PRODUCTION_TYPE" name="PRODUCTION_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "MARKET" name="MARKET"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_QTY" name="PLAN_QTY"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "JOB_ORDER" name="JOB_ORDER"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  </sql>    
  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH _EQP AS (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') AS EQUIPMENT_ID
               , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_ELEC
          FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID
          AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-')
      )
      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                 THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                   THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                     THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                       THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                         THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                                           THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                             THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')               THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '') THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                       A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                      ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                      ,(CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE '-' END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID
                      ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                      ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID = '-' THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                      ,CASE WHEN E.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                      ,CASE WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                      ,CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN (CASE WHEN D.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Equipment - Elec.' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                      ,CASE WHEN G.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                      ,CASE WHEN F.PROD_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                      ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Item' ELSE '' END AS MSG7
                      ,CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'A9000' THEN '' 					-- [E20251020-000252] egl line a9000 add
                      		  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' then 'EGL Line' 
                      		  ELSE '' END AS MSG8
                      ,CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'A9000' THEN '' -- [E20251020-000252] egl line a9000 add
                      		  WHEN A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F4000','F5300','F5500','F5400','F5600','F6000','F6200','F7000','F7100','F7200','F7300') 	
                      						THEN 'Only (F4000,F5300,F5400,F5500,F5600,F6000,F6200,F7000,F7100,F7200,F7300) operation can be uploaded.' 
                      			ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                      ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG10
              				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, (CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE '-' END), A.ITEM_ID, A.MARKET
              				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, (CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE '-' END), A.ITEM_ID, A.MARKET)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
              				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
                FROM (
                    SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
                         , ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                         , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                         , A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                         , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    FROM   BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                    AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                    WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
                ) A
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,  A.ITEM_ID
                    FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS  = IC.CLASS_ID
                    AND    IC.USE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) B
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_ELEC, A.MODEL_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                    AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.MODEL_TYPE
                ) C
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = C.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID       = C.LINE_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, '-' AS EQUIPMENT_ID, A.IS_ELEC
                    FROM   _EQP A
                    WHERE  A.IS_ELEC = 'N'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.IS_ELEC
                    FROM   _EQP A
                    WHERE  A.IS_ELEC = 'Y'
                    AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID <> '-'
                ) D
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
                AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = D.EQUIPMENT_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
                    FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) E
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            --        /*
            --        SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS PROD_TYPE
            --        FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
            --        WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_TYPE'
            --        AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            --        */
                ) F
                ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = F.PROD_TYPE
                AND A.DIVISION_ID     = F.DIVISION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS MARKET
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                ) G
                ON  A.MARKET = G.MARKET
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                     SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
                     FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                     AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) R
                ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
                AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
                AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
                AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
                AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
                AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
                AND  A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

</sql>    



  <sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation_WO">    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH _EQUIP AS (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.EQUIPMENT_ID, E.ITEM_ID
               , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER( PARTITION BY E.ITEM_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                                     ORDER BY     E.ITEM_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, D.PRIORITY) AS EQU_NUM
          FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          INNER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID
          AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = ISNULL(C.ELECTRODE_TYPE,'-')
          AND    C.EQUIPMENT_TYPE = 'M'
          AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          INNER JOIN (
              SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.PRIORITY, A.ITEM_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              AND    A.MONTH = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,dbo.SYSDATE1(),112), 1, 6)
              AND    A.PRIORITY < 9
          ) D
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
          AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
          INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     D.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID
          AND    D.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
          AND    D.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID
          AND    D.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID
          WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      )
      , _PLAN_GROUP AS (
          SELECT A.*
          FROM (
              SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
                   , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                   , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                   , D.OPERATION_ID
                   , E.LINE_ID
                   , MAX(E.MODEL_TYPE) AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , SCM_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , SCM_OPERATION_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , SCM_LINE_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  A.SEGMENT1         = B.INSTANCE_ID
              AND    B.FACTORY_ID       = C.FACTORY_ID
              AND    B.INSTANCE_TYPE    = D.INSTANCE_TYPE
              AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = D.COMPANY_ID
              AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND    C.SITE_ID          = D.SITE_ID
              AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = E.COMPANY_ID
              AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = E.DIVISION_ID
              AND    C.SITE_ID          = E.SITE_ID
              AND    C.PLANT_ID         = E.PLANT_ID
              AND    C.FACTORY_ID       = E.FACTORY_ID
              AND    D.OPERATION_ID     = E.OPERATION_ID
              AND    A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
              AND    A.ATTRIBUTE1       = 'PLAN GROUP'
              AND    A.SEGMENT1        != 'KR_CELL_M_P'
              AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    D.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE1
                     , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                     , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                     , D.OPERATION_ID
                     , E.LINE_ID
          ) A
          , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID      = B.SEGMENT1
          AND   A.PLAN_GROUP_ID    = B.SEGMENT2
          AND   B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
          AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      )
      , INST_INFO AS (
          SELECT A.*
          FROM (
              SELECT A.*
                  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                                      ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.INSTANCE_TYPE DESC, A.INSTANCE_ID ) AS ROW_NUM
              FROM (
                  SELECT * FROM _PLAN_GROUP
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT A.*
                  FROM (
                      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
                           , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                           , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                           , D.OPERATION_ID
                           , E.LINE_ID
                           , '-' AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
                      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , SCM_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , SCM_OPERATION_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , SCM_LINE_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.SEGMENT1         = B.INSTANCE_ID
                      AND    B.FACTORY_ID       = C.FACTORY_ID
                      AND    B.INSTANCE_TYPE    = D.INSTANCE_TYPE
                      AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = D.COMPANY_ID
                      AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = D.DIVISION_ID
                      AND    C.SITE_ID          = D.SITE_ID
                      AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = E.COMPANY_ID
                      AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = E.DIVISION_ID
                      AND    C.SITE_ID          = E.SITE_ID
                      AND    C.PLANT_ID         = E.PLANT_ID
                      AND    C.FACTORY_ID       = E.FACTORY_ID
                      AND    D.OPERATION_ID     = E.OPERATION_ID
                      AND    A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                      AND    A.ATTRIBUTE1       = 'BUILDING'
                      AND    A.SEGMENT1        != 'KR_CELL_M_P'
                      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    D.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE1
                             , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                             , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                             , D.OPERATION_ID
                             , E.LINE_ID
                  ) A
                  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM   _PLAN_GROUP BB
                      WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = BB.COMPANY_ID
                      AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = BB.DIVISION_ID
                      AND    A.SITE_ID      = BB.SITE_ID
                      AND    A.PLANT_ID     = BB.PLANT_ID
                      AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = BB.FACTORY_ID
                      AND    A.OPERATION_ID = BB.OPERATION_ID
                      AND    A.LINE_ID      = BB.LINE_ID
                  )
              ) A
          ) A
          WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
      )
      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                                 THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                                   THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                                     THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                                       THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                                         THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '')                                                          THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                                            THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')                              THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '')                THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '') THEN MSG11 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG11 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG11 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                       A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                      ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                      ,(CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE ISNULL(D.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID
                      --,CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                      ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                      ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID = '-' THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                      ,CASE WHEN E.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                      ,CASE WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                      --,(CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN H.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Equipment or Line Assign' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END) AS MSG4
                      ,(CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN H.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL AND (A.INSTANCE_ID NOT LIKE '%CELL%' AND A.INSTANCE_ID NOT LIKE '%PACK%') THEN 'Equipment or Line Assign' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END) AS MSG4 -- cell, pack exception.... 20220713
                      ,CASE WHEN I.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                      ,CASE WHEN F.PROD_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                      ,CASE WHEN G.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Assign' ELSE '' END AS MSG7
                      ,'' AS MSG8
                      ,CASE WHEN DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY A.INSTANCE_ID)>1 THEN '[There are two or more instances of data.]' ELSE '' END MSG9
                      ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Item' ELSE '' END AS MSG10
                      ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG11
              				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, (CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE D.EQUIPMENT_ID END), A.ITEM_ID,  A.MARKET -- A.PLAN_DATE, A.MARKET
              				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, (CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE D.EQUIPMENT_ID END), A.ITEM_ID,  A.MARKET)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'--A.PLAN_DATE, A.MARKET)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
              				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
                FROM (
                    SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
                          ,A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                          ,A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                          ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                          ,B.INSTANCE_ID, A.MARKET
                    FROM (
                        SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
                             , ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID -- ISNULL(B.FACTORY_ID,'-') AS FACTORY_ID
                             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                             , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                             , A.MARKET
                        FROM   BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                        LEFT OUTER JOIN  SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                        AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                        --AND B.FACTORY_ID IN ('E1','E7','E8','EA','M1','M2','M3','M4','M5','M6','M7','M8')
                        AND B.FACTORY_ID IN ('E1','E7','E8','EA','M1','M2','M3','M4','M5','M6','M7','M8','A2')
                        WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
                    ) A
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN INST_INFO B
                    ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
                ) A
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,  A.ITEM_ID
                    FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK) , SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS  = IC.CLASS_ID
                    AND    IC.USE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) B
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                    FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                    AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                ) C
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = C.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID       = C.LINE_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM _EQUIP WHERE EQU_NUM = 1) D
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = D.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
                    FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) E
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    /*
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    */
                ) F
                ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = F.PROD_TYPE
                AND A.DIVISION_ID     = F.DIVISION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                    FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    AND    A.MONTH = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,dbo.SYSDATE1(),112), 1, 6)
                    AND    A.PRIORITY < 9
                ) G
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = G.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID  = G.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID      = G.SITE_ID
                AND A.PLANT_ID     = G.PLANT_ID
                AND A.FACTORY_ID   = G.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = G.ITEM_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = G.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = G.LINE_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN _EQUIP H
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID   = H.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = H.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = H.LINE_ID
                AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = H.EQUIPMENT_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = H.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS MARKET
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                ) I
                ON  A.MARKET = I.MARKET
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                     SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
                     FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                     AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) R
                ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
                AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
                AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
                AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
                AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
                AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
                AND  A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
  	
  </sql>    
  <sql id="insert_PostInfo" >
 
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
    		
    		INSERT INTO FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M (
               PLAN_WEEK, PLAN_REVISION
              ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,LINE_ID, OPERATION_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
              ,PLAN_DATE
              ,PLAN_QTY
            	,INSERT_ID,INSERT_TIME,UPDATE_ID,UPDATE_TIME
    		)
        SELECT @PLAN_WEEK AS PLAN_WEEK, A.NEW_PLAN_REVISION
        	   , B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
        	   , B.LINE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.EQUIPMENT_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
        	   , B.PLAN_DATE
        	   , MAX(B.PLAN_QTY) AS PLAN_QTY
        	   , @USER_ID AS INSERT_ID, GETDATE() AS INSERT_TIME
        	   , @USER_ID AS UPDATE_ID, GETDATE() AS UPDATE_TIME
        FROM   (
        	SELECT DISTINCT A.*
        	FROM (
        	  @SELECT_LIST
        	) A
        ) A
        , FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H B WITH(NOLOCK)
        , FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V C WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE  1=1
        AND    (CASE WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE A.FACTORY_ID END) = (CASE WHEN A.CONFIRM_AREA = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN B.PLAN_GROUP_ID ELSE B.FACTORY_ID END)
        AND    A.INSTANCE_ID    = C.INSTANCE_ID
        AND    B.COMPANY_ID     = C.COMPANY_ID
        AND    B.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID
        AND    B.SITE_ID        = C.SITE_ID
        AND    B.PLANT_ID       = C.PLANT_ID
        AND    B.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID
        AND    B.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID
        AND    B.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID
        AND    B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
        AND    B.PLAN_TYPE      = @REV_TYPE
        AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR,B.PLAN_DATE,112) > @BUCKET_TO
	      GROUP BY A.NEW_PLAN_REVISION, B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
      		     , B.LINE_ID, B.OPERATION_ID, B.EQUIPMENT_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.MARKET
      		     , B.PLAN_DATE
    		;
      	
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "SELECT_LIST" name="SELECT_LIST"  dbType="command" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_WEEK" name="PLAN_WEEK"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "REV_TYPE" name="REV_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
    
  </sql>

  <sql id="update_hisDetail">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
        MERGE INTO HIS_FP_PLAN_DETAIL_H AS A
        USING (
            SELECT B.PLAN_DATE, B.INSTANCE_ID
                  ,B.DIVISION_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                  ,B.PLAN_ID
                  ,B.CONFIRM_ID, B.CONFIRM_TIME, B.CONFIRM_FLAG
                  ,B.RELEASE_TIME, B.RELEASE_FLAG, B.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
                  ,B.MES_TRANSFER_FLAG, B.MES_TRANSFER_TIME
                  ,B.DESCRIPTION
                  ,B.INSERT_ID, B.INSERT_TIME
                  ,B.UPDATE_ID, B.UPDATE_TIME
            FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_DETAIL_H B
            WHERE  B.PLAN_DATE = @PLAN_DATE
            AND    B.PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)
           
          ) AS B
          ON (A.PLAN_DATE   = B.PLAN_DATE
          AND A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID
          AND A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
          UPDATE SET
            PLAN_ID           = B.PLAN_ID
           ,CONFIRM_ID        = B.CONFIRM_ID
           ,CONFIRM_TIME      = B.CONFIRM_TIME
           ,CONFIRM_FLAG      = B.CONFIRM_FLAG
           ,RELEASE_TIME      = B.RELEASE_TIME
           ,RELEASE_FLAG      = B.RELEASE_FLAG
           ,RELEASE_PLAN_ID   = B.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
           ,MES_TRANSFER_FLAG = B.MES_TRANSFER_FLAG
           ,MES_TRANSFER_TIME = B.MES_TRANSFER_TIME
           ,UPDATE_ID         = B.UPDATE_ID
           ,UPDATE_TIME       = B.UPDATE_TIME
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
          INSERT (
             PLAN_DATE
            ,INSTANCE_ID
            ,DIVISION_ID
            ,FACTORY_ID
            ,PLAN_ID
            ,CONFIRM_ID
            ,CONFIRM_TIME
            ,CONFIRM_FLAG
            ,RELEASE_TIME
            ,RELEASE_FLAG
            ,RELEASE_PLAN_ID
            ,MES_TRANSFER_FLAG
            ,MES_TRANSFER_TIME
            ,DESCRIPTION
            ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
            ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE
          ) VALUES (
             B.PLAN_DATE
            ,B.INSTANCE_ID
            ,B.DIVISION_ID
            ,B.FACTORY_ID
            ,B.PLAN_ID
            ,B.CONFIRM_ID
            ,B.CONFIRM_TIME
            ,B.CONFIRM_FLAG
            ,B.RELEASE_TIME
            ,B.RELEASE_FLAG
            ,B.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
            ,B.MES_TRANSFER_FLAG
            ,B.MES_TRANSFER_TIME
            ,B.DESCRIPTION
            ,B.INSERT_ID, B.INSERT_TIME, B.UPDATE_ID, B.UPDATE_TIME
            ,@USER_ID, dbo.FN_SITE_TIME(@SITE_ID), 'CONFIRM'
          )
        ;
      END;
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_LT" name="PLAN_LT"  dbType="Command" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "SITE_ID" name="SITE_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

  </sql>
  <sql id="update_hisDetail2">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN
          MERGE INTO HIS_FP_PLAN_GROUP_DETAIL_H AS A
          USING (
            SELECT B.PLAN_DATE, B.INSTANCE_ID, B.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                  ,B.PLAN_ID
                  ,B.CONFIRM_ID, B.CONFIRM_TIME, B.CONFIRM_FLAG
                  ,B.RELEASE_TIME, B.RELEASE_FLAG, B.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
                  ,B.MES_TRANSFER_FLAG, B.MES_TRANSFER_TIME
                  ,B.DESCRIPTION
                  ,B.INSERT_ID, B.INSERT_TIME
                  ,B.UPDATE_ID, B.UPDATE_TIME
            FROM   SCM_FP_PLAN_GROUP_DETAIL_H B
            WHERE  B.PLAN_DATE = @PLAN_DATE
            AND    B.PLAN_ID IN (@PLAN_LT)

          ) AS B
            ON (A.PLAN_DATE     = B.PLAN_DATE
            AND A.INSTANCE_ID   = B.INSTANCE_ID
            AND A.PLAN_GROUP_ID = B.PLAN_GROUP_ID
            AND A.PLAN_ID       = B.PLAN_ID)
          WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET
              PLAN_ID           = B.PLAN_ID
             ,CONFIRM_ID        = B.CONFIRM_ID
             ,CONFIRM_TIME      = B.CONFIRM_TIME
             ,CONFIRM_FLAG      = B.CONFIRM_FLAG
             ,RELEASE_TIME      = B.RELEASE_TIME
             ,RELEASE_FLAG      = B.RELEASE_FLAG
             ,RELEASE_PLAN_ID   = B.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
             ,MES_TRANSFER_FLAG = B.MES_TRANSFER_FLAG
             ,MES_TRANSFER_TIME = B.MES_TRANSFER_TIME
             ,UPDATE_ID         = B.UPDATE_ID
             ,UPDATE_TIME       = B.UPDATE_TIME
          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (
               PLAN_DATE
              ,INSTANCE_ID
              ,PLAN_GROUP_ID
              ,PLAN_ID
              ,CONFIRM_ID
              ,CONFIRM_TIME
              ,CONFIRM_FLAG
              ,RELEASE_TIME
              ,RELEASE_FLAG

  <sql id="find_saveConfirm">
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH MAIN AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
          FROM (
              SELECT A.*
                    , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER( PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.INSTANCE_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ORDER BY A.PLAN_WEEK DESC, A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) AS ROW_NUM
              FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_H A WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  1=1
              AND  @REV_TYPE = 'Y'
              AND (
								@REV_LIST
              )
              AND A.PLAN_WEEK <= @PLAN_WEEK
          ) A
          WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
      )
      SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
           , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.LINE_NAME,'-') AS LINE_NAME, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
          @BUCKET_SQL
      FROM (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
               , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
               , A.ITEM_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
               , 'Y' AS IS_PAST
          FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN MAIN B
          ON  A.PLAN_WEEK     = B.PLAN_WEEK
          AND A.PLAN_REVISION = B.PLAN_REVISION
          WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) <  @_MIN_DATE
          AND   CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) >= @BUCKET_FROM
          UNION ALL
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
               , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
               , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
               , A.ITEM_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
               , 'N' AS IS_PAST
          FROM   BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE  A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
      ) A
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
      AND    A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, MAX(LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
        FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
        GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
      ) C
      ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
      AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
      AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
      AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
      AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID
      AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
      AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID
      GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.LINE_NAME,'-'), A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'-'), A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
      ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.LINE_NAME,'-'), A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'-'), A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
      ]]>
      </text>

        <parameter replace-what = "REV_TYPE" name="REV_TYPE"  dbType="command" dbLen="100" />

  <sql id="find_WOData_List">

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH WO_DATA AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
                 MO.[COMPANY_ID]
                ,MO.[DIVISION_ID]
                ,MO.[SITE_ID]
                ,MO.[PLANT_ID]
                ,MO.[FACTORY_ID]
                ,MO.[PRODUCTION_TYPE]
                ,MO.[ITEM_ID]
                ,MO.[OPERATION_ID]
                ,MO.[LINE_ID]
                ,MO.[EQUIPMENT_ID]
                ,MO.MARKET
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, MO.[PLAN_DATE], 112) AS PLAN_DATE
          FROM  (
                SELECT MO.[COMPANY_ID]
                      ,MO.[DIVISION_ID]
                      ,MO.[SITE_ID]
                      ,MO.[PLANT_ID]
                      ,MO.[FACTORY_ID]
                      ,MO.[PLAN_WEEK]
                      ,MO.[PLAN_REVISION]
                      ,MAX(MO.[INSTANCE_ID])  AS INSTANCE_ID
                      ,MAX(MO.[PLAN_ID])      AS PLAN_ID
                      ,MO.[PRODUCTION_TYPE]
                      ,MAX(MO.[ORDER_TYPE])   AS ORDER_TYPE
                      ,MAX(MO.[WORK_ORDER_SPL_ID])  AS WORK_ORDER_SPL_ID
                      ,MAX(MO.[WORK_ORDER_ID]) AS WORK_ORDER_ID
                      ,MO.[ITEM_ID]
                      ,MO.[OPERATION_ID]
                      ,MO.[LINE_ID]
                      ,MAX(MO.[ELECTRODE_TYPE]) AS  ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      ,MO.[EQUIPMENT_ID]
                      ,MAX(MO.[LANE_QTY]) AS   LANE_QTY
                      ,MO.[PLAN_DATE]
                      ,SUM(MO.REMAIN_QTY)  AS REMAIN_QTY
                      ,MO.MARKET
                FROM   [FP_MANUAL_WORK_ORDER_H]  MO WITH(NOLOCK)
                WHERE  MO.[CUTOFF_DATE]     = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
                AND    MO.[PLAN_TYPE]       = 'ROLLING'
                AND    MO.[OPERATION_ID] NOT IN ('E1000','E2500')
                AND    MO.[PLAN_REVISION]  != '-'
                GROUP BY MO.[COMPANY_ID]
                       ,MO.[DIVISION_ID]
                       ,MO.[SITE_ID]
                       ,MO.[PLANT_ID]
                       ,MO.[FACTORY_ID]
                       ,MO.[PLAN_WEEK]
                       ,MO.[PLAN_REVISION]
                       ,MO.[PRODUCTION_TYPE]
                       ,MO.[ITEM_ID]
                       ,MO.[OPERATION_ID]
                       ,MO.[LINE_ID]
                       ,MO.[EQUIPMENT_ID]
                       ,MO.[PLAN_DATE]
                       ,MO.MARKET
          ) MO
          LEFT OUTER JOIN [FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M]  WBP WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     MO.[COMPANY_ID]      = WBP.[COMPANY_ID]
          AND    MO.[DIVISION_ID]     = WBP.[DIVISION_ID]
          AND    MO.[SITE_ID]         = WBP.[SITE_ID]
          AND    MO.[PLANT_ID]        = WBP.[PLANT_ID]
          AND    MO.[FACTORY_ID]      = WBP.[FACTORY_ID]
          AND    MO.[PLAN_WEEK]       = WBP.[PLAN_WEEK]
          AND    MO.[PLAN_REVISION]   = WBP.[PLAN_REVISION]
          AND    MO.[PRODUCTION_TYPE] = WBP.[PRODUCTION_TYPE]
          AND    MO.[ITEM_ID]         = WBP.[ITEM_ID]
          AND    MO.[OPERATION_ID]    = WBP.[OPERATION_ID]
          AND    MO.[LINE_ID]         = WBP.[LINE_ID]
          AND    MO.[EQUIPMENT_ID]    = WBP.[EQUIPMENT_ID]
          AND    MO.[PLAN_DATE]       = WBP.[PLAN_DATE]
          AND    MO.MARKET            = WBP.MARKET
          WHERE  ABS(MO.REMAIN_QTY - ISNULL(WBP.PLAN_QTY,0)) > 1
      )
      SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
            ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
            ,A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
            ,A.MARKET
            @LIST_BUCKET 
      FROM (
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'-') AS NICK_NAME, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
              ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
              ,SUM(A.REMAIN_QTY) AS QTY
              ,(CASE WHEN C.COMPANY_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS IS_NOMATCH
              ,A.MARKET
        FROM   FP_MANUAL_WORK_ORDER_H A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M B
        ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
        LEFT OUTER JOIN WO_DATA C
        ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
        AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
        AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
        AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID
        AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID = C.EQUIPMENT_ID
        AND    A.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID
        AND    CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) = C.PLAN_DATE
        AND    A.MARKET       = C.MARKET
        WHERE  CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.CUTOFF_DATE, 112) = @BUCKET_FROM
        AND    A.PLAN_TYPE    = @PLAN_TYPE
        AND    A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('E1000','E2500')
        GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                ,A.ITEM_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME,'-'), A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112), C.COMPANY_ID
                ,A.MARKET
      ) A
      GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
              ,A.MARKET
      ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
              ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
              ,A.MARKET
    
      ]]>
      </text>

        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_TYPE" name="PLAN_TYPE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

			<sql id= "merge_FP01624_MEMO_P">
				
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      BEGIN

                        @DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, @SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, @PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID, @FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID, 
                        @OPERATION_ID AS OPERATION_ID, @LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, @ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,

                        @MEMO AS MEMO, 
                        @MEMO_TYPE AS MEMO_TYPE,

              AND A.PLAN_DATE = B.PLAN_DATE AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
              AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
              AND A.MEMO_TYPE = B.MEMO_TYPE )
          WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET MEMO = B.MEMO
                     , UPDATE_ID = B.USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = B.USER_TIME
          WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (
               INSTANCE_ID, COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
              ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,PLAN_DATE, MARKET, PRODUCTION_TYPE, TOP_ITEM_ID, ITEM_ID
              ,MEMO
              ,MEMO_TYPE
              ,INSERT_ID, INSERT_TIME
              ,UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME
            )

              ,B.OPERATION_ID, B.LINE_ID, B.ELECTRODE_TYPE, B.EQUIPMENT_ID
              ,B.PLAN_DATE, B.MARKET, B.PRODUCTION_TYPE, B.TOP_ITEM_ID, B.ITEM_ID
              ,B.MEMO
              ,B.MEMO_TYPE
