		<update-batch id= "update_UOM">
			<insert-sql>
				
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      UPDATE FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M
      SET    FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.ROLL_QTY  = B.ROLL_OUT_QTY
           , FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.JR_QTY    = B.JR_OUT_QTY
           , FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.CELL_QTY  = B.CELL_OUT_QTY
           , FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.BATCH_QTY = B.BATCH_IN_QTY
  	  FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
  	  INNER JOIN (
      	  SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
      				 , A.DIVISION_ID
      				 , A.SITE_ID
      				 , A.PLANT_ID
      				 , A.FACTORY_ID
      				 , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
      				 , A.ITEM_ID
      				 , A.OPERATION_ID
      				 , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      				 , A.MARKET
      				 , A.LINE_ID
      				 , A.PLAN_DATE
      				 , A.PLAN_QTY
      				 , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_M ELSE A.PLAN_QTY END END AS ROLL_OUT_QTY
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_M / A.LANE ELSE A.PLAN_QTY /A.LANE END END AS JR_OUT_QTY
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_BATCH ELSE A.PLAN_QTY / A.M_BATCH END / ISNULL(A.YIELD, 1) END AS BATCH_IN_QTY
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY ELSE A.PLAN_QTY * A.CELL_M END
      					      WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' AND A.CELL_REQ_QTY > 0 THEN  A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_REQ_QTY END AS CELL_OUT_QTY
      		 FROM (
      					SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
      						   , A.DIVISION_ID
      						   , A.SITE_ID
      						   , A.PLANT_ID
      						   , A.FACTORY_ID
      						   , ISNULL(SI.APPLIED_MODEL, A.ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID
      						   , A.ITEM_ID
      						   , A.OPERATION_ID
      						   , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      						   , A.MARKET
      						   , A.LINE_ID
      						   , SI.ITEM_UOM
      						   , A.PLAN_DATE
      						   , A.PLAN_QTY
      						   , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
      					  ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN
      					   ISNULL(
          						 (
              							SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS LANE
              							FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              							WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              							AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              							AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Lane Number'
              							AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              							AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              							AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              							AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              							AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              							AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              							AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              							AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              							ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
              								CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
              								ELSE
              								CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
              								END
              								,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
              								,C.MODEL_ID
              								,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          						 )
          						 ,(
              						  SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS LANE
              						  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              						  WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              						  AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              						  AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Lane Number'
              						  AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              						  AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              						  AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              						  AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              						  AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              						  AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              						  AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              						  AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              						  ORDER BY VALUE
          						 )
      					   )
      					 END AS LANE
      				   ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' AND SI.ITEM_UOM = 'M' THEN
      				   ISNULL(
          					   (
            					  SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS M_BATCH
            					  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					  WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					  AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					  AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (m/batch)'
            					  AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					  AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					  AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					  AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					  AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					  AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					  AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
            					  AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					  ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
            						  CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
            						   ELSE
            						  CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
            						   END
            						 ,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
            						 ,C.MODEL_ID
            						 ,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          					 )
          					 ,(
            					  SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS M_BATCH
            					  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					  WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					  AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					  AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (m/batch)'
            					  AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					  AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					  AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					  AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					  AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					  AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					  AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
            					  AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					  ORDER BY VALUE
          					 )
      				   )
      				  END  AS M_BATCH
      				 ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' AND SI.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN
      					ISNULL(
          					 (
              					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_BATCH
              					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'cell/batch'
              					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              					 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
              						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
              						  ELSE
              						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
              						  END
              						,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
              						,C.MODEL_ID
              						,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          					),(
              					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_BATCH
              					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'cell/batch'
              					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              					 ORDER BY VALUE
          					)
      				   )
      				  END  AS CELL_BATCH
      				 ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN
      					 ISNULL(
          					(
            					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_M
            					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (cell/m)'
            					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
            					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
            						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
            						  ELSE
            						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
            						  END
            						,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
            						,C.MODEL_ID
            						,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          					),(
            					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_M
            					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (cell/m)'
            					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID 
            					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					 ORDER BY VALUE
          					)
      				  )
      				 END  AS CELL_M
      				 ,( SELECT TOP 1 SY.YIELD
        				  FROM   SCM_YIELD_M  SY WITH(NOLOCK)
        				  WHERE  SY.[COMPANY_ID]   = A.[COMPANY_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[DIVISION_ID]  = A.[DIVISION_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[SITE_ID]      = A.[SITE_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[PLANT_ID]     = A.[PLANT_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[FACTORY_ID]   = A.[FACTORY_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[OPERATION_ID] = A.[OPERATION_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[LINE_ID]      = A.[LINE_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[ITEM_ID]      = A.[ITEM_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[MONTH]        = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6), [dbo].[FN_SITE_TIME] (A.SITE_ID), 112)
        				  AND    SY.[YIELD]        > 0
        				  AND    SY.[YIELD]       <= 1 )  AS YIELD
      				 ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' THEN
      				  (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(MCT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)
      				   FROM   SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP MCT WITH(NOLOCK)
      				   WHERE  MCT.[COMPANY_ID]    = A.[COMPANY_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[DIVISION_ID]   = A.[DIVISION_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[SITE_ID]       = A.[SITE_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[PLANT_ID]      = A.[PLANT_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[CHILD_ITEM_ID] = A.[ITEM_ID]
      				   AND    EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
              								  FROM SCM_ITEM_M  M WITH(NOLOCK)
              								  WHERE  M.COMPANY_ID  = MCT.COMPANY_ID
              								  AND    M.DIVISION_ID = MCT.DIVISION_ID
              								  AND    M.SITE_ID     = MCT.SITE_ID
              								  AND    M.ITEM_ID     = MCT.MODEL_ID
              								  AND    M.FLOW_ID LIKE 'A%')
      					GROUP  BY [MODEL_ID]
      					ORDER  BY CASE WHEN MCT.MODEL_ID = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
      					1 DESC )
      					END  AS CELL_REQ_QTY
      				FROM   [dbo].[FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)
      				LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[SCM_LINE_M] L WITH(NOLOCK)
      				ON    L.OPERATION_ID   = 'E2000'
      				AND    L.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
      				AND    A.COMPANY_ID    = L.COMPANY_ID
      				AND    A.DIVISION_ID   = L.DIVISION_ID
      				AND    A.SITE_ID       = L.SITE_ID
      				AND    A.PLANT_ID      = L.PLANT_ID
      				AND    A.FACTORY_ID    = L.FACTORY_ID
      				AND    A.OPERATION_ID  = L.OPERATION_ID
      				AND    A.LINE_ID       = L.LINE_ID
      				,[dbo].[SCM_ITEM_M] SI  WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  SI.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
      				AND    SI.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
      				AND    SI.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
      				AND    SI.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
      				AND    A.PLAN_WEEK     = @PLAN_WEEK
      				AND    A.PLAN_REVISION = @NEW_PLAN_REVISION
      		) A
  	  ) B
  	  ON    A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
  	  AND   A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
  	  AND   A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
  	  AND   A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
  	  AND   A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
  	  AND   A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
  	  AND   A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
  	  AND   A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
  	  AND   A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
  	  AND   A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
  	  AND   A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
  	  AND   A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
      WHERE A.PLAN_WEEK       = @PLAN_WEEK
      AND   A.PLAN_REVISION   = @NEW_PLAN_REVISION
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_WEEK" name="PLAN_WEEK"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "NEW_PLAN_REVISION" name="NEW_PLAN_REVISION"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


			</insert-sql>
		
			<update-sql>


      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      UPDATE FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M
      SET    FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.ROLL_QTY  = B.ROLL_OUT_QTY
           , FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.JR_QTY    = B.JR_OUT_QTY
           , FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.CELL_QTY  = B.CELL_OUT_QTY
           , FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M.BATCH_QTY = B.BATCH_IN_QTY
  	  FROM   FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
  	  INNER JOIN (
      	  SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
      				 , A.DIVISION_ID
      				 , A.SITE_ID
      				 , A.PLANT_ID
      				 , A.FACTORY_ID
      				 , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
      				 , A.ITEM_ID
      				 , A.OPERATION_ID
      				 , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      				 , A.MARKET
      				 , A.LINE_ID
      				 , A.PLAN_DATE
      				 , A.PLAN_QTY
      				 , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_M ELSE A.PLAN_QTY END END AS ROLL_OUT_QTY
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_M / A.LANE ELSE A.PLAN_QTY /A.LANE END END AS JR_OUT_QTY
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_BATCH ELSE A.PLAN_QTY / A.M_BATCH END / ISNULL(A.YIELD, 1) END AS BATCH_IN_QTY
      				 , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN CASE WHEN A.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN A.PLAN_QTY ELSE A.PLAN_QTY * A.CELL_M END
      					      WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' AND A.CELL_REQ_QTY > 0 THEN  A.PLAN_QTY / A.CELL_REQ_QTY END AS CELL_OUT_QTY
      		 FROM (
      					SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
      						   , A.DIVISION_ID
      						   , A.SITE_ID
      						   , A.PLANT_ID
      						   , A.FACTORY_ID
      						   , ISNULL(SI.APPLIED_MODEL, A.ITEM_ID) AS TOP_ITEM_ID
      						   , A.ITEM_ID
      						   , A.OPERATION_ID
      						   , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
      						   , A.MARKET
      						   , A.LINE_ID
      						   , SI.ITEM_UOM
      						   , A.PLAN_DATE
      						   , A.PLAN_QTY
      						   , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
      					  ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN
      					   ISNULL(
          						 (
              							SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS LANE
              							FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              							WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              							AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              							AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Lane Number'
              							AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              							AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              							AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              							AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              							AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              							AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              							AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              							AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              							ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
              								CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
              								ELSE
              								CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
              								END
              								,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
              								,C.MODEL_ID
              								,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          						 )
          						 ,(
              						  SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS LANE
              						  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              						  WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              						  AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              						  AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Lane Number'
              						  AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              						  AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              						  AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              						  AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              						  AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              						  AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              						  AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              						  AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              						  ORDER BY VALUE
          						 )
      					   )
      					 END AS LANE
      				   ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' AND SI.ITEM_UOM = 'M' THEN
      				   ISNULL(
          					   (
            					  SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS M_BATCH
            					  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					  WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					  AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					  AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (m/batch)'
            					  AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					  AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					  AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					  AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					  AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					  AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					  AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
            					  AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					  ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
            						  CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
            						   ELSE
            						  CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
            						   END
            						 ,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
            						 ,C.MODEL_ID
            						 ,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          					 )
          					 ,(
            					  SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS M_BATCH
            					  FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					  WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					  AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					  AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (m/batch)'
            					  AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					  AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					  AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					  AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					  AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					  AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					  AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
            					  AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					  ORDER BY VALUE
          					 )
      				   )
      				  END  AS M_BATCH
      				 ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' AND SI.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN
      					ISNULL(
          					 (
              					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_BATCH
              					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'cell/batch'
              					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              					 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
              						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
              						  ELSE
              						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
              						  END
              						,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
              						,C.MODEL_ID
              						,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          					),(
              					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_BATCH
              					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
              					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
              					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
              					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'cell/batch'
              					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
              					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
              					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
              					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
              					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
              					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
              					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
              					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
              					 ORDER BY VALUE
          					)
      				   )
      				  END  AS CELL_BATCH
      				 ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' THEN
      					 ISNULL(
          					(
            					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_M
            					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (cell/m)'
            					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
            					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PRODUCTION_TYPE LIKE '%TEST' THEN 
            						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
            						  ELSE
            						 CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'TEST' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
            						  END
            						,(CASE WHEN C.MODEL_ID   = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
            						,C.MODEL_ID
            						,( CASE WHEN C.VERSION  LIKE 'Z%' THEN REPLACE(C.VERSION, 'Z', '/') ELSE C.VERSION END ) DESC
          					),(
            					 SELECT TOP 1 VALUE AS CELL_M
            					 FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
            					 WHERE  C.MAX_VER_FLAG = 'Y'
            					 AND    ISNULL(C.VALUE, 0) > 0
            					 AND    C.CATEGORY     = 'Pancake (cell/m)'
            					 AND    C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
            					 AND    C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
            					 AND    C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
            					 AND    C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
            					 AND    C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
            					 AND    C.OPERATION    = A.OPERATION_ID
            					 AND    C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID 
            					 AND    C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = L.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
            					 ORDER BY VALUE
          					)
      				  )
      				 END  AS CELL_M
      				 ,( SELECT TOP 1 SY.YIELD
        				  FROM   SCM_YIELD_M  SY WITH(NOLOCK)
        				  WHERE  SY.[COMPANY_ID]   = A.[COMPANY_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[DIVISION_ID]  = A.[DIVISION_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[SITE_ID]      = A.[SITE_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[PLANT_ID]     = A.[PLANT_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[FACTORY_ID]   = A.[FACTORY_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[OPERATION_ID] = A.[OPERATION_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[LINE_ID]      = A.[LINE_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[ITEM_ID]      = A.[ITEM_ID]
        				  AND    SY.[MONTH]        = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6), [dbo].[FN_SITE_TIME] (A.SITE_ID), 112)
        				  AND    SY.[YIELD]        > 0
        				  AND    SY.[YIELD]       <= 1 )  AS YIELD
      				 ,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' THEN
      				  (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(MCT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)
      				   FROM   SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP MCT WITH(NOLOCK)
      				   WHERE  MCT.[COMPANY_ID]    = A.[COMPANY_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[DIVISION_ID]   = A.[DIVISION_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[SITE_ID]       = A.[SITE_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[PLANT_ID]      = A.[PLANT_ID]
      				   AND    MCT.[CHILD_ITEM_ID] = A.[ITEM_ID]
      				   AND    EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
              								  FROM SCM_ITEM_M  M WITH(NOLOCK)
              								  WHERE  M.COMPANY_ID  = MCT.COMPANY_ID
              								  AND    M.DIVISION_ID = MCT.DIVISION_ID
              								  AND    M.SITE_ID     = MCT.SITE_ID
              								  AND    M.ITEM_ID     = MCT.MODEL_ID
              								  AND    M.FLOW_ID LIKE 'A%')
      					GROUP  BY [MODEL_ID]
      					ORDER  BY CASE WHEN MCT.MODEL_ID = SI.APPLIED_MODEL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
      					1 DESC )
      					END  AS CELL_REQ_QTY
      				FROM   [dbo].[FP_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)
      				LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[SCM_LINE_M] L WITH(NOLOCK)
      				ON    L.OPERATION_ID   = 'E2000'
      				AND    L.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
      				AND    A.COMPANY_ID    = L.COMPANY_ID
      				AND    A.DIVISION_ID   = L.DIVISION_ID
      				AND    A.SITE_ID       = L.SITE_ID
      				AND    A.PLANT_ID      = L.PLANT_ID
      				AND    A.FACTORY_ID    = L.FACTORY_ID
      				AND    A.OPERATION_ID  = L.OPERATION_ID
      				AND    A.LINE_ID       = L.LINE_ID
      				,[dbo].[SCM_ITEM_M] SI  WITH(NOLOCK)
      				WHERE  SI.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
      				AND    SI.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
      				AND    SI.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
      				AND    SI.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
      				AND    A.PLAN_WEEK     = @PLAN_WEEK
      				AND    A.PLAN_REVISION = @NEW_PLAN_REVISION
      		) A
  	  ) B
  	  ON    A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
  	  AND   A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
  	  AND   A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
  	  AND   A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
  	  AND   A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
  	  AND   A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
  	  AND   A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
  	  AND   A.EQUIPMENT_ID    = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
  	  AND   A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
  	  AND   A.MARKET          = B.MARKET
  	  AND   A.PLAN_DATE       = B.PLAN_DATE
  	  AND   A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
      WHERE A.PLAN_WEEK       = @PLAN_WEEK
      AND   A.PLAN_REVISION   = @NEW_PLAN_REVISION
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_WEEK" name="PLAN_WEEK"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "NEW_PLAN_REVISION" name="NEW_PLAN_REVISION"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


			</update-sql>

        <parameter replace-what = "OPERATION_ID" name="OPERATION_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

  	<sql id="excel2_find_Excel_buffer_validation">    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH _EQP AS (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-') AS EQUIPMENT_ID
               , MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_ELEC
          FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID
          AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, ISNULL(C.EQUIPMENT_ID,'-')
      )
      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                 THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                   THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                     THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                       THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                         THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '')                                           THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                             THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')               THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '' AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '') THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                       A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                      ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                      ,(CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE '-' END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID
                      ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                      ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                      ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID = '-' THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                      ,CASE WHEN E.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                      ,CASE WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                      ,CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN (CASE WHEN D.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Equipment - Elec.' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END AS MSG4
                      ,CASE WHEN G.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                      ,CASE WHEN F.PROD_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                      ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Item' ELSE '' END AS MSG7
                      ,CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'A9000' THEN '' 							-- [E20251020-000252] egl line a9000 add
                      		  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' then 'EGL Line' 
                      		  ELSE '' END AS MSG8
                      ,CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'A9000' THEN '' 							-- [E20251020-000252] egl line a9000 add
                      		  WHEN A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F4000','F5300','F5500','F5400','F5600','F6000','F6200','F7000','F7100','F7200','F7300') 
                      						THEN 'Only (F4000,F5300,F5400,F5500,F5600,F6000,F6200,F7000,F7100,F7200,F7300) operation can be uploaded.' 
                      			ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                      --,CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'EGL' AND A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'A%' THEN 'EGL Line' ELSE '' END AS MSG8
                      --,CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F4000','F5300','F5400','F5500','F5600','F6000','F6200','F7000','F7100','F7200','F7300') THEN 'Only (F4000,F5300,F5400,F5500,F5600,F6000,F6200,F7000,F7100,F7200,F7300) operation can be uploaded.' ELSE '' END AS MSG9
                      ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG10
              				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, (CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE '-' END), A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MARKET
              				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET, (CASE WHEN C.IS_ELEC = 'Y' THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE '-' END), A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MARKET)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
              				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
                FROM (
                    SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
                         , ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID, ISNULL(B.FACTORY_ID,'-') AS FACTORY_ID
                         , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY, A.MARKET
                         , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                    FROM   BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN  SCM_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                    AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                    WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
                ) A
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,  A.ITEM_ID
                    FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A WITH(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS  = IC.CLASS_ID
                    AND    IC.USE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) B
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_ELEC, A.MODEL_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                    AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.MODEL_TYPE
                ) C
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = C.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID       = C.LINE_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, '-' AS EQUIPMENT_ID, A.IS_ELEC
                    FROM   _EQP A
                    WHERE  A.IS_ELEC = 'N'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.IS_ELEC
                    FROM   _EQP A
                    WHERE  A.IS_ELEC = 'Y'
                    AND    A.EQUIPMENT_ID <> '-'
                ) D
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
                AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = D.EQUIPMENT_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
                    FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) E
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    /*
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    */
                ) F
                ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = F.PROD_TYPE
                AND A.DIVISION_ID     = F.DIVISION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS MARKET
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                ) G
                ON  A.MARKET = G.MARKET
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                     SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
                     FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                     AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) R
                ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
                AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
                AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
                AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
                AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
                AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
                AND  A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


</sql>    


  <sql id="excel2_find_Excel_buffer_validation_WO">   
  	
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      WITH _EQUIP AS (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, C.EQUIPMENT_ID, E.ITEM_ID
               , ROW_NUMBER( ) OVER( PARTITION BY E.ITEM_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                                     ORDER BY     E.ITEM_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, D.PRIORITY) AS EQU_NUM
          FROM   SCM_LINE_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
          AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          INNER JOIN SCM_EQUIPMENT_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = C.PLANT_ID
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = C.FACTORY_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.LINE_ID      = C.LINE_ID
          AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = ISNULL(C.ELECTRODE_TYPE,'-')
          AND    C.EQUIPMENT_TYPE = 'M'
          AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
          INNER JOIN (
              SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.PRIORITY, A.ITEM_ID
              FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
              AND    A.MONTH = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,dbo.SYSDATE1(),112), 1, 6)
              AND    A.PRIORITY < 9
          ) D
          ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = D.COMPANY_ID
          AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND    A.SITE_ID      = D.SITE_ID
          AND    A.PLANT_ID     = D.PLANT_ID
          AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
          AND    A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
          AND    A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
          AND    A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
          INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
          ON     D.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID
          AND    D.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
          AND    D.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID
          AND    D.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID
          WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
      )
      , _PLAN_GROUP AS (
          SELECT A.*
          FROM (
              SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
                   , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                   , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                   , D.OPERATION_ID
                   , E.LINE_ID
                   , MAX(E.MODEL_TYPE) AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
              FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , SCM_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , SCM_OPERATION_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
                   , SCM_LINE_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  A.SEGMENT1         = B.INSTANCE_ID
              AND    B.FACTORY_ID       = C.FACTORY_ID
              AND    B.INSTANCE_TYPE    = D.INSTANCE_TYPE
              AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = D.COMPANY_ID
              AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = D.DIVISION_ID
              AND    C.SITE_ID          = D.SITE_ID
              AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = E.COMPANY_ID
              AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = E.DIVISION_ID
              AND    C.SITE_ID          = E.SITE_ID
              AND    C.PLANT_ID         = E.PLANT_ID
              AND    C.FACTORY_ID       = E.FACTORY_ID
              AND    D.OPERATION_ID     = E.OPERATION_ID
              AND    A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
              AND    A.ATTRIBUTE1       = 'PLAN GROUP'
              AND    A.SEGMENT1        != 'KR_CELL_M_P'
              AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    D.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              AND    E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
              GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE1
                     , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                     , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                     , D.OPERATION_ID
                     , E.LINE_ID
          ) A
          , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID      = B.SEGMENT1
          AND   A.PLAN_GROUP_ID    = B.SEGMENT2
          AND   B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
          AND   B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
      )
      , INST_INFO AS (
          SELECT A.*
          FROM (
              SELECT A.*
                  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                                      ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.INSTANCE_TYPE DESC, A.INSTANCE_ID ) AS ROW_NUM
              FROM (
                  SELECT * FROM _PLAN_GROUP
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT A.*
                  FROM (
                      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA
                           , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                           , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                           , D.OPERATION_ID
                           , E.LINE_ID
                           , '-' AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
                      FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , SCM_FACTORY_M C WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , SCM_OPERATION_M D WITH(NOLOCK)
                           , SCM_LINE_M E WITH(NOLOCK)
                      WHERE  A.SEGMENT1         = B.INSTANCE_ID
                      AND    B.FACTORY_ID       = C.FACTORY_ID
                      AND    B.INSTANCE_TYPE    = D.INSTANCE_TYPE
                      AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = D.COMPANY_ID
                      AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = D.DIVISION_ID
                      AND    C.SITE_ID          = D.SITE_ID
                      AND    C.COMPANY_ID       = E.COMPANY_ID
                      AND    C.DIVISION_ID      = E.DIVISION_ID
                      AND    C.SITE_ID          = E.SITE_ID
                      AND    C.PLANT_ID         = E.PLANT_ID
                      AND    C.FACTORY_ID       = E.FACTORY_ID
                      AND    D.OPERATION_ID     = E.OPERATION_ID
                      AND    A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                      AND    A.ATTRIBUTE1       = 'BUILDING'
                      AND    A.SEGMENT1        != 'KR_CELL_M_P'
                      AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    D.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      AND    E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                      GROUP BY A.SEGMENT1, A.ATTRIBUTE1
                             , C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID
                             , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
                             , D.OPERATION_ID
                             , E.LINE_ID
                  ) A
                  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM   _PLAN_GROUP BB
                      WHERE  A.COMPANY_ID   = BB.COMPANY_ID
                      AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = BB.DIVISION_ID
                      AND    A.SITE_ID      = BB.SITE_ID
                      AND    A.PLANT_ID     = BB.PLANT_ID
                      AND    A.FACTORY_ID   = BB.FACTORY_ID
                      AND    A.OPERATION_ID = BB.OPERATION_ID
                      AND    A.LINE_ID      = BB.LINE_ID
                  )
              ) A
          ) A
          WHERE A.ROW_NUM = 1
      )
      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
          SELECT TT.*
                ,MSG1
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')                                                                                                                                 THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '')                                                                                                                   THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '')                                                                                                     THEN MSG4 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG4 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG4 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '')                                                                                       THEN MSG5 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG5 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG5 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = '')                                                                         THEN MSG6 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG6 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG6 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '')                                                          THEN MSG7 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG7 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG7 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '')                                            THEN MSG8 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG8 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG8 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '')                              THEN MSG9 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG9 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG9 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '')                THEN MSG10 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG10 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG10 END) END)
                +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '' AND MSG3 = '' AND MSG4 = '' AND MSG5 = ''  AND MSG6 = '' AND MSG7 = '' AND MSG8 = '' AND MSG9 = '' AND MSG10 = '') THEN MSG11 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG11 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG11 END) END)
                + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
          FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                       A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID
                      ,A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.MARKET
                      ,(CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE D.EQUIPMENT_ID END) AS EQUIPMENT_ID
                      ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.PLAN_DATE,112) AS PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                      ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                      ,CASE WHEN A.COMPANY_ID = '-' THEN 'Building' ELSE '' END AS MSG1
                      ,CASE WHEN E.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN 'Operation' ELSE '' END AS MSG2
                      ,CASE WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line' ELSE '' END AS MSG3
                      --,(CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN H.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Equipment or Line Assign' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END) AS MSG4
                      ,(CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN H.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NULL AND (A.INSTANCE_ID NOT LIKE '%CELL%' AND A.INSTANCE_ID NOT LIKE '%PACK%') THEN 'Equipment or Line Assign' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END) AS MSG4 -- cell, pack exception.... 20220713
                      ,CASE WHEN I.MARKET IS NULL THEN 'Market' ELSE '' END AS MSG5
                      ,CASE WHEN F.PROD_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'Production Type' ELSE '' END AS MSG6
                      ,CASE WHEN G.LINE_ID IS NULL THEN 'Line Assign' ELSE '' END AS MSG7
                      ,'' AS MSG8
                      ,CASE WHEN DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY A.INSTANCE_ID)>1 THEN '[There are two or more instances of data.]' ELSE '' END MSG9
                      ,CASE WHEN B.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Item' ELSE '' END AS MSG10
                      ,CASE WHEN R.FACTORY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Permissions' ELSE '' END AS MSG11
              				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, (CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE D.EQUIPMENT_ID END), A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MARKET
              				                             ORDER BY     A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, (CASE WHEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.EQUIPMENT_ID ELSE D.EQUIPMENT_ID END), A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.MARKET)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
              				      ELSE '' END AS MSG99
                FROM (
                    SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
                          ,A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                          ,A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                          ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                          ,B.INSTANCE_ID, A.MARKET
                    FROM (
                        SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK, A.PLAN_REVISION
                             , ISNULL(B.COMPANY_ID,'-') AS COMPANY_ID, ISNULL(B.DIVISION_ID,'-') AS DIVISION_ID, ISNULL(B.SITE_ID,'-') AS SITE_ID, ISNULL(B.PLANT_ID,'-') AS PLANT_ID, ISNULL(B.FACTORY_ID,'-') AS FACTORY_ID
                             , A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLAN_DATE, A.PLAN_QTY
                             , A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_ORDER
                             , A.MARKET
                        FROM   BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M A
                        LEFT OUTER JOIN  SCM_FACTORY_M B
                        ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                        AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                        AND B.FACTORY_ID IN ('E1','E7','E8','EA','M1','M2','M3','M4','M5','M6','M7','M8')
                        WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
                    ) A
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN INST_INFO B
                    ON  A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
                ) A
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID,  A.ITEM_ID
                    FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A, SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M IC
                    WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS  = IC.CLASS_ID
                    AND    IC.USE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) B
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                    FROM   SCM_LINE_M A
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M B
                    ON     A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
                    AND    A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND    B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                    GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                ) C
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID    = C.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID       = C.LINE_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM _EQUIP WHERE EQU_NUM = 1) D
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID   = D.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = D.LINE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = D.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
                    FROM   SCM_OPERATION_M A
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) E
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = E.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID      = E.SITE_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    /*
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.SEGMENT1 AS PROD_TYPE
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
                    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_TYPE'
                    AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    */
                ) F
                ON  A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = F.PROD_TYPE
                AND A.DIVISION_ID     = F.DIVISION_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID
                    FROM   SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M A
                    WHERE  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) G
                ON  A.COMPANY_ID   = G.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.DIVISION_ID  = G.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SITE_ID      = G.SITE_ID
                AND A.PLANT_ID     = G.PLANT_ID
                AND A.FACTORY_ID   = G.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = G.ITEM_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = G.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = G.LINE_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN _EQUIP H
                ON  A.FACTORY_ID   = H.FACTORY_ID
                AND A.OPERATION_ID = H.OPERATION_ID
                AND A.LINE_ID      = H.LINE_ID
                AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = H.EQUIPMENT_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = H.ITEM_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS MARKET
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
                    WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DEMAND_MARKET_TYPE'
                ) I
                ON  A.MARKET = I.MARKET
                LEFT OUTER JOIN (
                     SELECT DISTINCT R.COMPANY_ID, R.DIVISION_ID, R.SITE_ID, R.PLANT_ID, R.FACTORY_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID
                     FROM   FP_USER_ROLE_INFO_V R WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE  R.USER_ID   = @USER_ID
                     AND    R.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                ) R
                ON   A.COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
                AND  A.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
                AND  A.SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
                AND  A.PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
                AND  A.FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
                AND  A.OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
                AND  A.LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
          ) TT
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "USER_ID" name="USER_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>
 
 </sql>

  	<update-batchs>
  		
  		<update-batch id="excel2_insert_Excel_buffer">
			<insert-sql>
		
   
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      INSERT INTO BUF_MPP_WPP_BASE_PLAN_M (
         PLAN_WEEK, PLAN_REVISION
        ,COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
        ,OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID, PRODUCTION_TYPE, MARKET
        ,PLAN_DATE, PLAN_QTY
        ,JOB_USER_ID, JOB_TIME, JOB_TYPE, JOB_ORDER
      )
      VALUES (
         RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PLAN_WEEK))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PLAN_REVISION)))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@COMPANY_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@DIVISION_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@SITE_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PLANT_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@FACTORY_ID)))
        ,RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@OPERATION_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@LINE_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@EQUIPMENT_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@ITEM_ID))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@PRODUCTION_TYPE))), RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@MARKET)))
        ,CONVERT(DATE,RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_DATE))), CEILING( REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@PLAN_QTY)),CHAR(9),0) )
        ,@USER_ID, dbo.SYSDATE1(), '-', @JOB_ORDER
      )
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_WEEK" name="PLAN_WEEK"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_REVISION" name="PLAN_REVISION"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "COMPANY_ID" name="COMPANY_ID"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />

<sql id="find_Excel_buffer_validation">
	

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT A.*
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' THEN (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN '' ELSE MSG99 END)
                  ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG99 = '' THEN __MSG ELSE __MSG + ' AND ' + MSG99 END)
                  END AS _MSG
            ,CASE WHEN __MSG = ' Not Found' AND MSG99 = '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS _VALID
      FROM (
        SELECT A.* 
              ,MSG1
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '')               THEN MSG2 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG2 END) END)
              +(CASE WHEN (MSG1 = '' AND MSG2 = '') THEN MSG3 ELSE (CASE WHEN MSG3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + MSG3 END) END)
              + ' Not Found' AS __MSG
        FROM (
          SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                ,CONVERT(CHAR(8), A.CUTOFF_DATE, 112) AS CUTOFF_DATE, A.WORK_ORDER_SPL_ID, A.WORK_ORDER_ID, A.DEMAND_ID
                ,A.PRODUCTION_TYPE, A.ORDER_TYPE, A.ITEM_ID, A.TOP_ITEM_ID, ISNULL(B.NICK_NAME, '-') AS NICK_NAME
                ,A.OPERATION_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.WORK_CENTER_ID, A.EQUIPMENT_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_DATE, 112) AS PLAN_DATE
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_START_TIME, 120) AS PLAN_START_TIME
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.PLAN_END_TIME, 120) AS PLAN_END_TIME
                ,A.PLAN_QTY
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.ACTUAL_START_TIME, 120) AS ACTUAL_START_TIME
                ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.ACTUAL_END_TIME, 120) AS ACTUAL_END_TIME
                ,A.ACTUAL_QTY, A.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY, A.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
                ,A.RUNNING_FLAG, A.WO_STATUS
                ,A.JOB_USER_ID, A.JOB_TIME, A.JOB_TYPE, A.JOB_SEQ, A.JOB_ORDER
                ,case when B.ITEM_ID is null then 'Material' else '' end as msg1
                ,case when C.FACTORY_ID is null then 'Building' else '' end as msg2
                ,case when D.DT is null then 'CutOff Date' else '' end as msg3
        				,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.CUTOFF_DATE,A.WORK_ORDER_SPL_ID
        				                             ORDER BY     A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID,A.CUTOFF_DATE,A.WORK_ORDER_SPL_ID)>1 THEN 'Data Overlap'
        				      ELSE '' end as msg99
          FROM   BUF_MES_WORK_ORDER_STATUS_H A(NOLOCK)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
            FROM   SCM_ITEM_M A(NOLOCK), SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M B(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  A.ITEM_CLASS = B.CLASS_ID
            AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND    B.USE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) B
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
          AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID
            FROM   SCM_FACTORY_M(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
          ) C
          ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
          AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID
          AND A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID
          LEFT OUTER JOIN TH_UIS_CAL D(NOLOCK)
          ON  CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), A.CUTOFF_DATE, 112) = D.DT
          WHERE A.JOB_USER_ID = @USER_ID
        ) A
      ) A
      ORDER BY A.JOB_ORDER
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what="USER_ID" name="USER_ID" dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100"/>

  	<sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
           , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
           , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
           , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
      ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>


    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_DateMap">
    

      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
            AS _DATE_TXT
            ,DAY_SEQ
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
    
     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
      ]]>
      </text>

      <parameters>
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
        <parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />

      </parameters>

    </sql>

        <sql id = "find_BukInfo">

     
      <text>
      <![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
      ]]>
      </text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVARCHAR" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>

    </sql>

	<sql id = "find_WeekCnt">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[
		
		  SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK
		       , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS WEEK_NAME
		       , COUNT(*) AS WEEK_COUNT
		       , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS W_VALUE
		       , '1' AS IS_DAY_VIEW
		  FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
		  WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
		  AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
		  GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
		  ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW
		
		]]>
		</text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>

	<sql id = "find_DateMap">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[

		      SELECT (CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD >= @PLAN_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_PLAN
		            ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS D_VALUE
		            ,YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
		            ,ISO_YYYYWW AS _WEEK
		            ,MONTH AS _MONTH
		            ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
		            +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri.)'
		                   WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat.)'
		                   ELSE '(SUN.)' END)
		            AS _DATE_TXT
		            ,DAY_SEQ
		      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
		      WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
		      ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
    

		]]>
		</text>
		
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "PLAN_DATE" name="PLAN_DATE"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>

	<sql id = "find_MonthCnt">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[

		      SELECT YYYYMM AS MONTH
		           , SUBSTRING(YYYYMM,1,4) + '-' +
		             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
		                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
		                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
		           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT
		           , 'M' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMM))-1) AS M_VALUE
		      FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
		      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
		      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
		      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
		      ORDER BY YYYYMM
    
		]]>
		</text>
		
		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>

	<sql id = "find_BukInfo">
		<text>
		<![CDATA[

					SELECT 	A.*
					FROM 	(
								SELECT 	YYYYMMDD AS _DATE
									    ,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,5,2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,7,2) + ' '
									    +(CASE WHEN DAY_SEQ=2 THEN '(Mon)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=3 THEN '(Tue)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=4 THEN '(Wed)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=5 THEN '(Thu)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=6 THEN '(Fri)'
									           WHEN DAY_SEQ=7 THEN '(Sat)'
									           ELSE '(SUN)' END)
									    AS _NAME
									    , 1 AS _COUNT
									    ,'D' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD))-1) AS _VALUE
									    , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									    , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									    , 'D' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL A WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @BUCKET_FROM AND @BUCKET_TO
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ISO_YYYYWW AS _DATE
									   , (SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,1,4) + 'W' + SUBSTRING(ISO_YYYYWW,5,2)) AS _NAME
									   , COUNT(*) AS _COUNT
									   , 'W' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ISO_YYYYWW))-1) AS _VALUE
									   , 1 AS _DATE_SEQ
									   , ISO_YYYYWW AS WEEK_SEQ
									   , 'W' AS _TYPE
								FROM   TH_UIS_CAL AS CAL WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
								AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
								GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW
							) A
					WHERE _TYPE='D'
					ORDER BY WEEK_SEQ, (CASE WHEN _TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), _DATE
    
		]]>
		</text>

		<parameters>
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_FROM" name="BUCKET_FROM"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
			<parameter replace-what = "BUCKET_TO" name="BUCKET_TO"  dbType="NVarChar" dbLen="100" />
		</parameters>
	</sql>
